const char* kCoreFunctions[] = {"has", "is-null", "len", "lower", "upper", "abs", "round", "floor", "ceil", "sqrt", "pow", "min", "max",
                                "coalesce", "if", "ref",
                                "append", "insert", "remove-at", "without", "range",
                                "replace", "replace-regex", "substring", "split", "trim", "pad",
                                "contains", "starts-with", "ends-with", "matches"};
const char* kCoreMethods[] = {"any", "all", "count", "sum", "min", "max", "avg", "first", "keys", "values",
                              "contains", "starts-with", "ends-with", "matches", "lower", "upper", "len",
                              "replace", "replace-regex", "substring", "split", "trim", "pad"};

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ string functions (spec §4.3)

bool is_string_function(const std::string& name) {
    return name == "replace" || name == "replace-regex" || name == "substring" || name == "split" || name == "trim" || name == "pad";
}

/// The widest result pad builds.
constexpr int64_t kMaxPadWidth = 1024;

/// An integral number a double holds exactly (up to 2^53).
bool integral_arg(const Value& v, int64_t& n) {
    double d;
    if (!try_number(v, d) || std::isnan(d) || std::floor(d) != d || std::fabs(d) > 9007199254740992.0) return false;  // up to 2^53; positions beyond the text are clamped
    n = static_cast<int64_t>(d);
    return true;
}

/// Byte offset of the UTF-16 position `units` in UTF-8 text (positions count UTF-16 code units, like len).
/// Counting exactly like utf16_length (continuation bytes add nothing, a lead byte from 0xF0 adds 2); a position inside
/// a surrogate pair rounds up to the end of the character.
size_t utf8_offset(const std::string& s, int64_t units) {
    int64_t u = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < s.size(); ++i) {
        unsigned char ch = static_cast<unsigned char>(s[i]);
        if ((ch & 0xC0) == 0x80) continue;  // continuation byte
        if (u >= units) return i;
        u += ch >= 0xF0 ? 2 : 1;
    }
    return s.size();
}

/// Whether position `at` of UTF-8 text `s` falls inside a character (on a continuation byte).
bool splits_character(const std::string& s, std::string::const_iterator at) {
    return at != s.cend() && (static_cast<unsigned char>(*at) & 0xC0) == 0x80;
}

/// Start offsets of every non-overlapping occurrence of `needle` in `hay`, left to right, ASCII case-insensitive
/// (like contains; folding ASCII keeps byte offsets).
std::vector<size_t> ifind_all(const std::string& hay, const std::string& needle) {
    const std::string h = ascii_lower(hay), n = ascii_lower(needle);
    std::vector<size_t> hits;
    for (size_t at = h.find(n); at != std::string::npos; at = h.find(n, at + n.size())) hits.push_back(at);
    return hits;
}

/// Portable replacement text: $0-$9 insert a group (empty when absent), $$ a dollar, any other $ is literal.
std::string expand_replacement(const std::smatch& m, const std::string& repl) {
    std::string out;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < repl.size(); ++i) {
        char ch = repl[i];
        if (ch == '$' && i + 1 < repl.size()) {
            char next = repl[i + 1];
            if (next == '$') {
                out += '$';
                ++i;
                continue;
            }
            if (next >= '0' && next <= '9') {
                size_t g = static_cast<size_t>(next - '0');
                if (g < m.size() && m[g].matched) out += m[g].str();
                ++i;
                continue;
            }
        }
        out += ch;
    }
    return out;
}

Value string_function(Exec& x, const std::string& name, const std::vector<Value>& vals) {
    if (name == "pad") {
        // A number pads its text form: pad(3, 2) -> "03".
        const Value& v = vals[0];
        if (!v.is_string() && !v.is_number()) return Value::error("type-mismatch", "pad() needs a string or a number, got " + describe_value(v));
        std::string text = v.is_string() ? v.as_string() : to_text(v);
        int64_t width = 0;
        if (!integral_arg(vals[1], width) || width < 0 || width > kMaxPadWidth)
            return Value::error("type-mismatch", "pad() width must be an integer from 0 to " + std::to_string(kMaxPadWidth));
        std::string fill = "0";
        if (vals.size() > 2) {
            if (!vals[2].is_string() || utf16_length(vals[2].as_string()) != 1)
                return Value::error("type-mismatch", "pad() fill must be a one-character string");
            fill = vals[2].as_string();
        }
        std::string prefix;
        for (int64_t have = static_cast<int64_t>(utf16_length(text)); have < width; ++have) prefix += fill;
        return Value::string(prefix + text);
    }
    if (!vals[0].is_string()) return Value::error("type-mismatch", name + "() needs a string, got " + describe_value(vals[0]));
    const std::string& s = vals[0].as_string();
    if (name == "trim") {
        static const char* ws = " \t\n\r\v\f";
        size_t a = s.find_first_not_of(ws);
        if (a == std::string::npos) return Value::string("");
        size_t b = s.find_last_not_of(ws);
        return Value::string(s.substr(a, b - a + 1));
    }
    if (name == "replace" || name == "split") {
        if (!vals[1].is_string() || (name == "replace" && !vals[2].is_string())) return Value::error("type-mismatch", name + "() needs string arguments");
        const std::string& from = vals[1].as_string();
        if (name == "split") {
            if (from.empty()) return Value::error("type-mismatch", "split() needs a non-empty separator");
            std::vector<Value> parts;
            size_t start = 0;
            for (size_t at : ifind_all(s, from)) {
                parts.push_back(Value::string(s.substr(start, at - start)));
                start = at + from.size();
            }
            parts.push_back(Value::string(s.substr(start)));
            return Value::list_of(std::move(parts));
        }
        if (from.empty()) return vals[0];
        const std::string& to = vals[2].as_string();
        std::string out;
        size_t pos = 0;
        for (size_t hit : ifind_all(s, from)) {
            out.append(s, pos, hit - pos);
            out += to;
            pos = hit + from.size();
        }
        out.append(s, pos, std::string::npos);
        return Value::string(out);
    }
    if (name == "substring") {
        int64_t start = 0, want = 0;
        if (!integral_arg(vals[1], start) || (vals.size() > 2 && !integral_arg(vals[2], want)))
            return Value::error("type-mismatch", "substring() needs integral start and length");
        if (vals.size() > 2 && want < 0) return Value::error("type-mismatch", "substring() length must not be negative");
        const int64_t n = static_cast<int64_t>(utf16_length(s));
        if (start < 0) start += n;
        start = std::max<int64_t>(0, std::min(n, start));
        int64_t count = n - start;
        if (vals.size() > 2) count = std::min(count, want);
        size_t a = utf8_offset(s, start);
        size_t b = utf8_offset(s, start + count);
        return Value::string(s.substr(a, b - a));
    }
    // replace-regex
    if (!vals[1].is_string() || !vals[2].is_string()) return Value::error("type-mismatch", "replace-regex() needs string arguments");
    const std::string& pattern = vals[1].as_string();
    const Exec::CachedRegex cached = compiled_regex(x, pattern);
    if (!cached.re) {
        std::string detail = invalid_regex_message(pattern, cached.error);
        x.warn_once("invalid-regex", detail, "invalid-regex");
        return Value::error("invalid-regex", detail);
    }
    const std::string& repl = vals[2].as_string();
    try {
        std::string out;
        auto last = s.cbegin();
        for (std::sregex_iterator it(s.cbegin(), s.cend(), *cached.re), end; it != end; ++it) {
            const std::smatch& m = *it;
            // std::regex works on bytes: a match that would split a UTF-8 character is skipped (spec §12).
            if (splits_character(s, m[0].first) || splits_character(s, m[0].second)) continue;
            out.append(last, m[0].first);
            out += expand_replacement(m, repl);
            last = m[0].second;
        }
        out.append(last, s.cend());
        return Value::string(out);
    } catch (const std::regex_error& ex) {
        std::string detail = "regex \"" + pattern + "\" failed on a value (" + ex.what() + "); simplify the pattern";
        x.warn_once("timeout", detail, "regex-timeout");
        return Value::error("timeout", detail);
    }
}

/// The ref() hint: malformed text is usually a name, not a $ref (spec §7).
std::string ref_hint(const Engine& e, const std::string& reference) {
    std::string t = reference;
    size_t a = t.find_first_not_of(" \t\r\n");
    size_t b = t.find_last_not_of(" \t\r\n");
    t = a == std::string::npos ? std::string() : t.substr(a, b - a + 1);
    size_t i = t.find_first_of("#@");
    std::string find = !e.find_hint.empty() ? "look it up with " + e.find_hint : "look it up by name: \xE2\x80\xA6 | where Name == \"\xE2\x80\xA6\"";
    return i == std::string::npos || i == 0 || i == t.size() - 1
               ? "ref() takes a $ref from a query result (Type#id), not a name; " + find
               : "the object may be gone or its $ref stale; re-query it (" + find + ") to get a fresh $ref";
}

Value len_of(const Value& v) {
    if (v.is_null()) return Value::missing();
    if (v.is_absent()) return v;
    if (v.is_string() || v.is_list() || v.is_map()) return Value::number(static_cast<double>(collection_size(v)));
    return Value::missing();
}

Value case_of(const Value& v, bool upper) {
    if (v.is_null() || v.is_absent()) return v;
    if (!v.is_string()) return Value::error("type-mismatch");
    return Value::string(upper ? ascii_upper(v.as_string()) : ascii_lower(v.as_string()));
}

Value num_of(const Value& v, double (*f)(double)) {
    if (v.is_null() || v.is_absent()) return v;
    double d;
    if (!try_number(v, d)) return Value::error("type-mismatch");
    return Value::number(f(d));
}

/// Like .NET Math.Min / Math.Max: NaN when either argument is NaN; -0 orders below +0.
double math_min(double a, double b) {
    if (std::isnan(a) || std::isnan(b)) return std::numeric_limits<double>::quiet_NaN();
    if (a == b) return std::signbit(a) ? a : b;
    return a < b ? a : b;
}

double math_max(double a, double b) {
    if (std::isnan(a) || std::isnan(b)) return std::numeric_limits<double>::quiet_NaN();
    if (a == b) return std::signbit(a) ? b : a;
    return a > b ? a : b;
}

double round_away(double v, int digits) {
    if (digits == 0) return std::round(v);
    if (std::fabs(v) >= 1e16) return v;
    double p = std::pow(10.0, digits);
    return std::round(v * p) / p;
}

/// Collection elements enter expressions here: destroyed objects read as null.
void live_all(Exec& x, std::vector<Value>& els) {
    if (!x.liveness_enabled()) return;
    for (auto& el : els) el = x.live(std::move(el));
}

Value quantify(Exec& x, const Value& v, const Eval* pred, const std::string& kind) {
    if (v.is_missing() || v.is_error()) return (kind == "count" || kind == "first") ? Value::missing() : Value::unknown();
    std::vector<Value> els;
    if (!elements(v, els)) {
        if (v.is_null()) {
            if (kind == "count") return Value::number(0);
            if (kind == "first") return Value::missing();
            return Value::boolean(kind == "all");
        }
        els = {v};  // a single object behaves as a one-element collection
    }
    live_all(x, els);
    ScopeGuard guard(x);
    double count = 0;
    bool saw_unknown = false;
    int64_t i = 0;
    for (auto& el : els) {
        x.visit();  // collection-method elements count toward maxVisited/timeout (spec §10)
        std::optional<bool> t = true;
        if (pred) {
            x.current = el;
            x.current_path = nullptr;
            x.index = i;
            t = truth((*pred)(x));
        }
        ++i;
        if (kind == "any") {
            if (t == std::optional<bool>(true)) return Value::boolean(true);
            if (!t) saw_unknown = true;
        } else if (kind == "all") {
            if (t == std::optional<bool>(false)) return Value::boolean(false);
            if (!t) saw_unknown = true;
        } else if (kind == "first") {
            if (t == std::optional<bool>(true)) return el;
        } else if (t == std::optional<bool>(true)) {
            ++count;
        }
    }
    if (kind == "any") return saw_unknown ? Value::unknown() : Value::boolean(false);
    if (kind == "all") return saw_unknown ? Value::unknown() : Value::boolean(true);
    if (kind == "first") return Value::missing();
    return Value::number(count);
}

Value aggregate(Exec& x, const Value& v, const Eval* sel, const std::string& kind) {
    if (v.is_missing() || v.is_error()) return v;
    std::vector<Value> els;
    if (!elements(v, els)) return v.is_null() ? Value::null() : Value::missing();
    live_all(x, els);
    ScopeGuard guard(x);
    std::vector<Value> values;
    values.reserve(els.size());
    for (auto& el : els) {
        x.visit();
        if (sel) {
            x.current = el;
            x.current_path = nullptr;
            values.push_back((*sel)(x));
        } else {
            values.push_back(el);
        }
    }
    return reduce(x, values, kind);
}

}  // namespace

double range_at(double start, double step, int64_t k) {
    // Two separately rounded operations, never a fused multiply-add (arm64 compilers contract a + b * c), so every runtime
    // produces the same numbers and the same count.
    volatile double offset = static_cast<double>(k) * step;
    return start + offset;
}

bool range_of(const Value& a, const Value& b, const Value& c, double& start, double& step, int64_t& count, Value& error) {
    double nums[3] = {0, 0, 1};
    const Value* vals[3] = {&a, &b, &c};
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {
        const Value& v = *vals[i];
        if (v.is_error()) {
            error = v;
            return false;
        }
        if (!try_number(v, nums[i])) {
            error = Value::error("type-mismatch", "range() expects numbers, got " + describe_value(v));
            return false;
        }
        if (!std::isfinite(nums[i])) {
            error = Value::error("type-mismatch", "range() expects finite numbers, got " + format_number_text(nums[i]));
            return false;
        }
    }
    start = nums[0];
    step = nums[2];
    if (step == 0) {
        error = Value::error("type-mismatch", "range() step must not be 0");
        return false;
    }
    const double n = std::ceil((nums[1] - start) / step);
    count = n <= 0 ? 0 : n >= 9.2e18 ? INT64_MAX : static_cast<int64_t>(n);
    // end is excluded: rounding in (end - start) / step can count one number too many (range(0, 2.1, 0.3)).
    while (count > 0 && count < INT64_MAX &&
           (step > 0 ? range_at(start, step, count - 1) >= nums[1] : range_at(start, step, count - 1) <= nums[1]))
        --count;
    return true;
}

void Compiler::arity(const Expr& c, size_t min, size_t max) {
    if (c.args.size() < min || c.args.size() > max) {
        std::string expect = min == max ? std::to_string(min) : std::to_string(min) + "-" + std::to_string(max);
        throw RqlException("arity", "'" + c.name + "' takes " + expect + " argument(s), got " + std::to_string(c.args.size()));
    }
}

const FunctionHandler* extension_function(Exec& x, const Expr& c, std::string& name) {
    if (c.kind != ExprKind::Call) return nullptr;
    const auto& fns = x.engine.functions();
    if (!c.on) {
        if (c.name.find('.') == std::string::npos) return nullptr;
        auto it = fns.find(c.name);
        if (it == fns.end()) return nullptr;
        name = it->first;
        return &it->second;
    }
    // ns.fn(x) parses as method fn on path ns: rewrite when a namespaced function is registered (spec §9).
    if (c.on->kind != ExprKind::Path || c.on->on || c.on->segments.empty()) return nullptr;
    std::vector<std::string> parts;
    for (auto& s : c.on->segments) {
        if (s.kind != SegmentKind::Member) return nullptr;
        parts.push_back(s.name);
    }
    auto it = fns.find(join(parts, ".") + "." + c.name);
    if (it == fns.end()) return nullptr;
    name = it->first;
    return &it->second;
}

Eval Compiler::compile_call(const Expr& c) {
    std::string ext;
    if (const FunctionHandler* fn = extension_function(x_, c, ext)) return compile_extension(ext, *fn, c.args);
    if (!c.on) return compile_function(c);
    return compile_method(c);
}

Eval Compiler::compile_extension(const std::string& name, const FunctionHandler& fn, const std::vector<ExprPtr>& argExprs) {
    std::vector<Eval> args;
    for (auto& a : argExprs) args.push_back(compile(*a));
    return [name, fn, args](Exec& x) {
        std::vector<Value> vals;
        vals.reserve(args.size());
        for (auto& a : args) vals.push_back(a(x));
        std::string what;
        try {
            return fn(vals);
        } catch (const std::exception& ex) {
            what = ex.what();
        } catch (...) {
            what = "non-standard exception";
        }
        // spec §9: an error value for the call plus one warning per function.
        std::string detail = name + "() threw: " + what;
        x.warn_once("function-threw", detail, "function-threw:" + name);
        return Value::error("function-threw", detail);
    };
}

Eval Compiler::compile_function(const Expr& c) {
    std::string name = ascii_lower(c.name);
    if (name == "has") {
        arity(c, 1, 1);
        struct Guard {
            int& depth;
            explicit Guard(int& d) : depth(d) { ++depth; }
            ~Guard() { --depth; }
        } guard(guarded_);
        Eval a = compile(*c.args[0]);
        return [a](Exec& x) {
            struct Probe {
                int& depth;
                explicit Probe(int& d) : depth(d) { ++depth; }
                ~Probe() { --depth; }
            } probe(x.key_probe);
            return Value::boolean(!a(x).is_missing());
        };
    }
    if (name == "is-null") {
        arity(c, 1, 1);
        Eval a = compile(*c.args[0]);
        return [a](Exec& x) { return tri(rql_equal(x, a(x), Value::null())); };
    }
    if (name == "len") {
        arity(c, 1, 1);
        Eval a = compile(*c.args[0]);
        return [a](Exec& x) { return len_of(a(x)); };
    }
    if (name == "lower" || name == "upper") {
        arity(c, 1, 1);
        Eval a = compile(*c.args[0]);
        bool up = name == "upper";
        return [a, up](Exec& x) { return case_of(a(x), up); };
    }
    if (name == "abs" || name == "floor" || name == "ceil" || name == "sqrt") {
        arity(c, 1, 1);
        Eval a = compile(*c.args[0]);
        double (*f)(double) = name == "abs"     ? static_cast<double (*)(double)>(std::fabs)
                              : name == "floor" ? static_cast<double (*)(double)>(std::floor)
                              : name == "ceil"  ? static_cast<double (*)(double)>(std::ceil)
                                                : static_cast<double (*)(double)>(std::sqrt);  // IEEE: sqrt(-1) is NaN
        return [a, f](Exec& x) { return num_of(a(x), f); };
    }
    if (name == "pow" || name == "min" || name == "max") {
        if (name == "pow") arity(c, 2, 2);
        else arity(c, 2, 64);
        std::vector<Eval> args;
        for (auto& e : c.args) args.push_back(compile(*e));
        double (*f)(double, double) = name == "pow"   ? static_cast<double (*)(double, double)>(std::pow)
                                      : name == "min" ? math_min
                                                      : math_max;
        return [args, f, name](Exec& x) -> Value {
            double acc = 0;
            for (size_t i = 0; i < args.size(); ++i) {
                Value v = args[i](x);
                if (v.is_null() || v.is_absent()) return v;  // the first null / missing / error / unknown argument
                double d;
                if (!try_number(v, d)) return Value::error("type-mismatch", name + "() expects numbers, got " + describe_value(v));
                acc = i == 0 ? d : f(acc, d);
            }
            return Value::number(acc);
        };
    }
    if (name == "round") {
        arity(c, 1, 2);
        Eval a = compile(*c.args[0]);
        Eval digits = c.args.size() > 1 ? compile(*c.args[1]) : Eval();
        return [a, digits](Exec& x) {
            int dg = 0;
            double dd;
            if (digits && try_number(digits(x), dd)) dd = std::max(0.0, std::min(15.0, dd)), dg = static_cast<int>(dd);
            Value v = a(x);
            if (v.is_null() || v.is_absent()) return v;
            double d;
            if (!try_number(v, d)) return Value::error("type-mismatch");
            return Value::number(round_away(d, dg));
        };
    }
    // List editing (spec §4.3): pure functions returning a new list; assign the result with `set`.
    if (name == "range") {
        arity(c, 2, 3);
        std::vector<Eval> args;
        for (auto& e : c.args) args.push_back(compile(*e));
        return [args](Exec& x) -> Value {
            double start = 0, step = 1;
            int64_t count = 0;
            Value error;
            // Left to right, like every other function (C++ argument evaluation order is unspecified).
            const Value from = args[0](x);
            const Value to = args[1](x);
            const Value by = args.size() > 2 ? args[2](x) : Value::number(1);
            if (!range_of(from, to, by, start, step, count, error)) return error;
            std::vector<Value> list;
            for (int64_t k = 0; k < count; ++k) {
                x.visit();  // a range is bounded by maxVisited like any stream (spec §2)
                list.push_back(Value::number(range_at(start, step, k)));
            }
            return Value::list_of(std::move(list));
        };
    }
    if (name == "append" || name == "insert" || name == "remove-at" || name == "without") {
        enum class ListFn { Append, Insert, RemoveAt, Without };
        const ListFn fn = name == "append" ? ListFn::Append : name == "insert" ? ListFn::Insert : name == "remove-at" ? ListFn::RemoveAt : ListFn::Without;
        if (fn == ListFn::Append) arity(c, 2, 64);
        else if (fn == ListFn::Insert) arity(c, 3, 3);
        else arity(c, 2, 2);
        std::vector<Eval> args;
        for (auto& e : c.args) args.push_back(compile(*e));
        return [args, name, fn](Exec& x) -> Value {
            Value first = args[0](x);
            if (!first.is_list()) return Value::error("type-mismatch", name + "() expects a list first");
            std::vector<Value> list;
            elements(first, list);  // a fresh copy: the argument is never modified
            live_all(x, list);
            auto index = [&](const Value& iv, bool inserting, int64_t& out) {
                double d;
                if (!try_number(iv, d) || !std::isfinite(d) || std::floor(d) != d) return false;
                int64_t n = static_cast<int64_t>(list.size());
                if (std::fabs(d) > static_cast<double>(n) + 1) return false;  // out of range: reject before casting (no UB)
                int64_t i = static_cast<int64_t>(d);
                if (i < 0) i += inserting ? n + 1 : n;
                if (i < 0 || i > n || (!inserting && i == n)) return false;
                out = i;
                return true;
            };
            if (fn == ListFn::Append) {
                for (size_t i = 1; i < args.size(); ++i) list.push_back(args[i](x));
            } else if (fn == ListFn::Insert) {
                int64_t i = 0;
                if (!index(args[1](x), true, i)) return Value::error("type-mismatch", "insert() index must be an integer in range");
                list.insert(list.begin() + i, args[2](x));
            } else if (fn == ListFn::RemoveAt) {
                int64_t i = 0;
                if (!index(args[1](x), false, i)) return Value::error("type-mismatch", "remove-at() index must be an integer in range");
                list.erase(list.begin() + i);
            } else {
                Value drop = args[1](x);
                list.erase(std::remove_if(list.begin(), list.end(),
                                          [&](const Value& e) { return rql_equal(x, e, drop) == std::optional<bool>(true); }),
                           list.end());
            }
            return Value::list_of(std::move(list));
        };
    }
    if (name == "coalesce") {
        arity(c, 1, 16);
        std::vector<Eval> args;
        for (auto& e : c.args) args.push_back(compile(*e));
        return [args](Exec& x) {
            for (auto& a : args) {
                Value v = a(x);
                if (!v.is_null() && !v.is_absent()) return v;
            }
            return Value::null();
        };
    }
    if (name == "if") {
        // Lazy: only the taken branch runs; a condition that is not true (false or unknown) takes the else branch.
        arity(c, 3, 3);
        Eval cond = compile_condition(*c.args[0]), then = compile(*c.args[1]), otherwise = compile(*c.args[2]);
        return [cond, then, otherwise](Exec& x) { return truth(cond(x)) == std::optional<bool>(true) ? then(x) : otherwise(x); };
    }
    if (name == "ref") {
        arity(c, 1, 64);
        std::vector<Eval> args;
        for (auto& e : c.args) args.push_back(compile(*e));
        return [args](Exec& x) {
            std::vector<Value> found;
            for (auto& a : args) {
                Value v = a(x);
                std::vector<Value> refs;
                if (v.is_list()) elements(v, refs);
                else refs.push_back(v);
                for (auto& r : refs) {
                    if (!r.is_string()) return Value::error("type-mismatch", "ref() expects reference strings");
                    std::string err;
                    Value o = x.resolve_ref(r.as_string(), err);
                    if (o.is_missing()) {
                        x.diagnostics.push_back(Diagnostic::error("stale-ref", err, ref_hint(x.engine, r.as_string())));
                        return Value::error("stale-ref", err);
                    }
                    found.push_back(o);
                }
            }
            return found.size() == 1 ? found[0] : Value::list_of(std::move(found));
        };
    }
    if (name == "contains" || name == "starts-with" || name == "ends-with" || name == "matches") {
        arity(c, 2, 2);
        return compile_op_args(name, c.args[0], c.args[1]);
    }
    if (is_string_function(name)) {
        std::vector<const Expr*> args;
        for (auto& a : c.args) args.push_back(a.get());
        return compile_string_function(c, name, args, 0);
    }
    std::vector<std::string> known;
    for (auto* f : kCoreFunctions) known.push_back(f);
    for (auto& kv : x_.engine.functions()) known.push_back(kv.first);
    throw RqlException("unknown-function", "unknown function '" + c.name + "'",
                       "functions: " + join(known, " ") + "; collection methods: list.any(pred) list.count() ...");
}

Eval Compiler::compile_method(const Expr& c) {
    Eval on = compile(*c.on);
    std::string name = ascii_lower(c.name);
    if (name == "any" || name == "all" || name == "count" || name == "first") {
        arity(c, name == "all" ? 1 : 0, 1);
        auto pred = c.args.empty() ? nullptr : std::make_shared<Eval>(compile_condition(*c.args[0]));
        return [on, pred, name](Exec& x) { return quantify(x, on(x), pred.get(), name); };
    }
    if (name == "sum" || name == "min" || name == "max" || name == "avg") {
        arity(c, 0, 1);
        auto sel = c.args.empty() ? nullptr : std::make_shared<Eval>(compile(*c.args[0]));
        return [on, sel, name](Exec& x) { return aggregate(x, on(x), sel.get(), name); };
    }
    if (name == "keys" || name == "values") {
        arity(c, 0, 0);
        bool keys = name == "keys";
        return [on, keys](Exec& x) {
            Value v = on(x);
            if (!v.is_map()) return Value::missing();
            std::vector<Value> out;
            v.map().for_each([&](const Value& k, const Value& val) {
                out.push_back(keys ? k : x.live(val));
                return true;
            });
            return Value::list_of(std::move(out));
        };
    }
    if (name == "contains" || name == "starts-with" || name == "ends-with" || name == "matches") {
        arity(c, 1, 1);
        return compile_op_args(name, c.on, c.args[0]);
    }
    if (name == "lower" || name == "upper") {
        arity(c, 0, 0);
        bool up = name == "upper";
        return [on, up](Exec& x) { return case_of(on(x), up); };
    }
    if (name == "len") {
        arity(c, 0, 0);
        return [on](Exec& x) { return len_of(on(x)); };
    }
    if (is_string_function(name)) {
        std::vector<const Expr*> args{c.on.get()};
        for (auto& a : c.args) args.push_back(a.get());
        return compile_string_function(c, name, args, 1);
    }
    std::vector<std::string> known;
    for (auto* m : kCoreMethods) known.push_back(m);
    throw RqlException("unknown-function", "unknown method '" + c.name + "'", "methods: " + join(known, " "));
}

Eval Compiler::compile_string_function(const Expr& c, const std::string& name, const std::vector<const Expr*>& argExprs, size_t receiver) {
    size_t min = 1, max = 1;
    if (name == "replace" || name == "replace-regex") min = max = 3;
    else if (name == "substring" || name == "pad") min = 2, max = 3;
    else if (name == "split") min = max = 2;
    arity(c, min - receiver, max - receiver);
    if (name == "replace-regex") check_literal_regex(x_, argExprs[1]);
    std::vector<Eval> args;
    for (auto* e : argExprs) args.push_back(compile(*e));
    bool regex = name == "replace-regex";
    return [args, name, regex](Exec& x) {
        std::vector<Value> vals;
        for (auto& a : args) {
            Value v = a(x);
            if (v.is_null() || v.is_absent()) return v;  // null / missing / error propagate (first one)
            vals.push_back(std::move(v));
        }
        Value r = string_function(x, name, vals);
        if (regex) x.check_time();
        return r;
    };
}

}  // namespace detail
}  // namespace rql

// Live value → JSON (spec §6). Mirrors dotnet/Rql.Execution/Encoder.cs and Describe.cs.
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>

#include "exec.hpp"

namespace rql {
namespace detail {

namespace {
const char* kEllipsis = "\xE2\x80\xA6";  // U+2026
}

Json Encoder::number(double d, bool single) {
    if (single) {
        double back = 0;
        if (parse_double(format_float(static_cast<float>(d)), back)) d = back;
    }
    if (std::isnan(d) || std::isinf(d)) return Json(format_number_text(d));
    if (std::fabs(d) < 9007199254740992.0 && std::floor(d) == d) return Json::number(d == 0 ? 0.0 : d, true);
    return Json(d);
}

Json Encoder::summary(const Value& obj) {
    Json o = Json::object();
    o.set("$ref", x_.ref_of(obj));
    if (const MemberDescriptor* dm = x_.view(obj.type()).display()) {
        try {
            Value name = dm->getter(obj.ptr());
            if (name.is_string()) o.set("name", name.as_string());
        } catch (const std::exception&) {
            // summaries never fail
        }
    }
    return o;
}

Json Encoder::inline_object(const Value& obj, int depth) {
    Json o = Json::object();
    const TypeView view = x_.view(obj.type());
    for (auto& m : view.implicit_members()) {  // explicit-only members are never read implicitly
        Value mv;
        try {
            mv = m.getter(obj.ptr());
        } catch (const std::exception& ex) {
            mv = Value::error("getter-threw", ex.what());
        }
        if (mv.is_list() || mv.is_map()) {
            o.set(m.name, friendly_type_of(mv) + "[" + std::to_string(collection_size(mv)) + "]");
            continue;
        }
        if (mv.is_object()) {
            const TypeView tv = x_.view(mv.type());
            bool value_like = !tv.id() && !tv.display();
            o.set(m.name, value_like && depth < 1 ? inline_object(mv, depth + 1) : summary(mv));
            continue;
        }
        o.set(m.name, encode(mv, depth + 1));
    }
    return o;
}

// Like the comparison nesting limit (spec §4.1): deeper lists and maps encode as "…".
constexpr size_t kMaxEncodeNesting = 32;

/// Pops the collection entered last, also when encoding its elements throws.
struct Leave {
    std::vector<const void*>& open;
    ~Leave() { open.pop_back(); }
};

bool Encoder::enter(const void* collection) {
    if (open_.size() >= kMaxEncodeNesting || std::find(open_.begin(), open_.end(), collection) != open_.end()) return false;
    open_.push_back(collection);
    return true;
}

Json Encoder::encode(const Value& v, int depth) {
    if (x_.is_dead(v)) return Json();  // destroyed objects encode as null (spec §13 liveness)
    // Adapter encoding first (spec §13): the first adapter that encodes wins.
    if (x_.has_capability(Capability::Encode)) {
        const auto& encoders = x_.adapters_for(v, Capability::Encode);
        if (!encoders.empty()) {
            EncodeContext ctx(*this, depth);
            if (auto j = first_answer(encoders, [&](const TypeAdapter& a) { return a.encode(v, ctx); })) return std::move(*j);
        }
    }
    switch (v.kind()) {
        case Value::Kind::Missing:
        case Value::Kind::Null:
        case Value::Kind::Unknown: return Json();
        case Value::Kind::Error: {
            Json o = Json::object();
            o.set("$error", v.error_code());
            return o;
        }
        case Value::Kind::Bool: return Json(v.as_bool());
        case Value::Kind::String: return Json(v.as_string());
        case Value::Kind::Number: return number(v.as_number(), v.is_single());
        case Value::Kind::Enum: return Json(to_text(v));
        case Value::Kind::Row: {
            Json o = Json::object();
            const RowData& r = v.row();
            for (size_t i = 0; i < r.values.size(); ++i) o.set((*r.columns)[i], encode(r.values[i], depth + 1));
            return o;
        }
        case Value::Kind::Entry: {
            Json o = Json::object();
            o.set("key", encode(v.entry().key, depth + 1));
            o.set("value", encode(v.entry().value, depth + 1));
            return o;
        }
        case Value::Kind::List: {
            auto& l = v.list();
            if (!enter(l.identity())) return Json(kEllipsis);
            Leave leave{open_};
            Json arr = Json::array();
            size_t total = l.size();
            size_t limit = static_cast<size_t>(std::max(0, x_.max_list_items));
            size_t n = std::min(total, limit);
            for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) arr.push(encode(l.at(i), depth + 1));
            if (total > n) arr.push(Json(std::string(kEllipsis) + "+" + std::to_string(total - n)));
            return arr;
        }
        case Value::Kind::Map: {
            if (!enter(v.map().identity())) return Json(kEllipsis);
            Leave leave{open_};
            Json o = Json::object();
            size_t n = 0, total = 0;
            size_t limit = static_cast<size_t>(std::max(0, x_.max_list_items));
            v.map().for_each([&](const Value& k, const Value& val) {
                ++total;
                if (n >= limit) return true;
                std::string key = to_text(k);
                if (o.contains(key)) return true;
                o.set(key, encode(val, depth + 1));
                ++n;
                return true;
            });
            if (total > n) o.set(kEllipsis, "+" + std::to_string(total - n));
            return o;
        }
        case Value::Kind::Struct: {
            if (depth > 2) return Json(kEllipsis);
            Json o = Json::object();
            const TypeView view = x_.view(v.type());
            for (auto& m : view.implicit_members()) {
                Value mv;
                try {
                    mv = m.getter(v.ptr());
                } catch (const std::exception& ex) {
                    mv = Value::error("getter-threw", ex.what());
                }
                o.set(m.name, encode(mv, depth + 1));
            }
            return o;
        }
        case Value::Kind::Object: {
            const TypeView tv = x_.view(v.type());
            if (!tv.id() && !tv.display() && depth <= 1) return inline_object(v, depth);
            return summary(v);
        }
    }
    return Json();
}

QueryResult Encoder::rows(const std::vector<std::string>& columns, const std::vector<std::vector<Value>>& rows) {
    QueryResult r;
    r.ok = true;
    r.kind = ResultKind::Rows;
    r.columns = columns;
    r.rows.emplace();
    int64_t bytes = 0;
    for (auto& row : rows) {
        std::vector<Json> enc;
        enc.reserve(row.size());
        for (auto& v : row) {
            enc.push_back(encode(v));
            bytes += static_cast<int64_t>(enc.back().dump().size());
        }
        bytes += static_cast<int64_t>(columns.size());
        if (bytes > x_.max_output_bytes && !r.rows->empty()) {
            r.truncated = true;
            r.diagnostics.push_back(Diagnostic::warning(
                "output-truncated",
                "output limited to " + std::to_string(x_.max_output_bytes) + " bytes; " + std::to_string(r.rows->size()) + " of " +
                    std::to_string(rows.size()) + " rows returned",
                "select fewer/smaller columns or page with skip/first"));
            break;
        }
        r.rows->push_back(std::move(enc));
    }
    r.total = static_cast<int64_t>(rows.size());
    return r;
}

QueryResult Encoder::items(const std::vector<Value>& items) {
    QueryResult r;
    r.ok = true;
    r.kind = ResultKind::Items;
    r.items.emplace();
    int64_t bytes = 0;
    for (auto& it : items) {
        Json n = encode(it);
        bytes += static_cast<int64_t>(n.dump().size());
        if (bytes > x_.max_output_bytes && !r.items->empty()) {
            r.truncated = true;
            r.diagnostics.push_back(Diagnostic::warning(
                "output-truncated",
                "output limited to " + std::to_string(x_.max_output_bytes) + " bytes; " + std::to_string(r.items->size()) + " of " +
                    std::to_string(items.size()) + " items returned",
                "use select to project fewer members"));
            break;
        }
        r.items->push_back(std::move(n));
    }
    return r;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ describe

QueryResult run_describe(Exec& x, Stream& stream) {
    std::vector<const TypeDescriptor*> types;
    std::vector<std::vector<std::string>> row_columns;
    Item it;
    while (stream.next(it)) {
        const Value& v = it.value;
        if (v.is_null() || v.is_absent()) continue;
        const TypeDescriptor* t = v.type();
        if (!t) t = v.is_string() ? builtin::string_type() : v.is_bool() ? builtin::bool_type() : builtin::double_type();
        if (std::find(types.begin(), types.end(), t) == types.end()) {
            types.push_back(t);
            row_columns.push_back(v.is_row() ? *v.row().columns : std::vector<std::string>{});
        }
        if (types.size() >= 8) break;
    }
    Json arr = Json::array();
    for (size_t i = 0; i < types.size(); ++i) {
        Json d = x.engine.describe_type(*types[i]);
        if (types[i] == builtin::row_type()) {
            Json members = Json::array();
            for (auto& c : row_columns[i]) {
                Json m = Json::object();
                m.set("name", c);
                m.set("type", "object");
                members.push(std::move(m));
            }
            d.set("members", std::move(members));
        }
        arr.push(std::move(d));
    }
    QueryResult r;
    r.ok = true;
    r.kind = ResultKind::Schema;
    r.types = std::move(arr);
    return r;
}

}  // namespace detail
}  // namespace rql

#include "rql/engine.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <unordered_set>

#include "exec.hpp"

namespace rql {

namespace {

bool ident_start(char c) { return (c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z') || (c >= 'a' && c <= 'z') || c == '_'; }

void validate_name(const std::string& name, bool require_namespace) {
    if (name.empty()) throw std::invalid_argument("name required");
    size_t start = 0;
    for (;;) {
        size_t dot = name.find('.', start);
        std::string part = name.substr(start, dot == std::string::npos ? std::string::npos : dot - start);
        if (part.empty() || !ident_start(part[0])) throw std::invalid_argument("invalid name '" + name + "'");
        if (dot == std::string::npos) break;
        start = dot + 1;
    }
    if (require_namespace && name.find('.') == std::string::npos)
        throw std::invalid_argument("extension names must be namespaced (ns.name): '" + name + "'");
}

const char* kCoreStageNames[] = {"where", "select", "sort", "first", "skip", "count", "describe", "get", "sum",
                                 "min", "max", "avg", "group-by", "distinct", "recurse", "set", "call"};
// Keep in sync with kCoreFunctions / kCoreMethods in compiler.cpp (the manifest lists what the compiler binds).
const char* kFunctionNames[] = {"has", "is-null", "len", "lower", "upper", "abs", "round", "floor", "ceil", "sqrt", "pow", "min", "max",
                                "coalesce", "if", "ref",
                                "append", "insert", "remove-at", "without", "range",
                                "replace", "replace-regex", "substring", "split", "trim", "pad",
                                "contains", "starts-with", "ends-with", "matches"};
const char* kMethodNames[] = {"any", "all", "count", "sum", "min", "max", "avg", "first", "keys", "values",
                              "contains", "starts-with", "ends-with", "matches", "lower", "upper", "len",
                              "replace", "replace-regex", "substring", "split", "trim", "pad"};

}  // namespace

Engine& Engine::add_source(const std::string& name, std::function<Value()> getter, std::string description) noexcept {
    try {
        validate_name(name, false);
        last_error_.clear();
        for (auto& s : sources_) {
            if (s.name == name) {
                s.getter = std::move(getter);
                s.description = std::move(description);
                std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(source_types_mutex_);
                source_types_.erase(name);
                return *this;
            }
        }
        sources_.push_back({name, std::move(getter), std::move(description)});
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(source_types_mutex_);
        source_types_.erase(name);
    } catch (const std::exception& ex) {
        last_error_ = ex.what();
    } catch (...) {
        last_error_ = "add_source failed";
    }
    return *this;
}

Engine& Engine::add_function(const std::string& name, FunctionHandler fn) noexcept {
    try {
        validate_name(name, true);
        last_error_.clear();
        functions_[name] = std::move(fn);
    } catch (const std::exception& ex) {
        last_error_ = ex.what();
    } catch (...) {
        last_error_ = "add_function failed";
    }
    return *this;
}

Engine& Engine::add_stage(const std::string& name, StageHandler handler) noexcept {
    try {
        validate_name(name, true);
        last_error_.clear();
        stages_[name] = std::move(handler);
    } catch (const std::exception& ex) {
        last_error_ = ex.what();
    } catch (...) {
        last_error_ = "add_stage failed";
    }
    return *this;
}

const SourceRegistration* Engine::find_source(const std::string& name) const noexcept {
    for (auto& s : sources_)
        if (s.name == name) return &s;
    const SourceRegistration* hit = nullptr;
    for (auto& s : sources_) {
        if (iequals(s.name, name)) {
            if (hit) return nullptr;
            hit = &s;
        }
    }
    return hit;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ adapters

Engine::Engine(TypeRegistry& types) : types_(&types) {}
Engine::~Engine() = default;

Engine& Engine::add_adapter(TypeAdapter adapter) noexcept {
    try {
        if (!adapter.target && adapter.interface_name.empty()) {
            last_error_ = "type adapter '" + adapter.name + "' needs a target type or an interface name";
            return *this;
        }
        if (adapter.name.empty()) adapter.name = adapter.target ? adapter.target->name + "Adapter" : adapter.interface_name + "Adapter";
        last_error_.clear();
        const bool caps[] = {bool(adapter.encode),  bool(adapter.coerce),    bool(adapter.equals),   bool(adapter.compare),
                             bool(adapter.stable_id), bool(adapter.is_alive), bool(adapter.components)};
        for (size_t i = 0; i < caps_.size(); ++i) caps_[i] = caps_[i] || caps[i];
        adapters_.push_back(std::make_unique<TypeAdapter>(std::move(adapter)));
        // Registering adapters while queries run is not supported, so cached adaptations can just go.
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(adapted_mutex_);
        adapted_.clear();
    } catch (const std::exception& ex) {
        last_error_ = ex.what();
    } catch (...) {
        last_error_ = "add_adapter failed";
    }
    return *this;
}

std::vector<std::string> Engine::explain(const TypeDescriptor& type) const noexcept {
    std::vector<std::string> out;
    try {
        std::vector<const TypeAdapter*> ordered;
        try {
            if (const detail::AdaptedType* a = adapted(&type)) ordered = a->adapters;
        } catch (const std::logic_error&) {
            ordered = detail::applicable_adapters(adapters_, type);  // member configuration bug: still explain the order
        }
        for (const TypeAdapter* a : ordered) {
            std::string target = a->target ? a->target->name : "interface " + a->interface_name;
            out.push_back(a->name + " (target " + target + ", rank " + std::to_string(adapter_rank(*a, type)) + ", priority " +
                          std::to_string(a->priority) + ")");
        }
    } catch (...) {
        out.clear();
    }
    return out;
}

Engine& Engine::exclude_types(TypeExclusion excluded) noexcept {
    try {
        if (!excluded) {
            last_error_ = "exclude_types needs a predicate";
            return *this;
        }
        last_error_.clear();
        if (excluded_) {
            TypeExclusion prev = std::move(excluded_);
            excluded_ = [prev, excluded](const TypeDescriptor& t) { return prev(t) || excluded(t); };
        } else {
            excluded_ = std::move(excluded);
        }
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(exclusion_mutex_);
            exclusion_scanned_.store(static_cast<size_t>(-1), std::memory_order_release);  // force a rescan
        }
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(adapted_mutex_);
        adapted_.clear();
    } catch (...) {
        last_error_ = "exclude_types failed";
    }
    return *this;
}

bool Engine::adapts() const {
    if (!adapters_.empty()) return true;
    if (!excluded_) return false;
    const size_t count = types_->registered_count();
    if (count == exclusion_scanned_.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) return exclusion_hits_.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(exclusion_mutex_);  // types were registered since the last scan
    if (count != exclusion_scanned_.load(std::memory_order_relaxed)) {
        const std::vector<const TypeDescriptor*> registered = types_->registered();
        exclusion_hits_.store(std::any_of(registered.begin(), registered.end(),
                                          [&](const TypeDescriptor* t) { return detail::excludes_members(*t, excluded_); }),
                              std::memory_order_release);
        exclusion_scanned_.store(count, std::memory_order_release);
    }
    return exclusion_hits_.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
}

std::vector<const TypeDescriptor*> Engine::subtypes_named(const TypeDescriptor* target, const std::string& name) const {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(subtypes_mutex_);
    if (types_->registered_count() != subtypes_registered_) {  // types were registered since: rebuild lazily
        subtypes_.clear();
        subtypes_registered_ = types_->registered_count();
    }
    auto it = subtypes_.find(target);
    if (it == subtypes_.end()) {
        std::unordered_map<std::string, std::vector<const TypeDescriptor*>> by_name;
        const std::vector<const TypeDescriptor*> registered = types_->registered();
        for (const TypeDescriptor* t : registered)
            if (t->kind == target->kind && t->derives_from(target)) by_name[t->name].push_back(t);
        it = subtypes_.emplace(target, std::move(by_name)).first;
    }
    auto hit = it->second.find(name);
    return hit == it->second.end() ? std::vector<const TypeDescriptor*>{} : hit->second;
}

size_t Engine::retained_literal_objects() noexcept {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(retained_mutex_);
    return retained_.size();
}

void Engine::release_literal_objects() noexcept {
    std::vector<std::shared_ptr<void>> released;
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(retained_mutex_);
        released.swap(retained_);
    }
}  // freed here, outside the lock

void Engine::retain(std::vector<std::shared_ptr<void>>& objects) noexcept {
    if (objects.empty()) return;
    try {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(retained_mutex_);
        retained_.reserve(retained_.size() + objects.size());
        for (auto& o : objects) retained_.push_back(std::move(o));
        objects.clear();
    } catch (...) {
        // Out of memory: keep the objects alive forever rather than risk dangling links.
        auto* leak = new (std::nothrow) std::vector<std::shared_ptr<void>>(std::move(objects));
        (void)leak;
    }
}

const detail::AdaptedType* Engine::adapted(const TypeDescriptor* type) const {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(adapted_mutex_);
    auto it = adapted_.find(type);
    if (it != adapted_.end()) return it->second.get();
    auto a = detail::build_adapted(*types_, *type, adapters_, excluded_);  // throws on adapter configuration bugs (not cached)
    return adapted_.emplace(type, std::move(a)).first->second.get();
}

detail::TypeView Engine::view_of(const TypeDescriptor* type, detail::Exec* x) const {
    if (!adapts()) return detail::TypeView(type, nullptr);
    if (x) return x->view(type);
    return detail::TypeView(type, adapted(type));
}

std::optional<bool> Engine::liveness(const Value& object, detail::Exec* x) {
    if (caps_[static_cast<size_t>(detail::Capability::IsAlive)] && object.type()) {
        const detail::TypeView tv = view_of(object.type(), x);
        auto verdict = detail::first_answer(tv.with(detail::Capability::IsAlive), [&](const TypeAdapter& a) { return a.is_alive(object); });
        if (verdict) return verdict;
    }
    if (is_alive) return is_alive(object);
    return std::nullopt;
}

std::optional<std::string> Engine::stable_id_of(const Value& object, detail::Exec* x) {
    detail::TypeView tv = view_of(object.type(), x);
    if (caps_[static_cast<size_t>(detail::Capability::StableId)]) {
        auto sid = detail::first_answer(tv.with(detail::Capability::StableId), [&](const TypeAdapter& a) { return a.stable_id(object); });
        if (sid) return sid;
    }
    const MemberDescriptor* idm = tv.id();
    if (!idm) return std::nullopt;
    Value id;
    try {
        id = idm->getter(object.ptr());
    } catch (const std::exception&) {
        return std::nullopt;
    }
    if (id.is_null() || id.is_absent()) return std::nullopt;
    return to_text(id);
}

namespace detail {
std::string Exec::ref_of(const Value& v) { return engine.ref_of_impl(v, this); }
Value Exec::resolve_ref(const std::string& reference, std::string& error) { return engine.resolve_ref(reference, error, this); }
std::vector<const TypeDescriptor*> Exec::subtypes_named(const TypeDescriptor* target, const std::string& name) {
    return engine.subtypes_named(target, name);
}
Exec::~Exec() {
    // Literal-built objects of a non-dry-run query may now be linked from the graph or host state
    // (also after a failed rollback): the engine retains them (spec §4.5 ownership).
    if (!options.dry_run) engine.retain(constructed);
}
}  // namespace detail

namespace {
QueryResult internal_error(const char* what) noexcept {
    try {
        return QueryResult::fail({Diagnostic::error("internal-error", std::string("internal error: ") + what,
                                                    "this is an RQL runtime bug or a throwing host callback; please report the query")});
    } catch (...) {
        return QueryResult();  // ok=false, no diagnostics (allocation failure)
    }
}
}  // namespace

QueryResult Engine::execute(const QueryPlan& plan, const Budgets& budgets, const QueryOptions& options) noexcept {
    try {
        if (!plan.source) return QueryResult::fail({Diagnostic::error("invalid-plan", "plan has no source")});
        detail::Exec x(*this, budgets, options, plan);
        QueryResult r;
        try {
            r = detail::run_pipeline(x);
        } catch (const std::exception& ex) {
            // Last line of defence: untrusted queries must never crash the host with a raw exception.
            r = internal_error(ex.what());
        } catch (...) {
            r = internal_error("unknown exception");
        }
        r.stats.visited = x.visited;
        r.stats.members_read = x.members_read;
        r.stats.elapsed_ms = x.elapsed_ms();
        return r;
    } catch (const std::exception& ex) {
        return internal_error(ex.what());
    } catch (...) {
        return internal_error("unknown exception");
    }
}

QueryResult Engine::execute_json(const std::string& plan_json, const Budgets& budgets, const QueryOptions& options) noexcept {
    QueryPlan plan;
    Diagnostic err;
    if (!try_decode_plan(std::string_view(plan_json), plan, err)) {
        try {
            return QueryResult::fail({err});
        } catch (...) {
            return QueryResult();
        }
    }
    return execute(plan, budgets, options);
}

QueryResult Engine::execute_request(const std::string& request_json) noexcept {
    Json req;
    std::string error;
    if (!Json::try_parse(request_json, req, error, 256)) {
        try {
            return QueryResult::fail({Diagnostic::error("invalid-plan", "request is not valid JSON: " + error)});
        } catch (...) {
            return QueryResult();
        }
    }
    return execute_request(req);
}

QueryResult Engine::execute_request(const Json& req) noexcept {
    try {
        if (!req.is_object()) throw RqlException("invalid-plan", "request must be an object");
        for (size_t i = 0; i < req.size(); ++i) {
            const std::string& k = req.key(i);
            if (k != "rql" && k != "plan" && k != "text" && k != "budgets" && k != "options")
                throw RqlException("invalid-plan", "unexpected property '" + k + "' in request");
        }
        if (const Json* v = req.find("rql")) {
            if (!v->is_string() || v->as_string() != kRqlVersion)
                throw RqlException("version-unsupported", "request version is not supported (supported: " + std::string(kRqlVersion) + ")");
        }
        const Json* plan = req.find("plan");
        const Json* text = req.find("text");
        if ((plan != nullptr) == (text != nullptr)) throw RqlException("invalid-plan", "request needs exactly one of 'plan' or 'text'");
        if (text)
            throw RqlException("unsupported", "the C++ runtime executes QueryPlans only; parse RQL text with the .NET/TypeScript parser sidecar");
        Budgets b;
        QueryOptions o;
        if (const Json* bj = req.find("budgets")) b = Budgets::from_json(*bj);
        if (const Json* oj = req.find("options")) o = QueryOptions::from_json(*oj);
        QueryPlan p = decode_plan(*plan);
        return execute(p, b, o);
    } catch (const RqlException& ex) {
        try {
            return QueryResult::fail({Diagnostic::from(ex)});
        } catch (...) {
            return QueryResult();
        }
    } catch (const std::exception& ex) {
        return internal_error(ex.what());
    } catch (...) {
        return internal_error("unknown exception");
    }
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ references

int64_t Engine::handle_of(const Value& v) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(handle_mutex_);
    const void *a, *b;
    if (!v.identity(a, b)) {
        int64_t id = ++next_handle_;
        return id;
    }
    HandleKey key{a, b};
    auto it = handles_.find(key);
    if (it != handles_.end()) return it->second;
    int64_t id = ++next_handle_;
    handles_.emplace(key, id);
    // Weak semantics: keep only the raw identity (no keep-alive), re-validated on resolution.
    handle_targets_.emplace(id, HandleTarget{v.is_object() ? Value::object(v.type(), v.ptr()) : Value::missing()});
    return id;
}

void Engine::clear_session_handles() noexcept {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(handle_mutex_);
    handles_.clear();
    handle_targets_.clear();
}

std::string Engine::ref_of(const Value& v) noexcept {
    try {
        return ref_of_impl(v, nullptr);
    } catch (...) {
        return "?";
    }
}

std::string Engine::ref_of_impl(const Value& v, detail::Exec* x) {
    if (v.is_object()) {
        const TypeDescriptor* t = v.type();
        if (auto id = stable_id_of(v, x)) return t->name + "#" + *id;
        return t->name + "@" + std::to_string(handle_of(v));
    }
    return type_name_of(v) + "@" + std::to_string(handle_of(v));
}

Value Engine::search_sources(const std::string& type, const std::string& id, const std::string* alt_id, const Value* identity,
                             detail::Exec* x) {
    Value alt_hit;  // first object matching alt_id (returned only when no object matches id)
    struct IdKey {
        const void* a;
        const void* b;
        bool operator==(const IdKey& o) const { return a == o.a && b == o.b; }
    };
    struct IdHash {
        size_t operator()(const IdKey& k) const { return std::hash<const void*>()(k.a) * 31u ^ std::hash<const void*>()(k.b); }
    };
    const void *ta = nullptr, *tb = nullptr;
    if (identity) identity->identity(ta, tb);
    std::unordered_set<IdKey, IdHash> visited;
    std::vector<std::pair<Value, int>> stack;
    for (auto& s : sources_) {
        Value v;
        try {
            v = s.getter();
        } catch (const std::exception&) {
            continue;
        }
        if (!v.is_null() && !v.is_absent()) stack.emplace_back(v, 0);
    }
    int budget = defaults_.max_visited;
    while (!stack.empty() && budget-- > 0) {
        if (x) x->visit();
        auto [o, depth] = stack.back();
        stack.pop_back();
        const void *a, *b;
        if (!o.identity(a, b) || !visited.insert(IdKey{a, b}).second) continue;
        if (o.is_list() || o.is_map()) {
            std::vector<Value> els;
            detail::elements(o, els);
            for (auto& e : els) {
                Value ev = e.is_entry() ? e.entry().value : e;
                if (ev.is_object() || ev.is_list() || ev.is_map()) stack.emplace_back(ev, depth);
            }
            continue;
        }
        if (!o.is_object()) continue;
        const TypeDescriptor* t = o.type();
        if (identity) {
            if (a == ta && b == tb) return o;
        } else if (t->is_a(type)) {
            auto sid = stable_id_of(o, x);
            if (sid && *sid == id) return o;
            if (sid && alt_id && alt_hit.is_missing() && *sid == *alt_id) alt_hit = o;
        }
        if (depth >= 32) continue;
        const detail::TypeView tv = view_of(t, x);
        for (auto& m : tv.implicit_members()) {
            if (!m.owning || !m.type) continue;
            if (m.type->kind == TypeKind::Enum || m.type->kind == TypeKind::Struct) continue;
            if (m.type->kind == TypeKind::Scalar && m.type->scalar != ScalarKind::Any) continue;
            Value v;
            try {
                v = m.getter(o.ptr());
            } catch (const std::exception&) {
                continue;
            }
            if (v.is_object() || v.is_list() || v.is_map()) stack.emplace_back(v, depth + 1);
        }
    }
    return alt_hit;
}

Value Engine::resolve_ref(const std::string& reference, std::string& error) noexcept {
    try {
        return resolve_ref(reference, error, nullptr);
    } catch (const std::exception& ex) {
        try {
            error = ex.what();
        } catch (...) {
        }
        return Value::missing();
    } catch (...) {
        return Value::missing();
    }
}

Value Engine::resolve_ref(const std::string& reference_in, std::string& error, detail::Exec* x) {
    std::string reference = reference_in;
    while (!reference.empty() && (reference.front() == ' ' || reference.front() == '\t')) reference.erase(reference.begin());
    while (!reference.empty() && (reference.back() == ' ' || reference.back() == '\t')) reference.pop_back();
    // Ids may contain spaces / parentheses (asset paths): the exact text is preferred, then copied display
    // forms such as "Enemy#12(Goblin_0012)" or "Enemy#12 Goblin" are tolerated (spec §7).
    size_t cut = reference.find_first_of(" (\t");
    if (cut == std::string::npos || cut == 0) return resolve_ref_core(reference, error, x, nullptr);
    const std::string trimmed = reference.substr(0, cut);
    return resolve_ref_core(reference, error, x, &trimmed);
}

namespace {
bool split_ref(const std::string& reference, std::string& type, std::string& id, char& kind) {
    size_t i = reference.find_first_of("#@");
    if (i == std::string::npos || i == 0 || i == reference.size() - 1) return false;
    type = reference.substr(0, i);
    id = reference.substr(i + 1);
    kind = reference[i];
    return true;
}
}  // namespace

Value Engine::find_stable(const std::string& type, const std::string& id, const std::string* alt_id, detail::Exec* x) {
    if (!x) return search_sources(type, id, alt_id, nullptr, nullptr);
    std::string key = type + "#" + id;
    if (alt_id) key += std::string(1, '\0') + *alt_id;
    auto cached = x->ref_cache.find(key);
    if (cached != x->ref_cache.end()) return cached->second;
    Value found = search_sources(type, id, alt_id, nullptr, x);
    x->ref_cache.emplace(key, found);
    return found;
}

Value Engine::check_resolved(const Value& found, const std::string& reference, const std::string& type, std::string& error,
                             detail::Exec* x) {
    if (!found.is_object() || !found.type()->is_a(type)) {
        error = "reference '" + reference + "' does not resolve to a live object";
        return Value::missing();
    }
    if (!alive(found, x)) {
        error = "reference '" + reference + "' points to a destroyed object";
        return Value::missing();
    }
    return found;
}

Value Engine::resolve_ref_core(const std::string& reference, std::string& error, detail::Exec* x, const std::string* fallback) {
    std::string type, id;
    char kind = 0;
    if (!split_ref(reference, type, id, kind)) {
        if (fallback) return resolve_ref_core(*fallback, error, x, nullptr);
        error = "malformed reference '" + reference + "' (expected Type#id or Type@handle)";
        return Value::missing();
    }
    Value found;
    if (kind == '@') {
        double h = 0;
        Value candidate;
        if (parse_double(id, h) && std::floor(h) == h) {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(handle_mutex_);
            auto it = handle_targets_.find(static_cast<int64_t>(h));
            if (it != handle_targets_.end()) candidate = it->second.value;
        }
        if (candidate.is_object()) {
            // The stored pointer may dangle. Trust it only when liveness is DECIDED for this handle's own
            // type (the type stored with the handle; deciding this never dereferences the object): the host
            // hook, or a liveness adapter of that type that answers. Otherwise re-validate by reachability
            // (identity comparison only).
            const std::optional<bool> verdict = liveness(candidate, x);
            if (!verdict) {
                found = search_sources(type, id, nullptr, &candidate, x);
            } else if (*verdict && candidate.type()->is_a(type)) {
                return candidate;  // liveness already decided above
            } else if (!*verdict) {
                error = "reference '" + reference + "' points to a destroyed object";
                return Value::missing();  // an exact match is final: no display-form fallback
            }
        }
    } else if (resolve_stable_ref) {
        found = resolve_stable_ref(type, id);
    } else {
        // One pass over the sources accepts the trimmed id too (when it names the same type); exact wins.
        std::string alt_type, alt_id;
        char alt_kind = 0;
        const bool one_pass = fallback && split_ref(*fallback, alt_type, alt_id, alt_kind) && alt_kind == '#' && alt_type == type;
        found = find_stable(type, id, one_pass ? &alt_id : nullptr, x);
        if (one_pass) {
            const auto sid = found.is_object() ? stable_id_of(found, x) : std::nullopt;
            if (found.is_object() && sid && *sid == alt_id && alt_id != id) return check_resolved(found, *fallback, type, error, x);
            fallback = nullptr;  // the trimmed form was searched in the same pass
        }
    }
    Value resolved = check_resolved(found, reference, type, error, x);
    // An exact match is final (a destroyed one is stale-ref); only an absent exact id tries the display form.
    if (resolved.is_missing() && fallback && !found.is_object()) return resolve_ref_core(*fallback, error, x, nullptr);
    return resolved;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ schema

Json Engine::describe_type(const TypeDescriptor& t) const noexcept {
    try {
        return describe_type_impl(t);
    } catch (...) {
        return Json();
    }
}

Json Engine::describe_type_impl(const TypeDescriptor& t) const {
    const detail::TypeView tv = view_of(&t, nullptr);
    Json o = Json::object();
    o.set("name", t.name);
    if (t.base) o.set("base", t.base->name);
    o.set("kind", t.kind == TypeKind::Enum ? "enum" : t.kind == TypeKind::Struct ? "struct" : "object");
    if (!tv.description().empty()) o.set("description", tv.description());
    if (const Json* literal = tv.literal_schema()) o.set("literal", *literal);
    if (t.kind == TypeKind::Enum) {
        Json values = Json::array();
        for (auto& e : t.enum_values) values.push(Json(e.first));
        o.set("values", std::move(values));
        o.set("members", Json::array());
        return o;
    }
    Json members = Json::array();
    for (auto& m : tv.members()) {
        Json mo = Json::object();
        mo.set("name", m.name);
        std::string tn = m.type ? m.type->friendly_name() : "object";
        if (m.nullable && m.type && m.type->is_value_type() && m.type->scalar != ScalarKind::String) tn += "?";
        mo.set("type", tn);
        if (mutations_.enabled && tv.member_writable(m)) mo.set("writable", true);
        if (m.explicit_only) mo.set("explicitOnly", true);
        if (!m.description.empty()) mo.set("description", m.description);
        members.push(std::move(mo));
    }
    o.set("members", std::move(members));
    // Callable methods (host + adapter), sorted by name then arity: "name(type param, ...) — description".
    std::vector<const MethodDescriptor*> callable;
    for (auto& m : tv.methods())
        if (m.callable) callable.push_back(&m);
    std::stable_sort(callable.begin(), callable.end(), [](const MethodDescriptor* a, const MethodDescriptor* b) {
        return a->name != b->name ? a->name < b->name : a->params.size() < b->params.size();
    });
    Json methods = Json::array();
    for (auto* m : callable)
        methods.push(Json(m->description.empty() ? t.signature(*m) : t.signature(*m) + " \xE2\x80\x94 " + m->description));
    if (methods.size() > 0) o.set("methods", std::move(methods));
    return o;
}

Json Engine::capabilities() noexcept {
    try {
        return capabilities_impl();
    } catch (...) {
        return Json();
    }
}

Json Engine::capabilities_impl() {
    Json o = Json::object();
    o.set("rql", kRqlVersion);
    o.set("runtime", runtime_name);
    Json sources = Json::array();
    for (auto& s : sources_) {
        Json so = Json::object();
        so.set("name", s.name);
        std::string type = "object";
        try {
            Value v = s.getter();
            type = friendly_type_of(v);
        } catch (const std::exception&) {
        }
        so.set("type", type);
        if (!s.description.empty()) so.set("description", s.description);
        sources.push(std::move(so));
    }
    o.set("sources", std::move(sources));
    Json stages = Json::array();
    for (auto* s : kCoreStageNames) stages.push(Json(s));
    for (auto& kv : stages_) stages.push(Json(kv.first));
    o.set("stages", std::move(stages));
    Json functions = Json::array();
    for (auto* f : kFunctionNames) functions.push(Json(f));
    for (auto& kv : functions_) functions.push(Json(kv.first));
    o.set("functions", std::move(functions));
    Json methods = Json::array();
    for (auto* m : kMethodNames) methods.push(Json(m));
    o.set("methods", std::move(methods));
    Json mut = Json::object();
    mut.set("enabled", mutations_.enabled);
    mut.set("maxTargets", mutations_.max_targets);
    mut.set("hardMaxTargets", mutations_.hard_max_targets);
    Json callable = Json::array();
    for (auto* t : types_->registered()) {
        const detail::TypeView tv = view_of(t, nullptr);  // includes adapter methods
        for (auto& m : tv.methods())
            if (m.callable) callable.push(Json(t->name + "." + t->signature(m)));
    }
    mut.set("callable", std::move(callable));
    o.set("mutations", std::move(mut));
    Json limits = Json::object();
    limits.set("maxVisited", defaults_.hard_max_visited);
    limits.set("maxRows", defaults_.hard_max_rows);
    limits.set("maxListItems", defaults_.max_list_items);
    limits.set("maxDepth", defaults_.max_depth);
    limits.set("timeoutMs", defaults_.hard_timeout_ms);
    limits.set("maxOutputBytes", defaults_.max_output_bytes);
    limits.set("maxMutationTargets", mutations_.max_targets);
    o.set("limits", std::move(limits));
    Json types = Json::array();
    for (auto* t : types_->registered()) types.push(describe_type_impl(*t));
    o.set("types", std::move(types));
    return o;
}

}  // namespace rql
