```cpp
			Must(TEXT("second button"), /* ref("@L@") | call AddChild("Button", "Cancel") */ TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"call":"ref","args":[{"lit":"@L@"}]},"stages":[{"op":"call","method":"AddChild","args":[{"lit":"Button"},{"lit":"Cancel"}]}]})RQL"), { { TEXT("L"), List } });
			const TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> Count = Run(/* unreal.asset("@WBP@") | get Widgets | count */ TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"call":"asset","on":{"path":["unreal"]},"args":[{"lit":"@WBP@"}]},"stages":[{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Widgets"]}},{"op":"count"}]})RQL"));
			TestEqual(TEXT("five widgets"), UnrealMcpRqlSpecHelpers::Number(Count), 5.0);
			const TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> Children = Run(/* ref("@L@") | get Children | select Name Parent.Name */ TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"call":"ref","args":[{"lit":"@L@"}]},"stages":[{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Children"]}},{"op":"select","fields":[{"name":"Name","expr":{"path":["Name"]}},{"name":"Parent.Name","expr":{"path":["Parent","Name"]}}]}]})RQL"), false, { { TEXT("L"), List } });
			TestEqual(TEXT("children in order"), UnrealMcpRqlSpecHelpers::CellText(Children, 1, 0), FString(TEXT("Cancel")));
			TestEqual(TEXT("their parent"), UnrealMcpRqlSpecHelpers::CellText(Children, 0, 1), FString(TEXT("List")));
			const TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> Tree = Run(/* unreal.asset("@WBP@") | get RootWidget | recurse Children | select $depth Name */ TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"call":"asset","on":{"path":["unreal"]},"args":[{"lit":"@WBP@"}]},"stages":[{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["RootWidget"]}},{"op":"recurse","via":[{"path":["Children"]}]},{"op":"select","fields":[{"name":"$depth","expr":{"path":[{"meta":"depth"}]}},{"name":"Name","expr":{"path":["Name"]}}]}]})RQL"));
			TestEqual(TEXT("recurse walks the tree"), UnrealMcpRqlSpecHelpers::RowCount(Tree), 5);

			Must(TEXT("a widget property"), /* ref("@T@") | set Text = "Hello RQL" */ TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"call":"ref","args":[{"lit":"@T@"}]},"stages":[{"op":"set","assign":[{"target":{"path":["Text"]},"value":{"lit":"Hello RQL"}}]}]})RQL"), { { TEXT("T"), Title } });
			UTextBlock* Text = Cast<UTextBlock>(Made->WidgetTree->FindWidget(TEXT("Title")));
			TestTrue(TEXT("text stored"), Text && Text->GetText().ToString() == TEXT("Hello RQL"));
			Must(TEXT("its canvas slot"), /* ref("@T@") | set Slot.LayoutData.Offsets.Left = 24 */ TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"call":"ref","args":[{"lit":"@T@"}]},"stages":[{"op":"set","assign":[{"target":{"path":["Slot","LayoutData","Offsets","Left"]},"value":{"lit":24}}]}]})RQL"), { { TEXT("T"), Title } });
			const UCanvasPanelSlot* Slot = Text ? Cast<UCanvasPanelSlot>(Text->Slot) : nullptr;
			TestTrue(TEXT("slot stored"), Slot && FMath::IsNearlyEqual(Slot->GetLayout().Offsets.Left, 24.0f));
			const TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> Status = Run(/* unreal.asset("@WBP@") | select Status */ TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"call":"asset","on":{"path":["unreal"]},"args":[{"lit":"@WBP@"}]},"stages":[{"op":"select","fields":[{"name":"Status","expr":{"path":["Status"]}}]}]})RQL"));
			TestEqual(TEXT("the Blueprint is marked modified"), UnrealMcpRqlSpecHelpers::CellText(Status), FString(TEXT("Dirty")));

			Must(TEXT("a widget removed"), /* unreal.asset("@WBP@") | get Widgets | where Name == "Cancel" | call Destroy() */ TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"call":"asset","on":{"path":["unreal"]},"args":[{"lit":"@WBP@"}]},"stages":[{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Widgets"]}},{"op":"where","pred":{"op":"==","args":[{"path":["Name"]},{"lit":"Cancel"}]}},{"op":"call","method":"Destroy","args":[]}]})RQL"));
			const TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> After = Run(/* ref("@L@") | get Children | count */ TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"call":"ref","args":[{"lit":"@L@"}]},"stages":[{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Children"]}},{"op":"count"}]})RQL"), false, { { TEXT("L"), List } });
			TestEqual(TEXT("one button left"), UnrealMcpRqlSpecHelpers::Number(After), 1.0);
			const TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> Compiled = Must(TEXT("compile"), /* unreal.asset("@WBP@") | call Compile() */ TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"call":"asset","on":{"path":["unreal"]},"args":[{"lit":"@WBP@"}]},"stages":[{"op":"call","method":"Compile","args":[]}]})RQL"));
			TestTrue(*FString::Printf(TEXT("compiles (%s)"), *UnrealMcpRqlSpecHelpers::CellText(Compiled, 0, 2)), UnrealMcpRqlSpecHelpers::CellText(Compiled, 0, 2).Contains(TEXT("\"Succeeded\":true")));

			if (!GEditor)
				return;
			Must(TEXT("one more for undo"), /* ref("@L@") | call AddChild("Image", "Icon") */ TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"call":"ref","args":[{"lit":"@L@"}]},"stages":[{"op":"call","method":"AddChild","args":[{"lit":"Image"},{"lit":"Icon"}]}]})RQL"), { { TEXT("L"), List } });
			TestNotNull(TEXT("added"), Made->WidgetTree->FindWidget(TEXT("Icon")));
			GEditor->UndoTransaction();
			const TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> Undone = Run(/* ref("@L@") | get Children | where Name == "Icon" | count */ TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"call":"ref","args":[{"lit":"@L@"}]},"stages":[{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Children"]}},{"op":"where","pred":{"op":"==","args":[{"path":["Name"]},{"lit":"Icon"}]}},{"op":"count"}]})RQL"), false, { { TEXT("L"), List } });
			TestEqual(TEXT("undo takes it out of the panel"), UnrealMcpRqlSpecHelpers::Number(Undone), 0.0);
		});
	});

	Describe("widget slots", [this]()
	{
		It("counts a same-value write of nested slot structs (Anchors) as unchanged", [this]()
		{
			UWidgetBlueprint* Made = MakeWidgetBlueprint();
			if (!TestNotNull(TEXT("widget blueprint"), Made))
				return;
			const FString Root = ResultRef(Must(TEXT("root"), /* unreal.asset("@WBP@") | call AddWidget("CanvasPanel", "Root") */ TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"call":"asset","on":{"path":["unreal"]},"args":[{"lit":"@WBP@"}]},"stages":[{"op":"call","method":"AddWidget","args":[{"lit":"CanvasPanel"},{"lit":"Root"}]}]})RQL")));
			const FString Button = ResultRef(Must(TEXT("a button"), /* unreal.asset("@WBP@") | call AddWidget("Button", "Play", ref("@R@")) */ TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"call":"asset","on":{"path":["unreal"]},"args":[{"lit":"@WBP@"}]},"stages":[{"op":"call","method":"AddWidget","args":[{"lit":"Button"},{"lit":"Play"},{"call":"ref","args":[{"lit":"@R@"}]}]}]})RQL"), { { TEXT("R"), Root } }));
			// ref("@B@") | set Slot.LayoutData.Anchors = "(Minimum=(X=0.5,Y=0),Maximum=(X=0.5,Y=0))"
			const TCHAR* Anchor = TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"call":"ref","args":[{"lit":"@B@"}]},"stages":[{"op":"set","assign":[{"target":{"path":["Slot","LayoutData","Anchors"]},"value":{"lit":"(Minimum=(X=0.5,Y=0),Maximum=(X=0.5,Y=0))"}}]}]})RQL");
			const TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> First = Must(TEXT("anchored"), Anchor, { { TEXT("B"), Button } });
			TestEqual(TEXT("the first write changes it"), UnrealMcpRqlSpecHelpers::RowCount(First), 1);
			const TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> Again = Must(TEXT("the same anchors again"), Anchor, { { TEXT("B"), Button } });
			TestEqual(TEXT("no changed row"), UnrealMcpRqlSpecHelpers::RowCount(Again), 0);
			TestTrue(TEXT("counted as unchanged"), Again.IsValid() && Again->HasField(TEXT("unchanged")) && Again->GetNumberField(TEXT("unchanged")) == 1.0);
		});
	});

	Describe("widget variables", [this]()
	{
		It("makes a widget a variable (the Designer's Is Variable) so a graph can read it, undoably", [this]()
		{
			UWidgetBlueprint* Made = MakeWidgetBlueprint();
			if (!TestNotNull(TEXT("widget blueprint"), Made))
				return;
			const FString Root = ResultRef(Must(TEXT("root"), /* unreal.asset("@WBP@") | call AddWidget("CanvasPanel", "Root") */ TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"call":"asset","on":{"path":["unreal"]},"args":[{"lit":"@WBP@"}]},"stages":[{"op":"call","method":"AddWidget","args":[{"lit":"CanvasPanel"},{"lit":"Root"}]}]})RQL")));
			Must(TEXT("a text block"), /* unreal.asset("@WBP@") | call AddWidget("TextBlock", "Label", ref("@R@")) */ TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"call":"asset","on":{"path":["unreal"]},"args":[{"lit":"@WBP@"}]},"stages":[{"op":"call","method":"AddWidget","args":[{"lit":"TextBlock"},{"lit":"Label"},{"call":"ref","args":[{"lit":"@R@"}]}]}]})RQL"), { { TEXT("R"), Root } });
			const TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> Before = Run(/* unreal.asset("@WBP@").Widgets | where Name == "Label" | select IsVariable */ TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"path":["Widgets"],"on":{"call":"asset","on":{"path":["unreal"]},"args":[{"lit":"@WBP@"}]}},"stages":[{"op":"where","pred":{"op":"==","args":[{"path":["Name"]},{"lit":"Label"}]}},{"op":"select","fields":[{"name":"IsVariable","expr":{"path":["IsVariable"]}}]}]})RQL"));
			TestEqual(*FString::Printf(TEXT("a text block starts as no variable (%s)"), *UnrealMcpRqlSpecHelpers::Codes(Before)), UnrealMcpRqlSpecHelpers::CellText(Before), FString(TEXT("false")));
			Refuses(TEXT("a graph cannot read it yet"), /* unreal.asset("@WBP@").EventGraph | call AddVariableGet("Label") */ TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"path":["EventGraph"],"on":{"call":"asset","on":{"path":["unreal"]},"args":[{"lit":"@WBP@"}]}},"stages":[{"op":"call","method":"AddVariableGet","args":[{"lit":"Label"}]}]})RQL"), TEXT("set IsVariable = true"));

			Must(TEXT("made a variable"), /* unreal.asset("@WBP@").Widgets | where Name == "Label" | set IsVariable = true */ TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"path":["Widgets"],"on":{"call":"asset","on":{"path":["unreal"]},"args":[{"lit":"@WBP@"}]}},"stages":[{"op":"where","pred":{"op":"==","args":[{"path":["Name"]},{"lit":"Label"}]}},{"op":"set","assign":[{"target":{"path":["IsVariable"]},"value":{"lit":true}}]}]})RQL"));
			UWidget* Label = Made->WidgetTree->FindWidget(TEXT("Label"));
			TestTrue(TEXT("the widget is a variable"), Label && Label->bIsVariable);
			if (GEditor)
			{
				GEditor->UndoTransaction();
				TestTrue(TEXT("undo makes it no variable again"), Label && !Label->bIsVariable);
				GEditor->RedoTransaction();
				TestTrue(TEXT("redo makes it a variable"), Label && Label->bIsVariable);
			}
			const FString Get = ResultRef(Must(TEXT("a graph reads it"), /* unreal.asset("@WBP@").EventGraph | call AddVariableGet("Label") */ TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"path":["EventGraph"],"on":{"call":"asset","on":{"path":["unreal"]},"args":[{"lit":"@WBP@"}]}},"stages":[{"op":"call","method":"AddVariableGet","args":[{"lit":"Label"}]}]})RQL")));
			TestTrue(TEXT("a get node"), Get.StartsWith(TEXT("K2Node_VariableGet#")));
			const TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> Compiled = Must(TEXT("compile"), /* unreal.asset("@WBP@") | call Compile() */ TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"call":"asset","on":{"path":["unreal"]},"args":[{"lit":"@WBP@"}]},"stages":[{"op":"call","method":"Compile","args":[]}]})RQL"));
			const FString CompileResult = UnrealMcpRqlSpecHelpers::CellText(Compiled, 0, 2);
			TestTrue(*FString::Printf(TEXT("compiles (%s)"), *CompileResult), CompileResult.Contains(TEXT("\"Succeeded\":true")));
			TestNotNull(TEXT("the generated class has the member"), FindFProperty<FObjectProperty>(Made->GeneratedClass, TEXT("Label")));

		});
	});

	Describe("levels", [this]()
	{
		It("copies a level to a file that opens at once; an unsaved level is named as such", [this]()
		{
			// The source is an engine template map that is not open, so the editor world stays as it is (later specs depend on it).
			const FString Source = TEXT("/Engine/Maps/Templates/Template_Default");
			const FString Copy = FString::Printf(TEXT("/Game/RqlSpecData/LV_Spec%d_%d"), Serial, FMath::Rand());
			const FString Unsaved = Copy + TEXT("_Unsaved");
			Must(TEXT("copied"), /* editor | call CopyAsset("@LV@", "@CP@") */ TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"path":["editor"]},"stages":[{"op":"call","method":"CopyAsset","args":[{"lit":"@LV@"},{"lit":"@CP@"}]}]})RQL"), { { TEXT("LV"), Source }, { TEXT("CP"), Copy } });
			TestTrue(TEXT("the copy is saved"), FPackageName::DoesPackageExist(Copy));
			// A level copied outside RQL stays in memory: OpenLevel says so instead of "no level".
			UEditorAssetLibrary::DuplicateAsset(Source, Unsaved);
			Refuses(TEXT("an unsaved level"), /* editor | call OpenLevel("@UN@") */ TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"path":["editor"]},"stages":[{"op":"call","method":"OpenLevel","args":[{"lit":"@UN@"}]}]})RQL"), TEXT("is not saved yet"), { { TEXT("UN"), Unsaved } });

			// Opening the copy replaces the editor world: only when the open level is a saved map that can come back.
			UWorld* Start = GEditor ? GEditor->GetEditorWorldContext().World() : nullptr;
			const FString Original = Start ? Start->GetOutermost()->GetName() : FString();
			if (Start && FPackageName::DoesPackageExist(Original) && (!Start->GetOutermost()->IsDirty() || FApp::IsUnattended()))
			{
				Must(TEXT("the copy opens"), /* editor | call OpenLevel("@CP@") */ TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"path":["editor"]},"stages":[{"op":"call","method":"OpenLevel","args":[{"lit":"@CP@"}]}]})RQL"), { { TEXT("CP"), Copy } });
				UWorld* Opened = GEditor->GetEditorWorldContext().World();
				TestTrue(TEXT("the editor shows the copy"), Opened && Opened->GetOutermost()->GetName() == Copy);
				UEditorLoadingAndSavingUtils::LoadMap(Original);
			}
			else
			{
				AddInfo(TEXT("opening the copy skipped: the open level is not a saved map (or has unsaved changes)"));
			}
			const TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> DropCopy = Run(/* editor | call DeleteAsset("@CP@", true) */ TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"path":["editor"]},"stages":[{"op":"call","method":"DeleteAsset","args":[{"lit":"@CP@"},{"lit":true}]}]})RQL"), true, { { TEXT("CP"), Copy } });
			Run(/* editor | call DeleteAsset("@UN@", true) */ TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"path":["editor"]},"stages":[{"op":"call","method":"DeleteAsset","args":[{"lit":"@UN@"},{"lit":true}]}]})RQL"), true, { { TEXT("UN"), Unsaved } });
			TestTrue(*FString::Printf(TEXT("the copy is deleted (%s)"), *UnrealMcpRqlSpecHelpers::Codes(DropCopy)), UnrealMcpRqlSpecHelpers::IsOk(DropCopy));
			// Never leave map files behind in the testbed, even when a delete failed.
			CollectGarbage(GARBAGE_COLLECTION_KEEPFLAGS);
			for (const FString& Package : { Copy, Unsaved })
				IFileManager::Get().Delete(*FPackageName::LongPackageNameToFilename(Package, FPackageName::GetMapPackageExtension()), false, true, true);
		});
	});

	Describe("Level Sequences", [this]()
	{
		It("binds actors, adds tracks and sections, keys channels and edits ranges", [this]()
		{
			ULevelSequence* Sequence = MakeSequence();
			Must(TEXT("playback range"), /* unreal.asset("@LS@") | set Start = 0, End = 150 */ TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"call":"asset","on":{"path":["unreal"]},"args":[{"lit":"@LS@"}]},"stages":[{"op":"set","assign":[{"target":{"path":["Start"]},"value":{"lit":0}},{"target":{"path":["End"]},"value":{"lit":150}}]}]})RQL"));
			const TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> Range = Run(/* unreal.asset("@LS@") | select DisplayRate Start End */ TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"call":"asset","on":{"path":["unreal"]},"args":[{"lit":"@LS@"}]},"stages":[{"op":"select","fields":[{"name":"DisplayRate","expr":{"path":["DisplayRate"]}},{"name":"Start","expr":{"path":["Start"]}},{"name":"End","expr":{"path":["End"]}}]}]})RQL"));
			TestTrue(*FString::Printf(TEXT("30 fps (%s)"), *UnrealMcpRqlSpecHelpers::CellText(Range, 0, 0)), UnrealMcpRqlSpecHelpers::CellText(Range, 0, 0).Contains(TEXT("30")));
			TestEqual(TEXT("start"), UnrealMcpRqlSpecHelpers::CellText(Range, 0, 1), FString(TEXT("0")));
			TestEqual(TEXT("end"), UnrealMcpRqlSpecHelpers::CellText(Range, 0, 2), FString(TEXT("150")));
			Refuses(TEXT("start after end"), /* unreal.asset("@LS@") | set Start = 200 */ TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"call":"asset","on":{"path":["unreal"]},"args":[{"lit":"@LS@"}]},"stages":[{"op":"set","assign":[{"target":{"path":["Start"]},"value":{"lit":200}}]}]})RQL"), TEXT("Start must be before End"));

			Must(TEXT("an actor"), /* editor | call SpawnActor("PointLight", "RqlSeqLamp") */ TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"path":["editor"]},"stages":[{"op":"call","method":"SpawnActor","args":[{"lit":"PointLight"},{"lit":"RqlSeqLamp"}]}]})RQL"));
			const TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> Bound = Must(TEXT("bound"), /* unreal.asset("@LS@") | call AddActor(unreal.find("RqlSeqLamp")) */ TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"call":"asset","on":{"path":["unreal"]},"args":[{"lit":"@LS@"}]},"stages":[{"op":"call","method":"AddActor","args":[{"call":"find","on":{"path":["unreal"]},"args":[{"lit":"RqlSeqLamp"}]}]}]})RQL"));
			TestTrue(TEXT("returns the binding"), UnrealMcpRqlSpecHelpers::CellText(Bound, 0, 2).Contains(TEXT("RqlSeqLamp")) || UnrealMcpRqlSpecHelpers::CellText(Bound, 0, 2).StartsWith(TEXT("SequenceBinding")));
			Refuses(TEXT("bound twice"), /* unreal.asset("@LS@") | call AddActor(unreal.find("RqlSeqLamp")) */ TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"call":"asset","on":{"path":["unreal"]},"args":[{"lit":"@LS@"}]},"stages":[{"op":"call","method":"AddActor","args":[{"call":"find","on":{"path":["unreal"]},"args":[{"lit":"RqlSeqLamp"}]}]}]})RQL"), TEXT("already bound"));
			const TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> Bindings = Run(/* unreal.asset("@LS@") | get Bindings | select Name Kind Class */ TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"call":"asset","on":{"path":["unreal"]},"args":[{"lit":"@LS@"}]},"stages":[{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Bindings"]}},{"op":"select","fields":[{"name":"Name","expr":{"path":["Name"]}},{"name":"Kind","expr":{"path":["Kind"]}},{"name":"Class","expr":{"path":["Class"]}}]}]})RQL"));
			TestEqual(TEXT("binding name"), UnrealMcpRqlSpecHelpers::CellText(Bindings, 0, 0), FString(TEXT("RqlSeqLamp")));
			TestEqual(TEXT("possessable"), UnrealMcpRqlSpecHelpers::CellText(Bindings, 0, 1), FString(TEXT("Possessable")));
			TestEqual(TEXT("class"), UnrealMcpRqlSpecHelpers::CellText(Bindings, 0, 2), FString(TEXT("PointLight")));

			Must(TEXT("transform track"), /* unreal.asset("@LS@") | get Bindings | call AddTrack("Transform") */ TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"call":"asset","on":{"path":["unreal"]},"args":[{"lit":"@LS@"}]},"stages":[{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Bindings"]}},{"op":"call","method":"AddTrack","args":[{"lit":"Transform"}]}]})RQL"));
			Refuses(TEXT("not a track class"), /* unreal.asset("@LS@") | get Bindings | call AddTrack("PointLight") */ TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"call":"asset","on":{"path":["unreal"]},"args":[{"lit":"@LS@"}]},"stages":[{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Bindings"]}},{"op":"call","method":"AddTrack","args":[{"lit":"PointLight"}]}]})RQL"), TEXT("not a track class"));
			const TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> Section = Run(/* unreal.asset("@LS@") | get Bindings | get Tracks | get Sections | select Start End */ TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"call":"asset","on":{"path":["unreal"]},"args":[{"lit":"@LS@"}]},"stages":[{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Bindings"]}},{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Tracks"]}},{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Sections"]}},{"op":"select","fields":[{"name":"Start","expr":{"path":["Start"]}},{"name":"End","expr":{"path":["End"]}}]}]})RQL"));
			TestEqual(TEXT("section over the playback range"), UnrealMcpRqlSpecHelpers::CellText(Section, 0, 0), FString(TEXT("0")));
			TestEqual(TEXT("section end"), UnrealMcpRqlSpecHelpers::CellText(Section, 0, 1), FString(TEXT("150")));

			Must(TEXT("a key"), /* unreal.asset("@LS@") | get Bindings | get Tracks | get Sections | call AddKey("Location.X", 30, 100) */ TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"call":"asset","on":{"path":["unreal"]},"args":[{"lit":"@LS@"}]},"stages":[{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Bindings"]}},{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Tracks"]}},{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Sections"]}},{"op":"call","method":"AddKey","args":[{"lit":"Location.X"},{"lit":30},{"lit":100}]}]})RQL"));
			Must(TEXT("another key"), /* unreal.asset("@LS@") | get Bindings | get Tracks | get Sections | call AddKey("location.x", 60, 250.5) */ TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"call":"asset","on":{"path":["unreal"]},"args":[{"lit":"@LS@"}]},"stages":[{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Bindings"]}},{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Tracks"]}},{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Sections"]}},{"op":"call","method":"AddKey","args":[{"lit":"location.x"},{"lit":60},{"lit":250.5}]}]})RQL"));
			const TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> Channels = Run(/* unreal.asset("@LS@") | get Bindings | get Tracks | get Sections | select Channels */ TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"call":"asset","on":{"path":["unreal"]},"args":[{"lit":"@LS@"}]},"stages":[{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Bindings"]}},{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Tracks"]}},{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Sections"]}},{"op":"select","fields":[{"name":"Channels","expr":{"path":["Channels"]}}]}]})RQL"));
			const FString ChannelText = UnrealMcpRqlSpecHelpers::CellText(Channels);
			TestTrue(*FString::Printf(TEXT("keys read back (%s)"), *ChannelText.Left(400)), ChannelText.Contains(TEXT("\"Frame\":30")) && ChannelText.Contains(TEXT("250.5")));
			Refuses(TEXT("unknown channel"), /* unreal.asset("@LS@") | get Bindings | get Tracks | get Sections | call AddKey("Nope", 1, 1) */ TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"call":"asset","on":{"path":["unreal"]},"args":[{"lit":"@LS@"}]},"stages":[{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Bindings"]}},{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Tracks"]}},{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Sections"]}},{"op":"call","method":"AddKey","args":[{"lit":"Nope"},{"lit":1},{"lit":1}]}]})RQL"), TEXT("Location.X"));
			Refuses(TEXT("a text value"), /* unreal.asset("@LS@") | get Bindings | get Tracks | get Sections | call AddKey("Location.X", 1, "far") */ TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"call":"asset","on":{"path":["unreal"]},"args":[{"lit":"@LS@"}]},"stages":[{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Bindings"]}},{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Tracks"]}},{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Sections"]}},{"op":"call","method":"AddKey","args":[{"lit":"Location.X"},{"lit":1},{"lit":"far"}]}]})RQL"), TEXT("a number"));
			Must(TEXT("an internal channel name keys the same channel"), /* unreal.asset("@LS@") | get Bindings | get Tracks | get Sections | call AddKey("Rotation.Z", 10, 45) */ TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"call":"asset","on":{"path":["unreal"]},"args":[{"lit":"@LS@"}]},"stages":[{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Bindings"]}},{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Tracks"]}},{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Sections"]}},{"op":"call","method":"AddKey","args":[{"lit":"Rotation.Z"},{"lit":10},{"lit":45}]}]})RQL"));
			const FString Yaw = UnrealMcpRqlSpecHelpers::CellText(Run(/* unreal.asset("@LS@") | get Bindings | get Tracks | get Sections | get Channels | where Name == "Rotation.Yaw" | select Keys */ TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"call":"asset","on":{"path":["unreal"]},"args":[{"lit":"@LS@"}]},"stages":[{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Bindings"]}},{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Tracks"]}},{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Sections"]}},{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Channels"]}},{"op":"where","pred":{"op":"==","args":[{"path":["Name"]},{"lit":"Rotation.Yaw"}]}},{"op":"select","fields":[{"name":"Keys","expr":{"path":["Keys"]}}]}]})RQL")));
			TestTrue(*FString::Printf(TEXT("Rotation.Z is the yaw (%s)"), *Yaw), Yaw.Contains(TEXT("\"Frame\":10")) && Yaw.Contains(TEXT("\"Value\":45")));
			Must(TEXT("a key past the end grows the section"), /* unreal.asset("@LS@") | get Bindings | get Tracks | get Sections | call AddKey("Location.Y", 200, 5) */ TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"call":"asset","on":{"path":["unreal"]},"args":[{"lit":"@LS@"}]},"stages":[{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Bindings"]}},{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Tracks"]}},{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Sections"]}},{"op":"call","method":"AddKey","args":[{"lit":"Location.Y"},{"lit":200},{"lit":5}]}]})RQL"));
			const TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> Grown = Run(/* unreal.asset("@LS@") | get Bindings | get Tracks | get Sections | select End */ TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"call":"asset","on":{"path":["unreal"]},"args":[{"lit":"@LS@"}]},"stages":[{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Bindings"]}},{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Tracks"]}},{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Sections"]}},{"op":"select","fields":[{"name":"End","expr":{"path":["End"]}}]}]})RQL"));
			TestTrue(TEXT("section grown"), FCString::Atoi(*UnrealMcpRqlSpecHelpers::CellText(Grown)) >= 200);
			Must(TEXT("section range"), /* unreal.asset("@LS@") | get Bindings | get Tracks | get Sections | set Start = 10 */ TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"call":"asset","on":{"path":["unreal"]},"args":[{"lit":"@LS@"}]},"stages":[{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Bindings"]}},{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Tracks"]}},{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Sections"]}},{"op":"set","assign":[{"target":{"path":["Start"]},"value":{"lit":10}}]}]})RQL"));

			Must(TEXT("visibility"), /* unreal.asset("@LS@") | get Bindings | call AddTrack("Visibility") */ TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"call":"asset","on":{"path":["unreal"]},"args":[{"lit":"@LS@"}]},"stages":[{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Bindings"]}},{"op":"call","method":"AddTrack","args":[{"lit":"Visibility"}]}]})RQL"));
			const TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> Bool = Run(/* unreal.asset("@LS@") | get Bindings | get Tracks | where $type == "MovieSceneVisibilityTrack" | get Sections | select Channels */ TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"call":"asset","on":{"path":["unreal"]},"args":[{"lit":"@LS@"}]},"stages":[{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Bindings"]}},{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Tracks"]}},{"op":"where","pred":{"op":"==","args":[{"path":[{"meta":"type"}]},{"lit":"MovieSceneVisibilityTrack"}]}},{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Sections"]}},{"op":"select","fields":[{"name":"Channels","expr":{"path":["Channels"]}}]}]})RQL"));
			const TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> BoolName = UnrealMcpRqlSpecHelpers::Parse(UnrealMcpRqlSpecHelpers::CellText(Bool).Mid(1).LeftChop(1));
			const FString Channel = BoolName.IsValid() ? BoolName->GetStringField(TEXT("Name")) : FString();
			Must(TEXT("a bool key"), /* unreal.asset("@LS@") | get Bindings | get Tracks | where $type == "MovieSceneVisibilityTrack" | get Sections | call AddKey("@C@", 15, false) */ TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"call":"asset","on":{"path":["unreal"]},"args":[{"lit":"@LS@"}]},"stages":[{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Bindings"]}},{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Tracks"]}},{"op":"where","pred":{"op":"==","args":[{"path":[{"meta":"type"}]},{"lit":"MovieSceneVisibilityTrack"}]}},{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Sections"]}},{"op":"call","method":"AddKey","args":[{"lit":"@C@"},{"lit":15},{"lit":false}]}]})RQL"), { { TEXT("C"), Channel } });
			const TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> BoolKeys = Run(/* unreal.asset("@LS@") | get Bindings | get Tracks | where $type == "MovieSceneVisibilityTrack" | get Sections | select Channels */ TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"call":"asset","on":{"path":["unreal"]},"args":[{"lit":"@LS@"}]},"stages":[{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Bindings"]}},{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Tracks"]}},{"op":"where","pred":{"op":"==","args":[{"path":[{"meta":"type"}]},{"lit":"MovieSceneVisibilityTrack"}]}},{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Sections"]}},{"op":"select","fields":[{"name":"Channels","expr":{"path":["Channels"]}}]}]})RQL"));
			TestTrue(*FString::Printf(TEXT("bool key (%s)"), *UnrealMcpRqlSpecHelpers::CellText(BoolKeys)), UnrealMcpRqlSpecHelpers::CellText(BoolKeys).Contains(TEXT("\"Value\":false")));

			Must(TEXT("an unbound track"), /* unreal.asset("@LS@") | call AddTrack("CameraCut") */ TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"call":"asset","on":{"path":["unreal"]},"args":[{"lit":"@LS@"}]},"stages":[{"op":"call","method":"AddTrack","args":[{"lit":"CameraCut"}]}]})RQL"));
			const TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> Tracks = Run(/* unreal.asset("@LS@") | get Tracks | select $type */ TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"call":"asset","on":{"path":["unreal"]},"args":[{"lit":"@LS@"}]},"stages":[{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Tracks"]}},{"op":"select","fields":[{"name":"$type","expr":{"path":[{"meta":"type"}]}}]}]})RQL"));
			TestEqual(TEXT("camera cut track"), UnrealMcpRqlSpecHelpers::CellText(Tracks), FString(TEXT("MovieSceneCameraCutTrack")));
			const TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> Listed = Run(/* levelSequences | where Path contains "@LS@" | count */ TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"path":["levelSequences"]},"stages":[{"op":"where","pred":{"op":"contains","args":[{"path":["Path"]},{"lit":"@LS@"}]}},{"op":"count"}]})RQL"));
			TestEqual(TEXT("levelSequences source"), UnrealMcpRqlSpecHelpers::Number(Listed), 1.0);
			TestTrue(TEXT("the sequence is dirty"), Sequence->GetOutermost()->IsDirty());

			if (!GEditor)
				return;
			Must(TEXT("a key to undo"), /* unreal.asset("@LS@") | get Bindings | get Tracks | where $type == "MovieScene3DTransformTrack" | get Sections | call AddKey("Location.Z", 90, 7) */ TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"call":"asset","on":{"path":["unreal"]},"args":[{"lit":"@LS@"}]},"stages":[{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Bindings"]}},{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Tracks"]}},{"op":"where","pred":{"op":"==","args":[{"path":[{"meta":"type"}]},{"lit":"MovieScene3DTransformTrack"}]}},{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Sections"]}},{"op":"call","method":"AddKey","args":[{"lit":"Location.Z"},{"lit":90},{"lit":7}]}]})RQL"));
			GEditor->UndoTransaction();
			const TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> Undone = Run(/* unreal.asset("@LS@") | get Bindings | get Tracks | where $type == "MovieScene3DTransformTrack" | get Sections | select Channels */ TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"call":"asset","on":{"path":["unreal"]},"args":[{"lit":"@LS@"}]},"stages":[{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Bindings"]}},{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Tracks"]}},{"op":"where","pred":{"op":"==","args":[{"path":[{"meta":"type"}]},{"lit":"MovieScene3DTransformTrack"}]}},{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Sections"]}},{"op":"select","fields":[{"name":"Channels","expr":{"path":["Channels"]}}]}]})RQL"));
			TestFalse(TEXT("undo removes the key"), UnrealMcpRqlSpecHelpers::CellText(Undone).Contains(TEXT("\"Frame\":90")));
		});

		It("animates a property: the property track of its type on the component's binding, keyed by the property name", [this]()
		{
			ULevelSequence* Sequence = MakeSequence();
			Must(TEXT("an actor"), /* editor | call SpawnActor("PointLight", "RqlSeqLamp") */ TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"path":["editor"]},"stages":[{"op":"call","method":"SpawnActor","args":[{"lit":"PointLight"},{"lit":"RqlSeqLamp"}]}]})RQL"));
			Must(TEXT("bound"), /* unreal.asset("@LS@") | call AddActor(unreal.find("RqlSeqLamp")) */ TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"call":"asset","on":{"path":["unreal"]},"args":[{"lit":"@LS@"}]},"stages":[{"op":"call","method":"AddActor","args":[{"call":"find","on":{"path":["unreal"]},"args":[{"lit":"RqlSeqLamp"}]}]}]})RQL"));
			// A property track class alone animates nothing: refused on a binding and unbound, naming the property form.
			Refuses(TEXT("a bare property track class"), /* unreal.asset("@LS@") | get Bindings | where Name == "RqlSeqLamp" | call AddTrack("MovieSceneFloatTrack") */ TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"call":"asset","on":{"path":["unreal"]},"args":[{"lit":"@LS@"}]},"stages":[{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Bindings"]}},{"op":"where","pred":{"op":"==","args":[{"path":["Name"]},{"lit":"RqlSeqLamp"}]}},{"op":"call","method":"AddTrack","args":[{"lit":"MovieSceneFloatTrack"}]}]})RQL"), TEXT("AddTrack(\"Intensity\")"));
			Refuses(TEXT("an unbound property track"), /* unreal.asset("@LS@") | call AddTrack("MovieSceneFloatTrack") */ TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"call":"asset","on":{"path":["unreal"]},"args":[{"lit":"@LS@"}]},"stages":[{"op":"call","method":"AddTrack","args":[{"lit":"MovieSceneFloatTrack"}]}]})RQL"), TEXT("bind the actor"));
			// An unknown name lists what can be animated (the light component's Interp properties).
			Refuses(TEXT("an unknown property"), /* unreal.asset("@LS@") | get Bindings | where Name == "RqlSeqLamp" | call AddTrack("NoSuchThing") */ TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"call":"asset","on":{"path":["unreal"]},"args":[{"lit":"@LS@"}]},"stages":[{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Bindings"]}},{"op":"where","pred":{"op":"==","args":[{"path":["Name"]},{"lit":"RqlSeqLamp"}]}},{"op":"call","method":"AddTrack","args":[{"lit":"NoSuchThing"}]}]})RQL"), TEXT("animatable properties: "));

			const TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> Added = Must(TEXT("intensity"), /* unreal.asset("@LS@") | get Bindings | where Name == "RqlSeqLamp" | call AddTrack("Intensity") */ TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"call":"asset","on":{"path":["unreal"]},"args":[{"lit":"@LS@"}]},"stages":[{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Bindings"]}},{"op":"where","pred":{"op":"==","args":[{"path":["Name"]},{"lit":"RqlSeqLamp"}]}},{"op":"call","method":"AddTrack","args":[{"lit":"Intensity"}]}]})RQL"));
			TestTrue(*FString::Printf(TEXT("returns a float track (%s)"), *UnrealMcpRqlSpecHelpers::CellText(Added, 0, 2)), UnrealMcpRqlSpecHelpers::CellText(Added, 0, 2).StartsWith(TEXT("MovieSceneFloatTrack")));
			Must(TEXT("a component property by path"), /* unreal.asset("@LS@") | get Bindings | where Name == "RqlSeqLamp" | call AddTrack("LightComponent0.LightColor") */ TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"call":"asset","on":{"path":["unreal"]},"args":[{"lit":"@LS@"}]},"stages":[{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Bindings"]}},{"op":"where","pred":{"op":"==","args":[{"path":["Name"]},{"lit":"RqlSeqLamp"}]}},{"op":"call","method":"AddTrack","args":[{"lit":"LightComponent0.LightColor"}]}]})RQL"));
			Refuses(TEXT("the same property twice"), /* unreal.asset("@LS@") | get Bindings | where Name == "RqlSeqLamp" | call AddTrack("Intensity") */ TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"call":"asset","on":{"path":["unreal"]},"args":[{"lit":"@LS@"}]},"stages":[{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Bindings"]}},{"op":"where","pred":{"op":"==","args":[{"path":["Name"]},{"lit":"RqlSeqLamp"}]}},{"op":"call","method":"AddTrack","args":[{"lit":"Intensity"}]}]})RQL"), TEXT("already has"));

			// The movie scene: one child possessable for the component, holding both property tracks, bound to their properties.
			UMovieScene* Scene = Sequence->GetMovieScene();
			const FMovieScenePossessable* Component = nullptr;
			for (int32 Index = 0; Index < Scene->GetPossessableCount(); ++Index)
				if (Scene->GetPossessable(Index).GetParent().IsValid())
					Component = &Scene->GetPossessable(Index);
			if (!TestNotNull(TEXT("a component binding under the actor"), Component))
				return;
			TestEqual(TEXT("named after the component"), Component->GetName(), FString(TEXT("LightComponent0")));
			const FMovieSceneBinding* Binding = Scene->FindBinding(Component->GetGuid());
			TArray<FString> Bound;
			for (UMovieSceneTrack* Track : Binding ? Binding->GetTracks() : TArray<UMovieSceneTrack*>())
				if (const UMovieScenePropertyTrack* Property = Cast<UMovieScenePropertyTrack>(Track))
					Bound.Add(Track->GetClass()->GetName() + TEXT(":") + Property->GetPropertyName().ToString());
			Bound.Sort();
			TestEqual(TEXT("tracks bound to their properties"), FString::Join(Bound, TEXT(",")), FString(TEXT("MovieSceneColorTrack:LightColor,MovieSceneFloatTrack:Intensity")));
			if (!GEditor)
				return;
			AActor* Lamp = nullptr;
			for (TActorIterator<AActor> It(GEditor->GetEditorWorldContext().World()); It; ++It)
				if (It->GetActorLabel() == TEXT("RqlSeqLamp"))
					Lamp = *It;
			UActorComponent* Light = Lamp ? Lamp->GetComponentByClass<UPointLightComponent>() : nullptr;
			TestTrue(TEXT("the component binding resolves to the light component"), Light && Sequence->FindBindingFromObject(Light, Lamp->GetWorld()) == Component->GetGuid());

			Must(TEXT("key at 0"), /* unreal.asset("@LS@") | get Bindings | where Name == "LightComponent0" | get Tracks | where $type == "MovieSceneFloatTrack" | get Sections | call AddKey("Intensity", 0, 0) */ TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"call":"asset","on":{"path":["unreal"]},"args":[{"lit":"@LS@"}]},"stages":[{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Bindings"]}},{"op":"where","pred":{"op":"==","args":[{"path":["Name"]},{"lit":"LightComponent0"}]}},{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Tracks"]}},{"op":"where","pred":{"op":"==","args":[{"path":[{"meta":"type"}]},{"lit":"MovieSceneFloatTrack"}]}},{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Sections"]}},{"op":"call","method":"AddKey","args":[{"lit":"Intensity"},{"lit":0},{"lit":0}]}]})RQL"));
			Must(TEXT("key at 60"), /* unreal.asset("@LS@") | get Bindings | where Name == "LightComponent0" | get Tracks | where $type == "MovieSceneFloatTrack" | get Sections | call AddKey("Intensity", 60, 5000) */ TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"call":"asset","on":{"path":["unreal"]},"args":[{"lit":"@LS@"}]},"stages":[{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Bindings"]}},{"op":"where","pred":{"op":"==","args":[{"path":["Name"]},{"lit":"LightComponent0"}]}},{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Tracks"]}},{"op":"where","pred":{"op":"==","args":[{"path":[{"meta":"type"}]},{"lit":"MovieSceneFloatTrack"}]}},{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Sections"]}},{"op":"call","method":"AddKey","args":[{"lit":"Intensity"},{"lit":60},{"lit":5000}]}]})RQL"));
			const FString Channels = UnrealMcpRqlSpecHelpers::CellText(Run(/* unreal.asset("@LS@") | get Bindings | where Name == "LightComponent0" | get Tracks | where $type == "MovieSceneFloatTrack" | get Sections | select Channels */ TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"call":"asset","on":{"path":["unreal"]},"args":[{"lit":"@LS@"}]},"stages":[{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Bindings"]}},{"op":"where","pred":{"op":"==","args":[{"path":["Name"]},{"lit":"LightComponent0"}]}},{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Tracks"]}},{"op":"where","pred":{"op":"==","args":[{"path":[{"meta":"type"}]},{"lit":"MovieSceneFloatTrack"}]}},{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Sections"]}},{"op":"select","fields":[{"name":"Channels","expr":{"path":["Channels"]}}]}]})RQL")));
			TestTrue(*FString::Printf(TEXT("the float channel is named Intensity and holds both keys (%s)"), *Channels.Left(600)),
				Channels.Contains(TEXT("\"Name\":\"Intensity\"")) && Channels.Contains(TEXT("\"Frame\":60")) && Channels.Contains(TEXT("5000")));

			// Visibility keys the actor's bHidden, as the Sequencer's Visibility track does.
			Must(TEXT("visibility"), /* unreal.asset("@LS@") | get Bindings | where Name == "RqlSeqLamp" | call AddTrack("Visibility") */ TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"call":"asset","on":{"path":["unreal"]},"args":[{"lit":"@LS@"}]},"stages":[{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Bindings"]}},{"op":"where","pred":{"op":"==","args":[{"path":["Name"]},{"lit":"RqlSeqLamp"}]}},{"op":"call","method":"AddTrack","args":[{"lit":"Visibility"}]}]})RQL"));
			const FMovieSceneBinding* ActorBinding = Scene->FindBinding(Component->GetParent());
			const UMovieSceneVisibilityTrack* Visibility = nullptr;
			for (UMovieSceneTrack* Track : ActorBinding ? ActorBinding->GetTracks() : TArray<UMovieSceneTrack*>())
				if (const UMovieSceneVisibilityTrack* Found = Cast<UMovieSceneVisibilityTrack>(Track))
					Visibility = Found;
			TestTrue(TEXT("visibility bound to bHidden"), Visibility && Visibility->GetPropertyName() == FName(TEXT("bHidden")));
			// Its bool is inverted (true = visible), so the channel is named Visible, not after bHidden.
			const FString VisibleChannel = UnrealMcpRqlSpecHelpers::CellText(Run(/* unreal.asset("@LS@") | get Bindings | where Name == "RqlSeqLamp" | get Tracks | where $type == "MovieSceneVisibilityTrack" | get Sections | select Channels */ TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"call":"asset","on":{"path":["unreal"]},"args":[{"lit":"@LS@"}]},"stages":[{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Bindings"]}},{"op":"where","pred":{"op":"==","args":[{"path":["Name"]},{"lit":"RqlSeqLamp"}]}},{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Tracks"]}},{"op":"where","pred":{"op":"==","args":[{"path":[{"meta":"type"}]},{"lit":"MovieSceneVisibilityTrack"}]}},{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Sections"]}},{"op":"select","fields":[{"name":"Channels","expr":{"path":["Channels"]}}]}]})RQL")));
			TestTrue(*FString::Printf(TEXT("the visibility channel is Visible (%s)"), *VisibleChannel), VisibleChannel.Contains(TEXT("\"Name\":\"Visible\"")));

			if (!GEditor)
				return;
			const int32 Before = Scene->GetPossessableCount();
			GEditor->UndoTransaction(); // visibility
			GEditor->UndoTransaction(); // key at 60
			GEditor->UndoTransaction(); // key at 0
			GEditor->UndoTransaction(); // light color
			GEditor->UndoTransaction(); // intensity (and the component binding)
			TestEqual(TEXT("undo removes the component binding"), Scene->GetPossessableCount(), Before - 1);
		});
	});
}

#endif // WITH_DEV_AUTOMATION_TESTS
```

`UnrealMCP/Source/UnrealMcpEditorTests/Private/UnrealMcpRqlSpec.cpp`:

```cpp
// Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak. Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.
// See the LICENSE file in the repository root for more information.

#if WITH_DEV_AUTOMATION_TESTS

#include "CoreMinimal.h"
#include "AssetRegistry/AssetRegistryModule.h"
#include "AssetRegistry/IAssetRegistry.h"
#include "Modules/ModuleManager.h"
#include "Misc/AutomationTest.h"
#include "UnrealMcpRqlTools.h"
#include "UnrealMcpCoreTools.h"
#include "UnrealMcpToolRegistry.h"
#include "Tools/UnrealMcpLogCollector.h"

#include "Components/AudioComponent.h"
#include "Components/LODSyncComponent.h"
#include "Components/PointLightComponent.h"
#include "Components/StaticMeshComponent.h"
#include "Engine/StaticMesh.h"
#include "Engine/StaticMeshActor.h"
#include "Dom/JsonObject.h"
#include "Dom/JsonValue.h"
#include "Editor.h"
#include "ScopedTransaction.h"
#include "Engine/LevelStreamingVolume.h"
#include "Engine/PointLight.h"
#include "Engine/TriggerVolume.h"
#include "UnrealMcpRqlSpecFixtures.h"
#include "Engine/World.h"
#include "EngineUtils.h"
#include "GameFramework/Actor.h"
#include "HAL/FileManager.h"
#include "EditorLevelUtils.h"
#include "Engine/Level.h"
#include "Layers/LayersSubsystem.h"
#include "Misc/PackageName.h"
#include "Misc/FileHelper.h"
#include "Misc/Paths.h"
#include "UnrealMcpRqlSpecHelpers.h"
#include "UObject/UObjectGlobals.h"
#include "UObject/UObjectIterator.h"
#include "Serialization/JsonReader.h"
#include "Serialization/JsonSerializer.h"

/**
 * The RQL data layer (docs/rql.md): the rql-* tools, the Unreal reflection provider, the core sources / members /
 * methods and the `editor` operations, executed in EditorContext so GEditor and the editor world are live.
 *
 * The C++ runtime has no RQL text parser (the sidecar parses), so each case carries the canonical QueryPlan of the query
 * in its comment, produced by Rql.Parser (com.IvanMurzak.Rql, PlanCodec.Serialize). Every case works on actors
 * labelled "RqlSpecLamp*" and removes them afterwards.
 */
BEGIN_DEFINE_SPEC(FUnrealMcpRqlSpec, "UnrealMcp.Tools.Rql",
	EAutomationTestFlags::EditorContext | EAutomationTestFlags::ProductFilter)

	/** Run a plan; the QueryResult JSON (null when it is not JSON). */
	TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> Exec(const FString& Plan, bool bMutate = false, bool bDryRun = false)
	{
		bool bOk = false;
		const FString Json = UnrealMcpRqlTools::ExecutePlan(Plan, bMutate, bDryRun, bOk);
		TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> Result = Parse(Json);
		if (Result.IsValid())
			TestEqual(TEXT("ok flag matches the result"), Result->GetBoolField(TEXT("ok")), bOk);
		else
			AddError(FString::Printf(TEXT("not JSON: %s"), *Json));
		return Result;
	}

	static TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> Parse(const FString& Json)
	{
		TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> Object;
		TSharedRef<TJsonReader<>> Reader = TJsonReaderFactory<>::Create(Json);
		return FJsonSerializer::Deserialize(Reader, Object) ? Object : nullptr;
	}

	static bool IsOk(const TSharedPtr<FJsonObject>& Result)
	{
		return Result.IsValid() && Result->GetBoolField(TEXT("ok"));
	}

	/** The diagnostics codes of a result, joined (for Contains checks and failure messages). */
	static FString Codes(const TSharedPtr<FJsonObject>& Result)
	{
		TArray<FString> Out;
		const TArray<TSharedPtr<FJsonValue>>* Diagnostics = nullptr;
		if (Result.IsValid() && Result->TryGetArrayField(TEXT("diagnostics"), Diagnostics))
		{
			for (const TSharedPtr<FJsonValue>& Diagnostic : *Diagnostics)
				Out.Add(Diagnostic->AsObject()->GetStringField(TEXT("code")) + TEXT(": ") + Diagnostic->AsObject()->GetStringField(TEXT("message")));
		}
		return FString::Join(Out, TEXT("; "));
	}

	/** rows[Row][Column] as JSON (null when absent). */
	static TSharedPtr<FJsonValue> Cell(const TSharedPtr<FJsonObject>& Result, int32 Row, int32 Column)
	{
		const TArray<TSharedPtr<FJsonValue>>* Rows = nullptr;
		if (!Result.IsValid() || !Result->TryGetArrayField(TEXT("rows"), Rows) || !Rows->IsValidIndex(Row))
			return nullptr;
		const TArray<TSharedPtr<FJsonValue>>& Cells = (*Rows)[Row]->AsArray();
		return Cells.IsValidIndex(Column) ? Cells[Column] : nullptr;
	}

	static int32 RowCount(const TSharedPtr<FJsonObject>& Result)
	{
		const TArray<TSharedPtr<FJsonValue>>* Rows = nullptr;
		return Result.IsValid() && Result->TryGetArrayField(TEXT("rows"), Rows) ? Rows->Num() : 0;
	}

	static FString CellText(const TSharedPtr<FJsonObject>& Result, int32 Row, int32 Column)
	{
		const TSharedPtr<FJsonValue> Value = Cell(Result, Row, Column);
		if (!Value.IsValid())
			return FString();
		if (Value->Type == EJson::Object)
		{
			FString Ref;
			Value->AsObject()->TryGetStringField(TEXT("$ref"), Ref);
			return Ref;
		}
		FString Text;
		return Value->TryGetString(Text) ? Text : FString();
	}

	static UWorld* World()
	{
		return GEditor ? GEditor->GetEditorWorldContext().World() : nullptr;
	}

	static TArray<AActor*> Lamps()
	{
		TArray<AActor*> Out;
		if (UWorld* W = World())
		{
			for (TActorIterator<AActor> It(W); It; ++It)
			{
				if (IsValid(*It) && It->GetActorLabel().StartsWith(TEXT("RqlSpecLamp")))
					Out.Add(*It);
			}
		}
		return Out;
	}

	static void Cleanup()
	{
		if (GEditor)
			GEditor->SelectNone(false, true);
		for (AActor* Actor : Lamps())
			Actor->GetWorld()->EditorDestroyActor(Actor, true);
	}

	/** editor | call SpawnActor("PointLight", "RqlSpecLamp", "(1, 2, 3)") */
	TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> SpawnLamp()
	{
		return Exec(TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"path":["editor"]},"stages":[{"op":"call","method":"SpawnActor","args":[{"lit":"PointLight"},{"lit":"RqlSpecLamp"},{"lit":"(1, 2, 3)"}]}]})RQL"), true);
	}

	/** Two point lights (RqlSpecLamp, RqlSpecLamp2); their light components. */
	TArray<UPointLightComponent*> SpawnTwoLamps()
	{
		SpawnLamp();
		/* editor | call SpawnActor("PointLight", "RqlSpecLamp2", "(0, 0, 0)") */
		Exec(TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"path":["editor"]},"stages":[{"op":"call","method":"SpawnActor","args":[{"lit":"PointLight"},{"lit":"RqlSpecLamp2"},{"lit":"(0, 0, 0)"}]}]})RQL"), true);
		TArray<UPointLightComponent*> Out;
		for (AActor* Lamp : Lamps())
		{
			if (UPointLightComponent* Light = Lamp->FindComponentByClass<UPointLightComponent>())
				Out.Add(Light);
		}
		return Out;
	}

	/** A StaticMeshActor labelled "RqlSpecLampMesh" (removed by Cleanup); whether it spawned. */
	static bool SpawnMesh()
	{
		AStaticMeshActor* Mesh = World() ? World()->SpawnActor<AStaticMeshActor>() : nullptr;
		if (Mesh)
			Mesh->SetActorLabel(TEXT("RqlSpecLampMesh"));
		return Mesh != nullptr;
	}

	/** actors | where Label == "RqlSpecLamp" | count */
	int32 CountLamps()
	{
		const TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> Result = Exec(TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"path":["actors"]},"stages":[{"op":"where","pred":{"op":"==","args":[{"path":["Label"]},{"lit":"RqlSpecLamp"}]}},{"op":"count"}]})RQL"));
		return Result.IsValid() ? static_cast<int32>(Result->GetNumberField(TEXT("value"))) : -1;
	}

END_DEFINE_SPEC(FUnrealMcpRqlSpec)

void FUnrealMcpRqlSpec::Define()
{
	BeforeEach([this]() { Cleanup(); });
	AfterEach([this]() { Cleanup(); });

	Describe("tools", [this]()
	{
		It("registers rql-query, rql-mutate and rql-schema as standard core tools; rql-query ships the unreal-rql skill", [this]()
		{
			FUnrealMcpToolRegistry Registry;
			UnrealMcpRqlTools::Register(Registry);
			TestEqual(TEXT("three tools"), Registry.Num(), 3);
			const FUnrealMcpRegisteredTool* Query = Registry.Find(TEXT("rql-query"));
			const FUnrealMcpRegisteredTool* Mutate = Registry.Find(TEXT("rql-mutate"));
			const FUnrealMcpRegisteredTool* Schema = Registry.Find(TEXT("rql-schema"));
			if (!TestTrue(TEXT("all registered"), Query && Mutate && Schema))
				return;
			TestTrue(TEXT("query is read-only"), Query->bReadOnlyHint);
			TestTrue(TEXT("mutate is destructive"), Mutate->bDestructiveHint);
			TestTrue(TEXT("standard surface"), Query->ToolType == EUnrealMcpToolType::Standard);
			TestEqual(TEXT("rql roles"), Query->Rql + Mutate->Rql + Schema->Rql, FString(TEXT("querymutateschema")));
			if (!TestEqual(TEXT("one skill"), Query->Skills.Num(), 1))
				return;
			TestEqual(TEXT("skill name"), Query->Skills[0].Name, FString(TEXT("unreal-rql")));
			TestTrue(TEXT("skill is the RQL guide"), Query->Skills[0].Markdown.Contains(TEXT("# RQL - query and change the Unreal Editor")));
			TestTrue(TEXT("skill lists the core sources"), Query->Skills[0].Markdown.Contains(TEXT("| `actors` |")));
			const TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> Descriptor = Query->ToDescriptorJson();
			TestTrue(TEXT("descriptor ships the skill and the role"), Descriptor->HasField(TEXT("skills")) && Descriptor->GetStringField(TEXT("rql")) == TEXT("query"));
			TestFalse(TEXT("other tools ship no skill"), Schema->ToDescriptorJson()->HasField(TEXT("skills")));
		});

		It("names a mutation's undo step after its query, and TRANSACTION UNDO reports which step it reverted", [this]()
		{
			FUnrealMcpLogCollector& Collector = FUnrealMcpLogCollector::Get();
			const bool bWasRegistered = Collector.IsRegistered();
			Collector.Startup();
			FUnrealMcpToolRegistry Registry;
			UnrealMcpRqlTools::Register(Registry);
			UnrealMcpEditorTools::Register(Registry);
			const FString Query = TEXT("editor | call SpawnActor(\"PointLight\", \"RqlSpecLamp\", \"(1, 2, 3)\")");
			TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> Args = MakeShared<FJsonObject>();
			Args->SetStringField(TEXT("query"), Query);
			Args->SetStringField(TEXT("plan"), TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"path":["editor"]},"stages":[{"op":"call","method":"SpawnActor","args":[{"lit":"PointLight"},{"lit":"RqlSpecLamp"},{"lit":"(1, 2, 3)"}]}]})RQL"));
			const FUnrealMcpToolResult Spawned = Registry.Execute(TEXT("rql-mutate"), FUnrealMcpToolCall(Args));
			TestTrue(*FString::Printf(TEXT("spawned (%s)"), *Spawned.Message), Spawned.bSuccess);
			TestEqual(TEXT("one lamp"), CountLamps(), 1);

			TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> Undo = MakeShared<FJsonObject>();
			Undo->SetStringField(TEXT("command"), TEXT("TRANSACTION UNDO"));
			const FUnrealMcpToolResult Undone = Registry.Execute(TEXT("console-run-command"), FUnrealMcpToolCall(Undo));
			TestTrue(TEXT("undo ran"), Undone.bSuccess);
			TestTrue(*FString::Printf(TEXT("the result names the reverted step (%s)"), *Undone.Message), Undone.Message.Contains(TEXT("RQL: ") + Query));
			TestEqual(TEXT("the lamp is gone"), CountLamps(), 0);
			if (!bWasRegistered)
				Collector.Shutdown();
		});

		It("answers a call without a parsed plan with an unsupported diagnostic", [this]()
		{
			FUnrealMcpToolRegistry Registry;
			UnrealMcpRqlTools::Register(Registry);
			TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> Args = MakeShared<FJsonObject>();
			Args->SetStringField(TEXT("query"), TEXT("actors | count"));
			const FUnrealMcpToolResult Result = Registry.Execute(TEXT("rql-query"), FUnrealMcpToolCall(Args));
			TestFalse(TEXT("fails"), Result.bSuccess);
			TestTrue(TEXT("says why"), Codes(Parse(Result.Message)).Contains(TEXT("unsupported")));
		});

		It("rejects a malformed plan with invalid-plan", [this]()
		{
			const TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> Result = Exec(TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","stages":[]})RQL"));
			TestFalse(TEXT("fails"), IsOk(Result));
			TestTrue(*FString::Printf(TEXT("invalid-plan (%s)"), *Codes(Result)), Codes(Result).Contains(TEXT("invalid-plan")));
		});
	});

	Describe("queries and mutations", [this]()
	{
		It("spawns an actor with a call and reads it back", [this]()
		{
			const TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> Spawned = SpawnLamp();
			TestTrue(*FString::Printf(TEXT("spawn ok (%s)"), *Codes(Spawned)), IsOk(Spawned));
			TestEqual(TEXT("one lamp in the world"), Lamps().Num(), 1);
			TestTrue(TEXT("receipt names the new actor"), CellText(Spawned, 0, 2).StartsWith(TEXT("PointLight#")));

			// actors | where Label == "RqlSpecLamp" | select $ref Label Location
			const TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> Read = Exec(TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"path":["actors"]},"stages":[{"op":"where","pred":{"op":"==","args":[{"path":["Label"]},{"lit":"RqlSpecLamp"}]}},{"op":"select","fields":[{"name":"$ref","expr":{"path":[{"meta":"ref"}]}},{"name":"Label","expr":{"path":["Label"]}},{"name":"Location","expr":{"path":["Location"]}}]}]})RQL"));
			TestTrue(*FString::Printf(TEXT("query ok (%s)"), *Codes(Read)), IsOk(Read));
			TestEqual(TEXT("one row"), RowCount(Read), 1);
			TestEqual(TEXT("label"), CellText(Read, 0, 1), FString(TEXT("RqlSpecLamp")));
			TestEqual(TEXT("location in the vector text form"), CellText(Read, 0, 2), FString(TEXT("(1, 2, 3)")));
		});

		It("sets members through the editor, and dry_run changes nothing", [this]()
		{
			SpawnLamp();
			TArray<AActor*> Found = Lamps();
			if (!TestEqual(TEXT("spawned"), Found.Num(), 1))
				return;
			AActor* Lamp = Found[0];

			// actors | where Label == "RqlSpecLamp" | set Location = "(-5, 0, 0)"   (dry run)
			const TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> Dry = Exec(TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"path":["actors"]},"stages":[{"op":"where","pred":{"op":"==","args":[{"path":["Label"]},{"lit":"RqlSpecLamp"}]}},{"op":"set","assign":[{"target":{"path":["Location"]},"value":{"lit":"(-5, 0, 0)"}}]}]})RQL"), true, true);
			TestTrue(*FString::Printf(TEXT("dry run ok (%s)"), *Codes(Dry)), IsOk(Dry));
			TestTrue(TEXT("dry run flagged"), Dry->HasField(TEXT("dryRun")));
			TestTrue(TEXT("dry run left the location"), Lamp->GetActorLocation().Equals(FVector(1, 2, 3)));

			// actors | where Label == "RqlSpecLamp" | set Location = "(10, 20, 30)", HiddenInEditor = true
			const TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> Set = Exec(TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"path":["actors"]},"stages":[{"op":"where","pred":{"op":"==","args":[{"path":["Label"]},{"lit":"RqlSpecLamp"}]}},{"op":"set","assign":[{"target":{"path":["Location"]},"value":{"lit":"(10, 20, 30)"}},{"target":{"path":["HiddenInEditor"]},"value":{"lit":true}}]}]})RQL"), true);
			TestTrue(*FString::Printf(TEXT("set ok (%s)"), *Codes(Set)), IsOk(Set));
			TestTrue(TEXT("location written"), Lamp->GetActorLocation().Equals(FVector(10, 20, 30)));
			TestTrue(TEXT("hidden in the editor"), Lamp->IsTemporarilyHiddenInEditor());
			TestTrue(TEXT("level marked dirty"), Lamp->GetOutermost()->IsDirty());
		});

		It("refuses writes in rql-query and to read-only members", [this]()
		{
			SpawnLamp();
			// The set plan above, but as rql-query (no mutation allowed).
			const TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> AsQuery = Exec(TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"path":["actors"]},"stages":[{"op":"where","pred":{"op":"==","args":[{"path":["Label"]},{"lit":"RqlSpecLamp"}]}},{"op":"set","assign":[{"target":{"path":["Location"]},"value":{"lit":"(-5, 0, 0)"}}]}]})RQL"));
			TestFalse(TEXT("rql-query refuses set"), IsOk(AsQuery));
			TestTrue(*FString::Printf(TEXT("permission-denied (%s)"), *Codes(AsQuery)), Codes(AsQuery).Contains(TEXT("permission-denied")));

			// actors | where Label == "RqlSpecLamp" | set Name = "Renamed"
			const TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> ReadOnly = Exec(TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"path":["actors"]},"stages":[{"op":"where","pred":{"op":"==","args":[{"path":["Label"]},{"lit":"RqlSpecLamp"}]}},{"op":"set","assign":[{"target":{"path":["Name"]},"value":{"lit":"Renamed"}}]}]})RQL"), true);
			TestFalse(TEXT("Name is read-only"), IsOk(ReadOnly));
			TestTrue(*FString::Printf(TEXT("readonly-member (%s)"), *Codes(ReadOnly)), Codes(ReadOnly).Contains(TEXT("readonly-member")));
		});

		It("walks components and writes reflected component properties", [this]()
		{
			SpawnLamp();
			// actors | where Label == "RqlSpecLamp" | get Components | select $type
			const TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> Types = Exec(TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"path":["actors"]},"stages":[{"op":"where","pred":{"op":"==","args":[{"path":["Label"]},{"lit":"RqlSpecLamp"}]}},{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Components"]}},{"op":"select","fields":[{"name":"$type","expr":{"path":[{"meta":"type"}]}}]}]})RQL"));
			TestTrue(*FString::Printf(TEXT("components ok (%s)"), *Codes(Types)), IsOk(Types));
			bool bHasLight = false;
			for (int32 Row = 0; Row < RowCount(Types); ++Row)
				bHasLight |= CellText(Types, Row, 0) == TEXT("PointLightComponent");
			TestTrue(TEXT("the point light component is listed"), bHasLight);

			// actors | where Label == "RqlSpecLamp" | get Components | where $ is PointLightComponent | set Intensity = 1234
			const TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> Set = Exec(TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"path":["actors"]},"stages":[{"op":"where","pred":{"op":"==","args":[{"path":["Label"]},{"lit":"RqlSpecLamp"}]}},{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Components"]}},{"op":"where","pred":{"op":"is","args":[{"path":[]},{"lit":"PointLightComponent"}]}},{"op":"set","assign":[{"target":{"path":["Intensity"]},"value":{"lit":1234}}]}]})RQL"), true);
			TestTrue(*FString::Printf(TEXT("set ok (%s)"), *Codes(Set)), IsOk(Set));
			TArray<AActor*> Found = Lamps();
			const APointLight* Lamp = Found.Num() == 1 ? Cast<APointLight>(Found[0]) : nullptr;
			TestTrue(TEXT("intensity written"), Lamp && Lamp->PointLightComponent && FMath::IsNearlyEqual(Lamp->PointLightComponent->Intensity, 1234.0f));

			// ... | select Intensity
			const TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> Read = Exec(TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"path":["actors"]},"stages":[{"op":"where","pred":{"op":"==","args":[{"path":["Label"]},{"lit":"RqlSpecLamp"}]}},{"op":"get","expr":{"path":["Components"]}},{"op":"where","pred":{"op":"is","args":[{"path":[]},{"lit":"PointLightComponent"}]}},{"op":"select","fields":[{"name":"Intensity","expr":{"path":["Intensity"]}}]}]})RQL"));
			const TSharedPtr<FJsonValue> Intensity = Cell(Read, 0, 0);
			TestTrue(TEXT("intensity reads back"), Intensity.IsValid() && FMath::IsNearlyEqual(Intensity->AsNumber(), 1234.0));
		});

		It("adds components, duplicates and destroys actors", [this]()
		{
			SpawnLamp();
			// actors | where Label == "RqlSpecLamp" | call AddComponent("StaticMeshComponent", "RqlSpecMesh")
			const TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> Added = Exec(TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"path":["actors"]},"stages":[{"op":"where","pred":{"op":"==","args":[{"path":["Label"]},{"lit":"RqlSpecLamp"}]}},{"op":"call","method":"AddComponent","args":[{"lit":"StaticMeshComponent"},{"lit":"RqlSpecMesh"}]}]})RQL"), true);
			TestTrue(*FString::Printf(TEXT("add ok (%s)"), *Codes(Added)), IsOk(Added));
			TArray<AActor*> Found = Lamps();
			TestTrue(TEXT("component added"), Found.Num() == 1 && Found[0]->GetInstanceComponents().Num() == 1);

			// actors | where Label == "RqlSpecLamp" | call Duplicate("(100, 0, 0)")
			const TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> Copied = Exec(TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"path":["actors"]},"stages":[{"op":"where","pred":{"op":"==","args":[{"path":["Label"]},{"lit":"RqlSpecLamp"}]}},{"op":"call","method":"Duplicate","args":[{"lit":"(100, 0, 0)"}]}]})RQL"), true);
			TestTrue(*FString::Printf(TEXT("duplicate ok (%s)"), *Codes(Copied)), IsOk(Copied));
			TestEqual(TEXT("two lamps"), Lamps().Num(), 2);

			// actors | where Label == "RqlSpecLamp" | call Destroy()
			const TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> Destroyed = Exec(TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"path":["actors"]},"stages":[{"op":"where","pred":{"op":"==","args":[{"path":["Label"]},{"lit":"RqlSpecLamp"}]}},{"op":"call","method":"Destroy","args":[]}]})RQL"), true);
			TestTrue(*FString::Printf(TEXT("destroy ok (%s)"), *Codes(Destroyed)), IsOk(Destroyed));
			TestEqual(TEXT("the original is gone"), CountLamps(), 0);
		});

		It("duplicates an actor at its own world transform plus the offset", [this]()
		{
			SpawnLamp();
			TArray<AActor*> Found = Lamps();
			if (!TestEqual(TEXT("one lamp"), Found.Num(), 1))
				return;
			// A root transform that is not identity: SpawnActor with a template would apply it twice.
			Found[0]->SetActorLocationAndRotation(FVector(0, 0, 150), FRotator(0, 45, 0));
			Found[0]->SetActorScale3D(FVector(2, 2, 0.5));
			// actors | where Label == "RqlSpecLamp" | call Duplicate("(300, 0, 0)")
			const TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> Copied = Exec(TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"path":["actors"]},"stages":[{"op":"where","pred":{"op":"==","args":[{"path":["Label"]},{"lit":"RqlSpecLamp"}]}},{"op":"call","method":"Duplicate","args":[{"lit":"(300, 0, 0)"}]}]})RQL"), true);
			TestTrue(*FString::Printf(TEXT("duplicate ok (%s)"), *Codes(Copied)), IsOk(Copied));
			AActor* Copy = nullptr;
			for (AActor* Actor : Lamps())
				Copy = Actor != Found[0] ? Actor : Copy;
			if (!TestNotNull(TEXT("the copy"), Copy))
				return;
			TestTrue(*FString::Printf(TEXT("location + offset (%s)"), *Copy->GetActorLocation().ToString()), Copy->GetActorLocation().Equals(FVector(300, 0, 150), 0.01));
			TestTrue(*FString::Printf(TEXT("same scale (%s)"), *Copy->GetActorScale3D().ToString()), Copy->GetActorScale3D().Equals(FVector(2, 2, 0.5), 0.001));
			TestTrue(*FString::Printf(TEXT("same rotation (%s)"), *Copy->GetActorRotation().ToString()), Copy->GetActorRotation().Equals(FRotator(0, 45, 0), 0.01));
		});

		It("spawns with the given rotation as the final one, and keeps the class default without one", [this]()
		{
			// editor | call SpawnActor("SpotLight", "RqlSpecLampSpot", "(0, 0, 300)", "(-90, 0, 0)")
			const TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> Rotated = Exec(TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"path":["editor"]},"stages":[{"op":"call","method":"SpawnActor","args":[{"lit":"SpotLight"},{"lit":"RqlSpecLampSpot"},{"lit":"(0, 0, 300)"},{"lit":"(-90, 0, 0)"}]}]})RQL"), true);
			// editor | call SpawnActor("SpotLight", "RqlSpecLampSpotDefault", "(0, 0, 300)")
			const TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> Default = Exec(TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"path":["editor"]},"stages":[{"op":"call","method":"SpawnActor","args":[{"lit":"SpotLight"},{"lit":"RqlSpecLampSpotDefault"},{"lit":"(0, 0, 300)"}]}]})RQL"), true);
			TestTrue(*FString::Printf(TEXT("spawned (%s %s)"), *Codes(Rotated), *Codes(Default)), IsOk(Rotated) && IsOk(Default));
			TestEqual(TEXT("two spot lights"), Lamps().Num(), 2);
			for (AActor* Actor : Lamps())
			{
				// Both point down: the given -90 pitch, and the SpotLight's own default.
				TestTrue(*FString::Printf(TEXT("%s points down (%s)"), *Actor->GetActorLabel(), *Actor->GetActorForwardVector().ToString()),
					Actor->GetActorForwardVector().Equals(FVector(0, 0, -1), 0.001));
			}
		});

		It("writes Layers through the Layers subsystem: missing layers are created, removed ones leave the actor, undo restores", [this]()
		{
			SpawnLamp();
			TArray<AActor*> Found = Lamps();
			ULayersSubsystem* LayersSubsystem = GEditor ? GEditor->GetEditorSubsystem<ULayersSubsystem>() : nullptr;
			if (!TestEqual(TEXT("one lamp"), Found.Num(), 1) || !TestNotNull(TEXT("layers subsystem"), LayersSubsystem))
				return;
			AActor* Lamp = Found[0];
			if (Lamp->GetLevel()->bIsPartitioned)
			{
				// A World Partition world (the full suite can leave one open): actors there take data layers, not editor layers.
				// actors | where Label == "RqlSpecLamp" | set Layers = ["RqlSpecLayerB"]
				const TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> Refused = Exec(TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"path":["actors"]},"stages":[{"op":"where","pred":{"op":"==","args":[{"path":["Label"]},{"lit":"RqlSpecLamp"}]}},{"op":"set","assign":[{"target":{"path":["Layers"]},"value":{"list":[{"lit":"RqlSpecLayerB"}]}}]}]})RQL"), true);
				TestTrue(*FString::Printf(TEXT("refused, naming data layers (%s)"), *Codes(Refused)), !IsOk(Refused) && Codes(Refused).Contains(TEXT("data layers")));
				return;
			}
			// A raw name already on the actor (what a plain property write used to leave) gets its layer created too.
			Lamp->Layers.Add(TEXT("RqlSpecLayerA"));
			// actors | where Label == "RqlSpecLamp" | set Layers = ["RqlSpecLayerA", "RqlSpecLayerB"]
			const TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> Both = Exec(TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"path":["actors"]},"stages":[{"op":"where","pred":{"op":"==","args":[{"path":["Label"]},{"lit":"RqlSpecLamp"}]}},{"op":"set","assign":[{"target":{"path":["Layers"]},"value":{"list":[{"lit":"RqlSpecLayerA"},{"lit":"RqlSpecLayerB"}]}}]}]})RQL"), true);
			TestTrue(*FString::Printf(TEXT("set (%s)"), *Codes(Both)), IsOk(Both));
			TestTrue(TEXT("layer A exists in the world (the Layers panel lists it)"), LayersSubsystem->IsLayer(TEXT("RqlSpecLayerA")));
			TestTrue(TEXT("layer B exists"), LayersSubsystem->IsLayer(TEXT("RqlSpecLayerB")));
			TestTrue(TEXT("the actor is in layer A"), LayersSubsystem->GetActorsFromLayer(TEXT("RqlSpecLayerA")).Contains(Lamp));
			// actors | where Label == "RqlSpecLamp" | set Layers = ["RqlSpecLayerB"]
			const TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> OnlyB = Exec(TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"path":["actors"]},"stages":[{"op":"where","pred":{"op":"==","args":[{"path":["Label"]},{"lit":"RqlSpecLamp"}]}},{"op":"set","assign":[{"target":{"path":["Layers"]},"value":{"list":[{"lit":"RqlSpecLayerB"}]}}]}]})RQL"), true);
			TestTrue(*FString::Printf(TEXT("replaced (%s)"), *Codes(OnlyB)), IsOk(OnlyB));
			TestFalse(TEXT("left layer A"), LayersSubsystem->GetActorsFromLayer(TEXT("RqlSpecLayerA")).Contains(Lamp));
			TestTrue(TEXT("still in layer B"), LayersSubsystem->GetActorsFromLayer(TEXT("RqlSpecLayerB")).Contains(Lamp));
			// actors | where Label == "RqlSpecLamp" | select Layers
			const TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> Read = Exec(TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"path":["actors"]},"stages":[{"op":"where","pred":{"op":"==","args":[{"path":["Label"]},{"lit":"RqlSpecLamp"}]}},{"op":"select","fields":[{"name":"Layers","expr":{"path":["Layers"]}}]}]})RQL"));
			const TSharedPtr<FJsonValue> Names = Cell(Read, 0, 0);
			TestTrue(*FString::Printf(TEXT("reads the names (%s)"), *Codes(Read)), Names.IsValid() && Names->Type == EJson::Array
				&& Names->AsArray().Num() == 1 && Names->AsArray()[0]->AsString() == TEXT("RqlSpecLayerB"));
			// actors | where Label == "RqlSpecLamp" | set Layers = [""]
			const TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> Empty = Exec(TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"path":["actors"]},"stages":[{"op":"where","pred":{"op":"==","args":[{"path":["Label"]},{"lit":"RqlSpecLamp"}]}},{"op":"set","assign":[{"target":{"path":["Layers"]},"value":{"list":[{"lit":""}]}}]}]})RQL"), true);
			TestTrue(*FString::Printf(TEXT("an empty name is refused (%s)"), *Codes(Empty)), !IsOk(Empty) && Codes(Empty).Contains(TEXT("cannot be empty")));
			GEditor->UndoTransaction();
			TestTrue(TEXT("undo puts the actor back in layer A"), Lamp->Layers.Contains(FName(TEXT("RqlSpecLayerA"))) && Lamp->Layers.Contains(FName(TEXT("RqlSpecLayerB"))));
			LayersSubsystem->DeleteLayer(TEXT("RqlSpecLayerA"));
			LayersSubsystem->DeleteLayer(TEXT("RqlSpecLayerB"));
		});

		It("reads Folder as null without a folder, and compares and prints transforms cleanly", [this]()
		{
			SpawnLamp();
			TArray<AActor*> Found = Lamps();
			if (!TestEqual(TEXT("one lamp"), Found.Num(), 1))
				return;
			// A quaternion round trip leaves double noise (-46.000000000000036) in the rotator.
			Found[0]->SetActorRotation(FQuat(FRotator(-46, 0, 0)));
			// actors | where Label == "RqlSpecLamp" | select Folder Rotation
			const TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> Read = Exec(TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"path":["actors"]},"stages":[{"op":"where","pred":{"op":"==","args":[{"path":["Label"]},{"lit":"RqlSpecLamp"}]}},{"op":"select","fields":[{"name":"Folder","expr":{"path":["Folder"]}},{"name":"Rotation","expr":{"path":["Rotation"]}}]}]})RQL"));
			const TSharedPtr<FJsonValue> Folder = Cell(Read, 0, 0);
			TestTrue(*FString::Printf(TEXT("folder null (%s)"), *Codes(Read)), Folder.IsValid() && Folder->IsNull());
			TestEqual(TEXT("rotation without noise"), CellText(Read, 0, 1), FString(TEXT("(-46, 0, 0)")));
			// actors | where Label == "RqlSpecLamp" and Folder is null | count
			const TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> NoFolder = Exec(TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"path":["actors"]},"stages":[{"op":"where","pred":{"op":"and","args":[{"op":"==","args":[{"path":["Label"]},{"lit":"RqlSpecLamp"}]},{"op":"==","args":[{"path":["Folder"]},{"lit":null}]}]}},{"op":"count"}]})RQL"));
			TestEqual(TEXT("is null finds it"), UnrealMcpRqlSpecHelpers::Number(NoFolder), 1.0);
			// actors | where Label == "RqlSpecLamp" and Location == {X: 1, Y: 2, Z: 3} | count
			const TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> ByObject = Exec(TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"path":["actors"]},"stages":[{"op":"where","pred":{"op":"and","args":[{"op":"==","args":[{"path":["Label"]},{"lit":"RqlSpecLamp"}]},{"op":"==","args":[{"path":["Location"]},{"object":[{"key":"X","value":{"lit":1}},{"key":"Y","value":{"lit":2}},{"key":"Z","value":{"lit":3}}]}]}]}},{"op":"count"}]})RQL"));
			TestEqual(*FString::Printf(TEXT("Location == object literal (%s)"), *Codes(ByObject)), UnrealMcpRqlSpecHelpers::Number(ByObject), 1.0);
		});

		It("refuses deleting an asset unsaved assets use, and names abstract classes and existing imports", [this]()
		{
			// A fresh folder per run: dropped assets stay in the asset registry until the editor restarts.
			const FString Folder = FString::Printf(TEXT("/Game/RqlSpecDelete/Run%s"), *FGuid::NewGuid().ToString(EGuidFormats::Digits));
			auto Plan = [&Folder](const TCHAR* Json) { return FString(Json).Replace(TEXT("/Game/RqlSpecDelete"), *Folder); };
			auto Drop = [&Folder]()
			{
				for (const TCHAR* Name : { TEXT("MI_Child"), TEXT("M_Base"), TEXT("RqlSpecPixel") })
					UnrealMcpRqlSpecHelpers::DropObject(FindObject<UObject>(nullptr, *FString::Printf(TEXT("%s/%s.%s"), *Folder, Name, Name)));
			};
			// editor | call CreateAsset("/Game/RqlSpecDelete/M_Base", "Material")
			const TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> Base = Exec(Plan(TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"path":["editor"]},"stages":[{"op":"call","method":"CreateAsset","args":[{"lit":"/Game/RqlSpecDelete/M_Base"},{"lit":"Material"}]}]})RQL")), true);
			// editor | call CreateMaterialInstance("/Game/RqlSpecDelete/MI_Child", "/Game/RqlSpecDelete/M_Base")
			const TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> Child = Exec(Plan(TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"path":["editor"]},"stages":[{"op":"call","method":"CreateMaterialInstance","args":[{"lit":"/Game/RqlSpecDelete/MI_Child"},{"lit":"/Game/RqlSpecDelete/M_Base"}]}]})RQL")), true);
			TestTrue(*FString::Printf(TEXT("created (%s %s)"), *Codes(Base), *Codes(Child)), IsOk(Base) && IsOk(Child));
			// editor | call DeleteAsset("/Game/RqlSpecDelete/M_Base")
			const TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> Deleted = Exec(Plan(TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"path":["editor"]},"stages":[{"op":"call","method":"DeleteAsset","args":[{"lit":"/Game/RqlSpecDelete/M_Base"}]}]})RQL")), true);
			TestFalse(TEXT("delete refused"), IsOk(Deleted));
			TestTrue(*FString::Printf(TEXT("names the unsaved referencer (%s)"), *Codes(Deleted)), Codes(Deleted).Contains(Folder + TEXT("/MI_Child")));
			TestNotNull(TEXT("the material is still there"), FindObject<UObject>(nullptr, *(Folder + TEXT("/M_Base.M_Base"))));

			// editor | call CreateAsset("/Game/RqlSpecDelete/DA_Abstract", "PrimaryDataAsset")
			const TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> Abstract = Exec(Plan(TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"path":["editor"]},"stages":[{"op":"call","method":"CreateAsset","args":[{"lit":"/Game/RqlSpecDelete/DA_Abstract"},{"lit":"PrimaryDataAsset"}]}]})RQL")), true);
			TestTrue(*FString::Printf(TEXT("abstract named (%s)"), *Codes(Abstract)), !IsOk(Abstract) && Codes(Abstract).Contains(TEXT("is abstract")));

			// A 1x1 PNG, imported twice: the second time it exists.
			static const uint8 Png[] = { 0x89,0x50,0x4E,0x47,0x0D,0x0A,0x1A,0x0A,0x00,0x00,0x00,0x0D,0x49,0x48,0x44,0x52,0x00,0x00,0x00,0x01,0x00,0x00,0x00,0x01,
				0x08,0x02,0x00,0x00,0x00,0x90,0x77,0x53,0xDE,0x00,0x00,0x00,0x0C,0x49,0x44,0x41,0x54,0x08,0xD7,0x63,0xF8,0xCF,0xC0,0x00,0x00,0x03,0x01,0x01,
				0x00,0x18,0xDD,0x8D,0xB0,0x00,0x00,0x00,0x00,0x49,0x45,0x4E,0x44,0xAE,0x42,0x60,0x82 };
			const FString File = FPaths::ConvertRelativePathToFull(FPaths::Combine(FPaths::ProjectIntermediateDir(), TEXT("RqlSpec"), TEXT("RqlSpecPixel.png")));
			TestTrue(TEXT("png written"), FFileHelper::SaveArrayToFile(TArrayView<const uint8>(Png, UE_ARRAY_COUNT(Png)), *File));
			// editor | call ImportAsset("@FILE@", "/Game/RqlSpecDelete")
			const FString Import = Plan(TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"path":["editor"]},"stages":[{"op":"call","method":"ImportAsset","args":[{"lit":"@FILE@"},{"lit":"/Game/RqlSpecDelete"}]}]})RQL")).Replace(TEXT("@FILE@"), *File);
			const TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> First = Exec(Import, true);
			TestTrue(*FString::Printf(TEXT("first import (%s)"), *Codes(First)), IsOk(First));
			const TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> Second = Exec(Import, true);
			TestTrue(*FString::Printf(TEXT("second import says it exists (%s)"), *Codes(Second)), !IsOk(Second) && Codes(Second).Contains(TEXT("already exists")));
			IFileManager::Get().Delete(*File, false, true);
			Drop();
		});

		It("lists every asset an import creates, not only the mesh", [this]()
		{
			const FString Folder = FString::Printf(TEXT("/Game/RqlSpecImport/Run%s"), *FGuid::NewGuid().ToString(EGuidFormats::Digits));
			// A one-triangle OBJ with a material: the importer makes the mesh and a material next to it.
			const FString File = FPaths::ConvertRelativePathToFull(FPaths::Combine(FPaths::ProjectIntermediateDir(), TEXT("RqlSpec"), TEXT("RqlSpecTri.obj")));
			TestTrue(TEXT("obj written"), FFileHelper::SaveStringToFile(
				TEXT("v 0 0 0\nv 100 0 0\nv 0 100 0\nvn 0 0 1\nvt 0 0\nvt 1 0\nvt 0 1\nusemtl RqlSpecRed\nf 1/1/1 2/2/1 3/3/1\n"), *File));
			// editor | call ImportAsset("@FILE@", "@FOLDER@")
			const FString Import = FString(TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"path":["editor"]},"stages":[{"op":"call","method":"ImportAsset","args":[{"lit":"@FILE@"},{"lit":"@FOLDER@"}]}]})RQL"))
				.Replace(TEXT("@FILE@"), *File).Replace(TEXT("@FOLDER@"), *(Folder + TEXT("/"))); // a trailing slash works too
			const TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> Imported = Exec(Import, true);
			TestTrue(*FString::Printf(TEXT("import ok (%s)"), *Codes(Imported)), IsOk(Imported));
			const TSharedPtr<FJsonValue> Result = Cell(Imported, 0, 2);
			TArray<FString> Refs;
			if (Result.IsValid() && Result->Type == EJson::Array)
			{
				for (const TSharedPtr<FJsonValue>& Item : Result->AsArray())
				{
					FString Ref;
					if (Item->Type == EJson::Object && Item->AsObject()->TryGetStringField(TEXT("$ref"), Ref))
						Refs.Add(Ref);
				}
			}
			const FString Listed = FString::Join(Refs, TEXT(", "));
			TestTrue(*FString::Printf(TEXT("the mesh first (%s)"), *Listed), Refs.Num() > 0 && Refs[0].StartsWith(TEXT("StaticMesh#")));
			TestTrue(*FString::Printf(TEXT("and the material it created (%s)"), *Listed), Refs.ContainsByPredicate([](const FString& Ref) { return Ref.StartsWith(TEXT("Material")); }));
			IFileManager::Get().Delete(*File, false, true);
			TArray<FAssetData> Created;
			FModuleManager::LoadModuleChecked<FAssetRegistryModule>(TEXT("AssetRegistry")).Get().GetAssetsByPath(FName(*Folder), Created, /*bRecursive*/ true);
			for (const FAssetData& Data : Created)
				UnrealMcpRqlSpecHelpers::DropObject(Data.FastGetAsset(/*bLoad*/ false));
		});

		It("accepts object references as text (an actor label for an Actor parameter)", [this]()
		{
			SpawnLamp();
			// editor | call SpawnActor("PointLight", "RqlSpecLamp2", "(0, 0, 0)", "(0, 0, 0)", "RqlSpecLamp")
			const TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> Child = Exec(TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"path":["editor"]},"stages":[{"op":"call","method":"SpawnActor","args":[{"lit":"PointLight"},{"lit":"RqlSpecLamp2"},{"lit":"(0, 0, 0)"},{"lit":"(0, 0, 0)"},{"lit":"RqlSpecLamp"}]}]})RQL"), true);
			TestTrue(*FString::Printf(TEXT("spawn with a parent ok (%s)"), *Codes(Child)), IsOk(Child));
			AActor* Parent = nullptr;
			AActor* Attached = nullptr;
			for (AActor* Actor : Lamps())
			{
				if (Actor->GetActorLabel() == TEXT("RqlSpecLamp")) Parent = Actor;
				if (Actor->GetActorLabel() == TEXT("RqlSpecLamp2")) Attached = Actor;

		It("gives a spawned class without a root component a scene root, so it keeps its location and can be a parent", [this]()
		{
			// editor | call SpawnActor("Actor", "RqlSpecLampRig", "(100, 200, 0)")
			const TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> Rig = Exec(TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"path":["editor"]},"stages":[{"op":"call","method":"SpawnActor","args":[{"lit":"Actor"},{"lit":"RqlSpecLampRig"},{"lit":"(100, 200, 0)"}]}]})RQL"), true);
			TestTrue(*FString::Printf(TEXT("spawn a plain Actor ok (%s)"), *Codes(Rig)), IsOk(Rig));
			// editor | call SpawnActor("PointLight", "RqlSpecLamp", "(0, 0, 0)", "(0, 0, 0)", unreal.find("RqlSpecLampRig"))
			const TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> Child = Exec(TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"path":["editor"]},"stages":[{"op":"call","method":"SpawnActor","args":[{"lit":"PointLight"},{"lit":"RqlSpecLamp"},{"lit":"(0, 0, 0)"},{"lit":"(0, 0, 0)"},{"call":"find","on":{"path":["unreal"]},"args":[{"lit":"RqlSpecLampRig"}]}]}]})RQL"), true);
			TestTrue(*FString::Printf(TEXT("spawn under it ok (%s)"), *Codes(Child)), IsOk(Child));
			AActor* Parent = nullptr;
			AActor* Attached = nullptr;
			for (AActor* Actor : Lamps())
			{
				if (Actor->GetActorLabel() == TEXT("RqlSpecLampRig")) Parent = Actor;
				if (Actor->GetActorLabel() == TEXT("RqlSpecLamp")) Attached = Actor;
			}
			if (!TestTrue(TEXT("both spawned"), Parent && Attached))
				return;
			TestTrue(TEXT("the plain Actor has a root"), Parent->GetRootComponent() != nullptr);
			TestEqual(TEXT("and kept its location"), Parent->GetActorLocation(), FVector(100, 200, 0));
			TestTrue(TEXT("the child is attached"), Attached->GetAttachParentActor() == Parent);
		});

		It("resolves stable refs and unreal.find", [this]()
		{
			SpawnLamp();
			TArray<AActor*> Found = Lamps();
			if (!TestEqual(TEXT("spawned"), Found.Num(), 1))
				return;
			// unreal.find("RqlSpecLamp") | select Label
			const TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> ByName = Exec(TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"call":"find","on":{"path":["unreal"]},"args":[{"lit":"RqlSpecLamp"}]},"stages":[{"op":"select","fields":[{"name":"Label","expr":{"path":["Label"]}}]}]})RQL"));
			TestEqual(*FString::Printf(TEXT("unreal.find (%s)"), *Codes(ByName)), CellText(ByName, 0, 0), FString(TEXT("RqlSpecLamp")));
			// unreal.find("RqlSpecLamp") | select $ref
			const TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> RefRow = Exec(TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"call":"find","on":{"path":["unreal"]},"args":[{"lit":"RqlSpecLamp"}]},"stages":[{"op":"select","fields":[{"name":"$ref","expr":{"path":[{"meta":"ref"}]}}]}]})RQL"));
			const FString Ref = CellText(RefRow, 0, 0);
			TestTrue(*FString::Printf(TEXT("a PointLight ref (%s)"), *Ref), Ref.StartsWith(TEXT("PointLight#")));
			// ref("PointLight#<id>") | select Label
			const FString RefPlan = FString::Printf(TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"call":"ref","args":[{"lit":"%s"}]},"stages":[{"op":"select","fields":[{"name":"Label","expr":{"path":["Label"]}}]}]})RQL"), *Ref);
			const TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> ByRef = Exec(RefPlan);
			TestEqual(*FString::Printf(TEXT("ref (%s)"), *Codes(ByRef)), CellText(ByRef, 0, 0), FString(TEXT("RqlSpecLamp")));

			// A destroyed actor's ref never resolves to another object (the id carries the slot's serial number).
			Found[0]->GetWorld()->EditorDestroyActor(Found[0], true);
			SpawnLamp();
			const TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> Stale = Exec(RefPlan);
			TestEqual(TEXT("a stale ref finds nothing"), RowCount(Stale), 0);
		});

		It("writes and reads the editor selection", [this]()
		{
			SpawnLamp();
			// editor | set Selection = [unreal.find("RqlSpecLamp")]
```
