```cpp
namespace UnrealMcpRqlEditorApiLocal
{
	IAssetTools& AssetTools()
	{
		return FModuleManager::LoadModuleChecked<FAssetToolsModule>(TEXT("AssetTools")).Get();
	}

	using UnrealMcpRql::Failed;

	/** The tail of every spawn: the final rotation, a root for root-less classes, the label and the parent. */
	AActor* FinishSpawnedActor(AActor* Actor, const FVector& Location, const FRotator& Rotation, const FString& Label, AActor* Parent)
	{
		UWorld* World = Actor->GetWorld();
		// SpawnActor composes the class's default root rotation (a SpotLight's -90 pitch) with Rotation. A rotation the
		// caller gave is the final one; none keeps the class default (a SpotLight points down).
		if (!Rotation.IsZero() && Actor->GetRootComponent())
		{
			Actor->SetActorRotation(Rotation, ETeleportType::TeleportPhysics);
			Actor->PostEditMove(/*bFinished*/ true); // construction scripts ran at the composed rotation
		}
		// A class without a root component (a plain Actor) has no transform: the location would be dropped and nothing
		// could attach to it. Give it the scene root the editor's Empty Actor gets (UActorFactoryEmptyActor).
		if (!Actor->GetRootComponent() && !UnrealMcpRql::AddComponent(Actor, USceneComponent::StaticClass(),
			USceneComponent::GetDefaultSceneRootVariableName().ToString(), [&Location, &Rotation](UActorComponent* Component)
			{
				USceneComponent* Root = CastChecked<USceneComponent>(Component);
				Root->Mobility = EComponentMobility::Movable;
				Root->bVisualizeComponent = true;
				Root->SetWorldLocationAndRotation(Location, Rotation);
			}))
		{
			World->EditorDestroyActor(Actor, /*bShouldModifyLevel*/ true);
			return nullptr;
		}
		if (!Label.IsEmpty())
			FActorLabelUtilities::SetActorLabelUnique(Actor, Label);
		if (Parent)
		{
			Actor->AttachToActor(Parent, FAttachmentTransformRules::KeepWorldTransform);
			if (Actor->GetAttachParentActor() != Parent)
			{
				const FString Reason = UnrealMcpRqlAttachFailure(Actor, Parent);
				World->EditorDestroyActor(Actor, /*bShouldModifyLevel*/ true);
				return Failed<AActor*>(FString::Printf(TEXT("could not attach to %s%s"), *Parent->GetActorLabel(), *Reason));
			}
		}
		return Actor;
	}

	/**
	 * The generated class of the one actor Blueprint asset named @p Name ("BP_Door"); null when there is none, or when
	 * several have the name (their paths in @p OutAmbiguous).
	 */
	UClass* BlueprintClassByName(const FString& Name, TArray<FString>& OutAmbiguous)
	{
		if (Name.IsEmpty() || Name.Contains(TEXT("/")) || Name.Contains(TEXT(".")))
			return nullptr;
		IAssetRegistry& Registry = FModuleManager::LoadModuleChecked<FAssetRegistryModule>(TEXT("AssetRegistry")).Get();
		TArray<FAssetData> Found;
		Registry.GetAssetsByClass(UBlueprint::StaticClass()->GetClassPathName(), Found, /*bSearchSubClasses*/ true);
		UClass* Match = nullptr;
		TArray<FString> Paths;
		for (const FAssetData& Data : Found)
		{
			if (!Data.AssetName.ToString().Equals(Name, ESearchCase::IgnoreCase))
				continue;
			const UBlueprint* Blueprint = Cast<UBlueprint>(Data.GetAsset());
			UClass* Class = Blueprint ? Blueprint->GeneratedClass.Get() : nullptr;
			if (!Class || !Class->IsChildOf(AActor::StaticClass()))
				continue;
			Paths.Add(Data.PackageName.ToString());
			Match = Class;
		}
		if (Paths.Num() > 1)
		{
			OutAmbiguous = MoveTemp(Paths);
			return nullptr;
		}
		return Match;
	}

	/** Writes stay inside project / plugin content: /Engine, /Script and /Temp are refused. */
	bool IsWritableRoot(const FString& Path)
	{
		for (const TCHAR* Root : { TEXT("/Engine"), TEXT("/Script"), TEXT("/Temp") })
		{
			if (Path.Equals(Root) || Path.StartsWith(FString(Root) + TEXT("/")))
				return false;
		}
		return true;
	}

	/** Long package name of an asset path ("/Game/Maps/Arena" or its object path); false + reason for a malformed path. */
	bool ToPackageName(const FString& Path, FString& OutPackage, FString& OutError)
	{
		OutPackage = Path.TrimStartAndEnd();
		if (FPackageName::IsValidObjectPath(OutPackage))
			OutPackage = FPackageName::ObjectPathToPackageName(OutPackage);
		if (!FPackageName::IsValidLongPackageName(OutPackage))
		{
			OutError = FString::Printf(TEXT("'%s' is not a valid asset path (expected e.g. '/Game/Maps/Arena')"), *Path);
			return false;
		}
		return true;
	}

	/**
	 * The folder and name of a new asset at @p Path: a valid, writable (project / plugin) package path where no asset is
	 * yet. False after reporting why (UnrealMcpRql::Fail).
	 */
	bool ValidateNewAssetPath(const FString& Path, FString& OutFolder, FString& OutName)
	{
		FString Package, Error;
		if (!ToPackageName(Path, Package, Error) || !IsWritableRoot(Package))
			return Failed<bool>(FString::Printf(TEXT("'%s' is not a writable asset path (use e.g. /Game/Folder/Name)"), *Path));
		if (UEditorAssetLibrary::DoesAssetExist(Package))
			return Failed<bool>(FString::Printf(TEXT("'%s' already exists"), *Package));
		OutFolder = FPackageName::GetLongPackagePath(Package);
		OutName = FPackageName::GetShortName(Package);
		return true;
	}

	/** On-disk .umap of an existing level package; false + reason otherwise (a missing map would log an engine error). */
	bool LevelFile(const FString& Path, FString& OutFile, FString& OutError)
	{
		FString Package;
		if (!ToPackageName(Path, Package, OutError))
			return false;
		if (!FPackageName::DoesPackageExist(Package, &OutFile))
		{
			UPackage* Loaded = FindPackage(nullptr, *Package);
			OutError = Loaded && UWorld::FindWorldInPackage(Loaded)
				? FString::Printf(TEXT("the level '%s' is not saved yet: editor | call SaveAsset(\"%s\") first"), *Package, *Package)
				: FString::Printf(TEXT("no level at '%s'"), *Package);
			return false;
		}
		if (!OutFile.EndsWith(FPackageName::GetMapPackageExtension(), ESearchCase::IgnoreCase))
		{
			OutError = FString::Printf(TEXT("'%s' is not a level"), *Package);
			return false;
		}
		return true;
	}
}

using namespace UnrealMcpRqlEditorApiLocal;

AActor* UnrealMcpRql::SpawnActor(UClass* Class, const FVector& Location, const FRotator& Rotation, const FString& Label, AActor* Parent)
{
	UWorld* World = FUnrealMcpObjectRef::GetEditorWorld();
	if (!World)
		return Failed<AActor*>(TEXT("no editor world"));
	if (!Class || !Class->IsChildOf(AActor::StaticClass()))
		return Failed<AActor*>(TEXT("not an actor class"));
	if (Class->HasAnyClassFlags(CLASS_Abstract))
		return Failed<AActor*>(FString::Printf(TEXT("'%s' is abstract"), *Class->GetName()));
	// UWorld::SpawnActor rather than the editor actor subsystem: no viewport snapping (headless-safe). The open RQL
	// transaction records the transactional actor, so Ctrl+Z removes it.
	FActorSpawnParameters Params;
	Params.ObjectFlags |= RF_Transactional;
	AActor* Actor = World->SpawnActor<AActor>(Class, Location, Rotation, Params);
	if (!Actor)
		return Failed<AActor*>(FString::Printf(TEXT("could not spawn %s"), *Class->GetName()));
	// A volume is its brush: spawned bare it has no shape, so a NavMeshBoundsVolume / TriggerVolume / PostProcessVolume
	// would bound nothing. Give it the editor's default box (200 cm, as the Place Actors panel does); Scale sizes it.
	if (AVolume* Volume = Cast<AVolume>(Actor); Volume && !Volume->Brush)
		UnrealMcpRqlBuildVolumeBox(Volume, FVector(100.0));
	return FinishSpawnedActor(Actor, Location, Rotation, Label, Parent);
}

void UnrealMcpRqlBuildVolumeBox(AVolume* Volume, const FVector& HalfExtent)
{
	// The editor's box brush (what the Brush Settings' Cube builder makes), centred on the actor.
	UCubeBuilder* Builder = NewObject<UCubeBuilder>();
	FGCObjectScopeGuard BuilderGuard(Builder);
	Builder->X = static_cast<float>(2.0 * HalfExtent.X);
	Builder->Y = static_cast<float>(2.0 * HalfExtent.Y);
	Builder->Z = static_cast<float>(2.0 * HalfExtent.Z);
	if (UBrushComponent* Component = Volume->GetBrushComponent())
		Component->Modify(); // the brush it points at is replaced: undo restores the old one
	UActorFactory::CreateBrushForVolumeActor(Volume, Builder);
}

FString UnrealMcpRqlAttachFailure(const AActor* Actor, const AActor* Parent)
{
	const USceneComponent* Root = Actor ? Actor->GetRootComponent() : nullptr;
	const USceneComponent* ParentRoot = Parent ? Parent->GetRootComponent() : nullptr;
	if (!Root)
		return TEXT(": it has no root component (no transform)");
	if (!ParentRoot)
		return FString::Printf(TEXT(": %s has no root component (no transform); give it one with AddComponent(\"SceneComponent\", \"Root\")"),
			*Parent->GetActorLabel());
	// The engine refuses a Static component under a non-Static one (it could not follow its parent's movement).
	if (Root->Mobility == EComponentMobility::Static && ParentRoot->Mobility != EComponentMobility::Static)
		return FString::Printf(TEXT(": a Static %s cannot attach to a %s parent (set the parent's root Mobility to Static, or this actor's to Movable)"),
			*Actor->GetClass()->GetName(), ParentRoot->Mobility == EComponentMobility::Movable ? TEXT("Movable") : TEXT("Stationary"));
	return FString();
}

namespace UnrealMcpRqlEditorApiLocal
{
	/** What a spawn places: an actor class (a Blueprint's generated class too), or an asset with the actor factory that places it. */
	struct FSpawnTarget
	{
		UClass* Class = nullptr;
		UObject* Asset = nullptr;
		UActorFactory* Factory = nullptr;
	};

	/** Resolve @p Name for SpawnActor (bAssetOnly: SpawnActorFromAsset); false + the reason when nothing spawnable matches. */
	bool ResolveSpawnTarget(const FString& Name, bool bAssetOnly, FSpawnTarget& Out, FString& OutError)
	{
		auto UseClass = [&Out, &OutError](UClass* Class)
		{
			if (Class->HasAnyClassFlags(CLASS_Abstract | CLASS_Deprecated | CLASS_NewerVersionExists))
			{
				OutError = FString::Printf(TEXT("'%s' is abstract or deprecated and cannot be spawned"), *Class->GetName());
				return false;
			}
			Out.Class = Class;
			return true;
		};
		const bool bPath = Name.StartsWith(TEXT("/"));
		if (bAssetOnly && !bPath)
		{
			OutError = FString::Printf(TEXT("'%s' is not an asset path (SpawnActorFromAsset takes e.g. \"/Engine/BasicShapes/Cube\"; "
				"SpawnActor takes class names)"), *Name);
			return false;
		}
		if (!bAssetOnly)
		{
			if (UClass* Class = FUnrealMcpObjectRef::ResolveClass(Name))
			{
				if (Class->IsChildOf(AActor::StaticClass()))
					return UseClass(Class);
			}
			else
			{
				TArray<FString> Ambiguous;
				if (UClass* Blueprint = BlueprintClassByName(Name, Ambiguous))
					return UseClass(Blueprint);
				if (Ambiguous.Num() > 0)
				{
					OutError = FString::Printf(TEXT("several Blueprints are named '%s': use a path (%s)"), *Name, *FString::Join(Ambiguous, TEXT(", ")));
					return false;
				}
			}
		}
		// An asset the editor can place (a mesh dragged into the viewport becomes a StaticMeshActor showing it).
		if (bPath)
		{
			UObject* Asset = UnrealMcpRql::LoadObject(UObject::StaticClass(), Name);
			if (const UBlueprint* Blueprint = Cast<UBlueprint>(Asset); Blueprint && Blueprint->GeneratedClass
				&& Blueprint->GeneratedClass->IsChildOf(AActor::StaticClass()))
				return UseClass(Blueprint->GeneratedClass);
			if (Asset && !Asset->IsA<UClass>() && !Asset->IsA<UBlueprint>())
			{
				Out.Asset = Asset;
				Out.Factory = FActorFactoryAssetProxy::GetFactoryForAssetObject(Asset);
				if (Out.Factory)
					return true;
				OutError = FString::Printf(TEXT("'%s' is a %s, which cannot be placed in a level"), *Name, *Asset->GetClass()->GetName());
				return false;
			}
			if (bAssetOnly)
			{
				OutError = !Asset ? FString::Printf(TEXT("no asset at '%s'"), *Name)
					: Asset->IsA<UClass>() ? FString::Printf(TEXT("'%s' is a class, not an asset: use SpawnActor"), *Name)
					: FString::Printf(TEXT("'%s' is a %s, which cannot be placed in a level"), *Name, *Asset->GetClass()->GetName());
				return false;
			}
		}
		OutError = FString::Printf(TEXT("'%s' is not an actor class (try a class name such as \"PointLight\", a Blueprint "
			"name or path, or an asset to place such as a StaticMesh path)"), *Name);
		return false;
	}

	AActor* SpawnFromTarget(const FString& Name, bool bAssetOnly, const FString& Label, const FVector& Location, const FRotator& Rotation,
		AActor* Parent, const FVector& Scale)
	{
		FSpawnTarget Target;
		FString Error;
		if (!ResolveSpawnTarget(Name, bAssetOnly, Target, Error))
			return Failed<AActor*>(Error);
		AActor* Actor = nullptr;
		if (Target.Class)
		{
			Actor = UnrealMcpRql::SpawnActor(Target.Class, Location, Rotation, Label, Parent);
		}
		else
		{
			UWorld* World = FUnrealMcpObjectRef::GetEditorWorld();
			if (!World)
				return Failed<AActor*>(TEXT("no editor world"));
			FActorSpawnParameters Params;
			Params.ObjectFlags |= RF_Transactional;
			Actor = Target.Factory->CreateActor(Target.Asset, World->GetCurrentLevel(), FTransform(Rotation, Location), Params);
			if (!Actor)
				return Failed<AActor*>(FString::Printf(TEXT("could not place '%s'"), *Name));
			Actor = FinishSpawnedActor(Actor, Location, Rotation, Label, Parent);
		}
		if (Actor && !Scale.Equals(FVector::OneVector))
		{
			Actor->SetActorScale3D(Scale);
			Actor->PostEditMove(/*bFinished*/ true); // construction scripts ran at scale 1
		}
		return Actor;
	}
}

FString UnrealMcpRqlSpawnRefusal(const FString& Name, bool bAssetOnly)
{
	FSpawnTarget Target;
	FString Error;
	return ResolveSpawnTarget(Name, bAssetOnly, Target, Error) ? FString() : Error;
}

AActor* UUnrealMcpRqlEditorApi::SpawnActor(const FString& ClassName, const FString& Label, FVector Location, FRotator Rotation, AActor* Parent,
	FVector Scale)
{
	return SpawnFromTarget(ClassName, /*bAssetOnly*/ false, Label, Location, Rotation, Parent, Scale);
}

AActor* UUnrealMcpRqlEditorApi::SpawnActorFromAsset(const FString& AssetPath, const FString& Label, FVector Location, FRotator Rotation,
	AActor* Parent, FVector Scale)
{
	return SpawnFromTarget(AssetPath, /*bAssetOnly*/ true, Label, Location, Rotation, Parent, Scale);
}

UWorld* UUnrealMcpRqlEditorApi::OpenLevel(const FString& Path)
{
	if (!GEditor)
		return Failed<UWorld*>(TEXT("no editor"));
	FString File, Error;
	if (!LevelFile(Path, File, Error))
		return Failed<UWorld*>(Error);
	UWorld* Opened = UEditorLoadingAndSavingUtils::LoadMap(File);
	return Opened ? Opened : Failed<UWorld*>(FString::Printf(TEXT("could not open '%s'"), *Path));
}

UWorld* UUnrealMcpRqlEditorApi::NewLevel(const FString& Path, const FString& Template)
{
	if (!GEditor)
		return Failed<UWorld*>(TEXT("no editor"));
	// Validate everything before the current world is replaced.
	FString Package, Error;
	if (!Path.IsEmpty())
	{
		if (!ToPackageName(Path, Package, Error))
			return Failed<UWorld*>(Error);
		if (!IsWritableRoot(Package))
			return Failed<UWorld*>(FString::Printf(TEXT("'%s' is not a writable level path (use e.g. /Game/Maps/Name)"), *Package));
		FString Existing;
		if (FPackageName::DoesPackageExist(Package, &Existing) && !Existing.EndsWith(FPackageName::GetMapPackageExtension(), ESearchCase::IgnoreCase))
			return Failed<UWorld*>(FString::Printf(TEXT("'%s' exists and is not a level"), *Package));
	}
	UWorld* World = nullptr;
	if (!Template.IsEmpty())
	{
		FString TemplateFile;
		if (!LevelFile(Template, TemplateFile, Error))
			return Failed<UWorld*>(Error);
		World = UEditorLoadingAndSavingUtils::NewMapFromTemplate(TemplateFile, /*bSaveExistingMap*/ false);
	}
	else
	{
		World = GEditor->NewMap(); // the engine automation's headless-safe in-memory world
	}
	if (!World)
		return Failed<UWorld*>(TEXT("could not create the level"));
	if (!Package.IsEmpty() && !UEditorLoadingAndSavingUtils::SaveMap(World, Package))
		UnrealMcpRql::Fail(FString::Printf(TEXT("created the level but could not save it to '%s'"), *Package));
	return World;
}

void UUnrealMcpRqlEditorApi::SaveLevel(const FString& Path)
{
	UWorld* World = FUnrealMcpObjectRef::GetEditorWorld();
	if (!World)
		return Failed(TEXT("no editor world"));
	// As the editor scripting libraries do: in an -unattended editor PromptForCheckoutAndSave cancels every save unless a
	// script is marked as running, and in a windowed one the mark keeps the save free of prompts and failure dialogs.
	TGuardValue<bool> UnattendedScriptGuard(GIsRunningUnattendedScript, true);
	if (!Path.IsEmpty())
	{
		FString Package, Error;
		if (!ToPackageName(Path, Package, Error))
			return Failed(Error);
		if (!IsWritableRoot(Package))
			return Failed(FString::Printf(TEXT("'%s' is not a writable level path (use e.g. /Game/Maps/Name)"), *Package));
		if (!UEditorLoadingAndSavingUtils::SaveMap(World, Package))
			Failed(FString::Printf(TEXT("could not save the level to '%s'"), *Package));
		return;
	}
	// A never-saved level would open the interactive Save-As dialog (modal UI on the game thread): refuse instead.
	ULevel* Current = World->GetCurrentLevel();
	UPackage* LevelPackage = Current ? Current->GetPackage() : nullptr;
	if (!LevelPackage || !FPackageName::DoesPackageExist(LevelPackage->GetName()))
		return Failed(TEXT("the current level was never saved: call SaveLevel(\"/Game/Maps/Name\")"));
	// SaveCurrentLevel reports only a cancel as failure (a package that failed to save, e.g. a read-only file whose
	// checkout failed, still returns true), so a package left dirty is the failure signal.
	TArray<UPackage*> Dirty;
	if (LevelPackage->IsDirty())
		Dirty.Add(LevelPackage);
	for (UPackage* External : Current->GetLoadedExternalObjectPackages())
	{
		if (External->IsDirty())
			Dirty.Add(External);
	}
	const bool bSaved = UEditorLoadingAndSavingUtils::SaveCurrentLevel();
	TArray<FString> Unsaved;
	for (UPackage* Package : Dirty)
	{
		if (Package->IsDirty() && !UPackage::IsEmptyPackage(Package))
			Unsaved.Add(Package->GetName());
	}
	if (!bSaved || Unsaved.Num() > 0)
		Failed(FString::Printf(TEXT("the current level could not be saved (checkout or write failure)%s%s"),
			Unsaved.Num() > 0 ? TEXT(": ") : TEXT(""), *FString::Join(Unsaved, TEXT(", "))));
}

void UUnrealMcpRqlEditorApi::SaveAll()
{
	// Never-saved maps would prompt for a location: SaveDirtyPackages skips the prompt when it cannot ask.
	if (!UEditorLoadingAndSavingUtils::SaveDirtyPackages(/*bSaveMapPackages*/ true, /*bSaveContentPackages*/ true))
		Failed(TEXT("some packages could not be saved (never-saved levels need SaveLevel(path))"));
}

ULevel* UUnrealMcpRqlEditorApi::AddSublevel(const FString& Path, const FString& Streaming)
{
	UWorld* World = FUnrealMcpObjectRef::GetEditorWorld();
	if (!World)
		return Failed<ULevel*>(TEXT("no editor world"));
	if (World->IsPartitionedWorld())
		return Failed<ULevel*>(TEXT("a World Partition world streams by cells, not sublevels (use data layers, or a level without World Partition)"));
	const FString Package = FPackageName::ObjectPathToPackageName(Path.TrimStartAndEnd());
	FString File;
	if (!FPackageName::IsValidLongPackageName(Package) || !FPackageName::DoesPackageExist(Package, &File)
		|| !FPaths::GetExtension(File, /*bIncludeDot*/ true).Equals(FPackageName::GetMapPackageExtension(), ESearchCase::IgnoreCase))
		return Failed<ULevel*>(FString::Printf(TEXT("no saved level (map) at '%s' (save it first: editor | call SaveLevel())"), *Path));
	if (Package == World->GetOutermost()->GetName())
		return Failed<ULevel*>(TEXT("a level cannot be its own sublevel"));
	// The engine asks with a modal dialog (not skipped when unattended) when the world already streams that package.
	if (FLevelUtils::FindStreamingLevel(World, *Package))
		return Failed<ULevel*>(FString::Printf(TEXT("'%s' is already a sublevel of this world"), *Package));
	const FString Kind = Streaming.TrimStartAndEnd();
	UClass* StreamingClass = Kind.IsEmpty() || Kind.Equals(TEXT("Dynamic"), ESearchCase::IgnoreCase) ? ULevelStreamingDynamic::StaticClass()
		: Kind.Equals(TEXT("AlwaysLoaded"), ESearchCase::IgnoreCase) ? ULevelStreamingAlwaysLoaded::StaticClass() : nullptr;
	if (!StreamingClass)
		return Failed<ULevel*>(FString::Printf(TEXT("unknown streaming '%s' (Dynamic or AlwaysLoaded)"), *Streaming));
	// AddLevelToWorld makes the new level current: keep the current level where it was (spawns keep their target).
	ULevel* Current = World->GetCurrentLevel();
	ULevelStreaming* Added = UEditorLevelUtils::AddLevelToWorld(World, *Package, StreamingClass);
	ULevel* Level = Added ? Added->GetLoadedLevel() : nullptr;
	if (!Level)
	{
		if (Added)
			UEditorLevelUtils::RemoveInvalidLevelFromWorld(Added); // no broken entry left behind
		return Failed<ULevel*>(FString::Printf(TEXT("could not load '%s' as a sublevel"), *Package));
	}
	if (Current && Current != World->GetCurrentLevel())
		UEditorLevelUtils::MakeLevelCurrent(Current, /*bEvenIfLocked*/ false);
	return Level;
}

void UUnrealMcpRqlEditorApi::UnloadSublevel(ULevel* Level)
{
	UWorld* World = FUnrealMcpObjectRef::GetEditorWorld();
	if (!World)
		return Failed(TEXT("no editor world"));
	if (Level == World->PersistentLevel)
		return Failed(TEXT("the persistent level cannot be unloaded"));
	if (!UEditorLevelUtils::RemoveLevelFromWorld(Level))
		Failed(TEXT("could not unload the sublevel"));
}

UObject* UUnrealMcpRqlEditorApi::CopyAsset(const FString& Source, const FString& Destination)
{
	FString Folder, Name;
	if (!UEditorAssetLibrary::DoesAssetExist(Source))
		return Failed<UObject*>(FString::Printf(TEXT("no asset at '%s'"), *Source));
	if (!ValidateNewAssetPath(Destination, Folder, Name))
		return nullptr;
	UObject* Copy = UEditorAssetLibrary::DuplicateAsset(Source, Destination);
	if (!Copy)
		return Failed<UObject*>(FString::Printf(TEXT("could not copy '%s'"), *Source));
	// A level opens from its file only (OpenLevel, AddSublevel): a copied level is saved at once, as a new map is. Saving
	// the world package writes its external packages (one file per actor); its built data lives in a package of its own.
	// (UEditorLoadingAndSavingUtils::SaveMap(World, Path) is not used: in testing, opening the copy saved that way tripped
	// the editor's world-leak check, a fatal error.)
	if (UWorld* World = Cast<UWorld>(Copy))
	{
		TArray<UPackage*> Packages{ World->GetPackage() };
		if (World->PersistentLevel && World->PersistentLevel->MapBuildData)
			Packages.AddUnique(World->PersistentLevel->MapBuildData->GetPackage());
		if (!UEditorLoadingAndSavingUtils::SavePackages(Packages, /*bOnlyDirty*/ false))
			return Failed<UObject*>(FString::Printf(TEXT("copied the level to '%s' but could not save it: the copy is in memory only "
			"(editor | call SaveAsset(\"%s\") or DeleteAsset(\"%s\", true))"), *Destination, *Destination, *Destination));
	}
	return Copy;
}

void UUnrealMcpRqlEditorApi::MoveAsset(const FString& Source, const FString& Destination)
{
	FString Folder, Name;
	if (!UEditorAssetLibrary::DoesAssetExist(Source))
		return Failed(FString::Printf(TEXT("no asset at '%s'"), *Source));
	if (!IsWritableRoot(Source))
		return Failed(FString::Printf(TEXT("'%s' is engine content"), *Source));
	if (ValidateNewAssetPath(Destination, Folder, Name) && !UEditorAssetLibrary::RenameAsset(Source, Destination))
		Failed(FString::Printf(TEXT("could not move '%s'"), *Source));
}

void UUnrealMcpRqlEditorApi::DeleteAsset(const FString& Path, bool bForce)
{
	if (!UEditorAssetLibrary::DoesAssetExist(Path))
		return Failed(FString::Printf(TEXT("no asset at '%s'"), *Path));
	if (!IsWritableRoot(Path))
		return Failed(FString::Printf(TEXT("'%s' is engine content"), *Path));
	if (!bForce)
	{
		const FAssetData Data = UEditorAssetLibrary::FindAssetData(Path);
		TArray<FString> Referencers = UEditorAssetLibrary::FindPackageReferencersForAsset(Path);
		Referencers.Remove(Data.PackageName.ToString());
		// The asset registry knows saved references only: an unsaved asset that uses this one (a new material
		// instance's parent) shows up in memory alone. The memory scan walks every object: only when needed.
		UObject* Loaded = Referencers.Num() == 0 ? Data.FastGetAsset(/*bLoad*/ false) : nullptr;
		if (Loaded)
		{
			bool bReferenced = false, bReferencedByUndo = false;
			FReferencerInformationList Memory;
			ObjectTools::GatherObjectReferencersForDeletion(Loaded, bReferenced, bReferencedByUndo, &Memory);
			// bReferenced: something reachable other than the undo buffer holds it (the list also has garbage).
			if (!bReferenced)
				Memory.ExternalReferences.Reset();
			for (const FReferencerInformation& Info : Memory.ExternalReferences)
			{
				const UPackage* Package = Info.Referencer ? Info.Referencer->GetPackage() : nullptr;
				if (Package && Package != Loaded->GetPackage() && Package != GetTransientPackage() && !Package->HasAnyFlags(RF_Transient))
					Referencers.AddUnique(Package->GetName());
			}
		}
		if (Referencers.Num() > 0)
		{
			const TArray<FString> Shown(Referencers.GetData(), FMath::Min(Referencers.Num(), 5));
			return Failed(FString::Printf(TEXT("referenced by %d package(s) (%s); pass bForce = true to delete anyway"),
				Referencers.Num(), *FString::Join(Shown, TEXT(", "))));
		}
	}
	if (!UEditorAssetLibrary::DeleteAsset(Path))
		Failed(FString::Printf(TEXT("could not delete '%s'"), *Path));
}

void UUnrealMcpRqlEditorApi::CreateFolder(const FString& Path)
{
	if (!IsWritableRoot(Path) || !Path.StartsWith(TEXT("/")))
		return Failed(FString::Printf(TEXT("'%s' is not a writable content path (e.g. /Game/Props)"), *Path));
	if (!UEditorAssetLibrary::DoesDirectoryExist(Path) && !UEditorAssetLibrary::MakeDirectory(Path))
		Failed(FString::Printf(TEXT("could not create '%s'"), *Path));
}

void UUnrealMcpRqlEditorApi::RefreshAssets(const FString& Path, bool bForce)
{
	FModuleManager::LoadModuleChecked<FAssetRegistryModule>(TEXT("AssetRegistry")).Get()
		.ScanPathsSynchronous({ Path.IsEmpty() ? FString(TEXT("/Game")) : Path }, bForce);
}

UObject* UnrealMcpRql::CreateAsset(UClass* Class, const FString& Path)
{
	FString Folder, Name;
	if (!Class || Class->HasAnyClassFlags(CLASS_Deprecated | CLASS_NewerVersionExists)
		|| Class->IsChildOf(AActor::StaticClass()) || Class->IsChildOf(UActorComponent::StaticClass()))
		return Failed<UObject*>(FString::Printf(TEXT("'%s' is not an asset class (actors are spawned: SpawnActor)"),
			Class ? *Class->GetName() : TEXT("None")));
	if (Class->HasAnyClassFlags(CLASS_Abstract))
		return Failed<UObject*>(FString::Printf(TEXT("'%s' is abstract: create one of its subclasses (unreal.classes(\"%s\") lists them)"),
			*Class->GetName(), *Class->GetName()));
	if (!ValidateNewAssetPath(Path, Folder, Name))
		return nullptr;
	// The factory of the Content Browser's "New" menu when one creates this class (materials, input actions, data
	// tables, ...): it sets the asset up as that menu does. Otherwise a plain object in a new package.
	UClass* FactoryClass = nullptr;
	for (const UFactory* Default : AssetTools().GetNewAssetFactories())
	{
		if (Default && Default->GetSupportedClass() == Class)
		{
			FactoryClass = Default->GetClass();
			break;
		}
	}
	UObject* Created = nullptr;
	if (FactoryClass)
	{
		UFactory* Factory = NewObject<UFactory>(GetTransientPackage(), FactoryClass);
		FGCObjectScopeGuard FactoryGuard(Factory);
		Created = AssetTools().CreateAsset(Name, Folder, Class, Factory);
	}
	else if (UPackage* Package = CreatePackage(*(Folder / Name)))
	{
		Created = NewObject<UObject>(Package, Class, *Name, RF_Public | RF_Standalone | RF_Transactional);
		if (Created)
		{
			FAssetRegistryModule::AssetCreated(Created);
			Package->MarkPackageDirty();
		}
	}
	return Created ? Created : Failed<UObject*>(FString::Printf(TEXT("could not create a %s at '%s'"), *Class->GetName(), *Path));
}

UObject* UUnrealMcpRqlEditorApi::CreateAsset(const FString& Path, const FString& ClassName)
{
	UClass* Class = FUnrealMcpObjectRef::ResolveClass(ClassName);
	if (!Class)
		return Failed<UObject*>(FString::Printf(TEXT("'%s' is not an asset class (actors are spawned: SpawnActor)"), *ClassName));
	return UnrealMcpRql::CreateAsset(Class, Path);
}

UMaterialInstanceConstant* UUnrealMcpRqlEditorApi::CreateMaterialInstance(const FString& Path, UMaterialInterface* Parent)
{
	FString Folder, Name;
	if (!ValidateNewAssetPath(Path, Folder, Name))
		return nullptr;
	UMaterialInstanceConstantFactoryNew* Factory = NewObject<UMaterialInstanceConstantFactoryNew>();
	FGCObjectScopeGuard FactoryGuard(Factory);
	Factory->InitialParent = Parent;
	UMaterialInstanceConstant* Created = Cast<UMaterialInstanceConstant>(
		AssetTools().CreateAsset(Name, Folder, UMaterialInstanceConstant::StaticClass(), Factory));
	return Created ? Created : Failed<UMaterialInstanceConstant*>(FString::Printf(TEXT("could not create '%s'"), *Path));
}

TArray<UObject*> UUnrealMcpRqlEditorApi::ImportAsset(const FString& File, const FString& Destination, const FString& Name, bool bReplaceExisting)
{
	if (!FPaths::FileExists(File))
		return Failed<TArray<UObject*>>(FString::Printf(TEXT("no file '%s'"), *File));
	// The registry's package paths have no trailing slash: "/Game/Props/" would find no created assets.
	FString Folder = Destination;
	while (Folder.Len() > 1 && Folder.EndsWith(TEXT("/")))
		Folder.LeftChopInline(1);
	if (!IsWritableRoot(Folder) || !Folder.StartsWith(TEXT("/")))
		return Failed<TArray<UObject*>>(FString::Printf(TEXT("'%s' is not a writable content folder (e.g. /Game/Imported)"), *Destination));
	UAssetImportTask* Task = NewObject<UAssetImportTask>();
	FGCObjectScopeGuard TaskGuard(Task);
	Task->Filename = File;
	Task->DestinationPath = Folder;
	if (!Name.IsEmpty())
		Task->DestinationName = Name;
	Task->bAutomated = true;
	Task->bReplaceExisting = bReplaceExisting;
	Task->bSave = false;
	Task->bAsync = false;

	// Interchange imports are asynchronous under the hood; the legacy factories import synchronously (as the removed
	// asset-import tool did), so the result is known when the call returns.
	IConsoleVariable* const Interchange = IConsoleManager::Get().FindConsoleVariable(TEXT("Interchange.FeatureFlags.Import.Enable"));
	const bool bInterchange = Interchange && Interchange->GetBool();
	if (bInterchange)
		Interchange->Set(false, ECVF_SetByCode);
	ON_SCOPE_EXIT
	{
		if (bInterchange)
			Interchange->Set(true, ECVF_SetByCode);
	};
	// The task lists only the primary asset (the mesh of an FBX): the materials, textures and skeleton the importer creates
	// next to it are the assets the destination folder gains, found by diffing the registry.
	IAssetRegistry& Registry = FModuleManager::LoadModuleChecked<FAssetRegistryModule>(TEXT("AssetRegistry")).Get();
	const auto AssetsUnder = [&Registry, &Folder]()
	{
		TArray<FAssetData> Found;
		Registry.GetAssetsByPath(FName(*Folder), Found, /*bRecursive*/ true, /*bIncludeOnlyOnDiskAssets*/ false);
		TSet<FSoftObjectPath> Paths;
		for (const FAssetData& Data : Found)
			Paths.Add(Data.GetSoftObjectPath());
		return Paths;
	};
	const TSet<FSoftObjectPath> Before = AssetsUnder();
	AssetTools().ImportAssetTasks({ Task });
	TArray<UObject*> Imported;
	for (UObject* Object : Task->GetObjects())
	{
		if (Object)
			Imported.AddUnique(Object);
	}
	TArray<FSoftObjectPath> Created = AssetsUnder().Difference(Before).Array();
	Created.Sort([](const FSoftObjectPath& A, const FSoftObjectPath& B) { return A.LexicalLess(B); });
	for (const FSoftObjectPath& Path : Created)
	{
		if (UObject* Object = Path.TryLoad())
			Imported.AddUnique(Object);
	}
	if (Imported.Num() == 0)
	{
		// An existing asset of the same name is skipped without bReplaceExisting: name that, not an empty import.
		const FString Existing = Folder / (Name.IsEmpty() ? ObjectTools::SanitizeObjectName(FPaths::GetBaseFilename(File)) : Name);
		if (!bReplaceExisting && UEditorAssetLibrary::DoesAssetExist(Existing))
			UnrealMcpRql::Fail(FString::Printf(TEXT("'%s' already exists; pass bReplaceExisting = true to reimport over it, or a Name for a new asset"), *Existing));
		else
			UnrealMcpRql::Fail(FString::Printf(TEXT("the import of '%s' produced no assets"), *File));
	}
	return Imported;
}

void UUnrealMcpRqlEditorApi::SaveAsset(UObject* Asset)
{
	if (!UEditorAssetLibrary::SaveLoadedAsset(Asset, /*bOnlyIfIsDirty*/ false))
		Failed(FString::Printf(TEXT("could not save %s"), *Asset->GetPathName()));
}

int32 UUnrealMcpRqlEditorApi::ClearConsole()
{
	return FUnrealMcpLogCollector::Get().Clear();
}

UDataTable* UUnrealMcpRqlEditorApi::CreateDataTable(const FString& Path, const FString& RowStruct)
{
	const FString Wanted = RowStruct.TrimStartAndEnd();
	UScriptStruct* Struct = UnrealMcpPinTypes::ResolveStruct(Wanted);
	if (!Struct || !FDataTableEditorUtils::IsValidTableStruct(Struct))
		return Failed<UDataTable*>(FString::Printf(TEXT("'%s' is not a struct DataTable rows can use (a struct deriving from FTableRowBase, or a user-defined struct)"), *Wanted));
	FString Folder, Name;
	if (!ValidateNewAssetPath(Path, Folder, Name))
		return nullptr;
	UDataTableFactory* Factory = NewObject<UDataTableFactory>();
	FGCObjectScopeGuard FactoryGuard(Factory);
	Factory->Struct = Struct;
	UDataTable* Table = nullptr;
	{
		// Not recorded in the mutation's transaction: the factory creates the table before it assigns the row struct, and a
		// transaction snapshot of a table without one logs an error (creating an asset is not an undoable edit anyway).
		TGuardValue<ITransaction*> NoUndo(GUndo, nullptr);
		Table = Cast<UDataTable>(AssetTools().CreateAsset(Name, Folder, UDataTable::StaticClass(), Factory));
	}
	return Table ? Table : Failed<UDataTable*>(FString::Printf(TEXT("could not create a DataTable at '%s'"), *Path));
}
```

`UnrealMCP/Source/UnrealMcpRql/Private/UnrealMcpRqlEditorApi.h`:

```h
// Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak. Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.
// See the LICENSE file in the repository root for more information.

#pragma once

#include "CoreMinimal.h"
#include "UObject/Object.h"

#include "UnrealMcpRqlEditorApi.generated.h"

class AActor;
class AVolume;
class ULevel;
class UDataTable;
class UMaterialInstanceConstant;
class UMaterialInterface;
class UWorld;

/**
 * The `editor` RQL source (type "Editor"): editor operations that have no owner object, e.g.
 * `editor | call SpawnActor("PointLight", "Lamp", "(0, 0, 300)")`. Every UFUNCTION here is callable from rql-mutate
 * (the comment above it is the description agents see). They are BlueprintCallable only because UHT records C++ default
 * arguments for BlueprintCallable functions alone; BlueprintInternalUseOnly keeps them out of Blueprint menus. The
 * members IsPlaying, IsPaused, Selection, World and
 * CurrentLevel are added by the core RQL module. Failures go through UnrealMcpRql::Fail, so the call reports them.
 */
UCLASS(Transient)
class UUnrealMcpRqlEditorApi : public UObject
{
	GENERATED_BODY()

public:
	/** spawn an actor in the current level from a class name ("PointLight"), class path, Blueprint name or path, or an asset to place (a StaticMesh path gives a StaticMeshActor showing it); Label, Location, Rotation (final; omitted keeps the class default, a SpotLight points down), Parent and Scale are optional; returns the actor. Many at once: range(0, 100) | call editor.SpawnActor("/Engine/BasicShapes/Cube", "Cube_" + $, [($ % 10) * 150, floor($ / 10) * 150, 0]) */
	UFUNCTION(BlueprintCallable, Category = "Unreal MCP|RQL", meta = (BlueprintInternalUseOnly = "true"))
	AActor* SpawnActor(const FString& ClassName, const FString& Label = TEXT(""), FVector Location = FVector::ZeroVector,
		FRotator Rotation = FRotator::ZeroRotator, AActor* Parent = nullptr, FVector Scale = FVector(1.0));

	/** place an asset in the current level as the editor's drag and drop does (a StaticMesh gives a StaticMeshActor showing it, a Blueprint its actor, a sound an AmbientSound); Label, Location, Rotation, Parent and Scale are optional; returns the actor */
	UFUNCTION(BlueprintCallable, Category = "Unreal MCP|RQL", meta = (BlueprintInternalUseOnly = "true"))
	AActor* SpawnActorFromAsset(const FString& AssetPath, const FString& Label = TEXT(""), FVector Location = FVector::ZeroVector,
		FRotator Rotation = FRotator::ZeroRotator, AActor* Parent = nullptr, FVector Scale = FVector(1.0));

	/** open a level by asset path ("/Game/Maps/Arena"), replacing the editor world (unsaved edits of the current level are lost); returns the world */
	UFUNCTION(BlueprintCallable, Category = "Unreal MCP|RQL", meta = (BlueprintInternalUseOnly = "true"))
	UWorld* OpenLevel(const FString& Path);

	/** create a new empty level (or a copy of Template) and make it the editor world; saved to Path when given; returns the world */
	UFUNCTION(BlueprintCallable, Category = "Unreal MCP|RQL", meta = (BlueprintInternalUseOnly = "true"))
	UWorld* NewLevel(const FString& Path = TEXT(""), const FString& Template = TEXT(""));

	/** save the current level in place, or the persistent level to Path ("/Game/Maps/Copy") */
	UFUNCTION(BlueprintCallable, Category = "Unreal MCP|RQL", meta = (BlueprintInternalUseOnly = "true"))
	void SaveLevel(const FString& Path = TEXT(""));

	/** save every unsaved level and asset */
	UFUNCTION(BlueprintCallable, Category = "Unreal MCP|RQL", meta = (BlueprintInternalUseOnly = "true"))
	void SaveAll();

	/** add a saved level ("/Game/Maps/Sub_A") to the editor world as a streaming sublevel (Streaming: "Dynamic", or "AlwaysLoaded"); returns the loaded level (not undoable: UnloadSublevel removes it; the current level stays) */
	UFUNCTION(BlueprintCallable, Category = "Unreal MCP|RQL", meta = (BlueprintInternalUseOnly = "true"))
	ULevel* AddSublevel(const FString& Path, const FString& Streaming = TEXT("Dynamic"));

	/** remove a loaded streaming sublevel from the world (its map name "Sub_A", or levels | where Map == "Sub_A") */
	UFUNCTION(BlueprintCallable, Category = "Unreal MCP|RQL", meta = (BlueprintInternalUseOnly = "true"))
	void UnloadSublevel(ULevel* Level);

	/** copy an asset ("/Game/A" to "/Game/B"); returns the copy */
	UFUNCTION(BlueprintCallable, Category = "Unreal MCP|RQL", meta = (BlueprintInternalUseOnly = "true"))
	UObject* CopyAsset(const FString& Source, const FString& Destination);

	/** move or rename an asset */
	UFUNCTION(BlueprintCallable, Category = "Unreal MCP|RQL", meta = (BlueprintInternalUseOnly = "true"))
	void MoveAsset(const FString& Source, const FString& Destination);

	/** delete an asset; refuses when other packages reference it unless bForce */
	UFUNCTION(BlueprintCallable, Category = "Unreal MCP|RQL", meta = (BlueprintInternalUseOnly = "true"))
	void DeleteAsset(const FString& Path, bool bForce = false);

	/** create a content folder ("/Game/Props") */
	UFUNCTION(BlueprintCallable, Category = "Unreal MCP|RQL", meta = (BlueprintInternalUseOnly = "true"))
	void CreateFolder(const FString& Path);

	/** rescan a content path so files added on disk appear (bForce: full rescan) */
	UFUNCTION(BlueprintCallable, Category = "Unreal MCP|RQL", meta = (BlueprintInternalUseOnly = "true"))
	void RefreshAssets(const FString& Path = TEXT("/Game"), bool bForce = false);

	/** create an asset of a class ("InputAction", "Material", "DataAsset subclass", ...) at Path ("/Game/Input/IA_Jump") with the class's editor factory when it has one; returns it */
	UFUNCTION(BlueprintCallable, Category = "Unreal MCP|RQL", meta = (BlueprintInternalUseOnly = "true"))
	UObject* CreateAsset(const FString& Path, const FString& ClassName);

	/** create a material instance at Path from a parent material (unreal.asset(path) or its path); returns it */
	UFUNCTION(BlueprintCallable, Category = "Unreal MCP|RQL", meta = (BlueprintInternalUseOnly = "true"))
	UMaterialInstanceConstant* CreateMaterialInstance(const FString& Path, UMaterialInterface* Parent);

	/** import a file (FBX, PNG, …) from disk into a content folder; Name renames the asset; returns the imported asset first, then every other asset the import created in the folder (materials, textures, skeleton …) */
	UFUNCTION(BlueprintCallable, Category = "Unreal MCP|RQL", meta = (BlueprintInternalUseOnly = "true"))
	TArray<UObject*> ImportAsset(const FString& File, const FString& Destination, const FString& Name = TEXT(""),
		bool bReplaceExisting = false);

	/** save one asset (or level) package to disk */
	UFUNCTION(BlueprintCallable, Category = "Unreal MCP|RQL", meta = (BlueprintInternalUseOnly = "true"))
	void SaveAsset(UObject* Asset);

	/** clear the captured editor log (the console source); returns how many entries were removed */
	UFUNCTION(BlueprintCallable, Category = "Unreal MCP|RQL", meta = (BlueprintInternalUseOnly = "true"))
	int32 ClearConsole();

	/** add a gameplay tag ("Ability.Fire") to the project's tag list (Config/DefaultGameplayTags.ini, or Source: another tag ini such as "Abilities.ini"); written to disk at once, not undoable */
	UFUNCTION(BlueprintCallable, Category = "Unreal MCP|RQL", meta = (BlueprintInternalUseOnly = "true"))
	void AddGameplayTag(const FString& Name, const FString& Comment = TEXT(""), const FString& Source = TEXT(""));

	/** remove a gameplay tag from its tag ini (refused while assets reference it, or when C++ / a DataTable declares it); written at once, not undoable */
	UFUNCTION(BlueprintCallable, Category = "Unreal MCP|RQL", meta = (BlueprintInternalUseOnly = "true"))
	void RemoveGameplayTag(const FString& Name);

	/** rename a gameplay tag (and its children) in its tag ini, leaving a redirector from the old name; written at once, not undoable */
	UFUNCTION(BlueprintCallable, Category = "Unreal MCP|RQL", meta = (BlueprintInternalUseOnly = "true"))
	void RenameGameplayTag(const FString& Name, const FString& NewName);

	/** create a DataTable at Path whose rows are RowStruct (a struct name such as "GameplayTagTableRow", or a user-defined struct asset path); returns it, unsaved */
	UFUNCTION(BlueprintCallable, Category = "Unreal MCP|RQL", meta = (BlueprintInternalUseOnly = "true"))
	UDataTable* CreateDataTable(const FString& Path, const FString& RowStruct);
};

/**

 * a placeable asset. The `call` validator runs it for every planned spawn before the first one.
 */
FString UnrealMcpRqlSpawnRefusal(const FString& Name, bool bAssetOnly);

FString UnrealMcpRqlAttachFailure(const AActor* Actor, const AActor* Parent);
```

`UnrealMCP/Source/UnrealMcpRql/Private/UnrealMcpRqlGameplayTags.cpp`:

```cpp
// Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak. Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.
// See the LICENSE file in the repository root for more information.

#include "UnrealMcpRqlSession.h"
#include "UnrealMcpRqlEditorApi.h"
#include "UnrealMcpRqlSources.h"
#include "UnrealMcpRqlUtil.h"
#include "IUnrealMcpRqlModule.h"

#include "GameplayTagContainer.h"
#include "GameplayTagsEditorModule.h"
#include "GameplayTagsManager.h"
#include "Misc/EngineVersionComparison.h"
#include "Misc/OutputDevice.h"
#include "Modules/ModuleManager.h"

#include <exception>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

/**
 * Gameplay Tags (docs/rql.md "Gameplay Tags"). FGameplayTag is a struct around one FName and FGameplayTagContainer keeps
 * a second, derived array of parent tags, so writing their reflected members would store tags the tag tree does not
 * know and containers whose parent cache is stale. Instead tags are text: a tag reads as "Ability.Fire", a container as
 * ["Ability.Fire", "State.Stunned"], and writes take the same forms, validated against the registered tags (an unknown
 * tag is an error that names similar ones). Containers are rebuilt with AddTag, so their parent tags are right.
 */
namespace UnrealMcpRqlGameplayTagsLocal
{
	using namespace UnrealMcpRqlUtil;

	struct FTagInfo
	{
		std::string Name;
		std::string Comment;
		std::string Source;
		std::string Parent;
		int32_t Children = 0;
		bool Explicit = false;
		bool Restricted = false;
	};

	/** Up to five registered tags that look like @p Wanted (share its last part or contain it), for an error message. */
	FString Similar(const FString& Wanted)
	{
		FGameplayTagContainer All;
		UGameplayTagsManager::Get().RequestAllGameplayTags(All, /*OnlyIncludeDictionaryTags*/ false);
		FString Leaf = Wanted;
		Wanted.Split(TEXT("."), nullptr, &Leaf, ESearchCase::IgnoreCase, ESearchDir::FromEnd);
		TArray<FString> Found;
		for (const FGameplayTag& Tag : All.GetGameplayTagArray())
		{
			const FString Name = Tag.ToString();
			if (Name.Contains(Wanted) || (!Leaf.IsEmpty() && Name.Contains(Leaf)) || Wanted.Contains(Name))
				Found.Add(Name);
		}
		Found.Sort([](const FString& A, const FString& B) { return A.Len() != B.Len() ? A.Len() < B.Len() : A < B; });
		if (Found.Num() > 5)
			Found.SetNum(5);
		return Found.Num() > 0 ? FString::Printf(TEXT(" (similar: %s)"), *FString::Join(Found, TEXT(", "))) : FString();
	}

	/** The registered tag @p Text names; empty text and "None" are the empty tag. Throws for an unknown tag. */
	FGameplayTag ParseTag(const FString& Text)
	{
		const FString Trimmed = Text.TrimStartAndEnd();
		if (Trimmed.IsEmpty() || Trimmed.Equals(TEXT("None"), ESearchCase::IgnoreCase))
			return FGameplayTag();
		const FGameplayTag Tag = UGameplayTagsManager::Get().RequestGameplayTag(FName(*Trimmed), /*ErrorIfNotFound*/ false);
		if (!Tag.IsValid())
			Throw(FString::Printf(TEXT("'%s' is not a registered gameplay tag%s; add it with editor | call AddGameplayTag(\"%s\")"),
				*Trimmed, *Similar(Trimmed), *Trimmed));
		return Tag;
	}

	TArray<FString> TagTexts(const rql::Value& Value)
	{
		TArray<FString> Out;
		if (Value.is_string())
		{
			// "A.B, C.D" as well as ["A.B", "C.D"]
			UnrealMcpRqlFromStd(Value.as_string()).ParseIntoArray(Out, TEXT(","), /*InCullEmpty*/ true);
			return Out;
		}
		for (const rql::Value& Item : Items(Value))
		{
			if (!Item.is_string())
				ThrowMismatch(TEXT("a tag name"), Item);
			Out.Add(UnrealMcpRqlFromStd(Item.as_string()));
		}
		return Out;
	}

	FGameplayTagContainer ParseContainer(const rql::Value& Value)
	{
		FGameplayTagContainer Out;
		for (const FString& Text : TagTexts(Value))
		{
			const FGameplayTag Tag = ParseTag(Text);
			if (Tag.IsValid())
				Out.AddTag(Tag); // keeps the parent-tag cache right
		}
		return Out;
	}

	TArray<FString> Names(const FGameplayTagContainer& Container)
	{
		TArray<FString> Out;
		for (const FGameplayTag& Tag : Container.GetGameplayTagArray())
			Out.Add(Tag.ToString());
		return Out;
	}

	/** An RQL value as a set of tag names (a container struct, a list or comma-separated text); false for other values. */
	bool AsNames(const rql::Value& Value, const rql::TypeDescriptor* ContainerType, TSet<FName>& Out)
	{
		if (Value.is_struct() && Value.type() == ContainerType && Value.ptr())
		{
			for (const FGameplayTag& Tag : static_cast<const FGameplayTagContainer*>(Value.ptr())->GetGameplayTagArray())
				Out.Add(Tag.GetTagName());
			return true;
		}
		if (!Value.is_list() && !Value.is_string())
			return false;
		try
		{
			for (const FString& Text : TagTexts(Value))
				Out.Add(FName(*Text.TrimStartAndEnd()));
		}
		catch (const std::exception&)
		{
			return false;
		}
		return true;
	}

	void TagShape(FUnrealMcpRqlTypes&, rql::TypeDescriptor& D)
	{
		// The tag's name is the whole value: no writable members (a write replaces the tag, validated).
		D.members.clear();
		FUnrealMcpRqlTypes::SetMember(D, Member("Name", rql::builtin::string_type(), [](void* Self)
		{
			return Str(static_cast<const FGameplayTag*>(Self)->ToString());
		}, {}, "the tag text (\"None\" for no tag)"));
		FUnrealMcpRqlTypes::SetMember(D, Member("Parent", rql::builtin::string_type(), [](void* Self)
		{
			const FGameplayTag Parent = static_cast<const FGameplayTag*>(Self)->RequestDirectParent();
			return Str(Parent.IsValid() ? Parent.ToString() : FString());
		}, {}, "the direct parent tag, empty at the root"));
	}

	void ContainerShape(FUnrealMcpRqlTypes& T, rql::TypeDescriptor& D)
	{
		D.members.clear();
		FUnrealMcpRqlTypes::SetMember(D, Member("Names", T.Registry().list_type(rql::builtin::string_type(), false), [](void* Self)
		{
			return StrList(Names(*static_cast<const FGameplayTagContainer*>(Self)));
		}, {}, "the tags of the container (write the container itself: set Tags = [\"A.B\", \"C\"])"));
		const rql::TypeDescriptor* Int = rql::builtin::number_type(true, true, 4);
		FUnrealMcpRqlTypes::SetMember(D, Member("Num", Int, [Int](void* Self)
		{
			return rql::Value::number(static_cast<const FGameplayTagContainer*>(Self)->Num(), Int);
		}));
	}

	void QueryShape(FUnrealMcpRqlTypes&, rql::TypeDescriptor& D)
	{
		// A query is a compiled token stream: show it, never write its raw members.
		D.members.clear();
		FUnrealMcpRqlTypes::SetMember(D, Member("Description", rql::builtin::string_type(), [](void* Self)
		{
			const FGameplayTagQuery* Query = static_cast<const FGameplayTagQuery*>(Self);
			return Str(Query->IsEmpty() ? FString() : Query->GetDescription());
		}, {}, "the query in words (edit queries in the Details panel)"));
	}

	/** Capture what a GameplayTagsEditor call logs as an error / warning (it reports failures there, not through results). */
	class FTagLogCapture final : public FOutputDevice
	{
	public:
		FTagLogCapture() { GLog->AddOutputDevice(this); }
		virtual ~FTagLogCapture() override { GLog->RemoveOutputDevice(this); }
		virtual void Serialize(const TCHAR* Message, ELogVerbosity::Type Verbosity, const FName& Category) override
		{
			if (Verbosity <= ELogVerbosity::Warning && Category.ToString().Contains(TEXT("GameplayTag")))
				Messages.Add(Message);
		}
		FString Joined() const { return FString::Join(Messages, TEXT("; ")); }

	private:
		TArray<FString> Messages;
	};

	IGameplayTagsEditorModule* TagsEditor()
	{
		return FModuleManager::LoadModulePtr<IGameplayTagsEditorModule>(TEXT("GameplayTagsEditor"));
	}

	/** Whether a tag source (an ini, DataTable or native declaration) declares @p Tag, not only its children. */
	bool IsExplicitTag(FName Tag)
	{
		FString Comment;
		FName Source;
		bool bExplicit = false;
		bool bRestricted = false;
		bool bAllowChildren = false;
		return UGameplayTagsManager::Get().GetTagEditorData(Tag, Comment, Source, bExplicit, bRestricted, bAllowChildren) && bExplicit;
	}

	/** The engine's tag-string check plus empty segments ("A..B"), which it lets through and which make a nameless tag. */
	bool IsValidTagName(const FString& Tag, FText& OutError, FString* OutFixed = nullptr)
	{
		if (Tag.Contains(TEXT("..")))
		{
			OutError = FText::FromString(TEXT("empty segment between dots"));
			if (OutFixed)
			{
				TArray<FString> Parts;
				Tag.ParseIntoArray(Parts, TEXT("."));
				*OutFixed = FString::Join(Parts, TEXT("."));
			}
			return false;
		}
		return UGameplayTagsManager::Get().IsValidGameplayTagString(Tag, &OutError, OutFixed);
	}

	/** A dictionary tag (one some ini, DataTable or native declaration defines), or a failure. */
	bool RequireDictionaryTag(const FString& Name, FName& Out)
	{
		const FString Trimmed = Name.TrimStartAndEnd();
		Out = FName(*Trimmed);
		if (Trimmed.IsEmpty() || !UGameplayTagsManager::Get().IsDictionaryTag(Out))
		{
			UnrealMcpRql::Fail(FString::Printf(TEXT("'%s' is not a gameplay tag%s"), *Trimmed, *Similar(Trimmed)));
			return false;
		}
		return true;
	}
}

using namespace UnrealMcpRqlGameplayTagsLocal;

void UnrealMcpRqlAddGameplayTags(FUnrealMcpRqlSession& Session)
{
	FUnrealMcpRqlTypes& T = Session.Types();
	FUnrealMcpRqlTypes* Types = &T;
	UScriptStruct* TagStruct = FGameplayTag::StaticStruct();
	UScriptStruct* ContainerStruct = FGameplayTagContainer::StaticStruct();

	// Shapes and parsers before the first fill (AddAdapter below fills the descriptors).
	T.AddStructHook(TagStruct, &TagShape);
	T.AddStructHook(ContainerStruct, &ContainerShape);
	T.AddStructHook(FGameplayTagQuery::StaticStruct(), &QueryShape);
	T.AddStructParser(TagStruct, [](FUnrealMcpRqlTypes&, const rql::Value& Value, void* Out) -> bool
	{
		if (Value.is_null())
		{
			*static_cast<FGameplayTag*>(Out) = FGameplayTag();
			return true;
		}
		if (!Value.is_string())
			return false;
		*static_cast<FGameplayTag*>(Out) = ParseTag(UnrealMcpRqlFromStd(Value.as_string()));
		return true;
	});
	T.AddStructParser(ContainerStruct, [](FUnrealMcpRqlTypes&, const rql::Value& Value, void* Out) -> bool
	{
		if (Value.is_null())
		{
			*static_cast<FGameplayTagContainer*>(Out) = FGameplayTagContainer();
			return true;
		}
		if (!Value.is_string() && !Value.is_list())
			return false;
		*static_cast<FGameplayTagContainer*>(Out) = ParseContainer(Value);
		return true;
	});

	const rql::TypeDescriptor* TagType = T.ForStruct(TagStruct);
	const rql::TypeDescriptor* ContainerType = T.ForStruct(ContainerStruct);
	auto Coerce = [Types](UScriptStruct* Struct)
	{
		return UnrealMcpRqlStructCoerce(*Types, Struct,
			[](const rql::Value& Value) { return Value.is_string() || Value.is_list() || Value.is_null(); });
	};
	{
		rql::TypeAdapter Adapter;
		Adapter.name = "GameplayTag";
		Adapter.target = TagType;
		Adapter.description = "GameplayTag: write the tag text \"Ability.Fire\" (registered tags only; \"\" = none)";
		Adapter.encode = [](const rql::Value& Value, const rql::EncodeContext&) -> std::optional<rql::Json>
		{
			if (!Value.is_struct() || !Value.ptr())
				return std::nullopt;
			const FGameplayTag& Tag = *static_cast<const FGameplayTag*>(Value.ptr());
			return Tag.IsValid() ? rql::Json(UnrealMcpRqlToStd(Tag.ToString())) : rql::Json();
		};
		Adapter.coerce = Coerce(TagStruct);
		Adapter.equals = [TagType](const rql::Value& Value, const rql::Value& Other) -> std::optional<bool>
		{
			if (!Value.is_struct() || !Value.ptr())
				return std::nullopt;
			const FName Mine = static_cast<const FGameplayTag*>(Value.ptr())->GetTagName();
			if (Other.is_string())
				return Mine == FName(*UnrealMcpRqlFromStd(Other.as_string()).TrimStartAndEnd());
			if (Other.is_null())
				return Mine.IsNone();
			if (Other.is_struct() && Other.type() == TagType && Other.ptr())
				return Mine == static_cast<const FGameplayTag*>(Other.ptr())->GetTagName();
			return std::nullopt;
		};
		Session.AddAdapter(std::move(Adapter));
	}
	{
		rql::TypeAdapter Adapter;
		Adapter.name = "GameplayTagContainer";
		Adapter.target = ContainerType;
		Adapter.description = "GameplayTagContainer: write a list of registered tags [\"Ability.Fire\", \"State.Stunned\"] (or \"A.B, C.D\")";
		Adapter.encode = [](const rql::Value& Value, const rql::EncodeContext&) -> std::optional<rql::Json>
		{
			if (!Value.is_struct() || !Value.ptr())
				return std::nullopt;
			rql::Json List = rql::Json::array();
			for (const FString& Name : Names(*static_cast<const FGameplayTagContainer*>(Value.ptr())))
				List.push(rql::Json(UnrealMcpRqlToStd(Name)));
			return List;
		};
		Adapter.coerce = Coerce(ContainerStruct);
		Adapter.equals = [ContainerType](const rql::Value& Value, const rql::Value& Other) -> std::optional<bool>
		{
			TSet<FName> Mine;
			TSet<FName> Theirs;
			if (!AsNames(Value, ContainerType, Mine) || !AsNames(Other, ContainerType, Theirs))
				return std::nullopt;
			return Mine.Num() == Theirs.Num() && Mine.Includes(Theirs);
		};
		Session.AddAdapter(std::move(Adapter));
	}

	rql::TypeRegistry& Registry = T.Registry();
	Registry.structure<FTagInfo>("GameplayTagInfo")
		.member("Name", &FTagInfo::Name)
		.member("Comment", &FTagInfo::Comment)
		.member("Source", &FTagInfo::Source)
		.member("Parent", &FTagInfo::Parent)
		.member("Children", &FTagInfo::Children)
		.member("Explicit", &FTagInfo::Explicit)
		.member("Restricted", &FTagInfo::Restricted)
		.no_identity();
	const rql::TypeDescriptor* InfoType = Registry.descriptor<FTagInfo>();
	T.AddNativeType(InfoType);
	Session.AddSource(TEXT("gameplayTags"), InfoType, /*bList*/ true,
		TEXT("every registered gameplay tag, sorted (Name, Comment, Source ini, Parent, Children, Explicit, Restricted); "
			"change the list with editor | call AddGameplayTag / RemoveGameplayTag / RenameGameplayTag"), [InfoType]()
	{
		UGameplayTagsManager& Manager = UGameplayTagsManager::Get();
		FGameplayTagContainer All;
		Manager.RequestAllGameplayTags(All, /*OnlyIncludeDictionaryTags*/ false);
		TArray<FGameplayTag> Tags = All.GetGameplayTagArray();
		Tags.Sort([](const FGameplayTag& A, const FGameplayTag& B) { return A.ToString() < B.ToString(); });
		std::vector<rql::Value> Rows;
		Rows.reserve(static_cast<size_t>(Tags.Num()));
		for (const FGameplayTag& Tag : Tags)
		{
			auto Info = std::make_shared<FTagInfo>();
			Info->Name = UnrealMcpRqlToStd(Tag.ToString());
			FString Comment;
			FName Source;
			bool bExplicit = false;
			bool bRestricted = false;
			bool bAllowChildren = false;
			if (Manager.GetTagEditorData(Tag.GetTagName(), Comment, Source, bExplicit, bRestricted, bAllowChildren))
			{
				// An implicit parent ("Enemy" of "Enemy.Elite") has no entry of its own: the engine hands it the comment of the
				// child that created it, which is not the parent's.
				Info->Comment = bExplicit ? UnrealMcpRqlToStd(Comment) : std::string();
				Info->Source = Source.IsNone() ? std::string() : UnrealMcpRqlToStd(Source.ToString());
				Info->Explicit = bExplicit;
				Info->Restricted = bRestricted;
			}
			const FGameplayTag Parent = Tag.RequestDirectParent();
			Info->Parent = Parent.IsValid() ? UnrealMcpRqlToStd(Parent.ToString()) : std::string();
			if (const TSharedPtr<FGameplayTagNode> Node = Manager.FindTagNode(Tag))
				Info->Children = Node->GetChildTagNodes().Num();
			Rows.push_back(rql::Value::structure(InfoType, std::static_pointer_cast<void>(Info)));
		}
		return rql::Value::list_of(std::move(Rows));
	});
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ editor operations

void UUnrealMcpRqlEditorApi::AddGameplayTag(const FString& Name, const FString& Comment, const FString& Source)
{
	UGameplayTagsManager& Manager = UGameplayTagsManager::Get();
	const FString Tag = Name.TrimStartAndEnd();
	FText Error;
	FString Fixed;
	if (Tag.IsEmpty() || !IsValidTagName(Tag, Error, &Fixed))
		return UnrealMcpRql::Fail(FString::Printf(TEXT("'%s' is not a valid gameplay tag: %s%s"), *Tag, *Error.ToString(),
			Fixed.IsEmpty() || Fixed == Tag ? TEXT("") : *FString::Printf(TEXT(" (try \"%s\")"), *Fixed)));
	if (Manager.IsDictionaryTag(FName(*Tag)))
		return UnrealMcpRql::Fail(FString::Printf(TEXT("the gameplay tag '%s' already exists"), *Tag));
	if (!Manager.ShouldImportTagsFromINI())
		return UnrealMcpRql::Fail(TEXT("this project does not read gameplay tags from config (Project Settings > GameplayTags > Import Tags From Config)"));
	IGameplayTagsEditorModule* Editor = TagsEditor();
	if (!Editor)
		return UnrealMcpRql::Fail(TEXT("the GameplayTagsEditor plugin is not loaded"));
	FTagLogCapture Log;
	const FString SourceName = Source.TrimStartAndEnd();
	if (!Editor->AddNewGameplayTagToINI(Tag, Comment, SourceName.IsEmpty() ? NAME_None : FName(*SourceName)))
		return UnrealMcpRql::Fail(FString::Printf(TEXT("could not add the gameplay tag '%s'%s"), *Tag,
			Log.Joined().IsEmpty() ? TEXT("") : *(TEXT(": ") + Log.Joined())));
}

void UUnrealMcpRqlEditorApi::RemoveGameplayTag(const FString& Name)
{
	FName Tag;
	if (!RequireDictionaryTag(Name, Tag))
		return;
	IGameplayTagsEditorModule* Editor = TagsEditor();
	if (!Editor)
		return UnrealMcpRql::Fail(TEXT("the GameplayTagsEditor plugin is not loaded"));
	TSharedPtr<FGameplayTagNode> Node = UGameplayTagsManager::Get().FindTagNode(Tag);
	if (!Node.IsValid())
		return UnrealMcpRql::Fail(FString::Printf(TEXT("'%s' is not a gameplay tag"), *Name));
	const bool bWasExplicit = IsExplicitTag(Tag);
	FTagLogCapture Log;
	Editor->DeleteTagsFromINI({ Node }); // the log-only variant: failures are logged, not shown as toasts
	// An explicit tag with children is removed from its ini but lives on implicitly (as the tag editor's Delete leaves it).
	if (UGameplayTagsManager::Get().IsDictionaryTag(Tag) && (!bWasExplicit || IsExplicitTag(Tag)))
	{
		// Still there: referenced by assets, declared in C++ / a DataTable, or implicit (children keep it).
		const FString Why = Log.Joined();
		return UnrealMcpRql::Fail(FString::Printf(TEXT("the gameplay tag '%s' was not removed%s"), *Name.TrimStartAndEnd(),
			Why.IsEmpty() ? TEXT(" (it is implicit: remove its children, or it is declared outside the tag ini files)") : *(TEXT(": ") + Why)));
	}
}

void UUnrealMcpRqlEditorApi::RenameGameplayTag(const FString& Name, const FString& NewName)
{
	FName Tag;
	if (!RequireDictionaryTag(Name, Tag))
		return;
	UGameplayTagsManager& Manager = UGameplayTagsManager::Get();
	const FString Target = NewName.TrimStartAndEnd();
	FText Error;
	if (Target.IsEmpty() || !IsValidTagName(Target, Error))
		return UnrealMcpRql::Fail(FString::Printf(TEXT("'%s' is not a valid gameplay tag: %s"), *Target, *Error.ToString()));
	if (Manager.IsDictionaryTag(FName(*Target)))
		return UnrealMcpRql::Fail(FString::Printf(TEXT("the gameplay tag '%s' already exists"), *Target));
	IGameplayTagsEditorModule* Editor = TagsEditor();
	if (!Editor)
		return UnrealMcpRql::Fail(TEXT("the GameplayTagsEditor plugin is not loaded"));
	FString Comment;
	FName Source;
	bool bExplicit = false, bRestricted = false, bAllowChildren = false;
	Manager.GetTagEditorData(Tag, Comment, Source, bExplicit, bRestricted, bAllowChildren);
	// The listed descendants move with the tag. Each must live in a tag ini the editor can rewrite: the engine renames a
	// native / DataTable tag through a null tag list (a crash) and leaves a restricted one in place.
	const FString OldPrefix = Tag.ToString() + TEXT(".");
	FGameplayTagContainer Listed;
	Manager.RequestAllGameplayTags(Listed, /*OnlyIncludeDictionaryTags*/ true); // not ...ChildrenInDictionary: on 5.6 its names carry a number suffix ("A.B_645")
	TArray<FString> Children;
	for (const FGameplayTag& Child : Listed.GetGameplayTagArray())
	{
		const FString ChildName = Child.ToString();
		if (!ChildName.StartsWith(OldPrefix, ESearchCase::CaseSensitive))
			continue;
		FString ChildComment;
		FName ChildSource;
		bool bChildExplicit = false, bChildRestricted = false, bChildAllowChildren = false;
		Manager.GetTagEditorData(Child.GetTagName(), ChildComment, ChildSource, bChildExplicit, bChildRestricted, bChildAllowChildren);
		const FGameplayTagSource* Found = Manager.FindTagSource(ChildSource);
		if (bChildRestricted || !Found || !Found->SourceTagList)
			return UnrealMcpRql::Fail(FString::Printf(TEXT("cannot rename '%s': its child '%s' is %s, not in a tag ini; rename or remove it there first"),
				*Tag.ToString(), *ChildName, bChildRestricted ? TEXT("a restricted tag") : *FString::Printf(TEXT("declared by %s"), *ChildSource.ToString())));
		Children.Add(ChildName);
	}
	// Parents before children, so each renamed parent is written as a tag of its own.
	Children.Sort([](const FString& A, const FString& B)
	{
		int32 DotsA = 0, DotsB = 0;
		for (const TCHAR C : A) DotsA += C == TEXT('.');
		for (const TCHAR C : B) DotsB += C == TEXT('.');
		return DotsA < DotsB;
	});
	FTagLogCapture Log;
	TArray<FString> Failed;
#if UE_VERSION_OLDER_THAN(5, 7, 0)
	// Before 5.7 the engine renames the tag alone: rename the descendants first, as 5.7 does.
	for (const FString& ChildName : Children)
	{
		if (!Editor->RenameTagInINI(ChildName, Target + ChildName.RightChop(Tag.ToString().Len())))
			Failed.Add(ChildName);
	}
#endif
	const bool bRenamed = Editor->RenameTagInINI(Tag.ToString(), Target);
	// The engine renames the children first; the new parent then exists implicitly, so it never writes it and the tag
	// would lose its entry and comment. Write it as the renamed tag.
	if (bRenamed && bExplicit && !Manager.IsDictionaryTag(FName(*Target)))
		Editor->AddNewGameplayTagToINI(Target, Comment, Source, bRestricted, bAllowChildren);
	// Every descendant must exist under the new name.
	for (const FString& ChildName : Children)
	{
		if (!Failed.Contains(ChildName) && !Manager.FindTagNode(FName(*(Target + ChildName.RightChop(Tag.ToString().Len())))).IsValid())
			Failed.Add(ChildName);
	}
	if (bRenamed && Failed.Num() > 0)
		return UnrealMcpRql::Fail(FString::Printf(TEXT("renamed '%s' to '%s', but not its children %s%s"), *Tag.ToString(), *Target,
			*FString::Join(Failed, TEXT(", ")), Log.Joined().IsEmpty() ? TEXT("") : *(TEXT(": ") + Log.Joined())));
	// An explicit tag must stay explicit; an implicit one (only its children are listed) stays implicit.
	if (!bRenamed || !(bExplicit ? Manager.IsDictionaryTag(FName(*Target)) : Manager.FindTagNode(FName(*Target)).IsValid()))
		return UnrealMcpRql::Fail(FString::Printf(TEXT("could not rename '%s' to '%s'%s"), *Tag.ToString(), *Target,
			Log.Joined().IsEmpty() ? TEXT("") : *(TEXT(": ") + Log.Joined())));
}

```

```h
#pragma once

// Agent-facing texts of the rql-* tools and the unreal-rql skill (UTF-8, ASCII only so every compiler reads them alike).
// The language section is RQL's evaluated agent prompt adapted to Unreal, as Unity-MCP's RqlGuide does for Unity: the guide
// travels in the tool descriptions, which agents load before first use; the blurbs are the always-visible catalog lines.
// RQL's shared language rules (LanguageRules) follow the language section, so the rules every host states alike are not
// copied here.

#include "UnrealMcpRqlInclude.h"

namespace UnrealMcpRqlGuide
{
	/** RQL's own language rules text (conditions, ?:, list equality, group items, receipts, call, bulk create, vectors, map keys). */
	inline const char* LanguageRules()
	{
		return rql::language_rules();
	}

	inline const char* QueryBlurb()
	{
		return "Query the live Unreal Editor world (actors, components, assets, levels) with RQL in ONE call: filter, project, "
			"sort, count, walk hierarchies. Far fewer calls/tokens than reading objects one by one.";
	}

	inline const char* MutateBlurb()
	{
		return "Change the live Unreal Editor with RQL set/call: bulk edits in one all-or-nothing, undoable call; dry_run previews.";
	}

	inline const char* SchemaBlurb()
	{
		return "List RQL sources and the actor / component classes in the editor world; pass a type name for its members.";
	}

	inline const char* Language()
	{
		return R"RQL(RQL: source | stage | stage ...
Sources: actors (every actor of the editor world's loaded levels), levels, world, selection, console (editor log entries), editor (editor state and operations), dataTables, gameplayTags, settings (Project Settings / Editor Preferences sections), blueprints, widgetBlueprints, levelSequences, plus the sources of installed extensions (rql-schema lists them). Assets: unreal.assets("Material") or unreal.assets("StaticMesh", "/Game/Props") (at most 200, loaded lazily), unreal.asset("/Game/Materials/M_Red"). ref("PointLight#1234") resolves a $ref; unreal.find("Lamp") an actor by label, name or path; unreal.classes("ActorComponent", "Light") lists classes; unreal.settings("Maps & Modes") a settings object. A member path may follow a function: unreal.asset("/Game/BP_Door").EventGraph.
Stages:
  where <predicate>                  filter
  select a b.c alias=(expr)          project columns (wrap computed expressions in parentheses)
  sort <expr> [desc], ...            stable sort
  first N | skip N | count
  get <path>                         replace each item by a member (lists are flattened)
  recurse Children [max-depth=N] [include-self=false]   walk a hierarchy (input items included by default)
  distinct [expr] | sum expr | min expr | max expr | avg expr
  group-by expr                      rows key|count; group-by a, b (or kind=$type) gives one column per key, then count; aggregate each group's items: group-by $type | select key, count, avg = items.avg(Intensity) (items.sum / .min / .max / .count(pred) / .first().Label)
Expressions: == != < <= > >= and or not + - * / %; contains, starts-with, ends-with, matches "regex" (all case-insensitive); x in [a, b]; x is null; x is not null; $ is PointLight (includes subclasses; a Blueprint's $type is BP_Door_C, $ is BP_Door matches it and its child Blueprints); has(member); functions abs round floor ceil sqrt pow min(a, b) max(a, b) len lower upper coalesce; conditional: cond ? a : b or if(cond, a, b); text: replace(s, from, to) (case-insensitive), replace-regex(s, pattern, repl) ($1 = group 1), substring(s, start[, length]), split(s, sep), trim(s), pad(v, width[, fill]) - also as methods: Label.replace("Old", "New"), Label.substring(0, 4), Index.pad(3). After select, sort / where use the column names (sort Owner.Label). Literals: numbers, "strings", true/false/null, lists [a, b], objects {X: 1, Y: 2}.
Paths: a.b.c, list[0], map["key"]; .member on a list maps over its elements. List methods: .any(pred) .all(pred) .count([pred]) .sum(e) .min(e) .max(e) .first([pred]); inside them bare names refer to the element, falling back to the outer item.
Meta: $ (current item), $ref (stable id such as PointLight#1234), $type, $path, $index, $depth. Enums compare to strings: the entry name, the editor's display name or the number (Mobility == "Movable"); == on strings is case-sensitive.
Unreal: every object has Id, Name, Path. Actor has Label, Location, Rotation, Scale (world transform), Components (list), Children (attached actors), Parent, Folder, Level, HiddenInEditor (editor viewport only), bHidden (Actor Hidden In Game: invisible when playing), Selected; a Volume also BrushExtent (writable: rebuilds its box brush) and BrushBounds. Other members are the reflected properties (UPROPERTY EditAnywhere / VisibleAnywhere / BlueprintVisible) under their C++ names (bHidden, Intensity, RelativeLocation, StaticMesh); find them via actors | get Components | where $ is PointLightComponent (every light: $ is LightComponentBase; LightComponent leaves out sky lights). Vectors, rotators and colors print as (x, y, z) (rotators (pitch, yaw, roll)); write "(1, 2, 3)", [1, 2, 3] or {X: 1, Y: 2, Z: 3}; colors also "#ff8800". Vector, Vector2D, Vector4, LinearColor and Rotator compute component-wise: Scale * 1.5, Location + [0, 0, 100], Location - Other.Location (a rotator per axis, Rotation + [0, 90, 0] adds 90 to Yaw: an editor nudge, not a composed rotation); Quat and Transform do not. Object references accept ref("..."), unreal.asset(path) or an asset path "/Game/Meshes/SM_Cube". Material parameters: Scalars["Roughness"], Vectors["BaseColor"], Textures["Albedo"]. Gameplay tags are text: Tag == "Ability.Fire", set Tags = ["Ability.Fire", "State.Stunned"] (registered tags only). DataTable rows: Rows["Sword"].Damage (RowNames, RowStructName). Blueprints: Components (the components it adds; their defaults: StaticMesh, ...), Graphs / EventGraph -> Nodes -> Pins (Name Direction Type DefaultValue LinkedTo). User-defined structs: Fields. Widget Blueprints: RootWidget / Widgets, panels have Children, widgets Parent, Slot and IsVariable (set true to read the widget in graphs). Level Sequences: Bindings -> Tracks -> Sections -> Channels (frames at the display rate). Destroyed objects read as null (where StaticMesh == null finds empty references). Navigate with paths or get; select only projects output columns.
Results come back as compact rows (header line, then col|col). Long results are truncated - refine with where/first or use count. Unknown members produce warnings with suggestions; rql-schema(type) lists a type's members.)RQL";
	}

	inline const char* QueryExamples()
	{
		return R"RQL(Examples:
  actors | where Label contains "Enemy" | select $ref Label Location
  actors | get Components | where $ is PointLightComponent and Intensity > 2 | select Owner.Label Intensity LightColor
  actors | get Components | where $ is LightComponentBase and CastShadows | sort Intensity desc | select Owner.Label $type Intensity      every light kind (sky lights too)
  actors | where Parent == null | recurse Children | select $depth Label
  unreal.assets("MaterialInstanceConstant") | select Name Scalars Vectors
  console | where Verbosity == "Error" | sort Sequence desc | first 5 | select Message
  actors | get Components | where $ is LightComponentBase | group-by $type | select key, count, avg = items.avg(Intensity)
  levels | select Map IsPersistent IsCurrent IsVisible
  editor | select IsPlaying IsPaused Selection
  editor | select NextUndo UndoHistory RedoHistory      what Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y would revert (RQL steps are "RQL: <query>")
  actors | where $ is Volume | select Label BrushExtent BrushBounds      volume shapes (BrushExtent null = no brush, no shape)
  unreal.asset("/Game/Data/DT_Weapons") | get Rows | where Value.Damage > 10 | select Key Value.Damage
  gameplayTags | where Name starts-with "Ability." | select Name Comment
  settings | where Container == "Project" | select Category Section DisplayName
  unreal.asset("/Game/BP_Door").EventGraph | get Nodes | select $ref Title Pins.Name)RQL";
	}

	{

                         values see each target: $ (the target), $index (its position in the stream entering set / call)
  call Method(args)      invoke a method the tools expose

  actors | where Label == "Lamp" | set Parent = ref("StaticMeshActor#1234")   attach, keeping the world transform; null detaches
  actors | where Label == "Crate" | call Duplicate("(200, 0, 0)")        copy with an offset (returns the copy)
Levels, assets, editor state:
  editor | call OpenLevel("/Game/Maps/Arena")        editor | call NewLevel("/Game/Maps/New")
  editor | call SaveLevel()        editor | call SaveAll()        levels | where Map == "Sub" | set IsCurrent = true

Data, tags, settings (settings are saved to their ini at once, tag edits too; neither is undoable):

Widgets and sequences:

  unreal.asset("/Game/Cine/LS_Intro") | get Bindings | get Tracks | get Sections | call AddKey("Location.Z", 30, 200)    channels: Location.X, Rotation.Yaw, Scale.Z ...
  ... | get Bindings | where Name == "Lamp" | call AddTrack("Intensity")      any animatable property (the light component's too); key it: AddKey("Intensity", 60, 5000)
)RQL";
	}

	inline const char* QuerySyntaxShort()

		return R"RQL(Query part: the RQL of rql-query (full guide and the sources in its description); unreal.assets("Material"), unreal.asset(path), unreal.find("Label"), ref("PointLight#1234"). Stages: where, select, sort, first N, get <path>, recurse Children. Operators: == != < > and or not, contains, starts-with, $ is PointLight, cond ? a : b; conditions must be booleans (StaticMesh != null, has(x)). Paths a.b.c, list[0], map["key"]. Vectors/colors as "(1, 2, 3)" or "#ff8800"; enums as strings.)RQL";

	inline const char* MutateIntro()
	{
		return "Change the live Unreal Editor with an RQL query whose last stage is set or call. All-or-nothing: every target and "
			"value is checked before anything is written; a failure changes nothing. One undo step in the editor (Ctrl+Z). Changes "
			"are not saved to disk: when the user wants them saved, run editor | call SaveAsset(\"/Game/Path\") (one asset), SaveLevel() or SaveAll(). dry_run=true returns the "
			"receipt ($ref, member, old, new) without changing anything. The receipt lists the assignments that change a value; those that keep "
			"the old value are only counted (N unchanged). Do exactly the change requested; a read-only member fails "
			"with readonly-member instead of being approximated.";
	}

	inline const char* MutateOutro()
	{
		return "Object literals build values: set Settings = {Speed: 2}. At most 200 targets per call by default: pass max_targets "
			"(up to 1000) for a bigger edit, it stays one all-or-nothing undo step; beyond 1000 split it with first N / skip N. A misspelt "
			"member in where / get that leaves set / call nothing to change is an error (nothing changed); a real member no remaining "
			"item has is a no-match (0 changes, warning). Filter before setting a member only some classes have: where $ is "
			"LightComponentBase (or has(Intensity)) | set Intensity = ... When you use a different member than the user named (a "
			"misspelling, or the did-you-mean of a warning), tell the user which member you changed. Bulk create: range(0, N) | call "
			"editor.SpawnActor(... $ ...) spawns N actors in one call (each counts against max_targets; every spawn is checked "
			"before the first); the receipt has one row per actor with its $ref.";
	}

	{
		return "Without a type: RQL sources, functions, and the actor and component classes in the editor world (with counts), "

			"members (name type; ro = read-only) and methods. Use it before querying an unfamiliar class.";
	}
```

```cpp
// Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak. Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.
// See the LICENSE file in the repository root for more information.

#include "IUnrealMcpRqlModule.h"
#include "UnrealMcpRqlTypes.h"

#include "Interfaces/IPluginManager.h"
#include "Modules/ModuleManager.h"
#include "Tools/UnrealMcpObjectRef.h"

namespace UnrealMcpRqlModuleLocal
{
	bool GInCall = false;
	bool GCallFailed = false;
	FString GCallFailure;
}

FName IUnrealMcpRqlModule::GetModularFeatureName()
{
	static const FName Name(TEXT("UnrealMcpRqlModule"));
	return Name;
}

void UnrealMcpRql::Fail(const FString& Message)
{
	using namespace UnrealMcpRqlModuleLocal;
	if (!GInCall || GCallFailed)
		return; // outside an RQL call, or the first failure wins
	GCallFailed = true;
	GCallFailure = Message.IsEmpty() ? FString(TEXT("the call failed")) : Message;
}

UClass* UnrealMcpRql::ResolveClass(const FString& Name)
{
	return FUnrealMcpObjectRef::ResolveClass(Name);
}

UObject* UnrealMcpRql::LoadObject(UClass* Class, const FString& Path)
{
	return FUnrealMcpObjectRef::LoadObjectQuiet(Class, Path);
}

UWorld* UnrealMcpRql::EditorWorld()
{
	return FUnrealMcpObjectRef::GetEditorWorld();
}

FString UnrealMcpRql::PluginVersion(const FString& PluginName)
{
	const TSharedPtr<IPlugin> Plugin = IPluginManager::Get().FindPlugin(PluginName);
	return Plugin.IsValid() ? Plugin->GetDescriptor().VersionName : FString();
}

void UnrealMcpRqlBeginCall()
{
	using namespace UnrealMcpRqlModuleLocal;
	GInCall = true;
	GCallFailed = false;
	GCallFailure.Reset();
}

bool UnrealMcpRqlEndCall(FString& OutFailure)
{
	using namespace UnrealMcpRqlModuleLocal;
	GInCall = false;
	OutFailure = GCallFailure;
	const bool bFailed = GCallFailed;
	GCallFailed = false;
	GCallFailure.Reset();
	return bFailed;
}

/** The RQL data layer module (docs/rql.md): the editor coordinator registers the tools and runs the module pass. */
IMPLEMENT_MODULE(FDefaultModuleImpl, UnrealMcpRql)
```
