`UnrealMCP/Source/UnrealMcpRql/Private/UnrealMcpRqlSequences.cpp`:

```cpp
// Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak. Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.
// See the LICENSE file in the repository root for more information.

#include "UnrealMcpRqlSession.h"
#include "UnrealMcpRqlSources.h"
#include "UnrealMcpRqlUtil.h"
#include "Tools/UnrealMcpObjectRef.h"

#include "Channels/MovieSceneBoolChannel.h"
#include "Channels/MovieSceneChannelProxy.h"
#include "Channels/MovieSceneDoubleChannel.h"
#include "Channels/MovieSceneFloatChannel.h"
#include "Components/ActorComponent.h"
#include "Components/SceneComponent.h"
#include "EngineUtils.h"
#include "GameFramework/Actor.h"
#include "LevelSequence.h"
#include "MovieScene.h"
#include "MovieScenePossessable.h"
#include "MovieSceneSection.h"
#include "MovieSceneTrack.h"
#include "Tracks/MovieScene3DTransformTrack.h"
#include "Tracks/MovieSceneBoolTrack.h"
#include "Tracks/MovieSceneColorTrack.h"
#include "Tracks/MovieSceneDoubleTrack.h"
#include "Tracks/MovieSceneFloatTrack.h"
#include "Tracks/MovieScenePropertyTrack.h"
#include "Tracks/MovieSceneVectorTrack.h"
#include "Tracks/MovieSceneVisibilityTrack.h"

#include <memory>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

/**
 * Level Sequences (docs/rql.md "Level Sequences"). A sequence's bindings, tracks, sections and keys live in its
 * UMovieScene, mostly outside reflection (bindings are structs of GUIDs, keys are channel data). The core module
 * exposes them in the units the Sequencer shows: frames at the sequence's display rate. Every change is undoable; keys
 * are added to the double / float / bool channels sections have (transforms, floats, visibility ...).
 */
namespace UnrealMcpRqlSequencesLocal
{
	using namespace UnrealMcpRqlUtil;

	/** A binding of a sequence: valid while the sequence lives and still has a binding with that id. */
	struct FBindingHandle
	{
		TWeakObjectPtr<ULevelSequence> Sequence;
		FGuid Guid;

		const FMovieSceneBinding* Resolve() const
		{
			const ULevelSequence* Owner = Sequence.Get();
			const UMovieScene* Scene = Owner ? Owner->GetMovieScene() : nullptr;
			return Scene ? Scene->FindBinding(Guid) : nullptr;
		}
		const FMovieSceneBinding& Require() const
		{
			const FMovieSceneBinding* Binding = Resolve();
			if (!Binding)
				Throw(TEXT("the binding is gone: read the sequence's Bindings again"));
			return *Binding;
		}
	};

	char BindingTypeKey = 0;

	UMovieScene* SceneOf(const ULevelSequence* Sequence)
	{
		UMovieScene* Scene = Sequence ? Sequence->GetMovieScene() : nullptr;
		if (!Scene)
			Throw(TEXT("the Level Sequence has no movie scene"));
		return Scene;
	}

	UMovieScene* SceneOf(const UObject* Object)
	{
		UMovieScene* Scene = Object ? const_cast<UMovieScene*>(Object->GetTypedOuter<UMovieScene>()) : nullptr;
		if (!Scene)
			Throw(FString::Printf(TEXT("%s is not part of a Level Sequence"), Object ? *Object->GetName() : TEXT("the object")));
		return Scene;
	}

	/** Display frames (what the Sequencer shows) <-> tick frames (what the movie scene stores). */
	int32 ToDisplay(const UMovieScene* Scene, FFrameNumber Tick)
	{
		return FFrameRate::TransformTime(FFrameTime(Tick), Scene->GetTickResolution(), Scene->GetDisplayRate()).RoundToFrame().Value;
	}

	FFrameNumber ToTick(const UMovieScene* Scene, double Display)
	{
		return FFrameRate::TransformTime(FFrameTime::FromDecimal(Display), Scene->GetDisplayRate(), Scene->GetTickResolution()).RoundToFrame();
	}

	FString RateText(const FFrameRate& Rate)
	{
		return Rate.ToPrettyText().ToString();
	}

	const rql::TypeDescriptor* Int()
	{
		return rql::builtin::number_type(true, true, 4);
	}

	double NumberArg(const rql::Value& Value, const TCHAR* What)
	{
		if (!Value.is_number())
			ThrowMismatch(What, Value);
		return Value.as_number();
	}

	/** The track class a name means ("Transform", "Visibility", "CameraCut", "MovieSceneFloatTrack"); nullptr when none. */
	UClass* FindTrackClass(const FString& Name)
	{
		const FString Trimmed = Name.TrimStartAndEnd();
		if (Trimmed.Equals(TEXT("Transform"), ESearchCase::IgnoreCase))
			return UMovieScene3DTransformTrack::StaticClass();
		if (Trimmed.Equals(TEXT("Visibility"), ESearchCase::IgnoreCase))
			return UMovieSceneVisibilityTrack::StaticClass();
		UClass* Class = FUnrealMcpObjectRef::ResolveClass(Trimmed);
		if (!Class || !Class->IsChildOf(UMovieSceneTrack::StaticClass()))
			Class = FUnrealMcpObjectRef::ResolveClass(FString(TEXT("MovieScene")) + Trimmed + TEXT("Track"));
		if (!Class || !Class->IsChildOf(UMovieSceneTrack::StaticClass()) || Class->HasAnyClassFlags(CLASS_Abstract))
			return nullptr;
		return Class;
	}

	UClass* TrackClass(const FString& Name)
	{
		UClass* Class = FindTrackClass(Name);
		if (!Class)
			Throw(FString::Printf(TEXT("'%s' is not a track class (\"Transform\", \"Visibility\", \"CameraCut\", ...)"), *Name.TrimStartAndEnd()));
		return Class;
	}

	/** A section spanning the playback range on @p Track (what the Sequencer's "+ Track" does). */
	UMovieSceneSection* AddSection(UMovieScene* Scene, UMovieSceneTrack* Track)
	{
		Track->Modify();
		UMovieSceneSection* Section = Track->CreateNewSection();
		if (!Section)
			Throw(FString::Printf(TEXT("%s cannot have sections"), *Track->GetClass()->GetName()));
		Section->SetFlags(RF_Transactional);
		Section->SetRange(Scene->GetPlaybackRange());
		Track->AddSection(*Section);
		return Section;
	}

	/** A property track animates nothing until it names its property (Transform names its own; Visibility is set by AddBindingTrack). */
	bool NeedsProperty(const UClass* Class)
	{
		return Class->IsChildOf(UMovieScenePropertyTrack::StaticClass()) && !Class->IsChildOf(UMovieScene3DTransformTrack::StaticClass());
	}

	UMovieSceneTrack* AddTrackTo(UMovieScene* Scene, const FGuid* Binding, const FString& ClassName)
	{
		UClass* Class = TrackClass(ClassName);
		if (!Binding && NeedsProperty(Class))
			Throw(FString::Printf(TEXT("%s animates a property of a bound object: bind the actor (AddActor) and call AddTrack(\"<property>\") on its binding, e.g. AddTrack(\"Intensity\")"),
				*Class->GetName()));
		Scene->Modify();
		UMovieSceneTrack* Track = Binding ? Scene->AddTrack(Class, *Binding) : Scene->AddTrack(Class);
		if (!Track)
			Throw(FString::Printf(TEXT("could not add a %s"), *Class->GetName()));
		Track->SetFlags(RF_Transactional);
		AddSection(Scene, Track);
		return Track;
	}

	// ---------------------------------------------------------------- property tracks

	/** The property track class the Sequencer uses for a property (nullptr: no track animates it). */
	UClass* PropertyTrackClass(const FProperty* Property)
	{
		if (Property->IsA<FFloatProperty>())
			return UMovieSceneFloatTrack::StaticClass();
		if (Property->IsA<FDoubleProperty>())
			return UMovieSceneDoubleTrack::StaticClass();
		if (Property->IsA<FBoolProperty>())
			return UMovieSceneBoolTrack::StaticClass();
		if (const FStructProperty* Struct = CastField<FStructProperty>(Property))
		{
			if (Struct->Struct == TBaseStructure<FLinearColor>::Get() || Struct->Struct == TBaseStructure<FColor>::Get())
				return UMovieSceneColorTrack::StaticClass();
			if (Struct->Struct == TBaseStructure<FVector>::Get())
				return UMovieSceneDoubleVectorTrack::StaticClass();
		}
		return nullptr;
	}

	/** Keyable in the Sequencer: marked Interp (the "+ Track" property menu) and of a type a property track animates. */
	bool IsAnimatable(const FProperty* Property)
	{
		return Property->HasAnyPropertyFlags(CPF_Interp) && PropertyTrackClass(Property) != nullptr;
	}

	/** The object a binding possesses in the editor world: an actor, or a component of a bound actor (nullptr: not found). */
	UObject* BoundObject(ULevelSequence* Sequence, const FGuid& Guid)
	{
		UWorld* World = EditorWorld();
		UMovieScene* Scene = SceneOf(Sequence);
		const FMovieScenePossessable* Possessable = Scene->FindPossessable(Guid);
		if (!World || !Possessable)
			return nullptr;
		if (Possessable->GetParent().IsValid())
		{
			AActor* Owner = Cast<AActor>(BoundObject(Sequence, Possessable->GetParent()));
			if (!Owner)
				return nullptr;
			for (UActorComponent* Component : TInlineComponentArray<UActorComponent*>(Owner))
				if (Component->GetName() == Possessable->GetName() && Sequence->FindBindingFromObject(Component, Owner) == Guid)
					return Component;
			return nullptr;
		}
		// Asking the sequence is costly (a transient playback state per object): try the actors still labelled as the
		// possessable (named after the label when bound) first, then the rest of its class.
		const UClass* Class = Possessable->GetPossessedObjectClass();
		for (const bool bLabelled : { true, false })
		{
			for (TActorIterator<AActor> It(World); It; ++It)
			{
				if ((Class && !It->IsA(Class)) || (It->GetActorLabel() == Possessable->GetName()) != bLabelled)
					continue;
				if (Sequence->FindBindingFromObject(*It, World) == Guid)
					return *It;
			}
		}
		return nullptr;
	}

	/** An animatable property of @p Bound or (for an actor) of one of its components: "Intensity", "LightComponent0.Intensity". */
	TPair<UObject*, FProperty*> FindAnimatable(UObject* Bound, const FString& Path, bool bThrowIfMissing = true)
	{
		FString Owner, Name = Path.TrimStartAndEnd();
		if (Name.Contains(TEXT(".")))
			Name.Split(TEXT("."), &Owner, &Name);
		TArray<UObject*> Objects;
		if (Owner.IsEmpty())
			Objects.Add(Bound);
		TArray<FString> Available;
		if (AActor* Actor = Cast<AActor>(Bound))
		{
			for (UActorComponent* Component : TInlineComponentArray<UActorComponent*>(Actor))
			{
				const bool bNamed = Owner.IsEmpty() || Component->GetName().Equals(Owner, ESearchCase::IgnoreCase)
					|| Component->GetClass()->GetName().Equals(Owner, ESearchCase::IgnoreCase)
					|| Component->GetClass()->GetName().Equals(Owner + TEXT("Component"), ESearchCase::IgnoreCase);
				if (bNamed)
					Objects.Add(Component);
			}
		}
		TArray<TPair<UObject*, FProperty*>> Hits;
		for (UObject* Object : Objects)
		{
			for (TFieldIterator<FProperty> It(Object->GetClass()); It; ++It)
			{
				if (!IsAnimatable(*It))
					continue;
				const FString Shown = Object == Bound ? It->GetName() : Object->GetName() + TEXT(".") + It->GetName();
				Available.AddUnique(Shown);
				if (It->GetName().Equals(Name, ESearchCase::IgnoreCase))
					Hits.Add({ Object, *It });
			}
		}
		if (Hits.Num() == 1)
			return Hits[0];
		const FString Label = Cast<AActor>(Bound) ? Cast<AActor>(Bound)->GetActorLabel() : Bound->GetName();
		if (Hits.Num() > 1)
		{
			TArray<FString> Names;
			for (const TPair<UObject*, FProperty*>& Hit : Hits)
				Names.Add(Hit.Key->GetName() + TEXT(".") + Hit.Value->GetName());
			Throw(FString::Printf(TEXT("'%s' is a property of several components of %s: name one (%s)"), *Path, *Label, *FString::Join(Names, TEXT(", "))));
		}
		if (!bThrowIfMissing)
			return { nullptr, nullptr };
		Available.Sort();
		if (Available.Num() > 25)
		{
			Available.SetNum(25);
			Available.Add(TEXT("..."));
		}
		Throw(FString::Printf(TEXT("'%s' is not a track class nor an animatable property of %s (track classes: \"Transform\", \"Visibility\"; animatable properties: %s)"),
			*Path, *Label, Available.Num() ? *FString::Join(Available, TEXT(", ")) : TEXT("none")));
	}

	/** The binding of a component of a bound actor, made as the Sequencer makes it (a child possessable) when missing. */
	FGuid ComponentBinding(ULevelSequence* Sequence, const FGuid& ActorGuid, AActor* Actor, UActorComponent* Component)
	{
		UMovieScene* Scene = SceneOf(Sequence);
		for (int32 Index = 0; Index < Scene->GetPossessableCount(); ++Index)
		{
			const FMovieScenePossessable& Child = Scene->GetPossessable(Index);
			if (Child.GetParent() == ActorGuid && Child.GetName() == Component->GetName())
				return Child.GetGuid();
		}
		Sequence->Modify();
		Scene->Modify();
		const FGuid Guid = Scene->AddPossessable(Component->GetName(), Component->GetClass());
		if (FMovieScenePossessable* Possessable = Scene->FindPossessable(Guid))
			Possessable->SetParent(ActorGuid, Scene);
		Sequence->BindPossessableObject(Guid, *Component, Actor);
		return Guid;
	}

	/**
	 * AddTrack on a binding: a track class ("Transform", "Visibility", "MovieSceneFloatTrack" refused without a property),
	 * or a property to animate ("Intensity", "LightComponent0.Intensity"): the property track of its type, bound to the
	 * property, on the actor's binding or on its component's (created as the Sequencer does).
	 */
	UMovieSceneTrack* AddBindingTrack(ULevelSequence* Sequence, const FGuid& Guid, const FString& What)
	{
		UMovieScene* Scene = SceneOf(Sequence);
		UClass* Class = FindTrackClass(What);
		if (Class && Class->IsChildOf(UMovieSceneVisibilityTrack::StaticClass()))
		{
			// The Sequencer's Visibility track keys the actor's "Actor Hidden In Game" (a component's bHiddenInGame).
			const FMovieScenePossessable* Possessable = Scene->FindPossessable(Guid);
			const UClass* BoundClass = Possessable ? Possessable->GetPossessedObjectClass() : nullptr;
			UMovieScenePropertyTrack* Track = Cast<UMovieScenePropertyTrack>(AddTrackTo(Scene, &Guid, What));
			const FName Hidden = BoundClass && BoundClass->IsChildOf(USceneComponent::StaticClass()) ? FName(TEXT("bHiddenInGame")) : FName(TEXT("bHidden"));
			Track->SetPropertyNameAndPath(Hidden, Hidden.ToString());
			return Track;
		}
		if (Class && !NeedsProperty(Class))
			return AddTrackTo(Scene, &Guid, What);
		// A property, or a name that only resolves to a property track class ("Color" -> MovieSceneColorTrack): a property
		// of that name wins, else the class alone is refused (it would animate nothing).
		UObject* Bound = BoundObject(Sequence, Guid);
		const TPair<UObject*, FProperty*> Target = Bound ? FindAnimatable(Bound, What, /*bThrowIfMissing*/ Class == nullptr) : TPair<UObject*, FProperty*>(nullptr, nullptr);
		if (!Target.Key)
		{
			if (Class)
				Throw(FString::Printf(TEXT("%s needs the property it animates: call AddTrack(\"<property>\") instead (e.g. AddTrack(\"Intensity\")); the track class follows from the property's type"),
					*Class->GetName()));
			Throw(FString::Printf(TEXT("'%s' is not a track class, and the bound object is not in the editor world, so its properties cannot be looked up"), *What));
		}
		FGuid TrackGuid = Guid;
		if (Target.Key != Bound)
			TrackGuid = ComponentBinding(Sequence, Guid, CastChecked<AActor>(Bound), CastChecked<UActorComponent>(Target.Key));
		const FMovieSceneBinding* Binding = Scene->FindBinding(TrackGuid);
		if (!Binding)
			Throw(FString::Printf(TEXT("the binding of %s is missing from the movie scene (a damaged sequence): rebind it"), *Target.Key->GetName()));
		const FName Property = Target.Value->GetFName();
		for (UMovieSceneTrack* Existing : Binding->GetTracks())
		{
			const UMovieScenePropertyTrack* PropertyTrack = Cast<UMovieScenePropertyTrack>(Existing);
			if (PropertyTrack && PropertyTrack->GetPropertyName() == Property)
				Throw(FString::Printf(TEXT("%s already has a %s track: key it (get Tracks | get Sections | call AddKey(\"%s\", frame, value))"),
					*Target.Key->GetName(), *Property.ToString(), *Property.ToString()));
		}
		UClass* PropertyClass = PropertyTrackClass(Target.Value);
		Scene->Modify();
		UMovieScenePropertyTrack* Track = Cast<UMovieScenePropertyTrack>(Scene->AddTrack(PropertyClass, TrackGuid));
		if (!Track)
			Throw(FString::Printf(TEXT("could not add a %s"), *PropertyClass->GetName()));
		Track->SetFlags(RF_Transactional);
		Track->SetPropertyNameAndPath(Property, Property.ToString());
		if (UMovieSceneDoubleVectorTrack* Vector = Cast<UMovieSceneDoubleVectorTrack>(Track))
			Vector->SetNumChannelsUsed(3);
		AddSection(Scene, Track);
		return Track;
	}

	// ---------------------------------------------------------------- channels

	/**
	 * Visit every keyable channel of a section with its display name ("Location.X", "Rotation.Yaw", "Bool", "Weight") and
	 * its internal name ("Rotation.Z", the name Python and the channel metadata use; empty when there is none).
	 */
	void ForEachChannel(UMovieSceneSection* Section, TFunctionRef<void(const FString&, const FString&, FMovieSceneChannel*, FName)> Visit)
	{
		FMovieSceneChannelProxy& Proxy = Section->GetChannelProxy();
		// A property track's single channel carries no name (float, bool ... sections): it is named after the property.
		const UMovieScenePropertyTrack* PropertyTrack = Section->GetTypedOuter<UMovieScenePropertyTrack>();
		// A Visibility section's bool is inverted (true = visible) although the track binds bHidden: it is named Visible.
		const FString PropertyName = Cast<UMovieSceneVisibilityTrack>(PropertyTrack) ? FString(TEXT("Visible"))
			: PropertyTrack && !PropertyTrack->GetPropertyName().IsNone() ? PropertyTrack->GetPropertyName().ToString() : FString();
		for (const FMovieSceneChannelEntry& Entry : Proxy.GetAllEntries())
		{
			const FName Type = Entry.GetChannelTypeName();
			TArrayView<FMovieSceneChannel* const> Channels = Entry.GetChannels();
#if WITH_EDITOR
			TArrayView<const FMovieSceneChannelMetaData> Meta = Entry.GetMetaData();
#endif
			for (int32 Index = 0; Index < Channels.Num(); ++Index)
			{
				FString Name = FString::Printf(TEXT("%s%d"), *Type.ToString(), Index);
				FString Internal;
#if WITH_EDITOR
				if (Meta.IsValidIndex(Index))
				{
					const FString Display = Meta[Index].DisplayText.ToString();
					const FString Group = Meta[Index].Group.ToString();
					Internal = Meta[Index].Name.IsNone() ? FString() : Meta[Index].Name.ToString();
					Name = Display.IsEmpty() ? Internal : (Group.IsEmpty() ? Display : Group + TEXT(".") + Display);
				}
#endif
				if (Name.IsEmpty() || (Internal.IsEmpty() && Name.StartsWith(Type.ToString())))
					Name = PropertyName.IsEmpty() ? FString::Printf(TEXT("%s%d"), *Type.ToString(), Index)
						: Channels.Num() == 1 ? PropertyName : FString::Printf(TEXT("%s%d"), *PropertyName, Index);
				Visit(Name, Internal, Channels[Index], Type);
			}
		}
	}

	bool IsDouble(FName Type) { return Type == FMovieSceneDoubleChannel::StaticStruct()->GetFName(); }
	bool IsFloat(FName Type) { return Type == FMovieSceneFloatChannel::StaticStruct()->GetFName(); }
	bool IsBool(FName Type) { return Type == FMovieSceneBoolChannel::StaticStruct()->GetFName(); }

	rql::Value Keys(const UMovieScene* Scene, FMovieSceneChannel* Channel, FName Type)
	{
		std::vector<rql::Value> Out;
		auto Push = [&Out, Scene](FFrameNumber Time, rql::Value Value)
		{
			std::vector<std::pair<rql::Value, rql::Value>> Key;
			Key.emplace_back(Str(TEXT("Frame")), rql::Value::number(ToDisplay(Scene, Time), Int()));
			Key.emplace_back(Str(TEXT("Value")), std::move(Value));
			Out.push_back(rql::Value::map(std::make_shared<rql::OwnedMap>(nullptr, std::move(Key))));
		};
		if (IsDouble(Type))
		{
			TMovieSceneChannelData<FMovieSceneDoubleValue> Data = static_cast<FMovieSceneDoubleChannel*>(Channel)->GetData();
			for (int32 Index = 0; Index < Data.GetTimes().Num(); ++Index)
				Push(Data.GetTimes()[Index], rql::Value::number(Data.GetValues()[Index].Value));
		}
		else if (IsFloat(Type))
		{
			TMovieSceneChannelData<FMovieSceneFloatValue> Data = static_cast<FMovieSceneFloatChannel*>(Channel)->GetData();
			for (int32 Index = 0; Index < Data.GetTimes().Num(); ++Index)
				Push(Data.GetTimes()[Index], rql::Value::number(Data.GetValues()[Index].Value, rql::builtin::single_type()));
		}
		else if (IsBool(Type))
		{
			TMovieSceneChannelData<bool> Data = static_cast<FMovieSceneBoolChannel*>(Channel)->GetData();
			for (int32 Index = 0; Index < Data.GetTimes().Num(); ++Index)
				Push(Data.GetTimes()[Index], rql::Value::boolean(Data.GetValues()[Index]));
		}
		return rql::Value::list_of(std::move(Out));
	}

	void AddKey(UMovieSceneSection* Section, const FString& Wanted, double Frame, const rql::Value& Value)
	{
		const UMovieScene* Scene = SceneOf(Section);
		const FFrameNumber Time = ToTick(Scene, Frame);
		TArray<FString> Names;
		const FString Key = Wanted.TrimStartAndEnd();
		// The channel shown under that name, else the one with that internal name ("Rotation.Z" is the yaw).
		struct FHit { FString Name; FMovieSceneChannel* Channel = nullptr; FName Type; };
		FHit ByDisplay, ByInternal;
		ForEachChannel(Section, [&](const FString& Name, const FString& Internal, FMovieSceneChannel* Channel, FName Type)
		{
			Names.Add(Name);
			if (!ByDisplay.Channel && Name.Equals(Key, ESearchCase::IgnoreCase))
				ByDisplay = { Name, Channel, Type };
			else if (!ByInternal.Channel && !Internal.IsEmpty() && Internal.Equals(Key, ESearchCase::IgnoreCase))
				ByInternal = { Name, Channel, Type };
		});
		const FHit& Hit = ByDisplay.Channel ? ByDisplay : ByInternal;
		if (!Hit.Channel)
			Throw(FString::Printf(TEXT("%s has no channel '%s' (channels: %s)"), *Section->GetName(), *Wanted, *FString::Join(Names, TEXT(", "))));
		FMovieSceneChannel* Channel = Hit.Channel;
		const FName Type = Hit.Type;
		// AddCubicKey inserts next to a key at the same frame: drop that key first, so the new one replaces it.
		if (IsDouble(Type))
		{
			const double Number = NumberArg(Value, TEXT("a number"));
			Section->Modify();
			FMovieSceneDoubleChannel* DoubleChannel = static_cast<FMovieSceneDoubleChannel*>(Channel);
			TMovieSceneChannelData<FMovieSceneDoubleValue> Data = DoubleChannel->GetData();
			const int32 Existing = Data.FindKey(Time);
			if (Existing != INDEX_NONE)
				Data.RemoveKey(Existing);
			DoubleChannel->AddCubicKey(Time, Number);
		}
		else if (IsFloat(Type))
		{
			const double Number = NumberArg(Value, TEXT("a number"));
			Section->Modify();
			FMovieSceneFloatChannel* FloatChannel = static_cast<FMovieSceneFloatChannel*>(Channel);
			TMovieSceneChannelData<FMovieSceneFloatValue> Data = FloatChannel->GetData();
			const int32 Existing = Data.FindKey(Time);
			if (Existing != INDEX_NONE)
				Data.RemoveKey(Existing);
			FloatChannel->AddCubicKey(Time, static_cast<float>(Number));
		}
		else if (IsBool(Type))
		{
			const bool bValue = BoolArg(Value);
			Section->Modify();
			TMovieSceneChannelData<bool> Data = static_cast<FMovieSceneBoolChannel*>(Channel)->GetData();
			const int32 Existing = Data.FindKey(Time);
			if (Existing != INDEX_NONE)
				Data.GetValues()[Existing] = bValue;
			else
				Data.AddKey(Time, bValue);
		}
		else
		{
			Throw(FString::Printf(TEXT("channel '%s' (%s) is not a number or bool channel"), *Hit.Name, *Type.ToString()));
		}
		// A key outside the section grows it, as keying in the Sequencer does.
		if (Section->HasStartFrame() && Section->HasEndFrame() && !Section->GetRange().Contains(Time))
			Section->ExpandToFrame(Time);
	}

	// ---------------------------------------------------------------- hooks

	rql::Value WrapBinding(const rql::TypeDescriptor* Type, ULevelSequence* Sequence, const FGuid& Guid)
	{
		auto Handle = std::make_shared<FBindingHandle>();
		Handle->Sequence = Sequence;
		Handle->Guid = Guid;
		FBindingHandle* Raw = Handle.get();
		return rql::Value::object(Type, Raw, std::static_pointer_cast<void>(Handle));
	}

	void SequenceMembers(FUnrealMcpRqlTypes& T, rql::TypeDescriptor& D, const rql::TypeDescriptor* BindingType)
	{
		FUnrealMcpRqlTypes* Types = &T;
		const rql::TypeDescriptor* TrackType = T.ForClass(UMovieSceneTrack::StaticClass());
		auto Sequence = [](void* Self) { return static_cast<ULevelSequence*>(Self); };
		FUnrealMcpRqlTypes::SetMember(D, Member("DisplayRate", rql::builtin::string_type(),
			[Sequence](void* Self) { return Str(RateText(SceneOf(Sequence(Self))->GetDisplayRate())); }, {}, "frames per second of the frame numbers below"));
		FUnrealMcpRqlTypes::SetMember(D, Member("Start", Int(),
			[Sequence](void* Self)
			{
				const UMovieScene* Scene = SceneOf(Sequence(Self));
				return rql::Value::number(ToDisplay(Scene, UE::MovieScene::DiscreteInclusiveLower(Scene->GetPlaybackRange())), Int());
			},
			[Sequence](void* Self, const rql::Value& Value)
			{
				UMovieScene* Scene = SceneOf(Sequence(Self));
				const FFrameNumber Start = ToTick(Scene, NumberArg(Value, TEXT("a frame number")));
				const FFrameNumber End = UE::MovieScene::DiscreteExclusiveUpper(Scene->GetPlaybackRange());
				if (Start > End)
					Throw(TEXT("Start must be before End"));
				Scene->Modify();
				Scene->SetPlaybackRange(TRange<FFrameNumber>(Start, End));
			}, "first frame of the playback range"));
		FUnrealMcpRqlTypes::SetMember(D, Member("End", Int(),
			[Sequence](void* Self)
			{
				const UMovieScene* Scene = SceneOf(Sequence(Self));
				return rql::Value::number(ToDisplay(Scene, UE::MovieScene::DiscreteExclusiveUpper(Scene->GetPlaybackRange())), Int());
			},
			[Sequence](void* Self, const rql::Value& Value)
			{
				UMovieScene* Scene = SceneOf(Sequence(Self));
				const FFrameNumber Start = UE::MovieScene::DiscreteInclusiveLower(Scene->GetPlaybackRange());
				const FFrameNumber End = ToTick(Scene, NumberArg(Value, TEXT("a frame number")));
				if (End < Start)
					Throw(TEXT("End must be after Start"));
				Scene->Modify();
				Scene->SetPlaybackRange(TRange<FFrameNumber>(Start, End));
			}, "end of the playback range (exclusive)"));
		FUnrealMcpRqlTypes::SetMember(D, Member("Bindings", T.Registry().list_type(BindingType, false),
			[Sequence, BindingType](void* Self)
			{
				ULevelSequence* Owner = Sequence(Self);
				std::vector<rql::Value> Out;
				for (const FMovieSceneBinding& Binding : SceneOf(Owner)->GetBindings())
					Out.push_back(WrapBinding(BindingType, Owner, Binding.GetObjectGuid()));
				return rql::Value::list_of(std::move(Out));
			}, {}, "the objects the sequence animates (Name Kind Class Tracks)", /*bOwning*/ true));
		FUnrealMcpRqlTypes::SetMember(D, Member("Tracks", T.Registry().list_type(TrackType, true),
			[Types, Sequence](void* Self)
			{
				TArray<UObject*> Out;
				for (UMovieSceneTrack* Track : SceneOf(Sequence(Self))->GetTracks())
					Out.Add(Track);
				return Types->WrapObjects(Out);
			}, {}, "tracks not bound to an object (camera cuts, audio, events ...)", /*bOwning*/ true));

		FUnrealMcpRqlTypes::AddMethod(D, Method("AddActor", { FUnrealMcpRqlTypes::Param("Actor", T.ForClass(AActor::StaticClass())) }, BindingType,
			[Types, Sequence, BindingType](void* Self, const std::vector<rql::Value>& Args) -> rql::Value
			{
				ULevelSequence* Owner = Sequence(Self);
				AActor* Actor = Cast<AActor>(Types->AsObject(Args[0]));
				if (!Actor)
					ThrowMismatch(TEXT("an actor of the editor world"), Args[0]);
				UWorld* World = Actor->GetWorld();
				const FGuid Existing = Owner->FindBindingFromObject(Actor, World);
				if (Existing.IsValid())
					Throw(FString::Printf(TEXT("%s is already bound in %s"), *Actor->GetActorLabel(), *Owner->GetName()));
				UMovieScene* Scene = SceneOf(Owner);
				Owner->Modify();
				Scene->Modify();
				const FGuid Guid = Scene->AddPossessable(Actor->GetActorLabel(), Actor->GetClass());
				Owner->BindPossessableObject(Guid, *Actor, World);
				return WrapBinding(BindingType, Owner, Guid);
			}, "bind an actor of the level (a possessable, as dragging it into the Sequencer); returns the binding"));
		FUnrealMcpRqlTypes::AddMethod(D, Method("AddTrack", { FUnrealMcpRqlTypes::Param("Class", rql::builtin::string_type()) }, TrackType,
			[Types, Sequence](void* Self, const std::vector<rql::Value>& Args) -> rql::Value
			{
				return Types->WrapObject(AddTrackTo(SceneOf(Sequence(Self)), nullptr, TextArg(Args[0])));
			}, "add a track not bound to an object (with a section over the playback range); returns it"));
	}

	void BindingMembers(FUnrealMcpRqlTypes& T, rql::TypeDescriptor& D)
	{
		FUnrealMcpRqlTypes* Types = &T;
		const rql::TypeDescriptor* String = rql::builtin::string_type();
		auto Binding = [](void* Self) -> const FMovieSceneBinding& { return static_cast<FBindingHandle*>(Self)->Require(); };
		auto Handle = [](void* Self) { return static_cast<FBindingHandle*>(Self); };
		FUnrealMcpRqlTypes::SetMember(D, Member("Name", String, [Handle](void* Self)
		{
			UMovieScene* Scene = SceneOf(Handle(Self)->Sequence.Get());
			if (const FMovieScenePossessable* Possessable = Scene->FindPossessable(Handle(Self)->Guid))
				return Str(Possessable->GetName());
			if (const FMovieSceneSpawnable* Spawnable = Scene->FindSpawnable(Handle(Self)->Guid))
				return Str(Spawnable->GetName());
			return Str(FString());
		}, {}, "the name shown in the Sequencer"));
		FUnrealMcpRqlTypes::SetMember(D, Member("Guid", String, [Handle](void* Self) { return Str(Handle(Self)->Guid.ToString()); }));
		FUnrealMcpRqlTypes::SetMember(D, Member("Kind", String, [Handle](void* Self)
		{
			UMovieScene* Scene = SceneOf(Handle(Self)->Sequence.Get());
			const FGuid& Guid = Handle(Self)->Guid;
			return Str(Scene->FindPossessable(Guid) ? TEXT("Possessable") : Scene->FindSpawnable(Guid) ? TEXT("Spawnable") : TEXT("Other"));
		}, {}, "Possessable (an object of the level) or Spawnable (spawned by the sequence)"));
		FUnrealMcpRqlTypes::SetMember(D, Member("Class", String, [Handle](void* Self)
		{
			UMovieScene* Scene = SceneOf(Handle(Self)->Sequence.Get());
			if (const FMovieScenePossessable* Possessable = Scene->FindPossessable(Handle(Self)->Guid))
				return Str(Possessable->GetPossessedObjectClass() ? Possessable->GetPossessedObjectClass()->GetName() : FString());
			return Str(FString());
		}));
		FUnrealMcpRqlTypes::SetMember(D, Member("Tracks", T.Registry().list_type(T.ForClass(UMovieSceneTrack::StaticClass()), true),
			[Types, Binding](void* Self)
			{
				TArray<UObject*> Out;
				for (UMovieSceneTrack* Track : Binding(Self).GetTracks())
					Out.Add(Track);
				return Types->WrapObjects(Out);
			}, {}, "the tracks animating this object", /*bOwning*/ true));
		D.display_name = "Name";
		D.display_explicit = true;
		FUnrealMcpRqlTypes::AddMethod(D, Method("AddTrack", { FUnrealMcpRqlTypes::Param("Class", String) }, T.ForClass(UMovieSceneTrack::StaticClass()),
			[Types, Handle](void* Self, const std::vector<rql::Value>& Args) -> rql::Value
			{
				FBindingHandle* Bound = Handle(Self);
				Bound->Require();
				return Types->WrapObject(AddBindingTrack(Bound->Sequence.Get(), Bound->Guid, TextArg(Args[0])));
			}, "add a track with a section over the playback range: \"Transform\", \"Visibility\", or a property to animate (\"Intensity\", \"LightColor\", \"LightComponent0.Intensity\": the actor's or a component's, keyed in the section's channel of that name); returns it"));
	}

	void TrackMembers(FUnrealMcpRqlTypes& T, rql::TypeDescriptor& D)
	{
		FUnrealMcpRqlTypes* Types = &T;
		const rql::TypeDescriptor* SectionType = T.ForClass(UMovieSceneSection::StaticClass());
		FUnrealMcpRqlTypes::SetMember(D, Member("Sections", T.Registry().list_type(SectionType, true), [Types](void* Self)
		{
			TArray<UObject*> Out;
			for (UMovieSceneSection* Section : static_cast<UMovieSceneTrack*>(Self)->GetAllSections())
				Out.Add(Section);
			return Types->WrapObjects(Out);
		}, {}, "the sections of the track", /*bOwning*/ true));
		FUnrealMcpRqlTypes::SetMember(D, Member("DisplayName", rql::builtin::string_type(), [](void* Self)
		{
			return Str(static_cast<UMovieSceneTrack*>(Self)->GetDisplayName().ToString());
		}));
		FUnrealMcpRqlTypes::AddMethod(D, Method("AddSection", {}, SectionType, [Types](void* Self, const std::vector<rql::Value>&) -> rql::Value
		{
			UMovieSceneTrack* Track = static_cast<UMovieSceneTrack*>(Self);
			return Types->WrapObject(AddSection(SceneOf(Track), Track));
		}, "add a section over the playback range; returns it"));
	}

	void SectionMembers(FUnrealMcpRqlTypes& T, rql::TypeDescriptor& D)
	{
		auto Section = [](void* Self) { return static_cast<UMovieSceneSection*>(Self); };
		FUnrealMcpRqlTypes::SetMember(D, Member("Start", Int(),
			[Section](void* Self)
			{
				UMovieSceneSection* Target = Section(Self);
				return Target->HasStartFrame() ? rql::Value::number(ToDisplay(SceneOf(Target), Target->GetInclusiveStartFrame()), Int()) : rql::Value::null();
			},
			[Section](void* Self, const rql::Value& Value)
			{
				UMovieSceneSection* Target = Section(Self);
				const FFrameNumber Start = ToTick(SceneOf(Target), NumberArg(Value, TEXT("a frame number")));
				if (Target->HasEndFrame() && Start > Target->GetExclusiveEndFrame())
					Throw(TEXT("Start must be before End"));
				Target->Modify();
				Target->SetStartFrame(TRangeBound<FFrameNumber>::Inclusive(Start));
			}, "first frame (null: unbounded)", false, true));
		FUnrealMcpRqlTypes::SetMember(D, Member("End", Int(),
			[Section](void* Self)
			{
				UMovieSceneSection* Target = Section(Self);
				return Target->HasEndFrame() ? rql::Value::number(ToDisplay(SceneOf(Target), Target->GetExclusiveEndFrame()), Int()) : rql::Value::null();
			},
			[Section](void* Self, const rql::Value& Value)
			{
				UMovieSceneSection* Target = Section(Self);
				const FFrameNumber End = ToTick(SceneOf(Target), NumberArg(Value, TEXT("a frame number")));
				if (Target->HasStartFrame() && End < Target->GetInclusiveStartFrame())
					Throw(TEXT("End must be after Start"));
				Target->Modify();
				Target->SetEndFrame(TRangeBound<FFrameNumber>::Exclusive(End));
			}, "end frame, exclusive (null: unbounded)", false, true));
		FUnrealMcpRqlTypes::SetMember(D, Member("Channels", rql::builtin::any_type(), [Section](void* Self)
		{
			UMovieSceneSection* Target = Section(Self);
			const UMovieScene* Scene = SceneOf(Target);
			std::vector<rql::Value> Out;
			ForEachChannel(Target, [&Out, Scene](const FString& Name, const FString&, FMovieSceneChannel* Channel, FName Type)
			{
				std::vector<std::pair<rql::Value, rql::Value>> Entry;
				Entry.emplace_back(Str(TEXT("Name")), Str(Name));
				Entry.emplace_back(Str(TEXT("Type")), Str(IsDouble(Type) || IsFloat(Type) ? TEXT("Number") : IsBool(Type) ? TEXT("Bool") : Type.ToString()));
				Entry.emplace_back(Str(TEXT("Keys")), Keys(Scene, Channel, Type));
				Out.push_back(rql::Value::map(std::make_shared<rql::OwnedMap>(nullptr, std::move(Entry))));
			});
			return rql::Value::list_of(std::move(Out));
		}, {}, "the keyable channels: [{Name, Type, Keys: [{Frame, Value}]}] (frames at the display rate)"));
		FUnrealMcpRqlTypes::AddMethod(D, Method("AddKey",
			{ FUnrealMcpRqlTypes::Param("Channel", rql::builtin::string_type()), FUnrealMcpRqlTypes::Param("Frame", rql::builtin::double_type()),
			  FUnrealMcpRqlTypes::Param("Value", rql::builtin::any_type()) },
			nullptr, [Section](void* Self, const std::vector<rql::Value>& Args) -> rql::Value
			{
				AddKey(Section(Self), TextArg(Args[0]), NumberArg(Args[1], TEXT("a frame number")), Args[2]);
				return rql::Value::null();
			}, "key a channel (\"Location.X\", \"Intensity\", \"Visible\") at a frame: a number, or true / false for bool channels; replaces a key at that frame"));
	}
}

void UnrealMcpRqlAddSequences(FUnrealMcpRqlSession& Session)
{
	using namespace UnrealMcpRqlSequencesLocal;
	FUnrealMcpRqlTypes& T = Session.Types();
	FUnrealMcpRqlTypes* Types = &T;
	rql::TypeDescriptor& BindingType = T.NativeObjectType(&BindingTypeKey, TEXT("SequenceBinding"),
		TEXT("an object a Level Sequence animates: Name Guid Kind Class Tracks; call AddTrack"));
	BindingMembers(T, BindingType);
	const rql::TypeDescriptor* Binding = &BindingType;
	T.AddClassHook(ULevelSequence::StaticClass(), [Binding](FUnrealMcpRqlTypes& Types, rql::TypeDescriptor& D) { SequenceMembers(Types, D, Binding); });
	T.AddClassHook(UMovieSceneTrack::StaticClass(), &TrackMembers);
	T.AddClassHook(UMovieSceneSection::StaticClass(), &SectionMembers);
	Session.AddSource(TEXT("levelSequences"), T.ForClass(ULevelSequence::StaticClass()), /*bList*/ true,
		TEXT("the project's Level Sequences (DisplayRate Start End Bindings Tracks; call AddActor / AddTrack); sections have Start End Channels, call AddKey"),
		[Types]() { return UnrealMcpRqlAssetList(*Types, ULevelSequence::StaticClass(), FString()); });
}

#include "UnrealMcpRqlSession.h"

#include "IUnrealMcpRqlModule.h"

#include "Components/ActorComponent.h"

namespace UnrealMcpRqlSessionLocal
{
	/** Objects whose changes belong to the project (not class defaults of compiled-in classes, not transient helpers). */
	bool IsProjectObject(const UObject* Object)
	{
		if (!Object)
			return false;
		const UPackage* Package = Object->GetOutermost();
		return Package && Package != GetTransientPackage() && !Package->HasAnyPackageFlags(PKG_CompiledIn);
	}

	/** JSON from an extension (AddJsonMember) as an owned RQL value. */
	rql::Value FromJson(const TSharedPtr<FJsonValue>& Json)
	{
		if (!Json.IsValid())
			return rql::Value::null();
		switch (Json->Type)
		{
		case EJson::Boolean: return rql::Value::boolean(Json->AsBool());
		case EJson::Number: return rql::Value::number(Json->AsNumber());
		case EJson::String: return rql::Value::string(UnrealMcpRqlToStd(Json->AsString()));
		case EJson::Array:
		{
			std::vector<rql::Value> Items;
			for (const TSharedPtr<FJsonValue>& Item : Json->AsArray())
				Items.push_back(FromJson(Item));
			return rql::Value::list_of(std::move(Items));
		}
		case EJson::Object:
		{
			std::vector<std::pair<rql::Value, rql::Value>> Entries;
			const TSharedPtr<FJsonObject>& Object = Json->AsObject();
			if (Object.IsValid())
			{
				for (const TPair<FString, TSharedPtr<FJsonValue>>& Pair : Object->Values)
					Entries.emplace_back(rql::Value::string(UnrealMcpRqlToStd(Pair.Key)), FromJson(Pair.Value));
			}
			return rql::Value::map(std::make_shared<rql::OwnedMap>(nullptr, std::move(Entries)));
		}
		default:
			return rql::Value::null();
		}
	}

	FString TypeLabel(const FUnrealMcpRqlSession::FEntry& Entry)
	{
		const FString Name = Entry.Type ? UnrealMcpRqlFromStd(Entry.Type->name) : FString(TEXT("any"));
		return Entry.bList ? FString(TEXT("list of ")) + Name : Name;
	}

	FString Cell(const FString& Text)
	{
		return Text.Replace(TEXT("|"), TEXT("\\|")).Replace(TEXT("\n"), TEXT(" "));
	}

	/** The UE-typed registration surface handed to IUnrealMcpRqlModule::ConfigureRql. */
	class FModuleContext final : public FUnrealMcpRqlModuleContext
	{
	public:
		explicit FModuleContext(FUnrealMcpRqlSession& InSession) : Session(InSession) {}

		virtual void AddObjectSource(const FString& Name, const FString& Description, UClass* Class, TFunction<UObject*()> Getter) override
		{
			FUnrealMcpRqlTypes* Types = &Session.Types();
			Session.AddSource(Name, Types->ForClass(Class ? Class : UObject::StaticClass()), /*bList*/ false, Description,
				[Types, Getter]() { return Types->WrapObject(Getter ? Getter() : nullptr); });
		}

		virtual void AddObjectListSource(const FString& Name, const FString& Description, UClass* ElementClass,
			TFunction<TArray<UObject*>()> Getter) override
		{
			FUnrealMcpRqlTypes* Types = &Session.Types();
			Session.AddSource(Name, Types->ForClass(ElementClass ? ElementClass : UObject::StaticClass()), /*bList*/ true, Description,
				[Types, Getter]() { return Types->WrapObjects(Getter ? Getter() : TArray<UObject*>()); });
		}

		virtual void AddAssetSource(const FString& Name, const FString& Description, UClass* AssetClass) override
		{
			FUnrealMcpRqlTypes* Types = &Session.Types();
			Session.AddSource(Name, Types->ForClass(AssetClass ? AssetClass : UObject::StaticClass()), /*bList*/ true, Description,
				[Types, AssetClass]() { return UnrealMcpRqlAssetList(*Types, AssetClass, FString()); });
		}

		virtual void AddApiClass(UClass* Class, const FString& TypeName) override
		{
			Session.Types().AddApiClass(Class, TypeName);
		}

		virtual void ExposeProperties(UStruct* Owner, const TArray<FName>& PropertyNames, bool bWritable) override
		{
			Session.Types().ExposeProperties(Owner, PropertyNames, bWritable);
		}

		virtual void AddJsonMember(UClass* Class, const FString& Name, const FString& Description,
			TFunction<TSharedPtr<FJsonValue>(UObject*)> Getter) override
		{
			const std::string MemberName = UnrealMcpRqlToStd(Name);
			const std::string MemberDescription = UnrealMcpRqlToStd(Description);
			Session.Types().AddClassHook(Class, [MemberName, MemberDescription, Getter](FUnrealMcpRqlTypes&, rql::TypeDescriptor& Descriptor)
			{
				rql::MemberDescriptor Member;
				Member.name = MemberName;
				Member.description = MemberDescription;
				Member.type = rql::builtin::any_type();
				Member.nullable = true;
				Member.owning = false;
				Member.readonly = true;
				Member.getter = [Getter](void* Self) -> rql::Value
				{
					return Getter ? FromJson(Getter(static_cast<UObject*>(Self))) : rql::Value::null();
				};
				FUnrealMcpRqlTypes::SetMember(Descriptor, std::move(Member));
			});
		}

		virtual void AddClassDefaultsSource(const FString& Name, const FString& Description, UClass* BaseClass) override
		{
			FUnrealMcpRqlTypes* Types = &Session.Types();
			Session.AddSource(Name, Types->ForClass(BaseClass ? BaseClass : UObject::StaticClass()), /*bList*/ true, Description,
				[Types, BaseClass]() { return UnrealMcpRqlClassDefaultsList(*Types, BaseClass); });
		}

		virtual void AddObjectMember(UClass* Class, const FString& Name, const FString& Description, UClass* ObjectClass,
			TFunction<UObject*(UObject*)> Getter) override
		{
			const std::string MemberName = UnrealMcpRqlToStd(Name);
			const std::string MemberDescription = UnrealMcpRqlToStd(Description);
			Session.Types().AddClassHook(Class, [MemberName, MemberDescription, ObjectClass, Getter](FUnrealMcpRqlTypes& Types, rql::TypeDescriptor& Descriptor)
			{
				rql::MemberDescriptor Member;
				Member.name = MemberName;
				Member.description = MemberDescription;
				Member.type = Types.ForClass(ObjectClass ? ObjectClass : UObject::StaticClass());
				Member.nullable = true;
				Member.owning = false;
				Member.readonly = true;
				FUnrealMcpRqlTypes* TypesPtr = &Types;
				Member.getter = [TypesPtr, Getter](void* Self) -> rql::Value
				{
					return TypesPtr->WrapObject(Getter ? Getter(static_cast<UObject*>(Self)) : nullptr);
				};
				FUnrealMcpRqlTypes::SetMember(Descriptor, std::move(Member));
			});
		}

		virtual void AddObjectListMember(UClass* Class, const FString& Name, const FString& Description, UClass* ElementClass,
			TFunction<TArray<UObject*>(UObject*)> Getter) override
		{
			const std::string MemberName = UnrealMcpRqlToStd(Name);
			const std::string MemberDescription = UnrealMcpRqlToStd(Description);
			Session.Types().AddClassHook(Class, [MemberName, MemberDescription, ElementClass, Getter](FUnrealMcpRqlTypes& Types, rql::TypeDescriptor& Descriptor)
			{
				rql::MemberDescriptor Member;
				Member.name = MemberName;
				Member.description = MemberDescription;
				Member.type = Types.Registry().list_type(Types.ForClass(ElementClass ? ElementClass : UObject::StaticClass()), true);
				Member.owning = true;
				Member.readonly = true;
				FUnrealMcpRqlTypes* TypesPtr = &Types;
				Member.getter = [TypesPtr, Getter](void* Self) -> rql::Value
				{
					return TypesPtr->WrapObjects(Getter ? Getter(static_cast<UObject*>(Self)) : TArray<UObject*>());
				};
				FUnrealMcpRqlTypes::SetMember(Descriptor, std::move(Member));
			});
		}

		virtual void AddGuide(const FString& Topic, const FString& Markdown) override
		{
			Session.AddGuide(Topic, Markdown);
		}

	private:
		FUnrealMcpRqlSession& Session;
	};
}

using namespace UnrealMcpRqlSessionLocal;

void FUnrealMcpRqlModuleContext::AddApiSource(const FString& Name, const FString& Description, UClass* ApiClass, const FString& TypeName)
{
	AddApiClass(ApiClass, TypeName);
	AddObjectSource(Name, Description, ApiClass, [ApiClass]() -> UObject* { return ApiClass ? ApiClass->GetDefaultObject() : nullptr; });
}

FUnrealMcpRqlSession::FUnrealMcpRqlSession()
	: TypesPtr(MakeUnique<FUnrealMcpRqlTypes>())
	, EnginePtr(std::make_unique<rql::Engine>(TypesPtr->Registry()))
{
	rql::Engine& RqlEngine = *EnginePtr;
	RqlEngine.runtime_name = "unreal";
	// rql-query / rql-mutate take no budgets argument: hints must not advise raising budgets.* (rql-mutate's target limit
	// has its own argument, MutationPolicy::limit_argument). ref("Name") hints name the finder, type-list hints the schema tool.
	RqlEngine.defaults().budgets_adjustable = false;
	RqlEngine.find_hint = "unreal.find(\"\xE2\x80\xA6\")";
	RqlEngine.schema_hint = "rql-schema";
	RqlEngine.mutate_hint = "rql-mutate"; // a set / call sent to rql-query: the permission-denied hint names the mutation tool
	FUnrealMcpRqlTypes* TypeProvider = TypesPtr.Get();
	// Liveness from the weak pointer every object value carries: a destroyed (garbage) actor reads as null.
	RqlEngine.is_alive = [TypeProvider](const rql::Value& Object) { return TypeProvider->IsAlive(Object); };
	// Member names of every reflected class and struct: streams are polymorphic (actors | get Components), so a set whose
	// items all lack a member some component class has is a no-match, not a typo (RQL spec 8: a typo that empties a
	// mutation is an error).
	RqlEngine.is_known_member = [TypeProvider](const std::string& Name) { return TypeProvider->IsKnownMemberName(UnrealMcpRqlFromStd(Name)); };
	// "PointLight#1234": the id is FUnrealMcpRqlTypes::IdOf (object slot + serial), resolved without searching the sources.
	RqlEngine.resolve_stable_ref = [TypeProvider](const std::string& Type, const std::string& Id) -> rql::Value
	{
		int64 Parsed = 0;
		if (!LexTryParseString(Parsed, *UnrealMcpRqlFromStd(Id)))
			return rql::Value::missing();
		UObject* Object = FUnrealMcpRqlTypes::FindById(Parsed);
		if (!Object)
			return rql::Value::missing();
		rql::Value Wrapped = TypeProvider->WrapObject(Object);
		return Wrapped.type() && Wrapped.type()->is_a(Type) ? Wrapped : rql::Value::missing();
	};
	ConfigureMutations();
	UnrealMcpRqlConfigureCore(*this);
	ConfigureModules();
}

FUnrealMcpRqlSession::~FUnrealMcpRqlSession()
{
	CloseTransaction();
	EnginePtr.reset(); // before the registry it references
}

void FUnrealMcpRqlSession::ConfigureMutations()
{
	rql::MutationPolicy& Policy = EnginePtr->mutations();
	Policy.enabled = true;
	// A mutation is one undo step whatever its size, so the default target limit is an editor's (RQL spec 8 target
	// limit); rql-mutate's max_targets raises it per call up to the ceiling, and the mutation-limit hint names it.
	Policy.max_targets = DefaultMaxTargets;
	Policy.hard_max_targets = HardMaxTargets;
	Policy.limit_argument = "max_targets";
	FUnrealMcpRqlTypes* TypeProvider = TypesPtr.Get();
	auto WrittenObject = [TypeProvider](const rql::MutationRecord& Record) -> UObject*
	{
		UObject* Owner = TypeProvider->AsObject(Record.owner);
		return Owner ? Owner : TypeProvider->AsObject(Record.item);
	};
	// The actor whose editor view state (its selection, its temporary viewport hiding) a record sets: not saved with the
	// level, so it must not mark the level unsaved. The core members only: a class property of that name is saved data.
	auto ViewStateActor = [WrittenObject](const rql::MutationRecord& Record) -> AActor*
	{
		if (Record.method)
			return nullptr;
		FString Member = UnrealMcpRqlFromStd(Record.member);
		Member.Split(TEXT("."), nullptr, &Member, ESearchCase::CaseSensitive, ESearchDir::FromEnd);
		if (!Member.Equals(TEXT("Selected"), ESearchCase::IgnoreCase) && !Member.Equals(TEXT("HiddenInEditor"), ESearchCase::IgnoreCase))
			return nullptr;
		AActor* Actor = Cast<AActor>(WrittenObject(Record));
		return Actor && !FindFProperty<FProperty>(Actor->GetClass(), *Member) ? Actor : nullptr;
	};
	// The object whose saved state a record changes (null for view state).
	auto OwnerOf = [WrittenObject, ViewStateActor](const rql::MutationRecord& Record) -> UObject*
	{
		return ViewStateActor(Record) ? nullptr : WrittenObject(Record);
	};
	auto IsWritableTemplate = [this](const UObject* Object)
	{
		for (const TFunction<bool(const UObject*)>& Predicate : WritableTemplates)
		{
			if (Predicate(Object))
				return true;
		}
		return false;
	};
	// The checks that need the planned changes (dry runs report them too): the core one, then the modules' validators.
	Policy.validate_batch = [this, TypeProvider, IsWritableTemplate](const std::vector<rql::MutationRecord>& Records) -> std::string
	{
		// Class defaults and archetypes (the class-default sources' rows, a Blueprint's defaults) are read-only: an
		// in-memory change to a CDO is not a saved edit and leaks into every new instance. API objects (`editor`, the
		// extensions' operations) are class defaults by design and stay callable.
		for (const rql::MutationRecord& Record : Records)
		{
			for (UObject* Object : { TypeProvider->AsObject(Record.item), TypeProvider->AsObject(Record.owner) })
			{
				if (Object && Object->IsTemplate() && !TypeProvider->IsApiClass(Object->GetClass()) && !IsWritableTemplate(Object))
					return UnrealMcpRqlToStd(FString::Printf(
						TEXT("%s is a class default object, read-only through RQL (edit the class or Blueprint instead)"), *Object->GetName()));
			}
		}
		// A call cannot be undone generically: one object reached twice (actors | get Parent | call Destroy() over two
		// siblings) would run the call twice, and a second call failing after the first changed the editor breaks the
		// all-or-nothing promise. Refuse the duplicate before anything runs.
		TSet<TPair<const void*, FString>> Called;
		for (const rql::MutationRecord& Record : Records)
		{
			if (!Record.method || !Record.item.is_object() || !Record.item.ptr())
				continue;
			// An operations object (`editor`, an extension's) is called once per stream item by design (range(0, 300) | call
			// editor.SpawnActor(...) creates 300 actors): the same operation twice with the same arguments is the duplicate
			// (DeleteAsset("/Game/X") twice), except a spawn, where identical arguments still mean another actor.
			FString Key = UnrealMcpRqlFromStd(Record.method->name).ToLower();
			if (const UObject* Receiver = TypeProvider->AsObject(Record.item); Receiver && TypeProvider->IsApiClass(Receiver->GetClass()))
			{
				if (Key.StartsWith(TEXT("spawn")))
					continue;
				for (const rql::Value& Argument : Record.args)
					Key += TEXT("|") + UnrealMcpRqlFromStd(rql::to_text(Argument));
			}
			bool bTwice = false;
			Called.Add({ Record.item.ptr(), Key }, &bTwice);
			if (bTwice)
			{
				const UObject* Object = TypeProvider->AsObject(Record.item);
				const AActor* Actor = Cast<AActor>(Object);
				const FString Name = Actor ? Actor->GetActorLabel() : Object ? Object->GetName() : FString(TEXT("one object"));
				return UnrealMcpRqlToStd(FString::Printf(TEXT("%s would run twice on %s (it is in the stream more than once: "
					"add | distinct before call)"), *UnrealMcpRqlFromStd(Record.method->name), *Name));
			}
		}
		for (const FBatchValidator& Validator : BatchValidators)
		{
			const FString Reason = Validator(Records);
			if (!Reason.IsEmpty())
				return UnrealMcpRqlToStd(Reason);
		}
		return std::string();
	};
	// Only the engine creates UObjects: a literal ({} or {Name: ...}) for an object parameter or member is refused
	// (coercion-failed) and nothing is constructed, on dry runs and while RQL tries overloads too. Liveness is the
	// engine-wide is_alive hook here, not a per-type adapter, so RQL's own engine-object default does not cover them.
	Policy.can_construct_from_literal = [TypeProvider](const rql::TypeDescriptor& Type) -> std::optional<bool>
	{
		return TypeProvider->IsObjectType(&Type) ? std::optional<bool>(false) : std::nullopt;
	};
	// UE's own text form for structs without an RQL adapter (the editor's Copy): Anchors = "(Minimum=(X=0.5,Y=0),...)".
	Policy.coerce_text = [TypeProvider](const rql::TypeDescriptor& Type, const std::string& Text, std::string& Reason)
	{
		return TypeProvider->ParseStructText(Type, Text, Reason);
	};
	// One editor transaction per mutation (one Ctrl+Z step): owners are snapshotted before the first write. Objects the
	// calls create with RF_Transactional (SpawnActor, AddComponent, ...) are recorded into the same transaction.
	Policy.before_write = [this, OwnerOf, ViewStateActor](const std::vector<rql::MutationRecord>& Records)
	{
		if (TransactionIndex == INDEX_NONE && GEditor)
			TransactionIndex = GEditor->BeginTransaction(TEXT("UnrealMcp"), FText::FromString(UndoTitle), nullptr);
		for (const rql::MutationRecord& Record : Records)
		{
			UObject* Owner = OwnerOf(Record);
			if (IsProjectObject(Owner))
				Owner->Modify();
			else if (AActor* Actor = ViewStateActor(Record))
				Actor->Modify(/*bAlwaysMarkDirty*/ false); // undoable, without marking the level unsaved
		}
	};
	// Property writes already ran the editor's PreEditChange / PostEditChangeProperty; mark what changed as unsaved.
	Policy.committed = [this, OwnerOf](const std::vector<rql::MutationRecord>& Records)
	{
		for (const rql::MutationRecord& Record : Records)
		{
			UObject* Owner = OwnerOf(Record);
			if (IsProjectObject(Owner))
				Owner->MarkPackageDirty();
		}
		for (const FMutationHook& Hook : CommittedHooks)
			Hook(Records);
	};
}

void FUnrealMcpRqlSession::ConfigureModules()
{
	FModuleContext Context(*this);
	TSet<FString> Configured;
	for (IUnrealMcpRqlModule* Module : UnrealMcpRqlTools::Modules())
	{
		if (!UnrealMcpRqlTools::IsModuleEnabled(*Module))
			continue; // its extension is disabled in the Extensions window
		const FString Extension = Module->GetExtensionId();
		// One module per extension id, the first in Modules() order (the extension manager records the later ones as
		// duplicates with an error): a second module would register the same sources and types again.
		if (!Extension.IsEmpty())
		{
			bool bAlreadyConfigured = false;
			Configured.Add(Extension, &bAlreadyConfigured);
			if (bAlreadyConfigured)
				continue;
		}
		Module->ConfigureRql(Context);
		const FString Version = Module->GetExtensionVersion();
		FString Report = FString::Printf(TEXT("`%s`"), *Module->GetRqlModuleName());
		if (!Extension.IsEmpty())
			Report += FString::Printf(TEXT(" - %s %s"), *Extension, *Version);
		ModuleReports.Add(Report);
	}
}

void FUnrealMcpRqlSession::SetUndoTitle(const FString& QueryText)
{
	// One line (whitespace runs as one space), at most 120 characters.
	static constexpr int32 MaxChars = 120;
	TArray<FString> Words;
	QueryText.ParseIntoArrayWS(Words);
	const FString Query = FString::Join(Words, TEXT(" "));
	if (!Query.IsEmpty())
		UndoTitle = TEXT("RQL: ") + (Query.Len() > MaxChars ? Query.Left(MaxChars - 3) + TEXT("...") : Query);
}

void FUnrealMcpRqlSession::CloseTransaction()
{
	if (TransactionIndex != INDEX_NONE && GEditor)
		GEditor->EndTransaction();
	TransactionIndex = INDEX_NONE;
}

void FUnrealMcpRqlSession::AddSource(const FString& Name, const rql::TypeDescriptor* Type, bool bList, const FString& Description,
	std::function<rql::Value()> Getter)
{
	EnginePtr->add_source(UnrealMcpRqlToStd(Name), std::move(Getter), UnrealMcpRqlToStd(Description));
	SourceEntries.Add({ Name, Type, bList, Description });
}

void FUnrealMcpRqlSession::AddFunction(const FString& Name, const FString& Description, rql::FunctionHandler Handler)
{
	EnginePtr->add_function(UnrealMcpRqlToStd(Name), std::move(Handler));
	FunctionEntries.Add({ Name, nullptr, false, Description });
}

void FUnrealMcpRqlSession::AddGuide(const FString& Topic, const FString& Markdown)
{
	Guides.Add(TPair<FString, FString>(Topic, Markdown));
}

void FUnrealMcpRqlSession::AddBatchValidator(FBatchValidator Validator)
{
	BatchValidators.Add(MoveTemp(Validator));
}

void FUnrealMcpRqlSession::AddCommitted(FMutationHook Hook)
{
	CommittedHooks.Add(MoveTemp(Hook));
}

void FUnrealMcpRqlSession::AllowTemplateWrites(TFunction<bool(const UObject*)> Predicate)
{
	WritableTemplates.Add(MoveTemp(Predicate));
}

void FUnrealMcpRqlSession::AddAdapter(rql::TypeAdapter Adapter)
{
	TypesPtr->Fill(Adapter.target); // adapted views are cached per type: the descriptor must be complete first
	EnginePtr->add_adapter(std::move(Adapter));
}

FString FUnrealMcpRqlSession::Execute(const FString& PlanJson, bool bAllowMutation, bool bDryRun, bool& bOutOk, TOptional<int32> MaxTargets)
{
	Types().SetMutationRequest(bAllowMutation);
	const std::string Text = UnrealMcpRqlToStd(PlanJson);
	rql::QueryPlan Plan;
	rql::Diagnostic Error;
	rql::QueryResult Result;
	if (!rql::try_decode_plan(std::string_view(Text), Plan, Error))
	{
		Result = rql::QueryResult::fail({ Error });
	}
	else if (!FunctionSource(Plan, Result))
	{
		rql::QueryOptions Options;
		Options.allow_mutation = bAllowMutation;
		Options.dry_run = bDryRun;
		rql::Budgets Budgets;
		if (MaxTargets.IsSet())
			Budgets.max_mutation_targets = MaxTargets.GetValue(); // outside 1 .. hard_max_targets the engine refuses the request
		Result = EnginePtr->execute(Plan, Budgets, Options);
	}
	CloseTransaction();
	bOutOk = Result.ok;
	return UnrealMcpRqlFromStd(Result.to_json(/*include_stats*/ false).dump());
}

bool FUnrealMcpRqlSession::FunctionSource(rql::QueryPlan& Plan, rql::QueryResult& OutFailure)
{
	// RQL text lets a host function start a query, as in unreal.assets("Material") | select Name, optionally followed by
	// a member path (unreal.asset("/Game/BP").EventGraph). The C++ runtime (0.2.0) runs a bare function call itself but
	// not the member-path form, so the session handles both the same way: evaluate the call once (its arguments are
	// literals) and run the query on a source named after the function holding the value, navigating the member path.
	rql::ExprPtr Source = Plan.source;
	std::vector<rql::Segment> Members;
	if (Source && Source->kind == rql::ExprKind::Path && Source->on && Source->on->kind == rql::ExprKind::Call)
	{
		Members = Source->segments;
		Source = Source->on;
	}
	if (!Source || Source->kind != rql::ExprKind::Call || !Source->on || Source->on->kind != rql::ExprKind::Path || Source->on->on)
		return false;
	std::string Name;
	for (const rql::Segment& Segment : Source->on->segments)
	{
		if (Segment.kind != rql::SegmentKind::Member)
			return false;
		Name += Segment.name + ".";
	}
	Name += Source->name;
	const auto Function = EnginePtr->functions().find(Name);
	if (Function == EnginePtr->functions().end())
		return false;

	std::function<bool(const rql::Expr&, rql::Value&)> Literal = [&Literal](const rql::Expr& Expr, rql::Value& Out) -> bool
	{
		switch (Expr.kind)
		{
		case rql::ExprKind::Lit:
			switch (Expr.lit.type)
			{
			case rql::Literal::Type::Null: Out = rql::Value::null(); return true;
			case rql::Literal::Type::Bool: Out = rql::Value::boolean(Expr.lit.b); return true;
			case rql::Literal::Type::Number: Out = rql::Value::number(Expr.lit.n); return true;
			case rql::Literal::Type::String: Out = rql::Value::string(Expr.lit.s); return true;
			}
			return false;
		case rql::ExprKind::List:
		{
			std::vector<rql::Value> Items;
			for (const rql::ExprPtr& Item : Expr.args)
			{
				rql::Value Value;
				if (!Item || !Literal(*Item, Value))
					return false;
				Items.push_back(Value);
			}
			Out = rql::Value::list_of(std::move(Items));
			return true;
		}
		default:
			return false;
		}
	};
	std::vector<rql::Value> Args;
	for (const rql::ExprPtr& Arg : Source->args)
	{
		rql::Value Value;
		if (!Arg || !Literal(*Arg, Value))
		{
			OutFailure = rql::QueryResult::fail({ rql::Diagnostic::error("invalid-plan",
				Name + "(...) starts a query: its arguments must be literals (\"text\", numbers, lists)") });
			return true;
		}
		Args.push_back(Value);
	}
	rql::Value Value;
	try
	{
		Value = Function->second(Args);
	}
	catch (const std::exception& Error)
	{
		OutFailure = rql::QueryResult::fail({ rql::Diagnostic::error("function-threw", Name + "() threw: " + Error.what()) });
		return true;
	}
	catch (...)
	{
		OutFailure = rql::QueryResult::fail({ rql::Diagnostic::error("function-threw", Name + "() threw: non-standard exception") });
		return true;
	}
	if (Value.is_error())
	{
		OutFailure = rql::QueryResult::fail({ rql::Diagnostic::error(Value.error_code(), Value.error_detail()) });
		return true;
	}
	EnginePtr->add_source(Name, [Value]() { return Value; });
	if (Members.empty())
	{
		Plan.source = rql::plan::path(Name);
		return false;
	}
	std::vector<rql::Segment> Path;
	rql::Segment Head;
	Head.kind = rql::SegmentKind::Member;
	Head.name = Name;
	Path.push_back(Head);
	Path.insert(Path.end(), Members.begin(), Members.end());
	Plan.source = rql::plan::path(std::move(Path));
	return false;
}

FString FUnrealMcpRqlSession::Schema(const FString& TypeName, bool& bOutOk)
{
	rql::Json Root = rql::Json::object();
	bOutOk = true;

	// The classes present in the editor world (with counts), like Unity's component types of the loaded scenes: only for
	// the overview and the unknown-type candidates. Most frequent first, then by name (the chain fixture records it).
	TMap<FString, int32> ActorClasses;
	TMap<FString, int32> ComponentClasses;
	auto CountPresentClasses = [&ActorClasses, &ComponentClasses]()
	{
		if (UWorld* World = FUnrealMcpObjectRef::GetEditorWorld())
		{
			for (TActorIterator<AActor> It(World); It; ++It)
			{
				AActor* Actor = *It;
				if (!IsValid(Actor))
					continue;
				ActorClasses.FindOrAdd(Actor->GetClass()->GetName())++;
				Actor->ForEachComponent(/*bIncludeFromChildActors*/ false, [&ComponentClasses](UActorComponent* Component)
				{
					ComponentClasses.FindOrAdd(Component->GetClass()->GetName())++;
				});
			}
		}
		for (TMap<FString, int32>* Counts : { &ActorClasses, &ComponentClasses })
		{
			Counts->KeySort([](const FString& A, const FString& B) { return A < B; });
			Counts->ValueStableSort([](int32 A, int32 B) { return A > B; });
		}
	};

	const FString Wanted = TypeName.TrimStartAndEnd();
	if (!Wanted.IsEmpty())
	{
		const rql::TypeDescriptor* Found = TypesPtr->FindByName(Wanted);
		if (!Found)
		{
			// A source name ("console") stands for the type of its items.
			if (const FEntry* Source = SourceEntries.FindByPredicate([&Wanted](const FEntry& Entry) { return Entry.Name.Equals(Wanted, ESearchCase::IgnoreCase); }))
				Found = Source->Type;
		}
		if (!Found || Found->kind == rql::TypeKind::Scalar)
		{
			CountPresentClasses();
			bOutOk = false;
			Root.set("error", "unknown-type");
			Root.set("name", UnrealMcpRqlToStd(Wanted));
			rql::Json Candidates = rql::Json::array();
			for (const TMap<FString, int32>* Counts : { &ActorClasses, &ComponentClasses })
			{
				for (const TPair<FString, int32>& Pair : *Counts)
					Candidates.push(rql::Json(UnrealMcpRqlToStd(Pair.Key)));
			}
			Root.set("candidates", std::move(Candidates));
			return UnrealMcpRqlFromStd(Root.dump());
		}
		rql::Json TypeList = rql::Json::array();
		TypeList.push(Describe(Found));
		Root.set("types", std::move(TypeList));
		return UnrealMcpRqlFromStd(Root.dump());
	}

	rql::Json SourceList = rql::Json::array();
	for (const FEntry& Entry : SourceEntries)
	{
		rql::Json Item = rql::Json::object();
		Item.set("name", UnrealMcpRqlToStd(Entry.Name));
		Item.set("type", UnrealMcpRqlToStd(TypeLabel(Entry)));
		if (!Entry.Description.IsEmpty())
			Item.set("description", UnrealMcpRqlToStd(Entry.Description));
		SourceList.push(std::move(Item));
	}
	Root.set("sources", std::move(SourceList));

	rql::Json FunctionList = rql::Json::array();
	for (const FEntry& Entry : FunctionEntries)
	{
		rql::Json Item = rql::Json::object();
		Item.set("name", UnrealMcpRqlToStd(Entry.Name));
		Item.set("description", UnrealMcpRqlToStd(Entry.Description));
		FunctionList.push(std::move(Item));
	}
	Root.set("functions", std::move(FunctionList));

	CountPresentClasses();
	auto Present = [](const TMap<FString, int32>& Counts)
	{
		rql::Json List = rql::Json::array();
		int32 Shown = 0;
		for (const TPair<FString, int32>& Pair : Counts)
		{
			if (++Shown > 60)
				break;
			rql::Json Item = rql::Json::object();
			Item.set("type", UnrealMcpRqlToStd(Pair.Key));
			Item.set("count", rql::Json(static_cast<int>(Pair.Value)));
			List.push(std::move(Item));
		}
		return List;
	};
	Root.set("actorClasses", Present(ActorClasses));
	Root.set("componentClasses", Present(ComponentClasses));

	// Actor and SceneComponent (as Unity-MCP shows GameObject and Transform): the member names agents meet first.
	rql::Json TypeList = rql::Json::array();
	TypeList.push(Describe(TypesPtr->ForClass(AActor::StaticClass())));
	TypeList.push(Describe(TypesPtr->ForClass(USceneComponent::StaticClass())));
	Root.set("types", std::move(TypeList));
	return UnrealMcpRqlFromStd(Root.dump());
}

rql::Json FUnrealMcpRqlSession::Describe(const rql::TypeDescriptor* Type)
{
	rql::Json Entry = rql::Json::object();
	if (!Type)
		return Entry;
	TypesPtr->Fill(Type);
	Entry.set("type", EnginePtr->describe_type(*Type));
	// The base: the sidecar lists the type's own members and summarises the inherited ones ("+ inherited from <base>").
	if (Type->base)
	{
		TypesPtr->Fill(Type->base);
		Entry.set("shared", EnginePtr->describe_type(*Type->base));
	}
	return Entry;
}

FString FUnrealMcpRqlSession::SkillMarkdown() const
{
	FString Out;
	Out += TEXT("# RQL - query and change the Unreal Editor\n\n");
	Out += TEXT("RQL is one pipeline language for the whole editor: find actors and assets, read members, filter, aggregate, and change "
		"them in one call. Prefer one precise query over many exploratory calls.\n\n");
	Out += TEXT("- `rql-query` - read-only queries, compact table results.\n");
	Out += TEXT("- `rql-mutate` - queries ending with `set` / `call`; all-or-nothing, one undo step (Ctrl+Z), `dry_run: true` previews. "
		"Changes are not saved to disk until `editor | call SaveAll()` (or SaveLevel / SaveAsset).\n");
	Out += TEXT("- `rql-schema` - sources and the actor / component classes in the editor world; `rql-schema(type)` lists one type's members and methods.\n\n");
	Out += TEXT("```bash\n");
	Out += TEXT("unreal-mcp-cli run-tool rql-query --input '{\"query\": \"actors | where Label contains \\\"Enemy\\\" | select $ref Label\"}'\n");
	Out += TEXT("unreal-mcp-cli run-tool rql-mutate --input '{\"query\": \"actors | where Label == \\\"Player\\\" | set HiddenInEditor = true\"}'\n");
	Out += TEXT("```\n\n## Language\n\n```\n");
	Out += UnrealMcpRqlFromStd(UnrealMcpRqlGuide::Language());
	Out += TEXT("\n");
	Out += UnrealMcpRqlFromStd(UnrealMcpRqlGuide::LanguageRules());
	Out += UnrealMcpRqlFromStd(UnrealMcpRqlGuide::QueryExamples());
	Out += TEXT("\n```\n\n## Changing things (rql-mutate)\n\n```\n");
	Out += UnrealMcpRqlFromStd(UnrealMcpRqlGuide::MutateStages());
	Out += UnrealMcpRqlFromStd(UnrealMcpRqlGuide::MutateExamples());
	Out += TEXT("```\n\n## Sources\n\n| Source | What |\n|---|---|\n");
	TArray<FEntry> SortedSources = SourceEntries;
	SortedSources.Sort([](const FEntry& A, const FEntry& B) { return A.Name < B.Name; });
	for (const FEntry& Entry : SortedSources)
		Out += FString::Printf(TEXT("| `%s` | %s |\n"), *Entry.Name, *Cell(Entry.Description));
	TArray<FEntry> SortedFunctions = FunctionEntries;
	SortedFunctions.Sort([](const FEntry& A, const FEntry& B) { return A.Name < B.Name; });
	for (const FEntry& Entry : SortedFunctions)
		Out += FString::Printf(TEXT("| `%s(...)` | %s |\n"), *Entry.Name, *Cell(Entry.Description));
	for (const TPair<FString, FString>& Guide : Guides)
		Out += FString::Printf(TEXT("\n## %s\n\n%s\n"), *Guide.Key, *Guide.Value.TrimStartAndEnd());
	Out += TEXT("\n## Installed RQL modules\n\n- `Core`\n");
	for (const FString& Module : ModuleReports)
		Out += FString::Printf(TEXT("- %s\n"), *Module);
	return Out;
}

```

`UnrealMCP/Source/UnrealMcpRql/Private/UnrealMcpRqlSession.h`:

```h
// Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak. Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.
// See the LICENSE file in the repository root for more information.

#pragma once

#include "CoreMinimal.h"
#include "UnrealMcpRqlTypes.h"

#include <functional>
#include <memory>

/**
 * One RQL engine over the live editor state, built for ONE tool call and dropped after it (game thread only).
 *
 * Rebuilding per call is cheap (descriptors fill lazily: a query touches a few classes) and is what keeps the provider
 * safe: a Blueprint compile, a hot reload or a user-defined struct edit recreates FProperty / UFunction objects, so no
 * descriptor may outlive the call that built it. Stable refs ("PointLight#1234") survive: they are object ids.
 *
 * The core module (UnrealMcpRqlCore.cpp) and every IUnrealMcpRqlModule extension configure the session in its
 * constructor. Mutations run inside one editor transaction (one Ctrl+Z step) and mark the changed packages dirty.
 */
class FUnrealMcpRqlSession
{
public:
	/** A source or function as rql-schema and the skill list it. */
	struct FEntry
	{
		FString Name;
		/** A source's value type: the element type of a list source (bList), else the type of its one value. */
		const rql::TypeDescriptor* Type = nullptr;
		bool bList = false;
		FString Description;
	};

	FUnrealMcpRqlSession();
	~FUnrealMcpRqlSession();
	FUnrealMcpRqlSession(const FUnrealMcpRqlSession&) = delete;
	FUnrealMcpRqlSession& operator=(const FUnrealMcpRqlSession&) = delete;

	FUnrealMcpRqlTypes& Types() { return *TypesPtr; }

	/** rql-mutate's default target limit and the ceiling its max_targets argument can raise it to (RQL spec 8). */
	static constexpr int32 DefaultMaxTargets = 200;
	static constexpr int32 HardMaxTargets = 1000;

	/**
	 * Execute a canonical QueryPlan (JSON); returns the QueryResult JSON (spec form, no stats). @p MaxTargets, when set, is
	 * this request's target limit: outside 1 .. HardMaxTargets the engine refuses the request (invalid-value). Unset keeps
	 * DefaultMaxTargets.
	 */
	FString Execute(const FString& PlanJson, bool bAllowMutation, bool bDryRun, bool& bOutOk, TOptional<int32> MaxTargets = {});

	/**
	 * The query text a mutation names its undo step after ("RQL: actors | ... | set ..."), so the Undo History and
	 * TRANSACTION UNDO say which change they revert. Empty: "RQL mutation".
	 */
	void SetUndoTitle(const FString& QueryText);

	/** rql-schema data: sources, functions, present classes and type descriptors (JSON the sidecar renders). */
	FString Schema(const FString& TypeName, bool& bOutOk);

	/** The unreal-rql skill: language, operations, live sources / functions, module guides, installed modules. */
	FString SkillMarkdown() const;

	// ---- registration (core module + extension modules)

	/** A source whose value is @p Type (bList: a list of @p Type); the type labels it in rql-schema (never the getter). */
	void AddSource(const FString& Name, const rql::TypeDescriptor* Type, bool bList, const FString& Description,
		std::function<rql::Value()> Getter);
	void AddFunction(const FString& Name, const FString& Description, rql::FunctionHandler Handler);
	void AddGuide(const FString& Topic, const FString& Markdown);
	void AddAdapter(rql::TypeAdapter Adapter);

	/**
	 * Checks every planned change of a set / call stage at once (RQL MutationPolicy::validate_batch), before anything is
	 * written or called, dry runs included. A non-empty reason refuses the whole stage (invalid-value), nothing changed.
	 */
	using FBatchValidator = std::function<FString(const std::vector<rql::MutationRecord>& Records)>;
	void AddBatchValidator(FBatchValidator Validator);
	using FMutationHook = std::function<void(const std::vector<rql::MutationRecord>& Records)>;
	/** Runs after every write of a mutation succeeded (not on dry run or rollback): persistence, notifications. */
	void AddCommitted(FMutationHook Hook);
	/** Class default objects this predicate accepts are writable (settings objects); other templates stay read-only. */
	void AllowTemplateWrites(TFunction<bool(const UObject*)> Predicate);

private:
	TUniquePtr<FUnrealMcpRqlTypes> TypesPtr;
	std::unique_ptr<rql::Engine> EnginePtr;
	TArray<FEntry> SourceEntries;
	TArray<FEntry> FunctionEntries;
	TArray<TPair<FString, FString>> Guides;
	TArray<FString> ModuleReports;
	TArray<FBatchValidator> BatchValidators;
	TArray<FMutationHook> CommittedHooks;
	TArray<TFunction<bool(const UObject*)>> WritableTemplates;
	int32 TransactionIndex = INDEX_NONE;
	FString UndoTitle = TEXT("RQL mutation");

	/** A host function as the query source (unreal.assets("Material") | ...): evaluated into a source. True = failed. */
	bool FunctionSource(rql::QueryPlan& Plan, rql::QueryResult& OutFailure);
	/** {"type": descriptor, "shared": its base, whose members the sidecar summarises once} for rql-schema. */
	rql::Json Describe(const rql::TypeDescriptor* Type);
	void ConfigureMutations();
	void ConfigureModules();
	void CloseTransaction();
};

/** The core module: sources, functions, members, methods and struct adapters of the editor (UnrealMcpRqlCore.cpp). */
void UnrealMcpRqlConfigureCore(FUnrealMcpRqlSession& Session);
