`UnrealMCP/Source/UnrealMcpRql/Private/UnrealMcpRqlSettings.cpp`:

```cpp
// Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak. Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.
// See the LICENSE file in the repository root for more information.

#include "UnrealMcpRqlSession.h"
#include "UnrealMcpRqlSources.h"
#include "UnrealMcpRqlUtil.h"

#include "GameFramework/InputSettings.h"
#include "GenericPlatform/GenericPlatformFile.h"
#include "HAL/PlatformFileManager.h"
#include "ISettingsCategory.h"
#include "ISettingsContainer.h"
#include "ISettingsEditorModule.h"
#include "ISettingsModule.h"
#include "ISettingsSection.h"
#include "Misc/EngineVersionComparison.h"
#include "Misc/Paths.h"
#include "Modules/ModuleManager.h"
#include "UObject/UnrealType.h"

#include <cctype>
#include <memory>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

/**
 * Project and editor settings (docs/rql.md "Settings"): every section of the Project Settings and Editor Preferences
 * windows, with the object that section edits. Those objects are class defaults, read-only through RQL elsewhere; here
 * they are writable, and a write is saved to its config file after the mutation the way the settings editor saves it
 * (SSettingsEditor::HandleSettingsPropertyChanged): one property into Default<Config>.ini for project (default-config)
 * classes, the whole section otherwise. Config files are not part of the editor transaction: a settings write is saved
 * at once and Ctrl+Z does not revert it. Only config properties are writable (others would be lost on restart).
 */
namespace UnrealMcpRqlSettingsLocal
{
	using namespace UnrealMcpRqlUtil;

	struct FSectionRow
	{
		std::string Container;
		std::string Category;
		std::string Section;
		std::string DisplayName;
		std::string Description;
		TWeakObjectPtr<UObject> Object;
	};

	struct FSection
	{
		FName Container;
		TSharedPtr<ISettingsSection> Section;
		TWeakObjectPtr<UObject> Object;
	};

	/** The sections of the Project Settings ("Project") and Editor Preferences ("Editor") windows that edit an object. */
	TArray<FSection> Sections()
	{
		TArray<FSection> Out;
		ISettingsModule* Module = FModuleManager::GetModulePtr<ISettingsModule>(TEXT("Settings"));
		if (!Module)
			return Out;
		// Most sections (Physics, Rendering, Collision, Audio, plugin settings) are UDeveloperSettings that the
		// SettingsEditor module registers only once a settings window has been opened: register them now, so the
		// source does not depend on whether someone opened Project Settings in this editor session.
#if !UE_VERSION_OLDER_THAN(5, 6, 0)
		if (ISettingsEditorModule* SettingsEditor = FModuleManager::LoadModulePtr<ISettingsEditorModule>(TEXT("SettingsEditor")))
			SettingsEditor->UpdateSettings(/*bForce*/ true);
#endif
		for (const FName ContainerName : { FName(TEXT("Project")), FName(TEXT("Editor")) })
		{
			TSharedPtr<ISettingsContainer> Container = Module->GetContainer(ContainerName);
			if (!Container.IsValid())
				continue;
			TArray<TSharedPtr<ISettingsCategory>> Categories;
			Container->GetCategories(Categories);
			for (const TSharedPtr<ISettingsCategory>& Category : Categories)
			{
				TArray<TSharedPtr<ISettingsSection>> CategorySections;
				Category->GetSections(CategorySections);
				for (const TSharedPtr<ISettingsSection>& Section : CategorySections)
				{
					const TWeakObjectPtr<UObject> Object = Section.IsValid() ? Section->GetSettingsObject() : nullptr;
					if (Object.IsValid())
						Out.Add({ ContainerName, Section, Object });
				}
			}
		}
		return Out;
	}

	/** Per session: the settings objects (writable templates) and their sections, gathered on first use. */
	struct FSettingsIndex
	{
		TOptional<TArray<FSection>> Cached;

		const TArray<FSection>& All()
		{
			if (!Cached.IsSet())
				Cached = Sections();
			return Cached.GetValue();
		}

		const FSection* Find(const UObject* Object)
		{
			for (const FSection& Section : All())
			{
				if (Section.Object.Get() == Object)
					return &Section;
			}
			return nullptr;
		}
	};

	/** The member a write label starts with ("ActionMappings[0].Key" -> "ActionMappings"). */
	FString RootMember(const std::string& Label)
	{
		size_t End = 0;
		while (End < Label.size() && (std::isalnum(static_cast<unsigned char>(Label[End])) || Label[End] == '_'))
			++End;
		return UnrealMcpRqlFromStd(Label.substr(0, End));
	}

	/** The property behind a member name of @p Class (authored names: Blueprint-defined settings use display names). */
	FProperty* FindMemberProperty(UClass* Class, const FString& Member)
	{
		for (TFieldIterator<FProperty> It(Class); It; ++It)
		{
			if (It->GetAuthoredName().Equals(Member, ESearchCase::IgnoreCase) || It->GetName().Equals(Member, ESearchCase::IgnoreCase))
				return *It;
		}
		return nullptr;
	}

	void MakeWritable(const FString& RelativePath)
	{
		const FString Full = FPaths::ConvertRelativePathToFull(RelativePath);
		IPlatformFile& File = FPlatformFileManager::Get().GetPlatformFile();
		if (File.FileExists(*Full) && File.IsReadOnly(*Full))
			File.SetReadOnly(*Full, false);
	}

	/** Save one changed settings object as the settings editor does (see the file comment). */
	void Persist(UObject* Object, const FSection* Section, FProperty* Member)
	{
		UClass* Class = Object->GetClass();
		if (Class->HasAnyClassFlags(CLASS_DefaultConfig))
			MakeWritable(Object->GetDefaultConfigFilename());
		else if (Class->HasAnyClassFlags(CLASS_Config))
			MakeWritable(Class->GetConfigName());

		const bool bContainer = !Member || Member->IsA<FArrayProperty>() || Member->IsA<FSetProperty>() || Member->IsA<FMapProperty>()
			|| Member->ArrayDim > 1;
		if (Class->HasAnyClassFlags(CLASS_DefaultConfig) && !bContainer)
			Object->UpdateSinglePropertyInConfigFile(Member, Object->GetDefaultConfigFilename());
		else if (Section && Section->Section.IsValid())
			Section->Section->Save();
		else if (Class->HasAnyClassFlags(CLASS_DefaultConfig))
			Object->TryUpdateDefaultConfigFile();
		else
			Object->SaveConfig();

		// Legacy input: the key maps the player input uses are rebuilt from the edited mappings.
		if (UInputSettings* Input = Cast<UInputSettings>(Object))
			Input->ForceRebuildKeymaps();
	}

	UObject* FindSettings(FSettingsIndex& Index, const FString& Wanted)
	{
		const FString Name = Wanted.TrimStartAndEnd();
		for (const FSection& Section : Index.All())
		{
			UObject* Object = Section.Object.Get();
			if (!Object || !Section.Section.IsValid())
				continue;
			const UClass* Class = Object->GetClass();
			if (Section.Section->GetName().ToString().Equals(Name, ESearchCase::IgnoreCase)
				|| Section.Section->GetDisplayName().ToString().Equals(Name, ESearchCase::IgnoreCase)
				|| Class->GetName().Equals(Name, ESearchCase::IgnoreCase)
				|| (Name.Len() > 1 && Name[0] == TEXT('U') && Class->GetName().Equals(Name.Mid(1), ESearchCase::IgnoreCase)))
				return Object;
		}
		return nullptr;
	}
}

using namespace UnrealMcpRqlSettingsLocal;

void UnrealMcpRqlAddSettings(FUnrealMcpRqlSession& Session)
{
	FUnrealMcpRqlTypes& T = Session.Types();
	FUnrealMcpRqlTypes* Types = &T;
	TSharedRef<FSettingsIndex> Index = MakeShared<FSettingsIndex>();

	rql::TypeRegistry& Registry = T.Registry();
	Registry.structure<FSectionRow>("SettingsSection")
		.member("Container", &FSectionRow::Container)
		.member("Category", &FSectionRow::Category)
		.member("Section", &FSectionRow::Section)
		.member("DisplayName", &FSectionRow::DisplayName)
		.member("Description", &FSectionRow::Description)
		.no_identity();
	rql::TypeDescriptor* RowType = Registry.descriptor<FSectionRow>();
	FUnrealMcpRqlTypes::SetMember(*RowType, Member("Object", T.ForClass(UObject::StaticClass()), [Types](void* Self)
	{
		return Types->WrapObject(static_cast<FSectionRow*>(Self)->Object.Get());
	}, {}, "the settings object (its config properties are writable and saved to its ini)", /*bOwning*/ true, /*bNullable*/ true));
	T.AddNativeType(RowType);

	Session.AddSource(TEXT("settings"), RowType, /*bList*/ true,
		TEXT("the sections of Project Settings (Container \"Project\") and Editor Preferences (\"Editor\"): Container Category Section "
			"DisplayName Description, Object = the settings object; writes to its config properties are saved to its ini at once (not undoable)"),
		[Index, RowType]()
	{
		std::vector<rql::Value> Rows;
		for (const FSection& Section : Index->All())
		{
			TSharedPtr<ISettingsCategory> Category = Section.Section->GetCategory().Pin();
			auto Row = std::make_shared<FSectionRow>();
			Row->Container = UnrealMcpRqlToStd(Section.Container.ToString());
			Row->Category = Category.IsValid() ? UnrealMcpRqlToStd(Category->GetName().ToString()) : std::string();
			Row->Section = UnrealMcpRqlToStd(Section.Section->GetName().ToString());
			Row->DisplayName = UnrealMcpRqlToStd(Section.Section->GetDisplayName().ToString());
			Row->Description = UnrealMcpRqlToStd(Section.Section->GetDescription().ToString());
			Row->Object = Section.Object;
			Rows.push_back(rql::Value::structure(RowType, std::static_pointer_cast<void>(Row)));
		}
		return rql::Value::list_of(std::move(Rows));
	});
	Session.AddFunction(TEXT("unreal.settings"),
		TEXT("the settings object of a Project Settings / Editor Preferences section by name (\"Maps & Modes\", \"GameMapsSettings\", \"Input\"); writes are saved to its ini"),
		[Types, Index](const std::vector<rql::Value>& Args) -> rql::Value
		{
			if (Args.size() != 1 || !Args[0].is_string())
				return rql::Value::error("type-mismatch", "unreal.settings(section) expects a section or class name such as \"Maps & Modes\" or \"GameMapsSettings\"");
			const FString Wanted = UnrealMcpRqlFromStd(Args[0].as_string());
			UObject* Found = FindSettings(*Index, Wanted);
			if (!Found)
				return rql::Value::error("not-found", UnrealMcpRqlToStd(FString::Printf(
					TEXT("no settings section '%s' (settings | select Container Category Section DisplayName lists them)"), *Wanted)));
			return Types->WrapObject(Found);
		});

	// Settings objects are class defaults by design: writable here, saved after the mutation.
	Session.AllowTemplateWrites([Index](const UObject* Object) { return Index->Find(Object) != nullptr; });
	Session.AddBatchValidator([Types, Index](const std::vector<rql::MutationRecord>& Records) -> FString
	{
		for (const rql::MutationRecord& Record : Records)
		{
			UObject* Owner = Types->AsObject(Record.owner);
			if (!Owner || Record.method || !Index->Find(Owner))
				continue;
			const UObject* ItemObject = Types->AsObject(Record.item);
			if (ItemObject && ItemObject != Owner)
				continue; // written through a reference: the whole section is saved (a map entry has no object item)
			const FString Root = RootMember(Record.member);
			FProperty* Property = FindMemberProperty(Owner->GetClass(), Root);
			if (Property && !Property->HasAnyPropertyFlags(CPF_Config))
				return FString::Printf(TEXT("%s.%s is not a config property: it would not be saved (only config settings are writable)"),
					*Owner->GetClass()->GetName(), *Root);
		}
		return FString();
	});
	Session.AddCommitted([Types, Index](const std::vector<rql::MutationRecord>& Records)
	{
		// One save per (object, member); calls (CallInEditor buttons of a settings object) save the whole section.
		TSet<TPair<UObject*, FProperty*>> Saved;
		for (const rql::MutationRecord& Record : Records)
		{
			UObject* Owner = Types->AsObject(Record.owner);
			if (!Owner)
				Owner = Types->AsObject(Record.item);
			const FSection* Section = Owner ? Index->Find(Owner) : nullptr;
			if (!Section)
				continue;
			const UObject* ItemObject = Types->AsObject(Record.item);
			FProperty* Property = !Record.method && (!ItemObject || ItemObject == Owner)
				? FindMemberProperty(Owner->GetClass(), RootMember(Record.member)) : nullptr;
			bool bAlready = false;
			Saved.Add(TPair<UObject*, FProperty*>(Owner, Property), &bAlready);
			if (!bAlready)
				Persist(Owner, Section, Property);
		}
	});
}
```

`UnrealMCP/Source/UnrealMcpRql/Private/UnrealMcpRqlStructs.cpp`:

```cpp
// Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak. Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.
// See the LICENSE file in the repository root for more information.

#include "UnrealMcpRqlSession.h"
#include "UnrealMcpRqlSources.h"
#include "UnrealMcpRqlUtil.h"

#include "Engine/Blueprint.h"
#include "Math/Color.h"
#include "Math/IntPoint.h"
#include "Math/IntVector.h"
#include "Math/Quat.h"
#include "Math/Rotator.h"
#include "Math/Vector.h"
#include "Math/Vector2D.h"
#include "Math/Vector4.h"
#include "UObject/Class.h"
#include "UObject/SoftObjectPath.h"
#include "UObject/Object.h"

#include <cstdio>
#include <exception>
#include <optional>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

namespace UnrealMcpRqlStructsLocal
{
	/** One math struct with a text form: N components read / written as doubles. */
	struct FMathStruct
	{
		UScriptStruct* Struct = nullptr;
		int32 Count = 0;
		bool bColor = false;   // "#rrggbb[aa]" accepted, alpha optional (defaults to opaque)
		bool bSingle = false;  // float components: printed in single precision
		bool bArithmetic = false; // component-wise RQL arithmetic (Scale * 1.5, Location + [0, 0, 100]); never quaternions
		const char* Shape = "";
		TFunction<void(const void*, double*)> Get;
		TFunction<void(void*, const double*)> Set;
	};

	const TArray<FMathStruct>& MathStructs()
	{
		static TArray<FMathStruct> Specs;
		if (Specs.Num() > 0)
			return Specs;
		auto Add = [](UScriptStruct* Struct, int32 Count, bool bColor, bool bSingle, const char* Shape,
			TFunction<void(const void*, double*)> Get, TFunction<void(void*, const double*)> Set, bool bArithmetic = false)
		{
			FMathStruct Spec;
			Spec.Struct = Struct;
			Spec.Count = Count;
			Spec.bColor = bColor;
			Spec.bSingle = bSingle;
			Spec.bArithmetic = bArithmetic;
			Spec.Shape = Shape;
			Spec.Get = MoveTemp(Get);
			Spec.Set = MoveTemp(Set);
			Specs.Add(MoveTemp(Spec));
		};
		Add(TBaseStructure<FVector>::Get(), 3, false, false, "(x, y, z)",
			[](const void* P, double* O) { const FVector& V = *static_cast<const FVector*>(P); O[0] = V.X; O[1] = V.Y; O[2] = V.Z; },
			[](void* P, const double* I) { *static_cast<FVector*>(P) = FVector(I[0], I[1], I[2]); }, /*bArithmetic*/ true);
		Add(TBaseStructure<FVector2D>::Get(), 2, false, false, "(x, y)",
			[](const void* P, double* O) { const FVector2D& V = *static_cast<const FVector2D*>(P); O[0] = V.X; O[1] = V.Y; },
			[](void* P, const double* I) { *static_cast<FVector2D*>(P) = FVector2D(I[0], I[1]); }, /*bArithmetic*/ true);
		Add(TBaseStructure<FVector4>::Get(), 4, false, false, "(x, y, z, w)",
			[](const void* P, double* O) { const FVector4& V = *static_cast<const FVector4*>(P); O[0] = V.X; O[1] = V.Y; O[2] = V.Z; O[3] = V.W; },
			[](void* P, const double* I) { *static_cast<FVector4*>(P) = FVector4(I[0], I[1], I[2], I[3]); }, /*bArithmetic*/ true);
		Add(TBaseStructure<FRotator>::Get(), 3, false, false, "(pitch, yaw, roll) in degrees",
			[](const void* P, double* O) { const FRotator& R = *static_cast<const FRotator*>(P); O[0] = R.Pitch; O[1] = R.Yaw; O[2] = R.Roll; },
			[](void* P, const double* I) { *static_cast<FRotator*>(P) = FRotator(I[0], I[1], I[2]); }, /*bArithmetic*/ true);
		Add(TBaseStructure<FQuat>::Get(), 4, false, false, "(x, y, z, w)",
			[](const void* P, double* O) { const FQuat& Q = *static_cast<const FQuat*>(P); O[0] = Q.X; O[1] = Q.Y; O[2] = Q.Z; O[3] = Q.W; },
			[](void* P, const double* I) { *static_cast<FQuat*>(P) = FQuat(I[0], I[1], I[2], I[3]); });
		Add(TBaseStructure<FLinearColor>::Get(), 4, true, true, "(r, g, b, a) linear 0..1 or \"#rrggbb\"",
			[](const void* P, double* O) { const FLinearColor& C = *static_cast<const FLinearColor*>(P); O[0] = C.R; O[1] = C.G; O[2] = C.B; O[3] = C.A; },
			[](void* P, const double* I) { *static_cast<FLinearColor*>(P) = FLinearColor(static_cast<float>(I[0]), static_cast<float>(I[1]), static_cast<float>(I[2]), static_cast<float>(I[3])); }, /*bArithmetic*/ true);
		Add(TBaseStructure<FColor>::Get(), 4, true, false, "(r, g, b, a) 0..255 or \"#rrggbb\"",
			[](const void* P, double* O) { const FColor& C = *static_cast<const FColor*>(P); O[0] = C.R; O[1] = C.G; O[2] = C.B; O[3] = C.A; },
			[](void* P, const double* I)
			{
				auto Byte = [](double V) { return static_cast<uint8>(FMath::Clamp(FMath::RoundToInt(V), 0, 255)); };
				*static_cast<FColor*>(P) = FColor(Byte(I[0]), Byte(I[1]), Byte(I[2]), Byte(I[3]));
			});
		Add(TBaseStructure<FIntPoint>::Get(), 2, false, false, "(x, y)",
			[](const void* P, double* O) { const FIntPoint& V = *static_cast<const FIntPoint*>(P); O[0] = V.X; O[1] = V.Y; },
			[](void* P, const double* I) { *static_cast<FIntPoint*>(P) = FIntPoint(FMath::RoundToInt(I[0]), FMath::RoundToInt(I[1])); });
		Add(TBaseStructure<FIntVector>::Get(), 3, false, false, "(x, y, z)",
			[](const void* P, double* O) { const FIntVector& V = *static_cast<const FIntVector*>(P); O[0] = V.X; O[1] = V.Y; O[2] = V.Z; },
			[](void* P, const double* I) { *static_cast<FIntVector*>(P) = FIntVector(FMath::RoundToInt(I[0]), FMath::RoundToInt(I[1]), FMath::RoundToInt(I[2])); });
		return Specs;
	}

	const FMathStruct* Find(const UScriptStruct* Struct)
	{
		for (const FMathStruct& Spec : MathStructs())
		{
			if (Spec.Struct == Struct)
				return &Spec;
		}
		return nullptr;
	}

	/** Every number in a text such as "(1, 2.5, -3)", "X=1 Y=2 Z=3" or "P=0 Y=90 R=0" (locale-independent). */
	std::vector<double> Numbers(const std::string& Text)
	{
		auto Starts = [](char C) { return (C >= '0' && C <= '9') || C == '-' || C == '+' || C == '.'; };
		auto Continues = [&Starts](char C) { return Starts(C) || C == 'e' || C == 'E'; };
		std::vector<double> Out;
		size_t Cursor = 0;
		while (Cursor < Text.size())
		{
			if (!Starts(Text[Cursor]))
			{
				++Cursor;
				continue;
			}
			size_t End = Cursor + 1;
			while (End < Text.size() && Continues(Text[End]))
				++End;
			double Value = 0.0;
			if (rql::parse_double(std::string_view(Text).substr(Cursor, End - Cursor), Value))
			{
				Out.push_back(Value);
				Cursor = End;
			}
			else
			{
				++Cursor; // a lone sign or dot
			}
		}
		return Out;
	}

	bool Hex(const std::string& Text, const FMathStruct& Spec, double* Out)
	{
		const FString Trimmed = UnrealMcpRqlFromStd(Text).TrimStartAndEnd();
		if (!Trimmed.StartsWith(TEXT("#")) || (Trimmed.Len() != 7 && Trimmed.Len() != 9))
			return false;
		for (int32 Index = 1; Index < Trimmed.Len(); ++Index)
		{
			if (!FChar::IsHexDigit(Trimmed[Index]))
				return false; // not a color: the number parse below reports the malformed literal
		}
		const FColor Color = FColor::FromHex(Trimmed);
		if (Spec.Struct == TBaseStructure<FColor>::Get())
		{
			Out[0] = Color.R; Out[1] = Color.G; Out[2] = Color.B; Out[3] = Color.A;
		}
		else
		{
			const FLinearColor Linear(Color); // "#rrggbb" is sRGB, as in color pickers
			Out[0] = Linear.R; Out[1] = Linear.G; Out[2] = Linear.B; Out[3] = Linear.A;
		}
		return true;
	}

	bool Components(const FMathStruct& Spec, const rql::Value& Value, double* Out, FString& OutError)
	{
		std::vector<double> Parts;
		if (Value.is_string())
		{
			if (Spec.bColor && Hex(Value.as_string(), Spec, Out))
				return true;
			Parts = Numbers(Value.as_string());
		}
		else if (Value.is_list())
		{
			for (size_t Index = 0, Count = Value.list().size(); Index < Count; ++Index)
			{
				const rql::Value Item = Value.list().at(Index);
				if (!Item.is_number())
				{
					OutError = TEXT("list elements must be numbers");
					return false;
				}
				Parts.push_back(Item.as_number());
			}
		}
		else
		{
			return false;
		}
		const size_t Wanted = static_cast<size_t>(Spec.Count);
		if (Spec.bColor && Parts.size() == Wanted - 1)
			Parts.push_back(Spec.Struct == TBaseStructure<FColor>::Get() ? 255.0 : 1.0); // alpha
		if (Parts.size() != Wanted)
		{
			OutError = FString::Printf(TEXT("%s expects %d numbers %s"), *Spec.Struct->GetName(), Spec.Count, *UnrealMcpRqlFromStd(Spec.Shape));
			return false;
		}
		for (size_t Index = 0; Index < Wanted; ++Index)
			Out[Index] = Parts[Index];
		return true;
	}

	/**
	 * A double without the noise transform math leaves (-9.999999999999998, 7.8e-47): 12 significant digits, and 0 below
	 * 1e-9. An angle is first snapped to 1e-6 degrees: the arm64 (Mac) quaternion round trip of -46 degrees is
	 * -45.9999999942, noise that 12 digits keep. For display only; NaN and infinities pass through.
	 */
	double Tidy(double Value, bool bDegrees)
	{
		if (!FMath::IsFinite(Value))
			return Value;
		if (bDegrees && FMath::Abs(Value) < 1e15)
			Value = FMath::RoundToDouble(Value * 1e6) / 1e6;
		if (FMath::Abs(Value) < 1e-9)
			return 0.0;
		char Text[32];
		std::snprintf(Text, sizeof(Text), "%.12g", Value);
		double Parsed = Value;
		return rql::parse_double(Text, Parsed) ? Parsed : Value;
	}

	std::string Format(const FMathStruct& Spec, const void* Data)
	{
		double Parts[4] = { 0, 0, 0, 0 };
		Spec.Get(Data, Parts);
		std::string Out = "(";
		for (int32 Index = 0; Index < Spec.Count; ++Index)
		{
			if (Index > 0)
				Out += ", ";
			Out += rql::to_text(rql::Value::number(Spec.bSingle || Spec.Struct == TBaseStructure<FQuat>::Get() ? Parts[Index]
				: Tidy(Parts[Index], Spec.Struct == TBaseStructure<FRotator>::Get()),
				Spec.bSingle ? rql::builtin::single_type() : rql::builtin::double_type()));
		}
		return Out + ")";
	}
}

using namespace UnrealMcpRqlStructsLocal;

bool UnrealMcpRqlParseMathStruct(UScriptStruct* Struct, const rql::Value& Value, void* Out, FString& OutError)
{
	const FMathStruct* Spec = Find(Struct);
	if (!Spec)
		return false;
	double Parts[4] = { 0, 0, 0, 0 };
	if (!Components(*Spec, Value, Parts, OutError))
		return false;
	Spec->Set(Out, Parts);
	return true;
}

std::function<rql::AdapterOutcome(const rql::Value&, const rql::TypeDescriptor&, rql::Value&, std::string&)>
	UnrealMcpRqlStructCoerce(FUnrealMcpRqlTypes& Types, UScriptStruct* Struct, std::function<bool(const rql::Value&)> Accepts)
{
	FUnrealMcpRqlTypes* TypesPtr = &Types;
	return [TypesPtr, Struct, Accepts](const rql::Value& Value, const rql::TypeDescriptor&, rql::Value& Result, std::string& Reason)
	{
		if (!Accepts(Value))
			return rql::AdapterOutcome::NotHandled;
		rql::Value Built = TypesPtr->WrapStruct(Struct, nullptr);
		try
		{
			TypesPtr->CoerceStruct(Struct, Value, Built.ptr());
		}
		catch (const std::exception& Error)
		{
			Reason = Error.what();
			return rql::AdapterOutcome::Failed;
		}
		Result = Built;
		return rql::AdapterOutcome::Ok;
	};
}

namespace UnrealMcpRqlStructsLocal
{
	/**
	 * Soft object / class paths (FSoftObjectPath, FSoftClassPath: GameDefaultMap, a class to spawn ...) as text:
	 * "/Game/Maps/Arena.Arena" out, a path, an object or "" in. Paths are not checked for an existing asset (they are
	 * soft: the asset may not be loaded or not exist yet), the same rule as soft object properties.
	 */
	void AddSoftPathAdapter(FUnrealMcpRqlSession& Session, UScriptStruct* Struct)
	{
		FUnrealMcpRqlTypes* Types = &Session.Types();
		const rql::TypeDescriptor* Descriptor = Types->ForStruct(Struct);
		if (!Descriptor)
			return;
		// Text is the whole value: no raw members (AssetPath / SubPathString) to write past the adapter.
		Types->AddStructHook(Struct, [](FUnrealMcpRqlTypes&, rql::TypeDescriptor& D)
		{
			D.members.clear();
			FUnrealMcpRqlTypes::SetMember(D, UnrealMcpRqlUtil::Member("Path", rql::builtin::string_type(), [](void* Self)
			{
				return UnrealMcpRqlUtil::Str(static_cast<const FSoftObjectPath*>(Self)->ToString());
			}, {}, "the path text"));
			FUnrealMcpRqlTypes::SetMember(D, UnrealMcpRqlUtil::Member("Package", rql::builtin::string_type(), [](void* Self)
			{
				return UnrealMcpRqlUtil::Str(static_cast<const FSoftObjectPath*>(Self)->GetLongPackageName());
			}, {}, "the package (\"/Game/Maps/Arena\")"));
		});
		const bool bClassPath = Struct->GetFName() == FName(TEXT("SoftClassPath"));
		Types->AddStructParser(Struct, [bClassPath](FUnrealMcpRqlTypes& T, const rql::Value& Value, void* Out) -> bool
		{
			FSoftObjectPath& Path = *static_cast<FSoftObjectPath*>(Out);
			if (Value.is_null() || (Value.is_string() && Value.as_string().empty()))
			{
				Path.Reset();
				return true;
			}
			if (UObject* Object = T.AsObject(Value))
			{
				// A class path holds a class: a Blueprint stands for its generated class, other objects do not fit.
				if (bClassPath && !Object->IsA<UClass>())
				{
					const UBlueprint* Blueprint = Cast<UBlueprint>(Object);
					if (!Blueprint || !Blueprint->GeneratedClass)
						UnrealMcpRqlUtil::Throw(FString::Printf(TEXT("%s is not a class (a class path takes a class or a Blueprint)"), *Object->GetName()));
					Object = Blueprint->GeneratedClass;
				}
				Path = FSoftObjectPath(Object);
				return true;
			}
			if (!Value.is_string())
				return false;
			// SetPath silently resets text that is not an object path ("Arena", "Game/Maps/Arena"): refuse it instead.
			const FString Text = UnrealMcpRqlFromStd(Value.as_string()).TrimStartAndEnd();
			Path.SetPath(Text);
			if (Path.IsNull() && !Text.IsEmpty() && !Text.Equals(TEXT("None")))
				UnrealMcpRqlUtil::Throw(FString::Printf(TEXT("'%s' is not an object path (\"/Game/Maps/Arena.Arena\")"), *Text));
			return true;
		});
		rql::TypeAdapter Adapter;
		Adapter.name = UnrealMcpRqlToStd(Struct->GetName());
		Adapter.target = Descriptor;
		Adapter.description = UnrealMcpRqlToStd(Struct->GetName()) + ": an asset path as text (\"/Game/Maps/Arena.Arena\"), an object, or \"\" for none";
		Adapter.encode = [](const rql::Value& Value, const rql::EncodeContext&) -> std::optional<rql::Json>
		{
			if (!Value.is_struct() || !Value.ptr())
				return std::nullopt;
			const FSoftObjectPath& Path = *static_cast<const FSoftObjectPath*>(Value.ptr());
			return Path.IsNull() ? rql::Json() : rql::Json(UnrealMcpRqlToStd(Path.ToString()));
		};
		Adapter.coerce = UnrealMcpRqlStructCoerce(*Types, Struct,
			[](const rql::Value& Value) { return Value.is_string() || Value.is_null() || Value.is_object(); });
		Adapter.equals = [](const rql::Value& Value, const rql::Value& Other) -> std::optional<bool>
		{
			if (!Value.is_struct() || !Value.ptr())
				return std::nullopt;
			const FSoftObjectPath& Path = *static_cast<const FSoftObjectPath*>(Value.ptr());
			if (Other.is_null())
				return Path.IsNull();
			if (!Other.is_string())
				return std::nullopt;
			const FString Text = UnrealMcpRqlFromStd(Other.as_string()).TrimStartAndEnd();
			// "/Game/Maps/Arena" matches "/Game/Maps/Arena.Arena" (the package path an edit field shows).
			return Path.ToString().Equals(Text, ESearchCase::IgnoreCase) || Path.GetLongPackageName().Equals(Text, ESearchCase::IgnoreCase);
		};
		Session.AddAdapter(std::move(Adapter));
	}
}

void UnrealMcpRqlAddStructAdapters(FUnrealMcpRqlSession& Session)
{
	FUnrealMcpRqlTypes* Types = &Session.Types();
	// The reflected structs of FSoftObjectPath / FSoftClassPath (no TBaseStructure for them).
	for (const TCHAR* Path : { TEXT("/Script/CoreUObject.SoftObjectPath"), TEXT("/Script/CoreUObject.SoftClassPath") })
	{
		if (UScriptStruct* Struct = FindObject<UScriptStruct>(nullptr, Path))
			AddSoftPathAdapter(Session, Struct);
	}
	for (const FMathStruct& Spec : MathStructs())
	{
		const rql::TypeDescriptor* Descriptor = Types->ForStruct(Spec.Struct);
		if (!Descriptor)
			continue;
		const FMathStruct* SpecPtr = &Spec; // MathStructs() is a function-local static: stable for the process
		rql::TypeAdapter Adapter;
		Adapter.name = UnrealMcpRqlToStd(Spec.Struct->GetName());
		Adapter.target = Descriptor;
		Adapter.description = UnrealMcpRqlToStd(Spec.Struct->GetName()) + ": write \"" + Spec.Shape + "\", a list of numbers or {member: value}";
		Adapter.encode = [SpecPtr](const rql::Value& Value, const rql::EncodeContext&) -> std::optional<rql::Json>
		{
			if (!Value.is_struct() || !Value.ptr())
				return std::nullopt;
			return rql::Json(Format(*SpecPtr, Value.ptr()));
		};
		// Structs and {X: 1} literals: RQL's own coercion.
		Adapter.coerce = UnrealMcpRqlStructCoerce(*Types, Spec.Struct, [](const rql::Value& Value) { return Value.is_string() || Value.is_list(); });
		// Equality with the text, list and object forms (where Location == "(0, 0, 100)" / {X: 0, Y: 0, Z: 100}),
		// approximate like RQL's .NET tuple adapters: components within 1e-5.
		Adapter.equals = [SpecPtr, Types](const rql::Value& Value, const rql::Value& Other) -> std::optional<bool>
		{
			if (!Value.is_struct() || !Value.ptr())
				return std::nullopt;
			double Mine[4] = { 0, 0, 0, 0 };
			double Theirs[4] = { 0, 0, 0, 0 };
			SpecPtr->Get(Value.ptr(), Mine);
			if (Other.is_struct() && Other.type() == Value.type() && Other.ptr())
				SpecPtr->Get(Other.ptr(), Theirs);
			else if (Other.is_string() || Other.is_list())
			{
				FString Ignored;
				if (!Components(*SpecPtr, Other, Theirs, Ignored))
					return false; // not this struct's form: not equal
			}
			else if (Other.is_map() && Other.map().object_literal())
			{
				// {X: 100, Z: 300}: the named members over this value, as a write applies them (the others match).
				rql::Value Built = Types->WrapStruct(SpecPtr->Struct, Value.ptr());
				try
				{
					Types->CoerceStruct(SpecPtr->Struct, Other, Built.ptr());
				}
				catch (const std::exception&)
				{
					return false; // not this struct's members: not equal
				}
				SpecPtr->Get(Built.ptr(), Theirs);
			}
			else
				return std::nullopt;
			for (int32 Index = 0; Index < SpecPtr->Count; ++Index)
			{
				if (!(FMath::Abs(Mine[Index] - Theirs[Index]) <= 1e-5))
					return false;
			}
			return true;
		};
		// Component-wise arithmetic (RQL spec 4.2): set Scale = Scale * 1.5, Location + [0, 0, 100]. A rotator's is per
		// axis (Pitch, Yaw, Roll), as in the Details panel, not a composed rotation.
		if (Spec.bArithmetic)
		{
			Adapter.components = [SpecPtr](const rql::Value& Value) -> std::optional<std::vector<double>>
			{
				if (!Value.is_struct() || !Value.ptr())
					return std::nullopt;
				double Parts[4] = { 0, 0, 0, 0 };
				SpecPtr->Get(Value.ptr(), Parts);
				std::vector<double> Out(Parts, Parts + SpecPtr->Count);
				if (SpecPtr->bSingle)
				{
					for (double& Part : Out)
						Part = rql::widen_single(static_cast<float>(Part));
				}
				return Out;
			};
			Adapter.from_components = [SpecPtr, Types](const rql::TypeDescriptor&, const std::vector<double>& Parts) -> std::optional<rql::Value>
			{
				if (Parts.size() != static_cast<size_t>(SpecPtr->Count))
					return std::nullopt;
				rql::Value Built = Types->WrapStruct(SpecPtr->Struct, nullptr);
				if (!Built.ptr())
					return std::nullopt;
				SpecPtr->Set(Built.ptr(), Parts.data());
				return Built;
			};
		}
		Session.AddAdapter(std::move(Adapter));
	}
}
```

```cpp
// Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak. Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.

#include "UnrealMcpRqlTools.h"

#include "IUnrealMcpRqlModule.h"
#include "UnrealMcpRqlGuide.h"
#include "UnrealMcpRqlSession.h"
#include "UnrealMcpToolRegistry.h"

#include "Dom/JsonObject.h"
#include "Features/IModularFeatures.h"
#include "Serialization/JsonReader.h"
#include "Serialization/JsonSerializer.h"

namespace UnrealMcpRqlToolsLocal
{
	/** SetEnabledExtensions; unset = every module. */
	TOptional<TSet<FString>> GEnabledExtensions;

	FString Text(const char* Utf8)
	{
		return UnrealMcpRqlFromStd(Utf8);
	}

	/** The QueryResult the sidecar renders when a call arrives without the parsed plan (e.g. a direct IPC caller). */
	FUnrealMcpToolResult MissingPlan()
	{
		rql::QueryResult Result = rql::QueryResult::fail({ rql::Diagnostic::error("unsupported",
			"RQL text is parsed by the unreal-mcp-bridge sidecar; this call carried no 'plan'",
			"call the tool through the MCP server (unreal-mcp-cli run-tool rql-query ...)") });
		return FUnrealMcpToolResult::Error(UnrealMcpRqlFromStd(Result.to_json(false).dump()));
	}

	FUnrealMcpToolResult Run(const FUnrealMcpToolCall& Call, bool bAllowMutation)
	{
		const FString Plan = Call.GetString(TEXT("plan"));
		if (Plan.IsEmpty())
			return MissingPlan();
		bool bOk = false;
		const bool bDryRun = bAllowMutation && Call.GetBool(TEXT("dry_run"), false);
		// An absent (or null, or non-numeric) max_targets keeps the default; any number given (a numeric string too, not a
		// boolean) reaches the engine, which refuses one outside 1 .. HardMaxTargets (invalid-value, nothing run).
		TOptional<int32> MaxTargets;
		const TSharedPtr<FJsonValue> Limit = bAllowMutation ? Call.Arguments->TryGetField(TEXT("max_targets")) : nullptr;
		double Requested = 0.0;
		if (Limit.IsValid() && Limit->Type != EJson::Boolean && Limit->TryGetNumber(Requested))
			MaxTargets = static_cast<int32>(FMath::Clamp<double>(Requested, MIN_int32, MAX_int32));
		FUnrealMcpRqlSession Session;
		Session.SetUndoTitle(Call.GetString(TEXT("query")));
		const FString Json = Session.Execute(Plan, bAllowMutation, bDryRun, bOk, MaxTargets);
		return bOk ? FUnrealMcpToolResult::Success(Json) : FUnrealMcpToolResult::Error(Json);
	}

	void RegisterTools(FUnrealMcpToolRegistry& Registry)
	{
		const FString Skill = UnrealMcpRqlTools::SkillMarkdown();

		Registry.Tool(TEXT("rql-query"))
			.Title(TEXT("RQL / Query"))
			.Description(Text(UnrealMcpRqlGuide::QueryIntro()) + TEXT("\n\n") + Text(UnrealMcpRqlGuide::Language()) + TEXT("\n")
				+ Text(UnrealMcpRqlGuide::LanguageRules()) + TEXT("\n") + Text(UnrealMcpRqlGuide::QueryExamples()))
			.SkillDescription(Text(UnrealMcpRqlGuide::QueryBlurb()))
			// The unreal-rql skill (sources and guides of the installed modules): the sidecar writes it beside the tool pages.
			.Skill(Text(UnrealMcpRqlGuide::SkillName()), Text(UnrealMcpRqlGuide::SkillDescription()), Skill)
			.Rql(TEXT("query"))
			.ParamString(TEXT("query"), TEXT("RQL query, e.g. actors | where $ is PointLight | select $ref Label Location"),
				EUnrealMcpParamRequirement::Required)
			.ReadOnlyHint(true)
			.OpenWorldHint(false)
			.Handle([](const FUnrealMcpToolCall& Call) { return Run(Call, /*bAllowMutation*/ false); });

		Registry.Tool(TEXT("rql-mutate"))
			.Title(TEXT("RQL / Mutate"))
			.Description(Text(UnrealMcpRqlGuide::MutateIntro()) + TEXT("\n") + Text(UnrealMcpRqlGuide::MutateStages())
				+ Text(UnrealMcpRqlGuide::MutateExamples()) + Text(UnrealMcpRqlGuide::MutateOutro()) + TEXT("\n\n")
				+ Text(UnrealMcpRqlGuide::QuerySyntaxShort()) + TEXT("\n\n") + Text(UnrealMcpRqlGuide::LanguageRules()))
			.SkillDescription(Text(UnrealMcpRqlGuide::MutateBlurb()))
			.Rql(TEXT("mutate"))
			.ParamString(TEXT("query"), TEXT("RQL query ending with a set or call stage, e.g. actors | where Label == \"Player\" | set HiddenInEditor = true"),
				EUnrealMcpParamRequirement::Required)
			.ParamBool(TEXT("dry_run"), TEXT("true = preview the receipt without changing anything"))
			.ParamInt(TEXT("max_targets"), FString::Printf(TEXT("Most objects set / call may change in this call (default %d, at most %d); raise it for a bigger bulk edit"),
				FUnrealMcpRqlSession::DefaultMaxTargets, FUnrealMcpRqlSession::HardMaxTargets))
			.DestructiveHint(true)
			.OpenWorldHint(false)
			.Handle([](const FUnrealMcpToolCall& Call) { return Run(Call, /*bAllowMutation*/ true); });

		Registry.Tool(TEXT("rql-schema"))
			.Title(TEXT("RQL / Schema"))
			.Description(Text(UnrealMcpRqlGuide::SchemaDescription()))
			.SkillDescription(Text(UnrealMcpRqlGuide::SchemaBlurb()))
			.Rql(TEXT("schema"))
			.ParamString(TEXT("type"), TEXT("Optional type name, e.g. \"PointLight\", \"StaticMeshComponent\", \"Vector\""))
			.ReadOnlyHint(true)
			.OpenWorldHint(false)
			.Handle([](const FUnrealMcpToolCall& Call)
			{
				bool bOk = false;
				const FString Json = UnrealMcpRqlTools::Schema(Call.GetString(TEXT("type")), bOk);
				return bOk ? FUnrealMcpToolResult::Success(Json) : FUnrealMcpToolResult::Error(Json);
			});
	}
}

using namespace UnrealMcpRqlToolsLocal;

namespace UnrealMcpRqlTools
{
	void Register(FUnrealMcpToolRegistry& Registry)
	{
		RegisterTools(Registry);
	}

	TArray<IUnrealMcpRqlModule*> Modules()
	{
		TArray<IUnrealMcpRqlModule*> Out = IModularFeatures::Get().GetModularFeatureImplementations<IUnrealMcpRqlModule>(
			IUnrealMcpRqlModule::GetModularFeatureName());
		Out.RemoveAll([](const IUnrealMcpRqlModule* Module) { return Module == nullptr; });
		Out.Sort([](const IUnrealMcpRqlModule& A, const IUnrealMcpRqlModule& B) { return A.GetRqlModuleName() < B.GetRqlModuleName(); });
		return Out;
	}

	void SetEnabledExtensions(const TSet<FString>& ExtensionIds)
	{
		GEnabledExtensions = ExtensionIds;
	}

	bool IsModuleEnabled(const IUnrealMcpRqlModule& Module)
	{
		const FString Id = Module.GetExtensionId();
		return Id.IsEmpty() || !GEnabledExtensions.IsSet() || GEnabledExtensions->Contains(Id);
	}

	IUnrealMcpRqlModule* FindModule(const FString& ExtensionId)
	{
		for (IUnrealMcpRqlModule* Module : Modules())
		{
			if (Module->GetExtensionId() == ExtensionId)
				return Module;
		}
		return nullptr;
	}

	bool RunPlan(const FString& PlanJson, bool bAllowMutation, TSharedPtr<FJsonObject>* OutResult)
	{
		bool bOk = false;
		const FString Json = ExecutePlan(PlanJson, bAllowMutation, /*bDryRun*/ false, bOk);
		if (OutResult)
		{
			OutResult->Reset();
			FJsonSerializer::Deserialize(TJsonReaderFactory<>::Create(Json), *OutResult);
		}
		return bOk;
	}

	FString ExecutePlan(const FString& PlanJson, bool bAllowMutation, bool bDryRun, bool& bOutOk)
	{
		FUnrealMcpRqlSession Session;
		return Session.Execute(PlanJson, bAllowMutation, bDryRun, bOutOk);
	}

	FString Schema(const FString& TypeName, bool& bOutOk)
	{
		FUnrealMcpRqlSession Session;
		return Session.Schema(TypeName, bOutOk);
	}

	FString SkillMarkdown()
	{
		FUnrealMcpRqlSession Session;
		return Session.SkillMarkdown();
	}
}
```

```cpp
#include "UnrealMcpRqlTypes.h"
```
