`UnrealMCP/Source/UnrealMcpRql/Private/UnrealMcpRqlUtil.h`:

```h
// Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak. Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.
// See the LICENSE file in the repository root for more information.

#pragma once

#include "CoreMinimal.h"
#include "UnrealMcpRqlTypes.h"
#include "UObject/Class.h"

#include <functional>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <vector>

class ULevel;
class UWorld;

/** Helpers shared by the provider (UnrealMcpRqlTypes.cpp), the core module and the struct adapters. Game thread. */
namespace UnrealMcpRqlUtil
{
	/** Fail the current RQL getter / setter / method: the engine reports the message to the agent. */
	[[noreturn]] inline void Throw(const FString& Message)
	{
		throw std::runtime_error(UnrealMcpRqlToStd(Message));
	}

	/** "expected <What>, got <the value>" (a value of the wrong type). */
	[[noreturn]] inline void ThrowMismatch(const TCHAR* What, const rql::Value& Got)
	{
		Throw(FString::Printf(TEXT("expected %s, got %s"), What, *UnrealMcpRqlFromStd(rql::describe_value(Got))));
	}

	inline rql::Value Str(const FString& Text)
	{
		return rql::Value::string(UnrealMcpRqlToStd(Text));
	}

	/** Any scalar as text (null / missing read as ""). */
	inline FString TextArg(const rql::Value& Value)
	{
		if (Value.is_string())
			return UnrealMcpRqlFromStd(Value.as_string());
		if (Value.is_null() || Value.is_missing())
			return FString();
		return UnrealMcpRqlFromStd(rql::to_text(Value));
	}

	/** true / false, a number (non-zero = true) or the text "true" / "false"; anything else throws. */
	inline bool BoolArg(const rql::Value& Value)
	{
		if (Value.is_bool())
			return Value.as_bool();
		if (Value.is_number())
			return Value.as_number() != 0.0;
		if (Value.is_string())
		{
			const FString Text = UnrealMcpRqlFromStd(Value.as_string());
			if (Text.Equals(TEXT("true"), ESearchCase::IgnoreCase))
				return true;
			if (Text.Equals(TEXT("false"), ESearchCase::IgnoreCase))
				return false;
		}
		ThrowMismatch(TEXT("true or false"), Value);
	}

	/** A computed member (read-only without a setter). */
	inline rql::MemberDescriptor Member(const char* Name, const rql::TypeDescriptor* Type, rql::Getter Get, rql::Setter Set = {},
		const char* Description = "", bool bOwning = false, bool bNullable = false)
	{
		rql::MemberDescriptor Result;
		Result.name = Name;
		Result.type = Type;
		Result.getter = MoveTemp(Get);
		Result.setter = MoveTemp(Set);
		Result.readonly = !Result.setter;
		Result.description = Description;
		Result.owning = bOwning;
		Result.nullable = bNullable;
		return Result;
	}

	/** A `call` method of a host type (@p Result nullptr = void). */
	inline rql::MethodDescriptor Method(const char* Name, std::vector<rql::ParamDescriptor> Params, const rql::TypeDescriptor* Result,
		std::function<rql::Value(void*, const std::vector<rql::Value>&)> Invoke, const char* Description)
	{
		rql::MethodDescriptor Out;
		Out.name = Name;
		Out.params = std::move(Params);
		Out.result = Result;
		Out.invoke = std::move(Invoke);
		Out.description = Description;
		return Out;
	}

	/** The list items of an RQL list value (throws for anything else). */
	inline std::vector<rql::Value> Items(const rql::Value& Value)
	{
		if (!Value.is_list())
			ThrowMismatch(TEXT("a list"), Value);
		std::vector<rql::Value> Out;
		for (size_t Index = 0, Count = Value.list().size(); Index < Count; ++Index)
			Out.push_back(Value.list().at(Index));
		return Out;
	}

	/** RQL list of strings. */
	inline rql::Value StrList(const TArray<FString>& Texts)
	{
		std::vector<rql::Value> Out;
		Out.reserve(static_cast<size_t>(Texts.Num()));
		for (const FString& Text : Texts)
			Out.push_back(Str(Text));
		return rql::Value::list_of(std::move(Out));
	}

	/** The editor world (null outside the editor). */
	UWorld* EditorWorld();

	/** Make @p Level the level new actors spawn into; throws when it is not a level or cannot become current (locked). */
	void MakeLevelCurrent(ULevel* Level);

	/** The value of a math / reflected struct from any RQL form (FUnrealMcpRqlTypes::CoerceStruct); throws on mismatch. */
	template <typename T>
	T StructArg(FUnrealMcpRqlTypes& Types, const rql::Value& Value)
	{
		T Out;
		FMemory::Memzero(&Out, sizeof(T)); // math structs are plain data; a {X: 1} literal writes over zeros
		Types.CoerceStruct(TBaseStructure<T>::Get(), Value, &Out);
		return Out;
	}
}
```

`UnrealMCP/Source/UnrealMcpRql/Private/UnrealMcpRqlWidgets.cpp`:

```cpp
// Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak. Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.
// See the LICENSE file in the repository root for more information.

#include "UnrealMcpRqlSession.h"
#include "UnrealMcpRqlSources.h"
#include "UnrealMcpRqlUtil.h"
#include "Tools/UnrealMcpObjectRef.h"

#include "BaseWidgetBlueprint.h"
#include "WidgetBlueprint.h"
#include "Blueprint/UserWidget.h"
#include "Blueprint/WidgetTree.h"
#include "Components/PanelSlot.h"
#include "Components/PanelWidget.h"
#include "Components/Widget.h"
#include "Kismet2/BlueprintEditorUtils.h"
#include "Kismet2/Kismet2NameValidators.h"
#include "Misc/EngineVersionComparison.h"

#include <vector>

/**
 * UMG widget trees (docs/rql.md "Widget Blueprints"). A Widget Blueprint's widgets live in its WidgetTree, which
 * reflection does not expose; the widgets themselves are UObjects whose properties (and `Slot`, the layout of the widget
 * in its parent panel) are reflected as usual. Adding and removing widgets changes the Blueprint's structure: it is
 * marked structurally modified (compile with `call Compile()`), and every change is undoable.
 */
namespace UnrealMcpRqlWidgetsLocal
{
	using namespace UnrealMcpRqlUtil;

	UBaseWidgetBlueprint* BlueprintOf(const UObject* Object)
	{
		return Object ? const_cast<UBaseWidgetBlueprint*>(Object->GetTypedOuter<UBaseWidgetBlueprint>()) : nullptr;
	}

	/**
	 * A widget's variable GUID, as the Designer registers it (from UE 5.6 the compiler checks every widget has one; UE 5.5
	 * widget Blueprints keep no such map).
	 */
	void RegisterVariable(UWidgetBlueprint* Blueprint, FName Name)
	{
#if !UE_VERSION_OLDER_THAN(5, 6, 0)
		Blueprint->OnVariableAdded(Name);
#endif
	}

	void UnregisterVariable(UWidgetBlueprint* Blueprint, FName Name)
	{
#if !UE_VERSION_OLDER_THAN(5, 6, 0)
		Blueprint->OnVariableRemoved(Name);
#endif
	}

	UWidgetTree* RequireTree(UBaseWidgetBlueprint* Blueprint)
	{
		if (!Blueprint || !Blueprint->WidgetTree)
			Throw(FString::Printf(TEXT("%s has no widget tree"), Blueprint ? *Blueprint->GetName() : TEXT("the Widget Blueprint")));
		return Blueprint->WidgetTree;
	}

	TArray<UObject*> AllWidgets(const UBaseWidgetBlueprint* Blueprint)
	{
		TArray<UObject*> Out;
		if (Blueprint && Blueprint->WidgetTree)
		{
			TArray<UWidget*> Widgets;
			Blueprint->WidgetTree->GetAllWidgets(Widgets);
			for (UWidget* Widget : Widgets)
				Out.Add(Widget);
		}
		return Out;
	}

	/**
	 * A new widget of @p ClassName named @p Name, added under @p Parent (a panel of the same tree), or as the root of an
	 * empty tree. Validates everything before creating the widget.
	 */
	UWidget* AddWidget(UBaseWidgetBlueprint* Blueprint, UWidget* Parent, const FString& ClassName, const FString& Name)
	{
		UWidgetTree* Tree = RequireTree(Blueprint);
		UClass* Class = FUnrealMcpObjectRef::ResolveClass(ClassName);
		if (!Class || !Class->IsChildOf(UWidget::StaticClass()) || Class->HasAnyClassFlags(CLASS_Abstract | CLASS_Deprecated))
			Throw(FString::Printf(TEXT("'%s' is not a widget class (e.g. \"Button\", \"TextBlock\", \"VerticalBox\", \"CanvasPanel\")"), *ClassName));
		UPanelWidget* Panel = nullptr;
		if (Parent)
		{
			Panel = Cast<UPanelWidget>(Parent);
			if (!Panel)
				Throw(FString::Printf(TEXT("%s is a %s, not a panel: widgets go into panels (CanvasPanel, VerticalBox, Border, ...)"),
					*Parent->GetName(), *Parent->GetClass()->GetName()));
			if (BlueprintOf(Panel) != Blueprint)
				Throw(TEXT("the parent panel belongs to another Widget Blueprint"));
			if (!Panel->CanAddMoreChildren())
				Throw(FString::Printf(TEXT("%s holds one child and already has it"), *Panel->GetName()));
		}
		else if (Tree->RootWidget)
		{
			Throw(FString::Printf(TEXT("%s already has a root widget (%s): add into a panel with AddWidget(class, name, parent)"),
				*Blueprint->GetName(), *Tree->RootWidget->GetName()));
		}
		const FString Trimmed = Name.TrimStartAndEnd();
		if (!Trimmed.IsEmpty())
		{
			if (!FName::IsValidXName(Trimmed, INVALID_OBJECTNAME_CHARACTERS))
				Throw(FString::Printf(TEXT("'%s' is not a valid widget name"), *Trimmed));
			if (Tree->FindWidget(FName(*Trimmed)) || FindObject<UObject>(Tree, *Trimmed))
				Throw(FString::Printf(TEXT("%s already has a widget named '%s'"), *Blueprint->GetName(), *Trimmed));
			// A widget is a variable of the Blueprint: no variable, function or graph may have its name either.
			if (FKismetNameValidator(Blueprint).IsValid(Trimmed) != EValidatorResult::Ok)
				Throw(FString::Printf(TEXT("%s already has a variable, function or graph named '%s'"), *Blueprint->GetName(), *Trimmed));
		}

		Blueprint->Modify();
		Tree->SetFlags(RF_Transactional);
		Tree->Modify();
		UWidget* Widget = Tree->ConstructWidget<UWidget>(Class, Trimmed.IsEmpty() ? NAME_None : FName(*Trimmed));
		if (!Widget)
			Throw(FString::Printf(TEXT("could not create a %s"), *Class->GetName()));
		UWidgetBlueprint* Designer = Cast<UWidgetBlueprint>(Blueprint);
		// A User Widget that is (or contains) this Blueprint would nest itself without end: the Designer refuses it too.
		UUserWidget* UserWidget = Cast<UUserWidget>(Widget);
		if (UserWidget && Designer && !Designer->IsWidgetFreeFromCircularReferences(UserWidget))
		{
			Widget->Rename(nullptr, GetTransientPackage(), REN_DontCreateRedirectors);
			Throw(FString::Printf(TEXT("a %s inside %s would be a circular reference"), *Class->GetName(), *Blueprint->GetName()));
		}
		Widget->SetFlags(RF_Transactional);
		// The editor registers every new widget as a variable of the Blueprint (its GUID: the compiler needs it).
		if (Designer)
			RegisterVariable(Designer, Widget->GetFName());
		if (Panel)
		{
			Panel->Modify();
			if (!Panel->AddChild(Widget))
				Throw(FString::Printf(TEXT("%s did not accept the widget"), *Panel->GetName()));
		}
		else
		{
			Tree->RootWidget = Widget;
		}
		FBlueprintEditorUtils::MarkBlueprintAsStructurallyModified(Blueprint);
		return Widget;
	}

	void RemoveWidget(UWidget* Widget)
	{
		UBaseWidgetBlueprint* Blueprint = BlueprintOf(Widget);
		UWidgetTree* Tree = RequireTree(Blueprint);
		Blueprint->Modify();
		Tree->Modify();
		Widget->Modify();
		if (UPanelWidget* Parent = Widget->GetParent())
			Parent->Modify();
		// RemoveWidget detaches it from its parent panel (or clears the root) and keeps the children with it.
		// The widget and every widget under it leave the Blueprint's variables.
		TArray<UWidget*> Removed{ Widget };
		UWidgetTree::GetChildWidgets(Widget, Removed); // panel children and named-slot contents
		if (!Tree->RemoveWidget(Widget))
			Throw(FString::Printf(TEXT("%s is not in the widget tree"), *Widget->GetName()));
		UWidgetBlueprint* Designer = Cast<UWidgetBlueprint>(Blueprint);
		for (UWidget* Gone : Removed)
		{
			const FName Name = Gone->GetFName();
			// The compiler visits every widget outered to the tree: move the removed ones out, as the Designer's Delete does.
			Gone->Modify();
			Gone->Rename(nullptr, GetTransientPackage(), REN_DontCreateRedirectors);
			if (Designer)
				UnregisterVariable(Designer, Name);
		}
		FBlueprintEditorUtils::MarkBlueprintAsStructurallyModified(Blueprint);
	}

	void WidgetBlueprintMembers(FUnrealMcpRqlTypes& T, rql::TypeDescriptor& D)
	{
		FUnrealMcpRqlTypes* Types = &T;
		const rql::TypeDescriptor* WidgetType = T.ForClass(UWidget::StaticClass());
		const rql::TypeDescriptor* String = rql::builtin::string_type();
		FUnrealMcpRqlTypes::SetMember(D, Member("RootWidget", WidgetType, [Types](void* Self)
		{
			const UBaseWidgetBlueprint* Blueprint = static_cast<UBaseWidgetBlueprint*>(Self);
			return Types->WrapObject(Blueprint->WidgetTree ? Blueprint->WidgetTree->RootWidget.Get() : nullptr);
		}, {}, "the root of the widget tree", /*bOwning*/ true, /*bNullable*/ true));
		FUnrealMcpRqlTypes::SetMember(D, Member("Widgets", T.Registry().list_type(WidgetType, true), [Types](void* Self)
		{
			return Types->WrapObjects(AllWidgets(static_cast<UBaseWidgetBlueprint*>(Self)));
		}, {}, "every widget of the tree (each: its reflected properties, Slot = its layout in the parent)", /*bOwning*/ false));
		FUnrealMcpRqlTypes::AddMethod(D, Method("AddWidget",
			{ FUnrealMcpRqlTypes::Param("Class", String), FUnrealMcpRqlTypes::OptionalParam("Name", String, rql::Value::string("")),
			  FUnrealMcpRqlTypes::OptionalParam("Parent", WidgetType, rql::Value::null(), /*bNullable*/ true) },
			WidgetType, [Types](void* Self, const std::vector<rql::Value>& Args) -> rql::Value
			{
				UWidget* Parent = Args[2].is_null() ? nullptr : Cast<UWidget>(Types->AsObject(Args[2]));
				if (!Args[2].is_null() && !Parent)
					ThrowMismatch(TEXT("a widget of this Blueprint"), Args[2]);
				return Types->WrapObject(AddWidget(static_cast<UBaseWidgetBlueprint*>(Self), Parent, TextArg(Args[0]), TextArg(Args[1])));
			}, "add a widget (\"TextBlock\", \"Button\", a User Widget Blueprint path) into a panel (Parent), or as the root of an empty tree; returns it"));
	}

	void WidgetMembers(FUnrealMcpRqlTypes& T, rql::TypeDescriptor& D)
	{
		FUnrealMcpRqlTypes* Types = &T;
		const rql::TypeDescriptor* WidgetType = T.ForClass(UWidget::StaticClass());
		const rql::TypeDescriptor* String = rql::builtin::string_type();
		FUnrealMcpRqlTypes::SetMember(D, Member("Parent", T.ForClass(UPanelWidget::StaticClass()),
			[Types](void* Self) { return Types->WrapObject(static_cast<UWidget*>(Self)->GetParent()); }, {},
			"the panel holding this widget (null for the root)", false, true));
		FUnrealMcpRqlTypes::SetMember(D, Member("WidgetBlueprint", T.ForClass(UBaseWidgetBlueprint::StaticClass()),
			[Types](void* Self) { return Types->WrapObject(BlueprintOf(static_cast<UWidget*>(Self))); }, {}, "", false, true));
		FUnrealMcpRqlTypes::SetMember(D, Member("IsVariable", rql::builtin::bool_type(),
			[](void* Self) { return rql::Value::boolean(static_cast<UWidget*>(Self)->bIsVariable); },
			[](void* Self, const rql::Value& Value)
			{
				UWidget* Widget = static_cast<UWidget*>(Self);
				UBaseWidgetBlueprint* Blueprint = BlueprintOf(Widget);
				if (!Blueprint)
					Throw(TEXT("only widgets of a Widget Blueprint's tree can be made variables (not of a running widget)"));
				const bool bVariable = BoolArg(Value);
				if (Widget->bIsVariable == bVariable)
					return;
				// The Designer's "Is Variable" checkbox: the widget becomes (or stops being) a member the graphs can read.
				Blueprint->Modify();
				Widget->Modify();
				Widget->bIsVariable = bVariable;
				FBlueprintEditorUtils::MarkBlueprintAsStructurallyModified(Blueprint);
			}, "the Designer's Is Variable: true makes the widget a Blueprint variable the graphs can read (AddVariableGet(name)); text blocks, images and panels start as false"));
		FUnrealMcpRqlTypes::AddMethod(D, Method("Destroy", {}, nullptr, [](void* Self, const std::vector<rql::Value>&) -> rql::Value
		{
			UWidget* Widget = static_cast<UWidget*>(Self);
			if (!BlueprintOf(Widget))
				Throw(TEXT("only widgets of a Widget Blueprint's tree can be removed (not of a running widget)"));
			RemoveWidget(Widget);
			return rql::Value::null();
		}, "remove the widget (and its children) from the tree"));
		FUnrealMcpRqlTypes::AddMethod(D, Method("AddChild",
			{ FUnrealMcpRqlTypes::Param("Class", String), FUnrealMcpRqlTypes::OptionalParam("Name", String, rql::Value::string("")) },
			WidgetType, [Types](void* Self, const std::vector<rql::Value>& Args) -> rql::Value
			{
				UWidget* Widget = static_cast<UWidget*>(Self);
				UBaseWidgetBlueprint* Blueprint = BlueprintOf(Widget);
				if (!Blueprint)
					Throw(TEXT("only widgets of a Widget Blueprint's tree can take children here"));
				return Types->WrapObject(AddWidget(Blueprint, Widget, TextArg(Args[0]), TextArg(Args[1])));
			}, "add a widget of a class into this panel; returns it"));
	}

	void PanelMembers(FUnrealMcpRqlTypes& T, rql::TypeDescriptor& D)
	{
		FUnrealMcpRqlTypes* Types = &T;
		FUnrealMcpRqlTypes::SetMember(D, Member("Children", T.Registry().list_type(T.ForClass(UWidget::StaticClass()), true),
			[Types](void* Self)
			{
				TArray<UObject*> Out;
				for (UWidget* Child : static_cast<UPanelWidget*>(Self)->GetAllChildren())
					Out.Add(Child);
				return Types->WrapObjects(Out);
			}, {}, "the widgets in this panel, in order", /*bOwning*/ true));
	}
}

void UnrealMcpRqlAddWidgets(FUnrealMcpRqlSession& Session)
{
	using namespace UnrealMcpRqlWidgetsLocal;
	FUnrealMcpRqlTypes& T = Session.Types();
	FUnrealMcpRqlTypes* Types = &T;
	T.AddClassHook(UBaseWidgetBlueprint::StaticClass(), &WidgetBlueprintMembers);
	T.AddClassHook(UWidget::StaticClass(), &WidgetMembers);
	T.AddClassHook(UPanelWidget::StaticClass(), &PanelMembers);
	Session.AddSource(TEXT("widgetBlueprints"), T.ForClass(UBaseWidgetBlueprint::StaticClass()), /*bList*/ true,
		TEXT("the project's Widget Blueprints (RootWidget, Widgets; call AddWidget / Compile); panels list Children, widgets have Parent and Slot"),
		[Types]() { return UnrealMcpRqlAssetList(*Types, UBaseWidgetBlueprint::StaticClass(), FString()); });
	// The widgets of a Widget Blueprint are templates (archetypes of the generated class's widget tree) and its design
	// data: editable like the Designer edits them, unlike other class defaults.
	Session.AllowTemplateWrites([](const UObject* Object) { return BlueprintOf(Object) != nullptr; });
	// A widget's properties are its Blueprint's design: an edit marks the Blueprint modified (compile to apply it).
	Session.AddCommitted([Types](const std::vector<rql::MutationRecord>& Records)
	{
		TSet<UBaseWidgetBlueprint*> Touched;
		for (const rql::MutationRecord& Record : Records)
		{
			UObject* Owner = Types->AsObject(Record.owner);
			if (UBaseWidgetBlueprint* Blueprint = Owner && !Record.method ? BlueprintOf(Owner) : nullptr)
				Touched.Add(Blueprint);
		}
		for (UBaseWidgetBlueprint* Blueprint : Touched)
			FBlueprintEditorUtils::MarkBlueprintAsModified(Blueprint);
	});
}
```

`UnrealMCP/Source/UnrealMcpRql/Public/IUnrealMcpRqlModule.h`:

```h
// Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak. Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.
// See the LICENSE file in the repository root for more information.

#pragma once

#include "CoreMinimal.h"
#include "Dom/JsonValue.h"
#include "Features/IModularFeature.h"
#include "Features/IModularFeatures.h"
#include "Modules/ModuleInterface.h"
#include "Templates/Function.h"
#include "Templates/UniquePtr.h"

#include <type_traits>

class AActor;
class UActorComponent;
class UClass;
class UObject;
class UStruct;
class UWorld;

/**
 * What an RQL module contributes to the editor's RQL engine (docs/rql.md "Extensions"). UE types only: the RQL
 * runtime is private to the UnrealMcpRql module.
 *
 * Every reflected type is already queryable without a module: UClass / UScriptStruct / UEnum members come from
 * FProperty (EditAnywhere / BlueprintVisible), so a module adds what reflection does not show — sources (where agents
 * start a query), operations (`call`), extra read-only members and the agent guide rendered into the `unreal-rql` skill.
 */
class UNREALMCPRQL_API FUnrealMcpRqlModuleContext
{
public:
	virtual ~FUnrealMcpRqlModuleContext() = default;

	/**
	 * A source whose value is one object of @p Class, e.g. an operations object: `niagara | call SpawnSystem(...)`.
	 * @p Class types the source in rql-schema (the getter is not run for it).
	 */
	virtual void AddObjectSource(const FString& Name, const FString& Description, UClass* Class, TFunction<UObject*()> Getter) = 0;

	/** A source whose value is a list of @p ElementClass objects, e.g. the Landscape actors of the editor world. */
	virtual void AddObjectListSource(const FString& Name, const FString& Description, UClass* ElementClass,
		TFunction<TArray<UObject*>()> Getter) = 0;

	/** A source listing the project assets of @p AssetClass (and subclasses), loaded lazily, at most 200 per query. */
	virtual void AddAssetSource(const FString& Name, const FString& Description, UClass* AssetClass) = 0;

	/**
	 * A source listing the class default objects of the subclasses of @p BaseClass: the loaded classes (abstract ones left
	 * out) and the project's Blueprint classes, sorted by class name, at most 200. Blueprint classes that are not loaded
	 * yet load when the query reads them (`gasAbilities | first 3` loads three).
	 */
	virtual void AddClassDefaultsSource(const FString& Name, const FString& Description, UClass* BaseClass) = 0;

	/**
	 * Make every UFUNCTION declared on @p Class callable with `call` (an operations class — its parameters and return value
	 * are converted like members). Usually the class default object is a source (AddObjectSource). @p TypeName renames
	 * the type for agents (default: the class name). A function reports a failure with UnrealMcpRql::Fail.
	 */
	virtual void AddApiClass(UClass* Class, const FString& TypeName = FString()) = 0;

	/** AddApiClass(@p ApiClass, @p TypeName) plus a source whose value is its class default object: `niagara | call ...`. */
	void AddApiSource(const FString& Name, const FString& Description, UClass* ApiClass, const FString& TypeName = FString());

	/** Expose properties that reflection hides (not EditAnywhere / BlueprintVisible) as members of @p Owner. */
	virtual void ExposeProperties(UStruct* Owner, const TArray<FName>& PropertyNames, bool bWritable = false) = 0;

	/** A read-only member of @p Class whose value is JSON (numbers, strings, lists, objects) computed from the instance. */
	virtual void AddJsonMember(UClass* Class, const FString& Name, const FString& Description,
		TFunction<TSharedPtr<FJsonValue>(UObject*)> Getter) = 0;

	/** A read-only member of @p Class holding one @p ObjectClass object (null when none), e.g. a component's bound asset. */
	virtual void AddObjectMember(UClass* Class, const FString& Name, const FString& Description, UClass* ObjectClass,
		TFunction<UObject*(UObject*)> Getter) = 0;

	/** A read-only member of @p Class listing objects (an owning list: `recurse` and `get` follow it). */
	virtual void AddObjectListMember(UClass* Class, const FString& Name, const FString& Description, UClass* ElementClass,
		TFunction<TArray<UObject*>(UObject*)> Getter) = 0;

	/** Markdown rendered into the `unreal-rql` skill under the heading @p Topic. */
	virtual void AddGuide(const FString& Topic, const FString& Markdown) = 0;
};

/**
 * The extension seam of the RQL data layer: an extension registers an implementation as a modular feature under
 * GetModularFeatureName() (IModularFeatures::Get().RegisterModularFeature) and unregisters it on shutdown. The editor's
 * extension manager republishes the rql-* tools whenever the set of modules changes; an extension disabled in the
 * Extensions window contributes nothing (GetExtensionId names it there).
 */
class UNREALMCPRQL_API IUnrealMcpRqlModule : public IModularFeature
{
public:
	static FName GetModularFeatureName();

	virtual ~IUnrealMcpRqlModule() = default;

	/** Stable module name shown in the `unreal-rql` skill, e.g. "Niagara". */
	virtual FString GetRqlModuleName() const = 0;

	/** The extension that ships the module (reverse-DNS id, e.g. "com.ivanmurzak.unreal-ai-niagara"); empty for none. */
	virtual FString GetExtensionId() const { return FString(); }

	/**
	 * The extension's version: return UnrealMcpRql::PluginVersion(TEXT("<plugin>")), its .uplugin VersionName
	 * (scripts/extension_release.py checks that the first-party extensions do).
	 */
	virtual FString GetExtensionVersion() const { return FString(); }

	/** Register sources, operations, members and guides. Runs on the game thread whenever the engine is (re)built. */
	virtual void ConfigureRql(FUnrealMcpRqlModuleContext& Context) = 0;
};

namespace UnrealMcpRql
{
	/** A class by short name ("PointLight", "AStaticMeshActor"), class path or Blueprint asset path; nullptr when none. */
	UNREALMCPRQL_API UClass* ResolveClass(const FString& Name);

	/** An object of @p Class by path ("/Game/Materials/M_Red" or its object path), loaded quietly; nullptr when none. */
	UNREALMCPRQL_API UObject* LoadObject(UClass* Class, const FString& Path);

	/**
	 * Fail the UFUNCTION that RQL is calling right now with @p Message (UFUNCTIONs cannot throw). The `call` stage reports
	 * it as an error. Changes the function already made stay (as with any failing call); validate before changing.
	 */
	UNREALMCPRQL_API void Fail(const FString& Message);

	/** Fail(@p Message) and return the "nothing" value of the function: `return UnrealMcpRql::Failed<AActor*>(TEXT("..."));`. */
	template <typename T = void>
	T Failed(const FString& Message)
	{
		Fail(Message);
		if constexpr (!std::is_void_v<T>)
			return T();
	}

	/** The editor world (null outside the editor). */
	UNREALMCPRQL_API UWorld* EditorWorld();

	/** The VersionName of the plugin @p PluginName (its .uplugin): GetExtensionVersion() returns it. Empty when unknown. */
	UNREALMCPRQL_API FString PluginVersion(const FString& PluginName);

	/**
	 * Spawn an actor of @p Class in the current level of the editor world (undoable within the RQL mutation), labelled
	 * @p Label when given and attached to @p Parent when given. nullptr after Fail() when it cannot.
	 */
	UNREALMCPRQL_API AActor* SpawnActor(UClass* Class, const FVector& Location, const FRotator& Rotation,
		const FString& Label = FString(), AActor* Parent = nullptr);

	/**
	 * Add an instance component of @p Class to @p Actor (named @p Name, or a unique name when empty; scene components
	 * attach to the root), as `actors | call AddComponent(...)` does. @p Configure runs before the component registers.
	 * nullptr after Fail() when it cannot.
	 */
	UNREALMCPRQL_API UActorComponent* AddComponent(AActor* Actor, UClass* Class, const FString& Name = FString(),
		TFunction<void(UActorComponent*)> Configure = nullptr);

	/**
	 * Create an asset of @p Class at @p Path ("/Game/Input/IA_Jump", project or plugin content, not taken yet), with the
	 * Content Browser's "New" factory when one creates the class, as `editor | call CreateAsset(...)` does. Unsaved.
	 * nullptr after Fail() when it cannot.
	 */
	UNREALMCPRQL_API UObject* CreateAsset(UClass* Class, const FString& Path);
}

/**
 * The editor module of an extension whose only job is its RQL module: owns a @p TRqlModule and registers it as the
 * IUnrealMcpRqlModule modular feature for the module's lifetime.
 *   IMPLEMENT_MODULE(TUnrealMcpRqlEditorModule<FMyRqlModule>, MyExtension)
 */
template <typename TRqlModule>
class TUnrealMcpRqlEditorModule : public IModuleInterface
{
public:
	virtual void StartupModule() override
	{
		RqlModule = MakeUnique<TRqlModule>();
		IModularFeatures::Get().RegisterModularFeature(IUnrealMcpRqlModule::GetModularFeatureName(), RqlModule.Get());
	}

	virtual void ShutdownModule() override
	{
		if (RqlModule.IsValid())
		{
			IModularFeatures::Get().UnregisterModularFeature(IUnrealMcpRqlModule::GetModularFeatureName(), RqlModule.Get());
			RqlModule.Reset();
		}
	}

private:
	TUniquePtr<TRqlModule> RqlModule;
};
```

`UnrealMCP/Source/UnrealMcpRql/Public/UnrealMcpPinTypes.h`:

```h
// Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Murzak. Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.
// See the LICENSE file in the repository root for more information.

#pragma once

#include "CoreMinimal.h"
#include "EdGraph/EdGraphPin.h"

/**
 * The friendly variable-type tokens of the tools (ARCHITECTURE §3.2), shared by blueprint-add-variable /
 * blueprint-modify-variable and the RQL user-defined struct fields: a primitive (bool, int, int64, byte, float, string,
 * name, text), a math struct (vector, vector2d, rotator, transform, color), or a class / struct name or path.
 */
namespace UnrealMcpPinTypes
{
	/** @p Type as a Blueprint pin type (an array when @p bIsArray); false + @p OutError when the token resolves to nothing. */
	UNREALMCPRQL_API bool Make(const FString& Type, bool bIsArray, FEdGraphPinType& OutPinType, FString& OutError);

	/** A struct by path ("/Game/Data/S_Enemy") or name ("GameplayTag", C++ spelling "FGameplayTag"); null when there is none. */
	UNREALMCPRQL_API UScriptStruct* ResolveStruct(const FString& Text);

	/** The token for a pin type ("int", "Vector", "StaticMesh", with "[]" / "{}" / "<map>" for containers). */
	UNREALMCPRQL_API FString ToString(const FEdGraphPinType& PinType);
}
```

`UnrealMCP/Source/UnrealMcpRql/Public/UnrealMcpRqlTools.h`:

```h

#pragma once

#include "CoreMinimal.h"
#include "Templates/Function.h"

class FUnrealMcpToolRegistry;
class FJsonObject;
class IUnrealMcpRqlModule;

/**
 * The RQL tool family (docs/rql.md): rql-query, rql-mutate, rql-schema — the data layer of the editor, in place of the
 * removed actor / object / asset / level / editor-state / reflection tools.
 *
 * The C++ runtime executes QueryPlans and has no text parser (RQL ADR-0003): the unreal-mcp-bridge sidecar parses the
 * agent's `query` text with Rql.Parser and adds the canonical plan JSON as the `plan` argument; the handlers execute it
 * and answer with the QueryResult JSON, which the sidecar renders as compact rows. rql-schema answers with JSON the
 * sidecar renders the same way. Handlers run on the game thread (the dispatcher guarantees it).
 */
namespace UnrealMcpRqlTools
{
	/** Register (or re-register: same-named entries are replaced) the three tools into @p Registry (core tools). */
	UNREALMCPRQL_API void Register(FUnrealMcpToolRegistry& Registry);

	/** The registered RQL modules (IUnrealMcpRqlModule modular features), sorted by module name. */
	UNREALMCPRQL_API TArray<IUnrealMcpRqlModule*> Modules();

	/**
	 * The extensions whose RQL modules are enabled (the editor's extension manager runs this from its module pass, then
	 * re-registers the tools: their skill lists what the modules add). A module without an extension id always loads;
	 * until the first call every module does.
	 */
	UNREALMCPRQL_API void SetEnabledExtensions(const TSet<FString>& ExtensionIds);

	/** Whether @p Module takes part in RQL sessions (SetEnabledExtensions). */
	UNREALMCPRQL_API bool IsModuleEnabled(const IUnrealMcpRqlModule& Module);

	/**
	 * Execute a QueryPlan JSON on a fresh session; returns the QueryResult JSON. Game thread. (Specs drive this.)
	 * With @p bAllowMutation the plan must end in a set or call stage (RQL 0.2.0: otherwise invalid-plan).
	 */
	UNREALMCPRQL_API FString ExecutePlan(const FString& PlanJson, bool bAllowMutation, bool bDryRun, bool& bOutOk);

	/** The rql-schema JSON for @p TypeName (empty = overview). Game thread. */
	UNREALMCPRQL_API FString Schema(const FString& TypeName, bool& bOutOk);

	/** The `unreal-rql` skill markdown (core + installed modules). Game thread. */
	UNREALMCPRQL_API FString SkillMarkdown();

	// ---- spec helpers (an extension's Automation spec)

	/** The registered RQL module of the extension @p ExtensionId; nullptr when none. */
	UNREALMCPRQL_API IUnrealMcpRqlModule* FindModule(const FString& ExtensionId);

	/**
	 * ExecutePlan without dry run: whether the QueryResult is ok; @p OutResult receives the parsed QueryResult JSON.
	 * Pass @p bAllowMutation only for plans that end in set / call (read plans with it fail with invalid-plan).
	 */
	UNREALMCPRQL_API bool RunPlan(const FString& PlanJson, bool bAllowMutation, TSharedPtr<FJsonObject>* OutResult = nullptr);
}
```

```cs
using System.IO;
using UnrealBuildTool;

/// <summary>
/// The RQL data layer of the editor (docs/rql.md): the vendored RQL C++ runtime (Source/ThirdParty/RQL, PolyForm
/// Shield 1.0.0), the Unreal reflection provider (UClass / UScriptStruct / UEnum / FProperty / UFunction descriptors),
/// the `editor` operations, the rql-query / rql-mutate / rql-schema tools and the IUnrealMcpRqlModule extension seam.
///
/// The RQL runtime reports failures with C++ exceptions inside its own code (its public API is noexcept), so this
/// module enables exceptions. It is a separate module because exceptions and the no-unity build below apply per
/// module: the vendored sources keep file-local helpers that a unity build would merge into one translation unit.
/// RQL types never cross this module's boundary: extensions use the UE-typed API in IUnrealMcpRqlModule.h.
/// </summary>
public class UnrealMcpRql : ModuleRules
{
	public UnrealMcpRql(ReadOnlyTargetRules Target) : base(Target)
	{
		PCHUsage = ModuleRules.PCHUsageMode.NoPCHs;
		bUseUnity = false;
		bEnableExceptions = true;

		string RqlRoot = Path.Combine(PluginDirectory, "Source", "ThirdParty", "RQL");
		PrivateIncludePaths.Add(Path.Combine(RqlRoot, "include"));
		PrivateIncludePaths.Add(RqlRoot); // the vendor wrappers include "src/<file>.cpp"
		// The runtime module's private headers (Tools/UnrealMcpObjectRef.h, Tools/UnrealMcpLogCollector.h): the types
		// are UNREALMCPRUNTIME_API-exported, this only opens the include path (same as UnrealMcpEditor).
		PrivateIncludePaths.Add(Path.Combine(ModuleDirectory, "..", "UnrealMcpRuntime", "Private"));

		PublicDependencyModuleNames.AddRange(new string[]
		{
			"Core",
			"CoreUObject",
			"Engine",
			"UnrealMcpRuntime",
		});

		PrivateDependencyModuleNames.AddRange(new string[]
		{
			"Json",
			"Projects", // IPluginManager: UnrealMcpRql::PluginVersion
			"UnrealEd",
			"AssetRegistry",
			"AssetTools",
			"MaterialEditor",
			"EditorScriptingUtilities",

			// gameplay tags (GameplayTags; the tag ini editing of the GameplayTagsEditor plugin), Project Settings
			// sections (Settings; SettingsEditor registers the auto-discovered UDeveloperSettings ones), Blueprint graphs (BlueprintGraph / Kismet: K2 nodes, schema, compile), UMG widget trees
			// (UMG) and Level Sequences (LevelSequence / MovieScene / MovieSceneTracks).
```
