```ts
  createUnrealSession,
  openEditorSession,
  EDITOR_QUIT_TOOL,
  readSessionLease,
  resolveSessionConnection,
  sessionEditorEnv,
} from '../src/lib/session.js';
import { readCode } from '../src/commands/exec.js';
import { PLUGIN_CONFIG_RELATIVE_PATH, resolveConnection } from '../src/utils/config.js';
import { generatePortFromDirectory } from '../src/utils/port.js';
import type { RunToolOptions, RunToolResult } from '../src/lib/types.js';
import { makeTempDir, rmTempDir, writeUProject } from './helpers.js';

const dirs: string[] = [];
afterEach(() => {
  while (dirs.length) rmTempDir(dirs.pop()!);
});

function project(): string {
  const dir = makeTempDir();
  dirs.push(dir);
  writeUProject(dir, 'Game');
  return dir;
}

/**
 * A fake process table: `spawnDetached` adds an editor that becomes "ready" after `readyAfterProbes` readiness
 * probes; `requestClose` / `forceKill` remove it.
 */
function fakeEditors(readyAfterProbes = 1) {
  const alive = new Set<number>();
  const spawned: Array<{ command: string; args: readonly string[]; env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv; hideWindow: boolean }> = [];
  let nextPid = 1000;
  let probes = 0;
  const ops: Partial<SessionProcessOps> = {
    spawnDetached: async (command, args, options) => {
      spawned.push({ command, args, env: options.env, hideWindow: options.hideWindow });
      const pid = nextPid++;
      alive.add(pid);
      return pid;
    },
    isAlive: (pid) => alive.has(pid),
    processStart: async (pid) => (alive.has(pid) ? `start-${pid}` : undefined),
    requestClose: async (pid) => alive.delete(pid),
    forceKill: async (pid) => alive.delete(pid),
    sleep: async () => {},
  };
  const probeReady = async (): Promise<string | undefined> => {
    if (alive.size === 0) return undefined;
    probes += 1;
    return probes >= readyAfterProbes ? 'http://localhost:5199' : undefined;
  };
  return { ops, probeReady, spawned, alive };
}

function okTool(data: unknown = { status: 'success', structured: { success: true, value: '3', logs: [] } }) {
  return vi.fn(async (_options: RunToolOptions): Promise<RunToolResult> => ({
    kind: 'success', success: true, endpoint: 'x', httpStatus: 200, data,
  }));
}

const CONNECTION = { url: 'http://localhost:5199', connectionMode: 'Custom' as const };
const noBuild = async (): Promise<void> => {};

/** Session seams of a cold project: the fake process table, no build, no editor of the user's. */
function coldSeams(editors: ReturnType<typeof fakeEditors>) {
  return { probeReady: editors.probeReady, processOps: editors.ops, editorBinary: 'UnrealEditor.exe', beforeLaunch: noBuild, listProcessesImpl: () => [] };
}

/** An editor the user opened on the project (pid 42, alive). */
function userEditor(dir: string, editors: ReturnType<typeof fakeEditors>) {
  editors.alive.add(42);
  return () => [{ pid: 42, commandLine: `"C:/UE/UnrealEditor.exe" "${path.join(dir, 'Game.uproject')}"` }];
}

describe('DEFAULT_EXEC_TIMEOUT_MS', () => {
  it('outlasts the server tool-timeout for the default editor tool timeout (300000 + 10000 margin)', () => {
    expect(DEFAULT_EXEC_TIMEOUT_MS).toBeGreaterThan(310_000);
  });
});

describe('execPython', () => {
  it('reuses a running editor without launching one', async () => {
    const dir = project();
    const editors = fakeEditors();
    const invoke = okTool();
    const result = await execPython({
      projectDir: dir,
      code: '1 + 2',
      url: CONNECTION.url,
      invoke,
      sessionOptions: { probeReady: async () => 'http://localhost:5199', processOps: editors.ops, editorBinary: 'UnrealEditor.exe', beforeLaunch: noBuild },
    });
    expect(result.kind).toBe('success');
    if (result.kind === 'success') expect(result.source).toBe('running');
    expect(editors.spawned).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(invoke).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.objectContaining({
      toolName: PYTHON_EXECUTE_TOOL, url: 'http://localhost:5199', input: { code: '1 + 2' },
    }));
  });

  it('starts a headless editor with -RenderOffscreen, the session env and a local server, then runs the code', async () => {
    const dir = project();
    const editors = fakeEditors(2);
    const invoke = okTool();
    const result = await execPython({
      projectDir: dir,
      code: 'print(1)',
      include: ['helpers'],
      url: CONNECTION.url,
      idleSeconds: 120,
      invoke,
      sessionOptions: coldSeams(editors),
    });
    expect(result.kind).toBe('success');
    if (result.kind === 'success') expect(result.source).toBe('started');
    expect(editors.spawned).toHaveLength(1);
    const [launch] = editors.spawned;
    expect(launch!.command).toBe('UnrealEditor.exe');
    expect(launch!.args).toEqual([path.join(dir, 'Game.uproject'), '-RenderOffscreen', '-unattended', '-nosplash']);
    expect(launch!.hideWindow).toBe(true);
    expect(launch!.env).toMatchObject({
      AIGD_SESSION_IDLE_SECONDS: '120',
      AIGD_SESSION_OWNER: 'cli',
      UNREAL_MCP_CONNECTION_MODE: 'Custom',
      UNREAL_MCP_HOST: 'http://localhost:5199',
      UNREAL_MCP_START_SERVER: 'true',
      UNREAL_MCP_TRANSPORT: 'http',
    });
    const lease = readSessionLease(dir);
    expect(lease).toMatchObject({ pid: 1000, mode: 'headless', engine: 'unreal', ownedBy: 'cli' });
    expect(launch!.env['AIGD_SESSION_NONCE']).toBe(lease!.nonce);
    expect(invoke).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.objectContaining({ input: { code: 'print(1)', include: ['helpers'] } }));
  });

  it('starts a windowed editor with --window', async () => {
    const dir = project();
    const editors = fakeEditors();
    await execPython({
      projectDir: dir,
      code: '1',
      url: CONNECTION.url,
      window: true,
      invoke: okTool(),
      sessionOptions: coldSeams(editors),
    });
    expect(editors.spawned[0]!.args).toEqual([path.join(dir, 'Game.uproject')]);
    expect(editors.spawned[0]!.hideWindow).toBe(false);
    expect(readSessionLease(dir)?.mode).toBe('window');
  });

  it('launches one editor for two parallel cold calls', async () => {
    const dir = project();
    const editors = fakeEditors(3);
    const run = () => execPython({
      projectDir: dir,
      code: '1',
      url: CONNECTION.url,
      invoke: okTool(),
      sessionOptions: coldSeams(editors),
    });
    const results = await Promise.all([run(), run()]);
    expect(results.map((r) => r.kind)).toEqual(['success', 'success']);
    expect(editors.spawned).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(results.map((r) => (r.kind === 'success' ? r.source : r.reason)).sort()).toEqual(['owned', 'started']);
  });

  it('waits for an editor the user is opening instead of starting a second one', async () => {
    const dir = project();
    let probes = 0;
    const editors = fakeEditors();
    const result = await execPython({
      projectDir: dir,
      code: '1',
      url: CONNECTION.url,
      invoke: okTool(),
      sessionOptions: {
        probeReady: async () => (++probes >= 3 ? 'http://localhost:5199' : undefined),
        processOps: editors.ops,
        editorBinary: 'UnrealEditor.exe', beforeLaunch: noBuild,
        listProcessesImpl: userEditor(dir, editors),
      },
    });
    expect(result.kind).toBe('success');
    if (result.kind === 'success') expect(result.source).toBe('foreign');
    expect(editors.spawned).toHaveLength(0);
  });

  it('reports a session failure when the editor exits before it is ready', async () => {
    const dir = project();
    const editors = fakeEditors(Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY);
    editors.ops.spawnDetached = async () => 7; // never alive
    const result = await execPython({
      projectDir: dir,
      code: '1',
      url: CONNECTION.url,
      invoke: okTool(),
      sessionOptions: coldSeams(editors),
    });
    expect(result).toMatchObject({ kind: 'failure', reason: 'session', sessionReason: 'exited' });
    expect(readSessionLease(dir)).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it('runs the pre-launch build once, under the startup lock, for two parallel cold calls', async () => {
    const dir = project();
    const editors = fakeEditors(3);
    let builds = 0;
    let building = false;
    const build = async (): Promise<void> => {
      expect(building).toBe(false);
      building = true;
      builds += 1;
      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 50));
      building = false;
    };
    const run = () => execPython({
      projectDir: dir,
      code: '1',
      url: CONNECTION.url,
      invoke: okTool(),
      sessionOptions: { ...coldSeams(editors), beforeLaunch: build },
    });
    const results = await Promise.all([run(), run()]);
    expect(results.map((r) => r.kind)).toEqual(['success', 'success']);
    expect(builds).toBe(1);
    expect(editors.spawned).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  it('does not launch when the pre-launch build fails', async () => {
    const dir = project();
    const editors = fakeEditors();
    const result = await execPython({
      projectDir: dir,
      code: '1',
      url: CONNECTION.url,
      invoke: okTool(),
      sessionOptions: {
        probeReady: editors.probeReady, processOps: editors.ops, editorBinary: 'UnrealEditor.exe', listProcessesImpl: () => [],
        beforeLaunch: async () => { throw new Error('Pre-launch build failed: UBT exited with code 6'); },
      },
    });
    expect(result).toMatchObject({ kind: 'failure', reason: 'session' });
    expect(result.kind === 'failure' && result.message).toMatch(/Pre-launch build failed/);
    expect(editors.spawned).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(readSessionLease(dir)).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it('records the server URL and connection mode in the lease and keeps the session files out of git', async () => {
    const dir = project();
    const editors = fakeEditors();
    await execPython({
      projectDir: dir,
      code: '1',
      url: 'http://127.0.0.1:5188',
      invoke: okTool(),
      sessionOptions: coldSeams(editors),
    });
    expect(readSessionLease(dir)).toMatchObject({ serverUrl: 'http://127.0.0.1:5188', connectionMode: 'Custom' });
    const gitignore = fs.readFileSync(path.join(dir, '.ai-game-dev', '.gitignore'), 'utf-8');
    expect(gitignore).toMatch(/session\.json/);
  });

  it('fails fast when an editor the user opened never answers on the local server (e.g. Cloud mode)', async () => {
    const dir = project();
    const editors = fakeEditors();
    const started = Date.now();
    const result = await execPython({
      projectDir: dir,
      code: '1',
      url: CONNECTION.url,
      invoke: okTool(),
      sessionOptions: {
        probeReady: async () => undefined,
        processOps: editors.ops,
        editorBinary: 'UnrealEditor.exe',
        beforeLaunch: noBuild,
        foreignReadyTimeoutMs: 50,
        listProcessesImpl: userEditor(dir, editors),
      },
    });
    expect(Date.now() - started).toBeLessThan(5_000);
    expect(result).toMatchObject({ kind: 'failure', reason: 'session', sessionReason: 'not-ready', sessionSource: 'foreign' });
    expect(result.kind === 'failure' && result.message).toMatch(/not started by the CLI[\s\S]*Cloud mode/);
    expect(editors.spawned).toHaveLength(0);
  });

  it('never probes the server of a stale lease (its URL may now serve another project)', async () => {
    const dir = project();
    const editors = fakeEditors();
    fs.mkdirSync(path.join(dir, '.ai-game-dev'), { recursive: true });
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, '.ai-game-dev', 'session.json'), JSON.stringify({
      pid: 999, nonce: 'stale', engine: 'unreal', mode: 'headless', startedAt: new Date().toISOString(), ownedBy: 'cli',
      hostId: os.hostname(), processStart: 'start-999', serverUrl: 'http://127.0.0.1:5999',
    }));
    const pinged: string[] = [];
    const fetchImpl = (async (input: string | URL | Request) => {
      const url = String(input);
      pinged.push(url);
      const up = url.startsWith('http://127.0.0.1:5999') || editors.alive.size > 0;
      return new Response('{}', { status: up ? 200 : 503 });
    }) as typeof fetch;
    const invoke = okTool();
    const result = await execPython({
      projectDir: dir,
      code: '1',
      url: CONNECTION.url,
      invoke,
      sessionOptions: { ...coldSeams(editors), probeReady: undefined, fetchImpl },
    });
    expect(result).toMatchObject({ kind: 'success', source: 'started', baseUrl: CONNECTION.url });
    expect(pinged.some((url) => url.includes(':5999'))).toBe(false);
    expect(invoke).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.objectContaining({ url: CONNECTION.url }));
  });

  it('reaches a live CLI-owned editor on the server its lease names', async () => {
    const dir = project();
    const editors = fakeEditors();
    const fetchImpl = (async (input: string | URL | Request) =>
      new Response('{}', { status: String(input).startsWith('http://127.0.0.1:5177') && editors.alive.size > 0 ? 200 : 503 })) as typeof fetch;
    const first = await execPython({
      projectDir: dir, code: '1', url: 'http://127.0.0.1:5177', invoke: okTool(),
      sessionOptions: { ...coldSeams(editors), probeReady: undefined, fetchImpl },
    });
    expect(first).toMatchObject({ kind: 'success', source: 'started' });
    const second = await execPython({
      projectDir: dir, code: '1', url: CONNECTION.url, invoke: okTool(),
      sessionOptions: { ...coldSeams(editors), probeReady: undefined, fetchImpl },
    });
    expect(second).toMatchObject({ kind: 'success', source: 'running', baseUrl: 'http://127.0.0.1:5177' });
    expect(editors.spawned).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  it('ignores a cached editor listing whose editor has quit', async () => {
    const dir = project();
    const editors = fakeEditors();
    const result = await execPython({
      projectDir: dir,
      code: '1',
      url: CONNECTION.url,
      invoke: okTool(),
      sessionOptions: {
        ...coldSeams(editors),
        listProcessesImpl: () => [{ pid: 43, commandLine: `"C:/UE/UnrealEditor.exe" "${path.join(dir, 'Game.uproject')}"` }],
      },
    });
    expect(result).toMatchObject({ kind: 'success', source: 'started' });
  });

  it('retries while a fresh editor has not initialized Python yet, but not a running one', async () => {
    const notYet = { kind: 'failure', success: false, endpoint: 'x', reason: 'http-error', httpStatus: 500, message: 'Internal Server Error',
      data: { error: 'NotAvailable: Python is not available in this editor (PythonScriptPlugin disabled or failed to start).' } } as RunToolResult;
    const ok: RunToolResult = { kind: 'success', success: true, endpoint: 'x', httpStatus: 200, data: { status: 'success', structured: { success: true, value: '3', logs: [] } } };
    const flaky = () => vi.fn<(o: RunToolOptions) => Promise<RunToolResult>>().mockResolvedValueOnce(notYet).mockResolvedValue(ok);

    const editors = fakeEditors();
    const fresh = flaky();
    const started = await execPython({
      projectDir: project(), code: '1', url: CONNECTION.url, invoke: fresh, sleep: async () => {}, sessionOptions: coldSeams(editors),
    });
    expect(started).toMatchObject({ kind: 'success', source: 'started' });
    expect(fresh).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);

    const running = flaky();
    const warm = await execPython({
      projectDir: project(), code: '1', url: CONNECTION.url, invoke: running, sleep: async () => {},
      sessionOptions: { ...coldSeams(fakeEditors()), probeReady: async () => CONNECTION.url },
    });
    expect(warm).toMatchObject({ kind: 'failure', reason: 'tool-failed' });
    expect(running).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

  it('rejects a remote --url (readiness must probe the local server)', async () => {
    const result = await execPython({ projectDir: project(), code: '1', url: 'https://ai-game.dev/mcp' });
    expect(result).toMatchObject({ kind: 'failure', reason: 'invalid-input' });
  });

  it('fails without a .uproject', async () => {
    const dir = makeTempDir();
    dirs.push(dir);
    expect(await execPython({ projectDir: dir, code: '1' })).toMatchObject({ kind: 'failure', reason: 'invalid-input' });
  });
});

describe('closeOwned (editor-quit)', () => {
  it('asks the plugin to save and quit, proving ownership with the lease nonce', async () => {
    const dir = project();
    const editors = fakeEditors();
    const quit = vi.fn(async (options: RunToolOptions): Promise<RunToolResult> => {
      editors.alive.clear();
      return { kind: 'success', success: true, endpoint: options.toolName, httpStatus: 200, data: { status: 'success' } };
    });
    const session = createUnrealSession({
      projectDir: dir, connection: CONNECTION, probeReady: editors.probeReady, processOps: editors.ops,
      editorBinary: 'UnrealEditor.exe', beforeLaunch: noBuild, listProcessesImpl: () => [], invokeSystemTool: quit,
    });
    await session.ensure();
    const nonce = readSessionLease(dir)!.nonce;
    const requestClose = vi.spyOn(editors.ops, 'requestClose');

    const result = await session.closeOwned({ timeoutMs: 1000 });
    expect(result).toMatchObject({ kind: 'closed', pid: 1000, forced: false });
    expect(quit).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.objectContaining({ toolName: EDITOR_QUIT_TOOL, input: { nonce } }));
    expect(requestClose).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(readSessionLease(dir)).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it('falls back to the OS polite quit when the plugin cannot be reached', async () => {
    const dir = project();
    const editors = fakeEditors();
    const unreachable = vi.fn(async (): Promise<RunToolResult> => ({
      kind: 'failure', success: false, endpoint: 'x', reason: 'connection-refused', message: 'ECONNREFUSED',
    }) as RunToolResult);
    const session = createUnrealSession({
      projectDir: dir, connection: CONNECTION, probeReady: editors.probeReady, processOps: editors.ops,
      editorBinary: 'UnrealEditor.exe', beforeLaunch: noBuild, listProcessesImpl: () => [], invokeSystemTool: unreachable,
    });
    await session.ensure();
    expect(await session.closeOwned({ timeoutMs: 1000 })).toMatchObject({ kind: 'closed' });
    expect(editors.alive.size).toBe(0);
  });

  it('closes without --url: editor-quit goes to the server named by the lease', async () => {
    const dir = project();
    const editors = fakeEditors();
    const quit = vi.fn(async (options: RunToolOptions): Promise<RunToolResult> => {
      editors.alive.clear();
      return { kind: 'success', success: true, endpoint: options.toolName, httpStatus: 200, data: { status: 'success' } };
    });
    const seams = { processOps: editors.ops, listProcessesImpl: () => [], invokeSystemTool: quit };
    const started = await execPython({
      projectDir: dir,
      code: '1',
      url: 'http://127.0.0.1:5177',
      invoke: okTool(),
      sessionOptions: { ...seams, probeReady: editors.probeReady, editorBinary: 'UnrealEditor.exe', beforeLaunch: noBuild },
    });
    expect(started.kind).toBe('success');
    const result = await closeOwnedSession({ projectDir: dir, timeoutMs: 1000, ...seams });
    expect(result).toMatchObject({ kind: 'success', result: { kind: 'closed', pid: 1000 } });
    expect(quit).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.objectContaining({ toolName: EDITOR_QUIT_TOOL, url: 'http://127.0.0.1:5177' }));
  });

  it('falls back to --url for a lease without a server URL (CLI 0.23)', async () => {
    const dir = project();
    const editors = fakeEditors();
    const quit = vi.fn(async (options: RunToolOptions): Promise<RunToolResult> => {
      editors.alive.clear();
      return { kind: 'success', success: true, endpoint: options.toolName, httpStatus: 200, data: { status: 'success' } };
    });
    const pid = await editors.ops.spawnDetached!('UnrealEditor.exe', [], { cwd: dir, env: {}, hideWindow: true });
    fs.mkdirSync(path.join(dir, '.ai-game-dev'), { recursive: true });
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, '.ai-game-dev', 'session.json'), JSON.stringify({
      pid, nonce: 'old', engine: 'unreal', mode: 'headless', startedAt: new Date().toISOString(), ownedBy: 'cli',
      hostId: os.hostname(), processStart: `start-${pid}`,
    }));
    const result = await closeOwnedSession({
      projectDir: dir, url: 'http://127.0.0.1:5166', timeoutMs: 1000, processOps: editors.ops, listProcessesImpl: () => [], invokeSystemTool: quit,
    });
    expect(result).toMatchObject({ kind: 'success', result: { kind: 'closed', pid } });
    expect(quit).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.objectContaining({ url: 'http://127.0.0.1:5166', input: { nonce: 'old' } }));
  });

  it('never touches an editor without our lease', async () => {
    const dir = project();
    const result = await closeOwnedSession({ projectDir: dir });
    expect(result).toMatchObject({ kind: 'success', result: { kind: 'not-owned', staleLeaseRemoved: false } });
  });
});

describe('openEditorSession', () => {
  it('names a Cloud-mode editor the user opened, like exec', async () => {
    const dir = project();
    const editors = fakeEditors();
    const result = await openEditorSession({
      projectDir: dir,
      mode: 'headless',
      url: CONNECTION.url,
      ...coldSeams(editors),
      probeReady: async () => undefined,
      foreignReadyTimeoutMs: 50,
      listProcessesImpl: userEditor(dir, editors),
    });
    expect(result).toMatchObject({ kind: 'failure', reason: 'not-ready', source: 'foreign' });
    expect(result.kind === 'failure' && result.message).toMatch(/not started by the CLI[\s\S]*Cloud mode/);
  });
});

describe('session connection', () => {
  it('keeps a loopback URL and builds the started editor env from it', async () => {
    const dir = project();
    const connection = await resolveSessionConnection(dir, { url: 'http://127.0.0.1:5188/', token: 't' });
    expect(connection).toEqual({ url: 'http://127.0.0.1:5188', token: 't', connectionMode: 'Custom' });
    expect(sessionEditorEnv(connection, 't')).toEqual({
      UNREAL_MCP_CONNECTION_MODE: 'Custom',
      UNREAL_MCP_HOST: 'http://127.0.0.1:5188',
      UNREAL_MCP_TRANSPORT: 'http',
      UNREAL_MCP_START_SERVER: 'true',
      UNREAL_MCP_KEEP_CONNECTED: 'true',
      UNREAL_MCP_TOKEN: 't',
    });
  });

  it('fills in the bound port for a port-less --url', async () => {
    const dir = project();
    const connection = await resolveSessionConnection(dir, { url: 'http://localhost' });
    expect(connection.url).toBe(`http://localhost:${generatePortFromDirectory(dir)}`);
  });

  it('rejects a --url whose port the project portOverride overrules, and follows the override otherwise', async () => {
    const dir = project();
    fs.mkdirSync(path.join(dir, '.ai-game-dev'), { recursive: true });
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, '.ai-game-dev', 'project.json'), JSON.stringify({ portOverride: 27001 }));
    await expect(resolveSessionConnection(dir, { url: 'http://localhost:5199' })).rejects.toThrow(/portOverride/);
    expect((await resolveSessionConnection(dir, { url: 'http://localhost:27001' })).url).toBe('http://localhost:27001');
    expect((await resolveSessionConnection(dir, { url: 'http://localhost' })).url).toBe('http://localhost:27001');
    expect((await resolveSessionConnection(dir)).url).toBe('http://localhost:27001');
  });

  it('uses the deterministic local port for a Cloud-mode project, never the cloud URL or its token', async () => {
    const dir = project();
    const configPath = path.join(dir, PLUGIN_CONFIG_RELATIVE_PATH);
    fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(configPath), { recursive: true });
    fs.writeFileSync(configPath, JSON.stringify({ connectionMode: 'Cloud', cloudUrl: 'https://ai-game.dev', cloudToken: 'cloud-secret' }));
    expect((await resolveConnection({ projectDir: dir, processEnv: {} })).url).toBe('https://ai-game.dev/mcp'); // the fixture is live
    const connection = await resolveSessionConnection(dir);
    expect(connection.url).toMatch(/^http:\/\/localhost:\d+$/);
    expect(connection.token).toBeUndefined();
  });
});

describe('readPythonResponse', () => {
  it('returns the value and the logs of a success', () => {
    expect(readPythonResponse({
      status: 'success',
      structured: { success: true, value: '3', logs: [{ level: 'info', message: 'hi' }] },
    })).toEqual({ ok: true, value: '3', logs: [{ level: 'info', message: 'hi' }] });
  });

  it('returns the error text of a failure', () => {
    expect(readPythonResponse({ status: 'error', content: [{ type: 'text', text: 'RuntimeError: boom' }] }))
      .toEqual({ ok: false, value: 'RuntimeError: boom', logs: [] });
  });

  it('prints null for a statement without a value', () => {
    expect(readPythonResponse({ status: 'success', structured: { success: true, logs: [] } }).value).toBe('null');
  });
});

describe('readCode', () => {
  const tty = { isTTY: true, read: () => '' };

  it('takes the argument', () => {
    expect(readCode('1 + 2', undefined, tty)).toBe('1 + 2');
  });

  it('reads a file and stdin', () => {
    const dir = makeTempDir();
    dirs.push(dir);
    const file = path.join(dir, 'a.py');
    fs.writeFileSync(file, 'x = 1\nx');
    expect(readCode(undefined, file, tty)).toBe('x = 1\nx');
    expect(readCode(undefined, '-', { isTTY: true, read: () => 'piped' })).toBe('piped');
    expect(readCode(undefined, undefined, { isTTY: false, read: () => 'piped' })).toBe('piped');
  });

  it('rejects both, none and empty input', () => {
    expect(() => readCode('1', 'a.py', tty)).toThrow(/not both/);
    expect(() => readCode(undefined, undefined, tty)).toThrow(/No code given/);
    expect(() => readCode(undefined, undefined, { isTTY: false, read: () => '  ' })).toThrow(/stdin/);
  });
});

describe('toolErrorText', () => {
  it('prefers the error the server returned for a failed tool', () => {
    const failure = { kind: 'failure', success: false, endpoint: 'x', reason: 'http-error', httpStatus: 500, message: 'Internal Server Error' } as const;
    expect(toolErrorText({ ...failure, data: { error: 'Runtime: ZeroDivisionError: division by zero' } })).toBe('Runtime: ZeroDivisionError: division by zero');
    expect(toolErrorText(failure)).toBe('Internal Server Error');
  });
});
```

`cli/tests/extensions-catalog-parity.test.ts`:

```ts
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as path from 'path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'url';
import {
  EXTENSIONS_CATALOG,
  EXTENSION_CATALOG_SCHEMA_VERSION,
  type ExtensionDescriptor,
} from '../src/utils/extensions-catalog.js';

// The CLI's EXTENSIONS_CATALOG mirror MUST stay value-equivalent to the SHARED source of
// truth `cli/extensions.catalog.json` (the future in-editor extensions panel / app reads the
// same JSON). If the catalog gains/changes an entry, this test fails until the mirror is
// updated — the drift tripwire that keeps the CLI + panel + app from diverging. Same
// discipline as godot-cli's `extensions-catalog-parity.test.ts`.
const __dirname = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
const CATALOG_JSON = path.resolve(__dirname, '..', 'extensions.catalog.json');

interface CatalogJsonTool {
  name?: string;
  description?: string;
}

interface CatalogJsonEntry {
  extensionId?: string;
  name?: string;
  description?: string;
  pluginName?: string;
  repo?: string | null;
  version?: string | null;
  minCoreVersion?: string | null;
  enginePlugins?: string[];
  tools?: CatalogJsonTool[];
}

/** Trim a string-or-null-or-absent field to a non-empty string, else null (mirrors the descriptor's nullable fields). */
function trimOrNull(v: string | null | undefined): string | null {
  if (v === undefined || v === null) return null;
  const s = String(v).trim();
  return s === '' ? null : s;
}

/** Normalize a raw JSON entry to the canonical ExtensionDescriptor shape. */
function normalizeJsonEntry(e: CatalogJsonEntry): ExtensionDescriptor {
  return {
    extensionId: (e.extensionId ?? '').trim(),
    name: (e.name ?? '').trim(),
    description: (e.description ?? '').trim(),
    pluginName: (e.pluginName ?? '').trim(),
    repo: trimOrNull(e.repo),
    version: trimOrNull(e.version),
    minCoreVersion: trimOrNull(e.minCoreVersion),
    enginePlugins: (e.enginePlugins ?? []).map((p) => p.trim()).filter((p) => p !== ''),
    tools: (e.tools ?? [])
      .filter((t) => t.name && t.name.trim() !== '')
      .map((t) => ({ name: (t.name ?? '').trim(), description: (t.description ?? '').trim() })),
  };
}

describe('extensions-catalog parity with cli/extensions.catalog.json', () => {
  it('the catalog JSON is reachable from the test (relative layout sanity)', () => {
    expect(fs.existsSync(CATALOG_JSON)).toBe(true);
  });

  it('the JSON schemaVersion matches the TS mirror constant', () => {
    const raw = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(CATALOG_JSON, 'utf-8')) as { schemaVersion?: number };
    expect(raw.schemaVersion).toBe(EXTENSION_CATALOG_SCHEMA_VERSION);
  });

  it('the TS mirror EXTENSIONS_CATALOG matches the JSON source of truth exactly', () => {
    const raw = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(CATALOG_JSON, 'utf-8')) as {
      extensions?: CatalogJsonEntry[];
    };
    const expected = (raw.extensions ?? [])
      .filter(
        (e) =>
          e.extensionId && e.extensionId.trim() !== '' && e.pluginName && e.pluginName.trim() !== '',
      )
      .map(normalizeJsonEntry);

    // Compare as plain objects (EXTENSIONS_CATALOG is readonly; spread to mutable for deep-equal).
    const actual = EXTENSIONS_CATALOG.map((d) => ({
      extensionId: d.extensionId,
      name: d.name,
      description: d.description,
      pluginName: d.pluginName,
      repo: d.repo,
      version: d.version,
      minCoreVersion: d.minCoreVersion,
      enginePlugins: [...d.enginePlugins],
      tools: d.tools.map((t) => ({ name: t.name, description: t.description })),
    }));

    expect(
      actual,
      'cli/src/utils/extensions-catalog.ts drifted from cli/extensions.catalog.json. ' +
        'Update EXTENSIONS_CATALOG to match the JSON source of truth.',
    ).toEqual(expected);
  });
});
```

```ts
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import * as fs from 'node:fs';
import * as path from 'node:path';
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import { zipSync } from 'fflate';
import { makeTempDir, rmTempDir, writeUProject } from './helpers.js';
import { EXTENSIONS_INDEX_URL, loadExtensionsIndex, parseExtensionsIndex } from '../src/utils/extensions-index.js';
import { installExtension } from '../src/lib/install-extension.js';

const dirs: string[] = [];
function temp() { const d = makeTempDir(); dirs.push(d); return d; }
afterEach(() => { while (dirs.length) rmTempDir(dirs.pop()!); });

function fixture() {
  return { schemaVersion: 1, extensions: [{
    extensionId: 'com.test.new-extension', name: 'New Tools', description: 'Newly published',
    pluginName: 'UnrealAINew', repo: 'IvanMurzak/Unreal-MCP', version: '1.2.0',
    minCoreVersion: '0.20.2', enginePlugins: ['Niagara'], tools: [],
    releases: {
      '1.1.0': { repo: 'IvanMurzak/Unreal-MCP', tag: 'new-v1.1.0' },
      '1.2.0': { repo: 'IvanMurzak/Unreal-MCP', tag: 'new-v1.2.0' },
    },
  }] };
}

function online(index: object, archiveVersion?: string) {
  const requests: string[] = [];
  const fetchImpl = (async (input: string | URL | Request) => {
    const url = String(input);
    requests.push(url);
    if (url === EXTENSIONS_INDEX_URL) return new Response(JSON.stringify(index));
    const m = /\/new-v([\d.]+)\/UnrealAINew-([\d.]+)\.zip$/.exec(url);
    if (!m || m[1] !== m[2]) return new Response('', { status: 404 });
    const bytes = zipSync({
      'UnrealAINew/UnrealAINew.uplugin': new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify({ FileVersion: 3, VersionName: archiveVersion ?? m[1] })),
      'UnrealAINew/Source/marker.cpp': new TextEncoder().encode('// installed'),
    });
    return new Response(bytes as unknown as BodyInit);
  }) as typeof fetch;
  return { requests, fetchImpl };
}

describe('independent component index', () => {
  it('installs a newly added extension without a CLI/catalog release and never asks for repository latest', async () => {
    const project = temp(); writeUProject(project, 'Game', '5.8');
    const github = online(fixture());
    const result = await installExtension({ projectDir: project, extensionId: 'UnrealAINew',
      fetchImpl: github.fetchImpl, indexCachePath: path.join(temp(), 'index.json') });
    expect(result.kind).toBe('success');
    if (result.kind !== 'success') throw result.error;
    expect(result.toVersion).toBe('1.2.0');
    expect(result.versionSource).toBe('index');
    expect(fs.existsSync(path.join(project, 'Plugins/UnrealAINew/Source/marker.cpp'))).toBe(true);
    expect(github.requests).toEqual([EXTENSIONS_INDEX_URL,
      'https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Unreal-MCP/releases/download/new-v1.2.0/UnrealAINew-1.2.0.zip']);
  });

  it('installs an explicit older version from its own historical tag', async () => {
    const project = temp(); writeUProject(project, 'Game', '5.8');
    const github = online(fixture());
    const result = await installExtension({ projectDir: project, extensionId: 'UnrealAINew', version: '1.1.0',
      fetchImpl: github.fetchImpl, indexCachePath: path.join(temp(), 'index.json') });
    expect(result.kind === 'success' && result.toVersion).toBe('1.1.0');
    expect(github.requests[1]).toContain('/new-v1.1.0/');
  });

  it('uses the selected historical version dependencies instead of latest dependencies', async () => {
    const project = temp(); writeUProject(project, 'Game', '5.8');
    const index = fixture();
    Object.assign(index.extensions[0].releases['1.1.0'], { enginePlugins: [], minCoreVersion: null });
    const result = await installExtension({ projectDir: project, extensionId: 'UnrealAINew', version: '1.1.0',
      fetchImpl: online(index).fetchImpl, indexCachePath: path.join(temp(), 'index.json') });
    expect(result.kind).toBe('success');
    const plugins = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(project, 'Game.uproject'), 'utf8')).Plugins;
    expect(plugins.some((p: { Name: string }) => p.Name === 'Niagara')).toBe(false);
  });

  it('rejects a wrong archive version before replacing the installed plugin', async () => {
    const project = temp(); writeUProject(project, 'Game', '5.8');
    const installed = path.join(project, 'Plugins/UnrealAINew'); fs.mkdirSync(installed, { recursive: true });
    const descriptor = path.join(installed, 'UnrealAINew.uplugin');
    fs.writeFileSync(descriptor, JSON.stringify({ VersionName: '1.1.0' }));
    const result = await installExtension({ projectDir: project, extensionId: 'UnrealAINew',
      fetchImpl: online(fixture(), '9.9.9').fetchImpl, indexCachePath: path.join(temp(), 'index.json') });
    expect(result.kind).toBe('failure');
    expect(JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(descriptor, 'utf8')).VersionName).toBe('1.1.0');
  });

  it('rejects an unpublished explicit version without downloading another asset', async () => {
    const project = temp(); writeUProject(project, 'Game', '5.8');
    const github = online(fixture());
    const result = await installExtension({ projectDir: project, extensionId: 'UnrealAINew', version: '9.0.0',
      fetchImpl: github.fetchImpl, indexCachePath: path.join(temp(), 'index.json') });
    expect(result.kind).toBe('failure');
    expect(github.requests).toEqual([EXTENSIONS_INDEX_URL]);
  });

  it('keeps an installed newer version even with --force', async () => {
    const project = temp(); writeUProject(project, 'Game', '5.8');
    const installed = path.join(project, 'Plugins/UnrealAINew'); fs.mkdirSync(installed, { recursive: true });
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(installed, 'UnrealAINew.uplugin'), JSON.stringify({ VersionName: '2.0.0' }));
    const github = online(fixture());
    const result = await installExtension({ projectDir: project, extensionId: 'UnrealAINew', force: true,
      fetchImpl: github.fetchImpl, indexCachePath: path.join(temp(), 'index.json') });
    expect(result.kind === 'success' && result.versionSource).toBe('installed');
    expect(github.requests).toEqual([EXTENSIONS_INDEX_URL]);
  });

  it('uses a validated cache with a visible stale-version warning', async () => {
    const cachePath = path.join(temp(), 'index.json');
    await loadExtensionsIndex({ cachePath, fetchImpl: online(fixture()).fetchImpl });
    const result = await loadExtensionsIndex({ cachePath, fetchImpl: (async () => { throw new Error('offline'); }) as typeof fetch });
    expect(result.index?.extensions[0].version).toBe('1.2.0');
    expect(result.warning).toContain('Newer releases may exist');
  });

  it('does not poison a good cache with an invalid response', async () => {
    const cachePath = path.join(temp(), 'index.json');
    const fetchImpl = online(fixture()).fetchImpl;
    await loadExtensionsIndex({ cachePath, fetchImpl });
    const result = await loadExtensionsIndex({ cachePath, fetchImpl: online({ schemaVersion: 999 }).fetchImpl });
    expect(result.index?.extensions).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(cachePath, 'utf8')).schemaVersion).toBe(1);
  });

  it('checks the archive hash before changing an existing installation', async () => {
    const project = temp(); writeUProject(project, 'Game', '5.8');
    const index = fixture();
    Object.assign(index.extensions[0].releases['1.2.0'], { sha256: createHash('sha256').update('wrong').digest('hex') });
    const installed = path.join(project, 'Plugins/UnrealAINew'); fs.mkdirSync(installed, { recursive: true });
    const descriptor = path.join(installed, 'UnrealAINew.uplugin');
    fs.writeFileSync(descriptor, JSON.stringify({ VersionName: '1.1.0' }));
    const before = fs.readFileSync(descriptor, 'utf8');
    const result = await installExtension({ projectDir: project, extensionId: 'UnrealAINew',
      fetchImpl: online(index).fetchImpl, indexCachePath: path.join(temp(), 'index.json') });
    expect(result.kind).toBe('failure');
    expect(fs.readFileSync(descriptor, 'utf8')).toBe(before);
  });

  it.each(['../Escape', 'Bad/Name', 'C:Drive'])('rejects unsafe plugin name %s', pluginName => {
    const index = fixture(); index.extensions[0].pluginName = pluginName;
    expect(() => parseExtensionsIndex(index)).toThrow();
  });

  it('rejects duplicate identities and foreign release repositories', () => {
    const duplicate = fixture(); duplicate.extensions.push(duplicate.extensions[0]);
    expect(() => parseExtensionsIndex(duplicate)).toThrow();
    const foreign = fixture(); foreign.extensions[0].releases['1.1.0'].repo = 'attacker/Unreal-MCP';
    expect(() => parseExtensionsIndex(foreign)).toThrow();
  });
});
```

`cli/tests/helpers.ts`:

```ts
import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as os from 'os';
import * as path from 'path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'url';

const HERE = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));

/** Create a unique temp directory and return its absolute path. */
export function makeTempDir(prefix = 'unreal-mcp-cli-test-'): string {
  return fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), prefix));
}

/** Remove a temp directory tree (best-effort). */
export function rmTempDir(dir: string): void {
  try {
    fs.rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true });
  } catch {
    /* ignore */
  }
}

/** Write a minimal `.uproject` into `dir` and return its path. */
export function writeUProject(dir: string, name: string, engineAssociation = '5.7'): string {
  fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
  const file = path.join(dir, `${name}.uproject`);
  fs.writeFileSync(
    file,
    JSON.stringify(
      {
        FileVersion: 3,
        EngineAssociation: engineAssociation,
        Modules: [{ Name: name, Type: 'Runtime', LoadingPhase: 'Default' }],
      },
      null,
      '\t',
    ),
    'utf-8',
  );
  return file;
}

/** Absolute path to the committed LauncherInstalled.dat fixture. */
export function launcherFixturePath(): string {
  return path.resolve(HERE, 'fixtures', 'LauncherInstalled.dat');
}

/** A `Response`-like stub for injecting into `fetchImpl`. */
export function fakeResponse(opts: { ok: boolean; status: number; body?: string; statusText?: string }): Response {
  return {
    ok: opts.ok,
    status: opts.status,
    statusText: opts.statusText ?? '',
    text: async () => opts.body ?? '',
    json: async () => JSON.parse(opts.body ?? '{}'),
  } as unknown as Response;
}
```

`cli/tests/install-engine.test.ts`:

```ts
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { detectInstalledEngines, planEngineInstall, launcherInstallUrl } from '../src/lib/install-engine.js';
import type { EngineInstallation } from '../src/utils/launcher.js';
import { launcherFixturePath } from './helpers.js';

// Stub a common-location-scan engine. `scanImpl: () => []` isolates the manifest;
// a populated stub exercises the manifest ∪ scan union (an engine on disk that the
// launcher manifest does not list — e.g. a freshly-installed or source/custom build).
const eng = (assoc: string, loc: string): EngineInstallation => ({
  appName: `UE_${assoc}`,
  appVersion: assoc,
  installLocation: loc,
  engineAssociation: assoc,
});

describe('detectInstalledEngines (fixture)', () => {
  it('detects the engines from the manifest', () => {
    const r = detectInstalledEngines({ manifestPath: launcherFixturePath(), scanImpl: () => [] });
    expect(r.success).toBe(true);
    expect(r.engines.map((e) => e.engineAssociation).sort()).toEqual(['5.5', '5.7']);
  });

  it('returns [] for a missing manifest (no throw)', () => {
    const r = detectInstalledEngines({ manifestPath: '/no/such/file.dat', scanImpl: () => [] });
    expect(r.engines).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('unions the common-location scan with the manifest (engine on disk but not in the manifest)', () => {
    const r = detectInstalledEngines({
      manifestPath: launcherFixturePath(),
      os: 'win32',
      scanImpl: () => [eng('5.8', 'C:\\Program Files\\Epic Games\\UE_5.8')],
    });
    expect(r.engines.map((e) => e.engineAssociation).sort()).toEqual(['5.5', '5.7', '5.8']);
  });

  it('dedups a scanned engine that matches a manifest entry by install location', () => {
    // The fixture lists 5.7; a scan that re-finds the SAME install path must not duplicate it.
    const r0 = detectInstalledEngines({ manifestPath: launcherFixturePath(), scanImpl: () => [] });
    const loc57 = r0.engines.find((e) => e.engineAssociation === '5.7')!.installLocation;
    const r = detectInstalledEngines({
      manifestPath: launcherFixturePath(),
      os: 'win32',
      scanImpl: () => [eng('5.7', loc57.toUpperCase())], // case-insensitive on win32
    });
    expect(r.engines.filter((e) => e.engineAssociation === '5.7')).toHaveLength(1);
  });
});

describe('planEngineInstall', () => {
  it('reports alreadyInstalled for a present version', () => {
    const r = planEngineInstall({ version: '5.7', manifestPath: launcherFixturePath(), scanImpl: () => [] });
    expect(r.alreadyInstalled).toBe(true);
    expect(r.installation?.installLocation).toContain('UE_5.7');
    expect(r.message).toContain('already installed');
  });

  it('finds a version present only via the common-location scan (manifest lag)', () => {
    const r = planEngineInstall({
      version: '5.8',
      manifestPath: launcherFixturePath(), // fixture has no 5.8
      os: 'win32',
      scanImpl: () => [eng('5.8', 'C:\\Program Files\\Epic Games\\UE_5.8')],
    });
    expect(r.alreadyInstalled).toBe(true);
    expect(r.installation?.engineAssociation).toBe('5.8');
    expect(r.message).toContain('already installed');
  });

  it('delegates to the Epic launcher for a missing version (never installs)', () => {
    const r = planEngineInstall({ version: '5.9', manifestPath: launcherFixturePath(), scanImpl: () => [] });
    expect(r.alreadyInstalled).toBe(false);
    expect(r.installation).toBeNull();
    expect(r.launcherUrl).toContain('com.epicgames.launcher://');
    expect(r.message).toContain('does not download engines');
  });
});

describe('launcherInstallUrl', () => {
  it('builds the plain, known-good Unreal Engine launcher deep link', () => {
    expect(launcherInstallUrl()).toBe('com.epicgames.launcher://ue/');
  });
});
```

`cli/tests/install-extension.test.ts`:

```ts
import { describe, it, expect, afterEach } from 'vitest';
import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as path from 'path';
import { zipSync } from 'fflate';
import { installExtension } from '../src/lib/install-extension.js';
import {
  EXTENSIONS_CATALOG,
  findExtension,
  hasVersion,
  unknownExtensionMessage,
  type ExtensionDescriptor,
} from '../src/utils/extensions-catalog.js';
import {
  resolveInstallSource,
  extensionDownloadUrl,
  extensionAssetName,
  releaseTag,
  stripLeadingV,
  assertTrustedDownloadUrl,
  parsePlainReleaseTag,
  resolveLatestExtensionVersion,
} from '../src/utils/extension-source.js';
import {
  parseUPluginDependencies,
  readUPluginVersionName,
  enablePluginsInUProject,
} from '../src/utils/uproject-plugins.js';
import { makeTempDir, rmTempDir, writeUProject } from './helpers.js';
import type { ExtensionBuildStep } from '../src/lib/types.js';

const dirs: string[] = [];
afterEach(() => {
  while (dirs.length) rmTempDir(dirs.pop()!);
});
function tmp(): string {
  const d = makeTempDir();
  dirs.push(d);
  return d;
}

/** Build a local extension plugin source dir: `<dir>/<name>/<name>.uplugin` + a Source marker. */
function makeExtensionSource(
  name: string,
  opts: { version?: string; plugins?: string[]; intermediate?: boolean } = {},
): string {
  const root = tmp();
  const pluginDir = path.join(root, name);
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(pluginDir, 'Source', name), { recursive: true });
  const uplugin: Record<string, unknown> = {
    FileVersion: 3,
    VersionName: opts.version ?? '1.0.0',
    FriendlyName: name,
    Modules: [{ Name: name, Type: 'Editor', LoadingPhase: 'Default' }],
  };
  if (opts.plugins && opts.plugins.length > 0) {
    uplugin.Plugins = opts.plugins.map((p) => ({ Name: p, Enabled: true }));
  }
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(pluginDir, `${name}.uplugin`), JSON.stringify(uplugin, null, '\t'), 'utf-8');
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(pluginDir, 'Source', name, `${name}.cpp`), '// marker', 'utf-8');
  if (opts.intermediate) {
    fs.mkdirSync(path.join(pluginDir, 'Intermediate', 'Build'), { recursive: true });
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(pluginDir, 'Intermediate', 'Build', 'x.obj'), 'OBJ', 'utf-8');
    fs.mkdirSync(path.join(pluginDir, 'Binaries', 'Win64'), { recursive: true });
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(pluginDir, 'Binaries', 'Win64', 'stale.dll'), 'DLL', 'utf-8');
  }
  return pluginDir;
}

/** A minimal UE project dir with a `.uproject`. */
function makeProject(name = 'MyGame'): string {
  const dir = tmp();
  writeUProject(dir, name, '5.7');
  return dir;
}

/** A `Response`-like stub whose body is a zip of `files`. */
function zipResponse(files: Record<string, Uint8Array>): Response {
  const bytes = zipSync(files);
  return {
    ok: true,
    status: 200,
    statusText: 'OK',
    arrayBuffer: async () => bytes.buffer.slice(bytes.byteOffset, bytes.byteOffset + bytes.byteLength),
  } as unknown as Response;
}

function enc(s: string): Uint8Array {
  return new TextEncoder().encode(s);
}

interface FakeRequest {
  url: string;
  method: string;
  redirect?: string;
  signal?: AbortSignal;
}

/**
 * A fake github.com for `fetchImpl`, routing by URL like the real site:
 * - `HEAD https://github.com/<repo>/releases/latest` → 302 to `/releases/tag/<latestTag>`
 *   (404 when `latestTag` is null — no published non-prerelease release);
 * - `HEAD .../releases/download/<tag>/<asset>` → 302 to a CDN when the asset exists, else 404;
 * - `GET  .../releases/download/<tag>/<asset>` → the plugin zip (VersionName = the tag's version).
 * `failResolution` makes every HEAD reject (offline / DNS failure).
 */
function fakeGitHub(opts: {
  latestTag?: string | null;
  /** The release carries no matching `<pluginName>-<version>.zip` asset. */
  missingAssets?: boolean;
  failResolution?: boolean;
  pluginPlugins?: string[];
}) {
  const requests: FakeRequest[] = [];
  const downloads: string[] = [];
  const fetchImpl = (async (url: string, init?: { method?: string; redirect?: string; signal?: AbortSignal }) => {
    const method = init?.method ?? 'GET';
    requests.push({ url, method, redirect: init?.redirect, signal: init?.signal });
    const res = (status: number, location?: string) =>
      ({ ok: status >= 200 && status < 300, status, statusText: String(status), headers: new Headers(location ? { location } : {}) }) as unknown as Response;
    if (method === 'HEAD') {
      if (opts.failResolution) throw new TypeError('fetch failed');
      const latest = /^https:\/\/github\.com\/([^/]+\/[^/]+)\/releases\/latest$/.exec(url);
      if (latest) {
        return opts.latestTag ? res(302, `https://github.com/${latest[1]}/releases/tag/${opts.latestTag}`) : res(404);
      }
      if (url.includes('/releases/download/')) {
        return opts.missingAssets ? res(404) : res(302, 'https://release-assets.githubusercontent.com/x');
      }
      return res(404);
    }
    const dl = /\/releases\/download\/v([^/]+)\/FooNiagara-[^/]+\.zip$/.exec(url);
    if (!dl) return res(404);
    downloads.push(url);
    const uplugin: Record<string, unknown> = { FileVersion: 3, VersionName: dl[1] };
    if (opts.pluginPlugins) uplugin.Plugins = opts.pluginPlugins.map((p) => ({ Name: p, Enabled: true }));
    return zipResponse({
      'FooNiagara/FooNiagara.uplugin': enc(JSON.stringify(uplugin)),
      'FooNiagara/Source/FooNiagara/FooNiagara.cpp': enc('// marker'),
    });
  }) as unknown as typeof fetch;
  return { fetchImpl, requests, downloads };
}

/** Plant an already-installed `Plugins/FooNiagara` at `version`. */
function plantInstalled(project: string, version: string): string {
  const dir = path.join(project, 'Plugins', 'FooNiagara');
  fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, 'FooNiagara.uplugin'), JSON.stringify({ FileVersion: 3, VersionName: version }), 'utf-8');
  return dir;
}

describe('extensions-catalog', () => {
  const sample: ExtensionDescriptor = {
    extensionId: 'com.foo.niagara',
    name: 'Niagara Tools',
    description: 'AI tools for Niagara.',
    pluginName: 'FooNiagara',
    repo: 'foo/Unreal-AI-Niagara',
    version: '1.2.0',
    minCoreVersion: '0.5.0',
    enginePlugins: ['Niagara'],
    tools: [{ name: 'niagara-create', description: 'Create a Niagara system.' }],
  };

  it('ships the Unreal-AI-Niagara entry', () => {
    expect(EXTENSIONS_CATALOG.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
    const niagara = findExtension('com.ivanmurzak.unreal-ai-niagara');
    expect(niagara).not.toBeNull();
    expect(niagara!.pluginName).toBe('UnrealAINiagara');
    expect(niagara!.repo).toBe('IvanMurzak/Unreal-AI-Niagara');
    expect(niagara!.version).toBe('0.1.0');
    expect(niagara!.enginePlugins).toEqual(['Niagara']);
    expect(niagara!.tools.map((t) => t.name)).toEqual([
      'niagara-list-systems',
      'niagara-get-system',
      'niagara-spawn-component',
    ]);
  });

  it('install-extension resolves the Niagara id to the v0.1.0 release zip by id', () => {
    // Default-channel resolution: a user typing `install-extension <niagara-id>` (no --source,
    // no --version) falls back to the catalog v0.1.0 GitHub-release zip when latest resolution fails.
    const niagara = findExtension('com.ivanmurzak.unreal-ai-niagara');
    expect(niagara).not.toBeNull();
    const source = resolveInstallSource({
      repo: niagara!.repo,
      pluginName: niagara!.pluginName,
      version: niagara!.version,
    });
    expect(source.kind).toBe('github-release');
    if (source.kind === 'github-release') {
      expect(source.url).toBe(
        'https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Unreal-AI-Niagara/releases/download/v0.1.0/UnrealAINiagara-0.1.0.zip',
      );
      expect(source.version).toBe('0.1.0');
    }
  });

  it('findExtension matches by extensionId, name, or pluginName (case-insensitive)', () => {
    const cat = [sample];
    expect(findExtension('com.foo.niagara', cat)).toBe(sample);
    expect(findExtension('NIAGARA TOOLS', cat)).toBe(sample);
    expect(findExtension('fooniagara', cat)).toBe(sample);
    expect(findExtension('nope', cat)).toBeNull();
    expect(findExtension('', cat)).toBeNull();
    expect(findExtension(undefined, cat)).toBeNull();
  });

  it('hasVersion reflects the pin', () => {
    expect(hasVersion(sample)).toBe(true);
    expect(hasVersion({ ...sample, version: null })).toBe(false);
    expect(hasVersion({ ...sample, version: '  ' })).toBe(false);
  });

  it('unknownExtensionMessage explains the empty catalog + the --source escape hatch', () => {
    const msg = unknownExtensionMessage('com.x.y', []);
    expect(msg).toContain('currently empty');
    expect(msg).toContain('--source');
  });
});

// ===========================================================================
// extension-source resolver (the pluggable channel seam)
// ===========================================================================

describe('extension-source', () => {
  it('builds a github.com release URL', () => {
    expect(stripLeadingV('v1.2.0')).toBe('1.2.0');
    expect(releaseTag('1.2.0')).toBe('v1.2.0');
    expect(extensionAssetName('FooNiagara', 'v1.2.0')).toBe('FooNiagara-1.2.0.zip');
    expect(extensionDownloadUrl('foo/Unreal-AI-Niagara', 'FooNiagara', '1.2.0')).toBe(
      'https://github.com/foo/Unreal-AI-Niagara/releases/download/v1.2.0/FooNiagara-1.2.0.zip',
    );
  });

  it('assertTrustedDownloadUrl accepts github https and rejects everything else', () => {
    expect(() => assertTrustedDownloadUrl('https://github.com/a/b/releases/download/v1/x.zip')).not.toThrow();
    expect(() => assertTrustedDownloadUrl('http://github.com/a/b')).toThrow(/only https/);
    expect(() => assertTrustedDownloadUrl('https://evil.test/a/b')).toThrow(/untrusted host/);
    expect(() => assertTrustedDownloadUrl('https://github.com.evil.test/a')).toThrow(/untrusted host/);
    expect(() => assertTrustedDownloadUrl('not a url')).toThrow(/malformed/);
  });

  it('resolveInstallSource prefers --source (local) over a release', () => {
    const s = resolveInstallSource({ source: '/some/dir', repo: 'a/b', pluginName: 'P', version: '1.0.0' });
    expect(s).toEqual({ kind: 'local', dir: '/some/dir' });
  });

  it('resolveInstallSource falls back to github-release when repo + version known', () => {
    const s = resolveInstallSource({ repo: 'a/b', pluginName: 'P', version: '1.0.0' });
    expect(s.kind).toBe('github-release');
    if (s.kind === 'github-release') {
      expect(s.url).toBe('https://github.com/a/b/releases/download/v1.0.0/P-1.0.0.zip');
      expect(s.version).toBe('1.0.0');
    }
  });

  it('resolveInstallSource throws clearly when neither a source nor a resolvable release exists', () => {
    expect(() => resolveInstallSource({ repo: null, pluginName: 'P', version: '1.0.0' })).toThrow(/no release repo/);
    expect(() => resolveInstallSource({ repo: 'a/b', pluginName: 'P', version: null })).toThrow(/No version/);
  });
});

// ===========================================================================
// uproject-plugins pure transforms
// ===========================================================================

describe('uproject-plugins', () => {
  it('parses declared (enabled) plugin deps and the version name', () => {
    const json = {
      VersionName: '2.3.4',
      Plugins: [
        { Name: 'Niagara', Enabled: true },
        { Name: 'Disabled', Enabled: false },
        { Name: 'NoFlag' },
        { Bad: 1 },
      ],
    };
    expect(parseUPluginDependencies(json)).toEqual(['Niagara', 'NoFlag']);
    expect(readUPluginVersionName(json)).toBe('2.3.4');
    expect(parseUPluginDependencies({})).toEqual([]);
    expect(readUPluginVersionName({})).toBeNull();
  });

  it('enables plugins (add + flip), is idempotent, dedupes, and preserves a trailing newline', () => {
    const base = JSON.stringify({ FileVersion: 3, Plugins: [{ Name: 'Existing', Enabled: false }] }, null, '\t') + '\n';
    const r1 = enablePluginsInUProject(base, ['MyExt', 'Existing', 'myext']);
    expect(r1.changed).toBe(true);
    expect(r1.text.endsWith('\n')).toBe(true);
    expect(r1.enabledPlugins.sort()).toEqual(['Existing', 'MyExt']);
    // addedOrFlipped lists exactly what this call switched on (MyExt appended, Existing flipped).
    expect(r1.addedOrFlipped.sort()).toEqual(['Existing', 'MyExt']);
    const parsed = JSON.parse(r1.text) as { Plugins: { Name: string; Enabled: boolean }[] };
    expect(parsed.Plugins.find((p) => p.Name === 'Existing')!.Enabled).toBe(true);

    // Idempotent: re-running makes no change.
    const r2 = enablePluginsInUProject(r1.text, ['MyExt', 'Existing']);
    expect(r2.changed).toBe(false);
    expect(r2.text).toBe(r1.text);
    expect(r2.addedOrFlipped).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('addedOrFlipped excludes plugins already enabled before the call', () => {
    const base = JSON.stringify({ FileVersion: 3, Plugins: [{ Name: 'AlreadyOn', Enabled: true }] }, null, '\t');
    const r = enablePluginsInUProject(base, ['AlreadyOn', 'NewExt']);
    expect(r.changed).toBe(true);
    // The full enabled set still includes the pre-existing plugin ...
    expect(r.enabledPlugins.sort()).toEqual(['AlreadyOn', 'NewExt']);
    // ... but addedOrFlipped reports only the newly switched-on extension.
    expect(r.addedOrFlipped).toEqual(['NewExt']);
  });

  it('creates a Plugins array when absent', () => {
    const base = JSON.stringify({ FileVersion: 3 }, null, '\t');
    const r = enablePluginsInUProject(base, ['MyExt']);
    expect(r.changed).toBe(true);
    expect(JSON.parse(r.text).Plugins).toEqual([{ Name: 'MyExt', Enabled: true }]);
  });
});

// ===========================================================================
// installExtension — local --source path
// ===========================================================================

describe('installExtension (local --source)', () => {
  it('places the plugin, enables it + the gating plugin, reports added + rebuildRequired', async () => {
    const project = makeProject();
    const source = makeExtensionSource('FooNiagara', { version: '1.0.0', plugins: ['Niagara'], intermediate: true });

    const r = await installExtension({ projectDir: project, extensionId: 'com.foo.niagara', source });
    expect(r.kind).toBe('success');
    if (r.kind !== 'success') return;

    expect(r.outcome).toBe('added');
    expect(r.changed).toBe(true);
    expect(r.rebuildRequired).toBe(true);
    expect(r.built).toBe(false);
    expect(r.sourceKind).toBe('local');
    expect(r.toVersion).toBe('1.0.0');
    expect(r.fromVersion).toBeNull();

    // Files placed, build cache excluded.
    const installed = path.join(project, 'Plugins', 'FooNiagara');
    expect(fs.existsSync(path.join(installed, 'FooNiagara.uplugin'))).toBe(true);
    expect(fs.existsSync(path.join(installed, 'Source', 'FooNiagara', 'FooNiagara.cpp'))).toBe(true);
    expect(fs.existsSync(path.join(installed, 'Intermediate'))).toBe(false);
    expect(fs.existsSync(path.join(installed, 'Binaries'))).toBe(false);

    // .uproject enabled the extension + the gating plugin.
    const upj = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(r.uprojectPath, 'utf-8')) as { Plugins: { Name: string; Enabled: boolean }[] };
    const enabled = upj.Plugins.filter((p) => p.Enabled).map((p) => p.Name);
    expect(enabled).toContain('FooNiagara');
    expect(enabled).toContain('Niagara');
    expect(r.enabledPlugins).toContain('Niagara');
  });

  it('is idempotent — a second identical install is a no-op already-up-to-date', async () => {
    const project = makeProject();
    const source = makeExtensionSource('FooNiagara', { version: '1.0.0', plugins: ['Niagara'] });
    await installExtension({ projectDir: project, extensionId: 'com.foo.niagara', source });

    const uprojectPath = path.join(project, 'MyGame.uproject');
    const before = fs.readFileSync(uprojectPath, 'utf-8');
    const r = await installExtension({ projectDir: project, extensionId: 'com.foo.niagara', source });
    expect(r.kind).toBe('success');
    if (r.kind !== 'success') return;
    expect(r.outcome).toBe('already-up-to-date');
    expect(r.changed).toBe(false);
    expect(r.rebuildRequired).toBe(false);
    // No write to the .uproject.
    expect(fs.readFileSync(uprojectPath, 'utf-8')).toBe(before);
  });

  it("reports 'enabled' (not 'updated') when files are current but the .uproject lost the enable entry", async () => {
    const project = makeProject();
    const source = makeExtensionSource('FooNiagara', { version: '1.0.0', plugins: ['Niagara'] });
    await installExtension({ projectDir: project, extensionId: 'com.foo.niagara', source });

    // Drop the extension's enable entry while the materialized files stay at the
    // same version on disk → re-install should re-enable, not "update".
    const uprojectPath = path.join(project, 'MyGame.uproject');
    const upj = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(uprojectPath, 'utf-8')) as { Plugins: { Name: string; Enabled: boolean }[] };
    upj.Plugins = upj.Plugins.filter((p) => p.Name !== 'FooNiagara');
    fs.writeFileSync(uprojectPath, JSON.stringify(upj, null, '\t'));

    const r = await installExtension({ projectDir: project, extensionId: 'com.foo.niagara', source });
    expect(r.kind).toBe('success');
    if (r.kind !== 'success') return;
    expect(r.outcome).toBe('enabled');
    expect(r.changed).toBe(true);
    expect(r.fromVersion).toBe('1.0.0');
    expect(r.toVersion).toBe('1.0.0');
    expect(r.message).toMatch(/Enabled existing extension FooNiagara 1\.0\.0/);
    // Only the re-enabled extension is reported, not the pre-existing Niagara.
    expect(r.enabledPlugins).toContain('FooNiagara');
    expect(r.enabledPlugins).not.toContain('Niagara');
  });

  it('updates when the source version is newer (fromVersion → toVersion)', async () => {
    const project = makeProject();
    await installExtension({
      projectDir: project,
      extensionId: 'com.foo.niagara',
      source: makeExtensionSource('FooNiagara', { version: '1.0.0' }),
    });
    const r = await installExtension({
      projectDir: project,
      extensionId: 'com.foo.niagara',
      source: makeExtensionSource('FooNiagara', { version: '2.0.0' }),
    });
    expect(r.kind).toBe('success');
    if (r.kind !== 'success') return;
    expect(r.outcome).toBe('updated');
    expect(r.fromVersion).toBe('1.0.0');
    expect(r.toVersion).toBe('2.0.0');
  });

  it('--force re-materializes even when already up to date', async () => {
    const project = makeProject();
    const source = makeExtensionSource('FooNiagara', { version: '1.0.0' });
    await installExtension({ projectDir: project, extensionId: 'com.foo.niagara', source });
    const r = await installExtension({ projectDir: project, extensionId: 'com.foo.niagara', source, force: true });
    expect(r.kind).toBe('success');
    if (r.kind !== 'success') return;
    expect(r.changed).toBe(true);
  });

  it('uses a catalog descriptor (pluginName + enginePlugins) when the id resolves, with --source for files', async () => {
    const project = makeProject();
    const catalog: ExtensionDescriptor[] = [
      {
        extensionId: 'com.foo.niagara',
        name: 'Niagara Tools',
        description: 'x',
        pluginName: 'FooNiagara',
        repo: 'foo/Unreal-AI-Niagara',
        version: '1.0.0',
        minCoreVersion: null,
        enginePlugins: ['Niagara', 'PluginBrowser'],
        tools: [],
      },
    ];
    // The source .uplugin only declares Niagara; the catalog adds PluginBrowser.
    const source = makeExtensionSource('FooNiagara', { version: '1.0.0', plugins: ['Niagara'] });
    const r = await installExtension({ projectDir: project, extensionId: 'com.foo.niagara', source, catalog });
    expect(r.kind).toBe('success');
    if (r.kind !== 'success') return;
    expect(r.enabledPlugins).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining(['FooNiagara', 'Niagara', 'PluginBrowser']));
  });
});

describe('installExtension (download + failures)', () => {
  const catalog: ExtensionDescriptor[] = [
    {
      extensionId: 'com.foo.niagara',
      name: 'Niagara Tools',
      description: 'x',
      pluginName: 'FooNiagara',
      repo: 'foo/Unreal-AI-Niagara',
      version: '1.0.0',
      minCoreVersion: null,
      enginePlugins: [],
      tools: [],
    },
  ];

  it('downloads + extracts the plugin zip from the (injected) GitHub release', async () => {
    const project = makeProject();
    const fake = fakeGitHub({ latestTag: 'v1.0.0', pluginPlugins: ['Niagara'] });

    const r = await installExtension({ projectDir: project, extensionId: 'com.foo.niagara', catalog, fetchImpl: fake.fetchImpl });
    expect(r.kind).toBe('success');
    if (r.kind !== 'success') return;
    expect(fake.downloads).toEqual([
      'https://github.com/foo/Unreal-AI-Niagara/releases/download/v1.0.0/FooNiagara-1.0.0.zip',
    ]);
    expect(r.outcome).toBe('added');
    expect(r.sourceKind).toBe('github-release');
    const installed = path.join(project, 'Plugins', 'FooNiagara');
    expect(fs.existsSync(path.join(installed, 'FooNiagara.uplugin'))).toBe(true);
    expect(fs.existsSync(path.join(installed, 'Source', 'FooNiagara', 'FooNiagara.cpp'))).toBe(true);
    expect(r.enabledPlugins).toContain('Niagara');
  });

  it('passes an abort signal (timeout) to every release request', async () => {
    const project = makeProject();
    const fake = fakeGitHub({ latestTag: 'v1.0.0' });

    const r = await installExtension({ projectDir: project, extensionId: 'com.foo.niagara', catalog, fetchImpl: fake.fetchImpl });
    expect(r.kind).toBe('success');
    expect(fake.requests.length).toBe(3); // latest HEAD, asset HEAD, zip GET
    for (const req of fake.requests) expect(req.signal).toBeInstanceOf(AbortSignal);
  });

  it('fails (no throw) on an HTTP error from the release', async () => {
    const project = makeProject();
    const fetchImpl = (async () => ({ ok: false, status: 404, statusText: 'Not Found' }) as unknown as Response) as unknown as typeof fetch;
    const r = await installExtension({ projectDir: project, extensionId: 'com.foo.niagara', catalog, fetchImpl });
    expect(r.kind).toBe('failure');
    if (r.kind === 'failure') expect(r.error.message).toMatch(/HTTP 404/);
  });

  it('fails (no throw) for an unknown extension with no --source', async () => {
    const project = makeProject();
    const r = await installExtension({ projectDir: project, extensionId: 'com.unknown.ext' });
    expect(r.kind).toBe('failure');
    if (r.kind === 'failure') expect(r.error.message).toMatch(/Unknown extension/);
  });

  it('fails (no throw) when the directory is not an Unreal project', async () => {
    const notProject = tmp();
    const source = makeExtensionSource('FooNiagara');
    const r = await installExtension({ projectDir: notProject, extensionId: 'com.foo.niagara', source });
    expect(r.kind).toBe('failure');
    if (r.kind === 'failure') expect(r.error.message).toMatch(/No .uproject/);
  });
});

// ===========================================================================
// Latest-release resolution — the catalog version is only an offline fallback
// ===========================================================================

describe('parsePlainReleaseTag', () => {
  it('accepts only plain vX.Y.Z tags', () => {
    expect(parsePlainReleaseTag('v0.1.2')).toBe('0.1.2');
    expect(parsePlainReleaseTag('v10.20.30')).toBe('10.20.30');
    expect(parsePlainReleaseTag('v1.2.0-beta.1')).toBeNull();
    expect(parsePlainReleaseTag('v1.2.0+build')).toBeNull();
    expect(parsePlainReleaseTag('1.2.0')).toBeNull();
    expect(parsePlainReleaseTag('v1.2')).toBeNull();
    expect(parsePlainReleaseTag('release-1')).toBeNull();
    expect(parsePlainReleaseTag('')).toBeNull();
  });
});

describe('resolveLatestExtensionVersion', () => {
  const input = { repo: 'foo/Unreal-AI-Niagara', pluginName: 'FooNiagara' };

  it('follows the /releases/latest redirect (HEAD, manual redirect) and verifies the asset', async () => {
    const fake = fakeGitHub({ latestTag: 'v1.2.0' });
    const r = await resolveLatestExtensionVersion({ ...input, fetchImpl: fake.fetchImpl });
    expect(r).toEqual({ kind: 'resolved', version: '1.2.0' });
    expect(fake.requests.map((q) => [q.method, q.redirect, q.url])).toEqual([
      ['HEAD', 'manual', 'https://github.com/foo/Unreal-AI-Niagara/releases/latest'],
      ['HEAD', 'manual', 'https://github.com/foo/Unreal-AI-Niagara/releases/download/v1.2.0/FooNiagara-1.2.0.zip'],
    ]);
  });

  it('is unresolved (no throw) on a network failure', async () => {
    const r = await resolveLatestExtensionVersion({ ...input, fetchImpl: fakeGitHub({ failResolution: true }).fetchImpl });
    expect(r.kind).toBe('unresolved');
    if (r.kind === 'unresolved') expect(r.reason).toMatch(/fetch failed/);
  });

  it('is unresolved when the release lacks the expected <Plugin>-<version>.zip asset', async () => {
    const r = await resolveLatestExtensionVersion({
      ...input,
      fetchImpl: fakeGitHub({ latestTag: 'v1.2.0', missingAssets: true }).fetchImpl,
    });
    expect(r.kind).toBe('unresolved');
    if (r.kind === 'unresolved') expect(r.reason).toMatch(/no FooNiagara-1\.2\.0\.zip asset/);
  });

  it('is unresolved for a prerelease-style or non-v tag', async () => {
    for (const latestTag of ['v1.3.0-rc.1', '1.3.0']) {
      const r = await resolveLatestExtensionVersion({ ...input, fetchImpl: fakeGitHub({ latestTag }).fetchImpl });
      expect(r.kind).toBe('unresolved');
      if (r.kind === 'unresolved') expect(r.reason).toMatch(/not a plain vX\.Y\.Z/);
    }
  });

  it('is unresolved when the repo has no published release (404, no redirect)', async () => {
    const r = await resolveLatestExtensionVersion({ ...input, fetchImpl: fakeGitHub({ latestTag: null }).fetchImpl });
    expect(r.kind).toBe('unresolved');
    if (r.kind === 'unresolved') expect(r.reason).toMatch(/HTTP 404/);
  });

  it('is unresolved when the redirect leaves the repo / github.com', async () => {
    const fetchImpl = (async () =>
      ({ ok: false, status: 302, headers: new Headers({ location: 'https://evil.test/foo/Unreal-AI-Niagara/releases/tag/v9.9.9' }) }) as unknown as Response) as unknown as typeof fetch;
    const r = await resolveLatestExtensionVersion({ ...input, fetchImpl });
    expect(r.kind).toBe('unresolved');
    if (r.kind === 'unresolved') expect(r.reason).toMatch(/unexpected latest-release redirect/);
  });
});

describe('installExtension (latest release vs catalog fallback)', () => {
  // The catalog lists 1.0.0 as the last known release; the repo's newest is 1.2.0.
  const catalog: ExtensionDescriptor[] = [
    {
      extensionId: 'com.foo.niagara',
      name: 'Niagara Tools',
      description: 'x',
      pluginName: 'FooNiagara',
      repo: 'foo/Unreal-AI-Niagara',
      version: '1.0.0',
      minCoreVersion: null,
      enginePlugins: [],
      tools: [],
    },
  ];
  const zipUrl = (v: string) => `https://github.com/foo/Unreal-AI-Niagara/releases/download/v${v}/FooNiagara-${v}.zip`;
  const installedVersion = (project: string) =>
    readUPluginVersionName(JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(project, 'Plugins', 'FooNiagara', 'FooNiagara.uplugin'), 'utf-8')));

  it('installs the newest release resolved online, not the catalog version', async () => {
    const project = makeProject();
    const fake = fakeGitHub({ latestTag: 'v1.2.0' });
    const r = await installExtension({ projectDir: project, extensionId: 'com.foo.niagara', catalog, fetchImpl: fake.fetchImpl });
    expect(r.kind).toBe('success');
    if (r.kind !== 'success') return;
    expect(fake.downloads).toEqual([zipUrl('1.2.0')]);
    expect(r.toVersion).toBe('1.2.0');
    expect(r.versionSource).toBe('latest-release');
    expect(r.warnings).toEqual([]);
    expect(installedVersion(project)).toBe('1.2.0');
  });

  it('falls back to the catalog version on a network failure (with a warning)', async () => {
    const project = makeProject();
    // HEADs fail (offline resolution); the GET for the fallback zip still answers.
    const fake = fakeGitHub({ failResolution: true });
    const r = await installExtension({ projectDir: project, extensionId: 'com.foo.niagara', catalog, fetchImpl: fake.fetchImpl });
    expect(r.kind).toBe('success');
    if (r.kind !== 'success') return;
    expect(fake.downloads).toEqual([zipUrl('1.0.0')]);
    expect(r.toVersion).toBe('1.0.0');
    expect(r.versionSource).toBe('catalog');
    expect(r.warnings.join('\n')).toMatch(/falling back to the catalog version 1\.0\.0/);
  });

  it('falls back to the catalog version when the latest release has no matching asset', async () => {
    const project = makeProject();
    const fake = fakeGitHub({ latestTag: 'v1.2.0', missingAssets: true });
    const r = await installExtension({ projectDir: project, extensionId: 'com.foo.niagara', catalog, fetchImpl: fake.fetchImpl });
    expect(r.kind).toBe('success');
    if (r.kind !== 'success') return;
    expect(fake.downloads).toEqual([zipUrl('1.0.0')]);
    expect(r.versionSource).toBe('catalog');
  });

  it('falls back to the catalog version when the latest tag is not a plain release', async () => {
    const project = makeProject();
    const fake = fakeGitHub({ latestTag: 'v1.3.0-beta.1' });
    const r = await installExtension({ projectDir: project, extensionId: 'com.foo.niagara', catalog, fetchImpl: fake.fetchImpl });
    expect(r.kind).toBe('success');
    if (r.kind !== 'success') return;
    expect(fake.downloads).toEqual([zipUrl('1.0.0')]);
    expect(r.versionSource).toBe('catalog');
  });

  it('an explicit --version wins: no latest resolution, and it may downgrade', async () => {
    const project = makeProject();
    plantInstalled(project, '1.2.0');
    const fake = fakeGitHub({ latestTag: 'v1.2.0' });
    const r = await installExtension({
      projectDir: project,
      extensionId: 'com.foo.niagara',
      catalog,
      version: '0.9.0',
      fetchImpl: fake.fetchImpl,
    });
    expect(r.kind).toBe('success');
    if (r.kind !== 'success') return;
    expect(fake.requests.some((q) => q.url.endsWith('/releases/latest'))).toBe(false);
    expect(fake.downloads).toEqual([zipUrl('0.9.0')]);
    expect(r.versionSource).toBe('explicit');
    expect(r.outcome).toBe('updated');
    expect(installedVersion(project)).toBe('0.9.0');
  });

  it('never downgrades an installed newer copy implicitly (even with --force)', async () => {
    for (const force of [false, true]) {
      const project = makeProject();
      plantInstalled(project, '2.0.0');
      const fake = fakeGitHub({ latestTag: 'v1.2.0' });
      const r = await installExtension({ projectDir: project, extensionId: 'com.foo.niagara', catalog, force, fetchImpl: fake.fetchImpl });
      expect(r.kind).toBe('success');
      if (r.kind !== 'success') return;
      expect(fake.downloads).toEqual([]);
      expect(r.toVersion).toBe('2.0.0');
      expect(r.versionSource).toBe('installed');
      expect(r.outcome).toBe('enabled'); // files kept; only the .uproject enable entry was written
      expect(r.warnings.join('\n')).toMatch(/newer than 1\.2\.0; keeping it/);
      expect(installedVersion(project)).toBe('2.0.0');
    }
  });

  it('updates an installed older copy to the latest release', async () => {
    const project = makeProject();
    plantInstalled(project, '1.0.0');
    const fake = fakeGitHub({ latestTag: 'v1.2.0' });
    const r = await installExtension({ projectDir: project, extensionId: 'com.foo.niagara', catalog, fetchImpl: fake.fetchImpl });
    expect(r.kind).toBe('success');
    if (r.kind !== 'success') return;
    expect(r.outcome).toBe('updated');
    expect(r.fromVersion).toBe('1.0.0');
    expect(r.toVersion).toBe('1.2.0');
    expect(installedVersion(project)).toBe('1.2.0');
  });

  it('is a no-op when the latest release is already installed and enabled', async () => {
    const project = makeProject();
    const first = await installExtension({ projectDir: project, extensionId: 'com.foo.niagara', catalog, fetchImpl: fakeGitHub({ latestTag: 'v1.2.0' }).fetchImpl });
    expect(first.kind).toBe('success');
    const fake = fakeGitHub({ latestTag: 'v1.2.0' });
    const r = await installExtension({ projectDir: project, extensionId: 'com.foo.niagara', catalog, fetchImpl: fake.fetchImpl });
    expect(r.kind).toBe('success');
    if (r.kind !== 'success') return;
    expect(r.outcome).toBe('already-up-to-date');
    expect(fake.downloads).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('a --source install never resolves online', async () => {
    const project = makeProject();
    const fake = fakeGitHub({ latestTag: 'v1.2.0' });
    const source = makeExtensionSource('FooNiagara', { version: '1.0.0' });
    const r = await installExtension({ projectDir: project, extensionId: 'com.foo.niagara', catalog, source, fetchImpl: fake.fetchImpl });
    expect(r.kind).toBe('success');
    if (r.kind !== 'success') return;
    expect(fake.requests).toEqual([]);
    expect(r.versionSource).toBe('local');
  });
});

describe('installExtension (--build)', () => {
  it('invokes the injected build runner and reports built + no rebuildRequired', async () => {
    const project = makeProject('MyGame');
    const source = makeExtensionSource('FooNiagara', { version: '1.0.0' });
    const steps: ExtensionBuildStep[] = [];
    const r = await installExtension({
      projectDir: project,
      extensionId: 'com.foo.niagara',
      source,
      build: true,
      engineRoot: 'C:/Engine',
      buildImpl: async (step) => {
        steps.push(step);
      },
    });
    expect(r.kind).toBe('success');
    if (r.kind !== 'success') return;
    expect(r.built).toBe(true);
    expect(r.rebuildRequired).toBe(false);
    expect(steps).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(steps[0].editorTarget).toBe('MyGameEditor');
    expect(steps[0].args).toContain('-WaitMutex');
    const normalized = steps[0].ubtPath.replace(/\\/g, '/');
    if (process.platform === 'darwin') {
      expect(normalized).toContain('C:/Engine/Engine/Build/BatchFiles/Mac/Build.sh');
    } else if (process.platform === 'linux') {
      expect(normalized).toContain('C:/Engine/Engine/Build/BatchFiles/Linux/Build.sh');
    } else {
      expect(normalized).toContain('C:/Engine/Engine/Binaries/DotNET/UnrealBuildTool/UnrealBuildTool.exe');
    }
  });

  it('warns + falls back to rebuild-on-next-open when no engine root resolves', async () => {
    const project = makeProject();
    const source = makeExtensionSource('FooNiagara', { version: '1.0.0' });
    const r = await installExtension({
      projectDir: project,
      extensionId: 'com.foo.niagara',
      source,
      build: true,
      resolveEngineRootImpl: () => null,
    });
    expect(r.kind).toBe('success');
    if (r.kind !== 'success') return;
    expect(r.built).toBe(false);
    expect(r.rebuildRequired).toBe(true);
    expect(r.warnings.join(' ')).toMatch(/no engine root/i);
  });

  it('a failing build does not throw — it warns and leaves rebuildRequired true', async () => {
    const project = makeProject();
    const source = makeExtensionSource('FooNiagara', { version: '1.0.0' });
    const r = await installExtension({
      projectDir: project,
      extensionId: 'com.foo.niagara',
      source,
      build: true,
      engineRoot: 'C:/Engine',
      buildImpl: async () => {
        throw new Error('compile error');
      },
    });
    expect(r.kind).toBe('success');
    if (r.kind !== 'success') return;
    expect(r.built).toBe(false);
    expect(r.rebuildRequired).toBe(true);
    expect(r.warnings.join(' ')).toMatch(/Build failed/);
  });
});
```
