`extensions/UnrealAIEnhancedInput/Source/UnrealAIEnhancedInput/Private/UnrealAIEnhancedInputModule.cpp`:

```cpp
// Copyright (c) 2026 IvanMurzak/Unreal-AI-EnhancedInput. Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.
// See the LICENSE file in the repository root for more information.

#include "Modules/ModuleManager.h"
#include "Misc/EngineVersionComparison.h"
#include "Dom/JsonObject.h"
#include "Dom/JsonValue.h"

#include "IUnrealMcpRqlModule.h"
#include "UnrealAIEnhancedInputRqlApi.h"

#include "EnhancedActionKeyMapping.h"
#include "InputAction.h"
#include "InputMappingContext.h"

/**
 * The extension's RQL module (Unreal-MCP docs/rql.md "Extensions"): Enhanced Input is queried and changed with
 * rql-query / rql-mutate instead of dedicated tools. Reflection exposes UInputAction (ValueType, Triggers, Modifiers,
 * ...) and UInputMappingContext; the module adds the asset sources, the `enhancedInput` authoring operations, a
 * context's key mappings (not a reflected property) and the agent guide rendered into the unreal-rql skill.
 *
 * The version is the .uplugin VersionName.
 */
class FUnrealAIEnhancedInputRqlModule : public IUnrealMcpRqlModule
{
	/** A context's live key mappings (GetMappings: the 5.7+ DefaultKeyMappings, the Mappings array before) as [{Action, Key}]. */
	static TSharedPtr<FJsonValue> KeyMappingsJson(UObject* Object)
	{
		TArray<TSharedPtr<FJsonValue>> Mappings;
		if (const UInputMappingContext* MappingContext = Cast<UInputMappingContext>(Object))
		{
			for (const FEnhancedActionKeyMapping& Mapping : MappingContext->GetMappings())
			{
				TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> Entry = MakeShared<FJsonObject>();
				Entry->SetStringField(TEXT("Action"), Mapping.Action ? Mapping.Action->GetName() : FString());
				Entry->SetStringField(TEXT("Key"), Mapping.Key.GetFName().ToString());
				Mappings.Add(MakeShared<FJsonValueObject>(Entry));
			}
		}
		return MakeShared<FJsonValueArray>(Mappings);
	}

public:
	virtual FString GetRqlModuleName() const override { return TEXT("EnhancedInput"); }
	virtual FString GetExtensionId() const override { return TEXT("com.ivanmurzak.unreal-ai-enhanced-input"); }
	virtual FString GetExtensionVersion() const override { return UnrealMcpRql::PluginVersion(TEXT("UnrealAIEnhancedInput")); }

	virtual void ConfigureRql(FUnrealMcpRqlModuleContext& Context) override
	{
		Context.AddAssetSource(TEXT("inputActions"), TEXT("Input Action assets (InputAction) of the project, at most 200"),
			UInputAction::StaticClass());
		Context.AddAssetSource(TEXT("inputContexts"), TEXT("Input Mapping Context assets (InputMappingContext) of the project, at most 200"),
			UInputMappingContext::StaticClass());
		Context.AddApiSource(TEXT("enhancedInput"),
			TEXT("Enhanced Input operations: call CreateAction(path, valueType) / CreateContext(path) / AddMapping(context, action, key) / RemoveMapping(context, action, key) / AddActionEvent(blueprint, action) / AddMappingContextOnBeginPlay(blueprint, context, priority)"),
			UUnrealAIEnhancedInputRqlApi::StaticClass(), TEXT("EnhancedInputOperations"));
		Context.AddJsonMember(UInputMappingContext::StaticClass(), TEXT("KeyMappings"), TEXT("the context's key mappings: Action, Key"), &KeyMappingsJson);
#if !UE_VERSION_OLDER_THAN(5, 7, 0)
		// Since UE 5.7 the reflected `Mappings` array is deprecated and stays empty (the mappings moved to DefaultKeyMappings):
		// an agent reading it saw [] beside a working mapping. It reads the live mappings too. (Before 5.7 it IS the live,
		// editable array: left as reflected.)
		Context.AddJsonMember(UInputMappingContext::StaticClass(), TEXT("Mappings"), TEXT("the context's key mappings: Action, Key (same as KeyMappings)"),
			&KeyMappingsJson);
#endif
		Context.AddGuide(TEXT("Enhanced Input"), TEXT(R"MD(Input Actions and Mapping Contexts are assets: `inputActions`, `inputContexts` (or `unreal.asset("/Game/Input/IA_Jump")`).
An action's members are its reflected properties (ValueType, Triggers, Modifiers, bConsumeInput, ...); a context lists its
bindings in `KeyMappings`.

```
inputActions | select $ref Name ValueType
inputContexts | select Name KeyMappings
enhancedInput | call CreateAction("/Game/Input/IA_Jump", "Boolean")            Boolean | Axis1D | Axis2D | Axis3D
enhancedInput | call CreateContext("/Game/Input/IMC_Default")
enhancedInput | call AddMapping("/Game/Input/IMC_Default", "/Game/Input/IA_Jump", "SpaceBar")
enhancedInput | call RemoveMapping("/Game/Input/IMC_Default", "/Game/Input/IA_Jump", "SpaceBar")
unreal.asset("/Game/Input/IA_Move") | set ValueType = "Axis2D"
```

Key names are Unreal FKey names (SpaceBar, W, LeftMouseButton, Gamepad_LeftX, Gamepad_FaceButton_Bottom). Created assets
are unsaved: `editor | call SaveAll()`.

Blueprint input (a Pawn / Character / PlayerController Blueprint): the context must be added at BeginPlay, then each action
gets one event node whose exec pins (Triggered, Started, Ongoing, Canceled, Completed) and ActionValue are wired with the
core graph calls. The jump example:

```
enhancedInput | call AddMappingContextOnBeginPlay("/Game/BP_Hero", "/Game/Input/IMC_Default")      once per Blueprint (Priority optional)
enhancedInput | call AddActionEvent("/Game/BP_Hero", "/Game/Input/IA_Jump")                       returns K2Node_EnhancedInputAction#N
unreal.asset("/Game/BP_Hero").EventGraph | call AddCallFunction("Jump")                             returns K2Node_CallFunction#M
ref("K2Node_EnhancedInputAction#N") | call Connect("Triggered", ref("K2Node_CallFunction#M"), "execute")
unreal.asset("/Game/BP_Hero") | call Compile()
```

The pawn must be the one the player controls (the GameMode's Default Pawn Class, or Auto Possess Player = Player 0 on a
placed one). The legacy key events (`EventGraph | call AddInputKey("SpaceBar")`) need none of this.)MD"));
	}
};

IMPLEMENT_MODULE(TUnrealMcpRqlEditorModule<FUnrealAIEnhancedInputRqlModule>, UnrealAIEnhancedInput)

```cpp
// Copyright (c) 2026 IvanMurzak/Unreal-AI-EnhancedInput. Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.
// See the LICENSE file in the repository root for more information.

#include "UnrealAIEnhancedInputRqlApi.h"

#include "IUnrealMcpRqlModule.h"

#include "EdGraph/EdGraph.h"
#include "EdGraphSchema_K2.h"
#include "EnhancedActionKeyMapping.h"
#include "EnhancedInputSubsystems.h"
#include "Engine/Blueprint.h"
#include "Engine/BlueprintGeneratedClass.h"
#include "GameFramework/Actor.h"
#include "InputAction.h"
#include "InputCoreTypes.h"
#include "InputMappingContext.h"
#include "K2Node_CallFunction.h"
#include "K2Node_CallParentFunction.h"
#include "K2Node_EnhancedInputAction.h"
#include "K2Node_Event.h"
#include "K2Node_GetSubsystem.h"
#include "Kismet/GameplayStatics.h"
#include "Kismet2/BlueprintEditorUtils.h"

namespace UnrealAIEnhancedInputRqlLocal
{
	bool ValidKey(const FString& Key, FKey& Out)
	{
		Out = FKey(*Key.TrimStartAndEnd());
		if (Out.IsValid())
			return true;
		UnrealMcpRql::Fail(FString::Printf(TEXT("'%s' is not a key name (e.g. SpaceBar, W, LeftMouseButton, Gamepad_FaceButton_Bottom)"), *Key));
		return false;
	}
}

namespace UnrealAIEnhancedInputRqlLocal
{
	/** The actor Blueprint and event graph @p Target names (the Blueprint, its event graph, or another of its event graphs); null after Fail. */
	UEdGraph* EventGraphOf(UObject* Target, UBlueprint*& OutBlueprint)
	{
		UEdGraph* Graph = Cast<UEdGraph>(Target);
		OutBlueprint = Graph ? FBlueprintEditorUtils::FindBlueprintForGraph(Graph) : Cast<UBlueprint>(Target);
		if (!OutBlueprint)
			return UnrealMcpRql::Failed<UEdGraph*>(FString::Printf(TEXT("%s is not a Blueprint or a Blueprint graph"),
				Target ? *Target->GetName() : TEXT("null")));
		if (!OutBlueprint->ParentClass || !OutBlueprint->ParentClass->IsChildOf(AActor::StaticClass()))
			return UnrealMcpRql::Failed<UEdGraph*>(FString::Printf(TEXT("%s is not an actor Blueprint: input events need an actor (a Pawn, a Character, a PlayerController)"),
				*OutBlueprint->GetName()));
		if (!Graph)
			Graph = FBlueprintEditorUtils::FindEventGraph(OutBlueprint);
		if (!Graph || !OutBlueprint->UbergraphPages.Contains(Graph))
			return UnrealMcpRql::Failed<UEdGraph*>(FString::Printf(TEXT("%s is not an event graph of %s (use its EventGraph)"),
				Graph ? *Graph->GetName() : TEXT("the graph"), *OutBlueprint->GetName()));
		return Graph;
	}

	/** A node of @p Class created in @p Graph at @p X, @p Y (@p Configure runs before its pins exist), as the editor's FGraphNodeCreator does. */
	UEdGraphNode* CreateGraphNode(UEdGraph* Graph, UClass* Class, double X, double Y, TFunctionRef<void(UEdGraphNode*)> Configure)
	{
		UEdGraphNode* Node = NewObject<UEdGraphNode>(Graph, Class, NAME_None, RF_Transactional);
		Graph->AddNode(Node, /*bFromUI*/ false, /*bSelectNewNode*/ false);
		Node->NodePosX = FMath::RoundToInt(X);
		Node->NodePosY = FMath::RoundToInt(Y);
		Configure(Node);
		Node->CreateNewGuid();
		Node->PostPlacedNewNode();
		if (Node->Pins.Num() == 0)
			Node->AllocateDefaultPins();
		return Node;
	}

	UK2Node_CallFunction* CreateCallNode(UEdGraph* Graph, UFunction* Function, double X, double Y)
	{
		return CastChecked<UK2Node_CallFunction>(CreateGraphNode(Graph, UK2Node_CallFunction::StaticClass(), X, Y,
			[Function](UEdGraphNode* Node) { CastChecked<UK2Node_CallFunction>(Node)->SetFromFunction(Function); }));
	}

	UEdGraphPin* RequirePin(UEdGraphNode* Node, const FName Name)
	{
		UEdGraphPin* Pin = Node->FindPin(Name);
		if (!Pin)
			UnrealMcpRql::Fail(FString::Printf(TEXT("%s has no pin %s"), *Node->GetNodeTitle(ENodeTitleType::ListView).ToString(), *Name.ToString()));
		return Pin;
	}

	bool Link(UEdGraphPin* A, UEdGraphPin* B)
	{
		if (!A || !B)
			return false;
		const UEdGraphSchema_K2* Schema = GetDefault<UEdGraphSchema_K2>();
		if (Schema->TryCreateConnection(A, B))
			return true;
		UnrealMcpRql::Fail(FString::Printf(TEXT("could not connect %s to %s: %s"), *A->PinName.ToString(), *B->PinName.ToString(),
			*Schema->CanCreateConnection(A, B).Message.ToString()));
		return false;
	}

	/** The Blueprint's existing BeginPlay event (an editor placeholder included), or null. */
	UK2Node_Event* FindBeginPlay(UBlueprint* Blueprint)
	{
		return FBlueprintEditorUtils::FindOverrideForFunction(Blueprint, AActor::StaticClass(), TEXT("ReceiveBeginPlay"));
	}

	/**
	 * A BeginPlay that starts overriding now (new, or the editor's placeholder) would silently drop a parent Blueprint's
	 * BeginPlay: when the parent implements it, Parent: BeginPlay runs first. Returns the exec pin what runs next connects to.
	 */
	UEdGraphPin* CallParentBeginPlay(UBlueprint* Blueprint, UK2Node_Event* Begin, UEdGraphPin* Then)
	{
		UFunction* Inherited = Blueprint->ParentClass ? Blueprint->ParentClass->FindFunctionByName(TEXT("ReceiveBeginPlay")) : nullptr;
		if (!Then || !Inherited || !Cast<UBlueprintGeneratedClass>(Inherited->GetOuterUClass()))
			return Then;
		UK2Node_CallFunction* Parent = CastChecked<UK2Node_CallFunction>(CreateGraphNode(Begin->GetGraph(), UK2Node_CallParentFunction::StaticClass(),
			Begin->NodePosX + 250, Begin->NodePosY, [Inherited](UEdGraphNode* Node) { CastChecked<UK2Node_CallFunction>(Node)->SetFromFunction(Inherited); }));
		UEdGraphPin* ParentExec = Parent->FindPin(UEdGraphSchema_K2::PN_Execute);
		return ParentExec && GetDefault<UEdGraphSchema_K2>()->TryCreateConnection(Then, ParentExec) ? Parent->FindPin(UEdGraphSchema_K2::PN_Then) : Then;
	}

	/** A new BeginPlay event in @p Graph; when a parent Blueprint implements BeginPlay, followed by its Parent: BeginPlay call. Returns the exec pin what runs next connects to. */
	UEdGraphPin* AddBeginPlay(UBlueprint* Blueprint, UEdGraph* Graph, UK2Node_Event*& OutEvent)
	{
		const FName Name(TEXT("ReceiveBeginPlay")); // protected: GET_FUNCTION_NAME_CHECKED cannot name it
		Graph->Modify();
		const FVector2D At = Graph->GetGoodPlaceForNewNode();
		OutEvent = CastChecked<UK2Node_Event>(CreateGraphNode(Graph, UK2Node_Event::StaticClass(), At.X, At.Y, [Name](UEdGraphNode* Node)
		{
			UK2Node_Event* Event = CastChecked<UK2Node_Event>(Node);
			Event->EventReference.SetExternalMember(Name, AActor::StaticClass());
			Event->bOverrideFunction = true;
		}));
		return CallParentBeginPlay(Blueprint, OutEvent, OutEvent->FindPin(UEdGraphSchema_K2::PN_Then));
	}

	/** The Add Mapping Context call node of @p Blueprint that adds @p Context, if any. */
	UK2Node_CallFunction* FindAddMappingContext(UBlueprint* Blueprint, const UInputMappingContext* Context)
	{
		TArray<UK2Node_CallFunction*> Calls;
		FBlueprintEditorUtils::GetAllNodesOfClass(Blueprint, Calls);
		for (UK2Node_CallFunction* Call : Calls)
		{
			const UEdGraphPin* Pin = Call->FunctionReference.GetMemberName() == TEXT("AddMappingContext") ? Call->FindPin(TEXT("MappingContext")) : nullptr;
			if (Pin && Pin->DefaultObject == Context)
				return Call;
		}
		return nullptr;
	}
}

using namespace UnrealAIEnhancedInputRqlLocal;

UInputAction* UUnrealAIEnhancedInputRqlApi::CreateAction(const FString& Path, EInputActionValueType ValueType)
{
	UInputAction* Action = Cast<UInputAction>(UnrealMcpRql::CreateAsset(UInputAction::StaticClass(), Path));
	if (Action)
		Action->ValueType = ValueType;
	return Action;
}

UInputMappingContext* UUnrealAIEnhancedInputRqlApi::CreateContext(const FString& Path)
{
	return Cast<UInputMappingContext>(UnrealMcpRql::CreateAsset(UInputMappingContext::StaticClass(), Path));
}

bool UUnrealAIEnhancedInputRqlApi::AddMapping(UInputMappingContext* Context, UInputAction* Action, const FString& Key)
{
	FKey Parsed;
	if (!ValidKey(Key, Parsed))
		return false;
	Context->Modify();
	Context->MapKey(Action, Parsed);
	Context->MarkPackageDirty();
	return true;
}

int32 UUnrealAIEnhancedInputRqlApi::RemoveMapping(UInputMappingContext* Context, UInputAction* Action, const FString& Key)
{
	FKey Parsed;
	if (!ValidKey(Key, Parsed))
		return 0;
	const int32 Removed = Context->GetMappings().FilterByPredicate([Action, &Parsed](const FEnhancedActionKeyMapping& Mapping)
	{
		return Mapping.Action == Action && Mapping.Key == Parsed;
	}).Num();
	if (Removed > 0)
	{
		Context->Modify();
		// UnmapKey removes one mapping per call; its control-mapping rebuild requests are deferred and coalesce.
		for (int32 Index = 0; Index < Removed; ++Index)
			Context->UnmapKey(Action, Parsed);
		Context->MarkPackageDirty();
	}
	return Removed;
}

UEdGraphNode* UUnrealAIEnhancedInputRqlApi::AddActionEvent(UObject* Graph, UInputAction* Action)
{
	UBlueprint* Blueprint = nullptr;
	UEdGraph* EventGraph = EventGraphOf(Graph, Blueprint);
	if (!EventGraph)
		return nullptr;
	if (!GetDefault<UK2Node_EnhancedInputAction>()->IsCompatibleWithGraph(EventGraph))
		return UnrealMcpRql::Failed<UEdGraphNode*>(FString::Printf(TEXT("%s cannot have input events"), *Blueprint->GetName()));
	TArray<UK2Node_EnhancedInputAction*> Existing;
	FBlueprintEditorUtils::GetAllNodesOfClass(Blueprint, Existing);
	for (const UK2Node_EnhancedInputAction* Node : Existing)
	{
		if (Node->InputAction == Action)
			return UnrealMcpRql::Failed<UEdGraphNode*>(FString::Printf(TEXT("%s already has an action event for %s (one per action: connect more "
				"nodes to its pins; find it with unreal.asset(path).EventGraph | get Nodes | where Title contains \"%s\")"),
				*Blueprint->GetName(), *Action->GetName(), *Action->GetName()));
	}
	EventGraph->Modify();
	const FVector2D At = EventGraph->GetGoodPlaceForNewNode();
	UEdGraphNode* Node = CreateGraphNode(EventGraph, UK2Node_EnhancedInputAction::StaticClass(), At.X, At.Y,
		[Action](UEdGraphNode* Created) { CastChecked<UK2Node_EnhancedInputAction>(Created)->InputAction = Action; });
	FBlueprintEditorUtils::MarkBlueprintAsStructurallyModified(Blueprint);
	return Node;
}

UEdGraphNode* UUnrealAIEnhancedInputRqlApi::AddMappingContextOnBeginPlay(UObject* Blueprint, UInputMappingContext* Context, int32 Priority)
{
	UBlueprint* Owner = nullptr;
	UEdGraph* EventGraph = EventGraphOf(Blueprint, Owner);
	if (!EventGraph)
		return nullptr;
	if (FindAddMappingContext(Owner, Context))
		return UnrealMcpRql::Failed<UEdGraphNode*>(FString::Printf(TEXT("%s already adds %s"), *Owner->GetName(), *Context->GetName()));
	UFunction* AddFunction = UEnhancedInputLocalPlayerSubsystem::StaticClass()->FindFunctionByName(TEXT("AddMappingContext"));
	UFunction* PlayerController = UGameplayStatics::StaticClass()->FindFunctionByName(GET_FUNCTION_NAME_CHECKED(UGameplayStatics, GetPlayerController));
	// The "Enhanced Input Local Player Subsystem" getter node: its class is not exported, so it is found by path.
	UClass* SubsystemNode = FindObject<UClass>(nullptr, TEXT("/Script/BlueprintGraph.K2Node_GetSubsystemFromPC"));
	if (!AddFunction || !PlayerController || !SubsystemNode)
		return UnrealMcpRql::Failed<UEdGraphNode*>(TEXT("this engine version lacks a node Add Mapping Context needs"));
	UK2Node_Event* Begin = FindBeginPlay(Owner);
	if (Begin && !Begin->IsNodeEnabled() && !Begin->IsAutomaticallyPlacedGhostNode())
		return UnrealMcpRql::Failed<UEdGraphNode*>(FString::Printf(TEXT("%s's BeginPlay is disabled: enable it first"), *Owner->GetName()));

	// The new nodes, wired among themselves (a failure here leaves only them, unconnected to the Blueprint's logic).
	UEdGraph* Graph = Begin ? Begin->GetGraph() : EventGraph;
	Graph->Modify();
	const FVector2D Origin = Begin ? FVector2D(Begin->NodePosX, Begin->NodePosY) : FVector2D(Graph->GetGoodPlaceForNewNode());
	const double X = Origin.X;
	const double Y = Origin.Y;
	UK2Node_CallFunction* GetController = CreateCallNode(Graph, PlayerController, X + 40, Y + 160);
	UEdGraphNode* GetSubsystem = CreateGraphNode(Graph, SubsystemNode, X + 300, Y + 160, [](UEdGraphNode* Node)
	{
		CastChecked<UK2Node_GetSubsystem>(Node)->Initialize(UEnhancedInputLocalPlayerSubsystem::StaticClass());
	});
	UK2Node_CallFunction* Add = CreateCallNode(Graph, AddFunction, X + 620, Y);
	const UEdGraphSchema_K2* Schema = GetDefault<UEdGraphSchema_K2>();
	UEdGraphPin* ContextPin = RequirePin(Add, TEXT("MappingContext"));
	UEdGraphPin* PriorityPin = RequirePin(Add, TEXT("Priority"));
	UEdGraphPin* AddExec = RequirePin(Add, UEdGraphSchema_K2::PN_Execute);
	UEdGraphPin* AddThen = RequirePin(Add, UEdGraphSchema_K2::PN_Then);
	if (!ContextPin || !PriorityPin || !AddExec || !AddThen)
		return nullptr;
	Schema->TrySetDefaultObject(*ContextPin, Context);
	Schema->TrySetDefaultValue(*PriorityPin, FString::FromInt(Priority));
	if (!Link(RequirePin(GetController, UEdGraphSchema_K2::PN_ReturnValue), RequirePin(GetSubsystem, TEXT("PlayerController")))
		|| !Link(RequirePin(GetSubsystem, UEdGraphSchema_K2::PN_ReturnValue), RequirePin(Add, UEdGraphSchema_K2::PN_Self)))
		return nullptr;

	// Then BeginPlay, checked before it changes: what it ran before now follows Add Mapping Context.
	UEdGraphPin* Then = nullptr;
	TArray<UEdGraphPin*> Before;
	if (Begin)
	{
		Then = RequirePin(Begin, UEdGraphSchema_K2::PN_Then);
		if (!Then)
			return nullptr;
		Before = Then->LinkedTo;
		for (UEdGraphPin* Next : Before)
		{
			if (Schema->CanCreateConnection(AddThen, Next).Response == CONNECT_RESPONSE_DISALLOW)
				return UnrealMcpRql::Failed<UEdGraphNode*>(FString::Printf(TEXT("cannot move %s after Add Mapping Context"), *Next->GetOwningNode()->GetNodeTitle(ENodeTitleType::ListView).ToString()));
		}
		Begin->Modify();
		Schema->BreakPinLinks(*Then, /*bSendsNodeNotifcation*/ true);
		if (!Begin->IsNodeEnabled() || Begin->IsAutomaticallyPlacedGhostNode())
		{
			Begin->SetEnabledState(ENodeEnabledState::Enabled, /*bUserAction*/ false);
			Begin->NodeComment.Empty(); // the placeholder's "This node is disabled ..." comment
			Begin->bCommentBubbleVisible = false;
			Then = CallParentBeginPlay(Owner, Begin, Then); // the placeholder starts overriding now
		}
	}
	else
	{
		Then = AddBeginPlay(Owner, Graph, Begin);
	}
	if (!Link(Then, AddExec))
		return nullptr;
	for (UEdGraphPin* Next : Before)
	{
		if (!Link(AddThen, Next))
			return nullptr;
	}
	FBlueprintEditorUtils::MarkBlueprintAsStructurallyModified(Owner);
	return Add;
}

```h
// Copyright (c) 2026 IvanMurzak/Unreal-AI-EnhancedInput. Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.
// See the LICENSE file in the repository root for more information.

#pragma once

#include "CoreMinimal.h"
#include "InputActionValue.h"
#include "UObject/Object.h"

#include "UnrealAIEnhancedInputRqlApi.generated.h"

class UEdGraphNode;
class UInputAction;
class UInputMappingContext;

/**
 * The `enhancedInput` RQL source (type "EnhancedInputOperations"): Enhanced Input authoring without an owner object,
 * e.g. `enhancedInput | call CreateAction("/Game/Input/IA_Jump", "Boolean")`. Every UFUNCTION here is callable from
 * rql-mutate (Unreal-MCP's IUnrealMcpRqlModule::AddApiClass); the doc comment is the description agents see.
 * BlueprintCallable only so UHT records the C++ default arguments; BlueprintInternalUseOnly keeps them out of menus.
 */
UCLASS(Transient)
class UUnrealAIEnhancedInputRqlApi : public UObject
{
	GENERATED_BODY()

public:
	/** create an Input Action asset at Path ("/Game/Input/IA_Jump") with a value type (Boolean, Axis1D, Axis2D, Axis3D); returns it (unsaved) */
	UFUNCTION(BlueprintCallable, Category = "Unreal AI|Enhanced Input", meta = (BlueprintInternalUseOnly = "true"))
	UInputAction* CreateAction(const FString& Path, EInputActionValueType ValueType = EInputActionValueType::Boolean);

	/** create an Input Mapping Context asset at Path ("/Game/Input/IMC_Default"); returns it (unsaved) */
	UFUNCTION(BlueprintCallable, Category = "Unreal AI|Enhanced Input", meta = (BlueprintInternalUseOnly = "true"))
	UInputMappingContext* CreateContext(const FString& Path);

	/** map a key ("SpaceBar", "W", "Gamepad_FaceButton_Bottom") to an action in a mapping context */
	UFUNCTION(BlueprintCallable, Category = "Unreal AI|Enhanced Input", meta = (BlueprintInternalUseOnly = "true"))
	bool AddMapping(UInputMappingContext* Context, UInputAction* Action, const FString& Key);

	/** remove every mapping of a key to an action from a mapping context; returns how many were removed */
	UFUNCTION(BlueprintCallable, Category = "Unreal AI|Enhanced Input", meta = (BlueprintInternalUseOnly = "true"))
	int32 RemoveMapping(UInputMappingContext* Context, UInputAction* Action, const FString& Key);

	/** add an Enhanced Input action event for Action to an actor Blueprint's event graph (the Blueprint, its path, or unreal.asset(path).EventGraph), as the Blueprint editor's "EnhancedInputAction IA_Jump" node: exec pins Triggered, Started, Ongoing, Canceled, Completed and the ActionValue; wire it with ref(node) | call Connect("Triggered", ref(other), "execute"); fires on the pawn the player controls once its mapping context is added (AddMappingContextOnBeginPlay); returns the node */
	UFUNCTION(BlueprintCallable, Category = "Unreal AI|Enhanced Input", meta = (BlueprintInternalUseOnly = "true"))
	UEdGraphNode* AddActionEvent(UObject* Graph, UInputAction* Action);

	/** make an actor Blueprint (or its path, or its event graph) add a mapping context when play starts: Event BeginPlay -> Get Player Controller (0) -> Enhanced Input Local Player Subsystem -> Add Mapping Context (Context, Priority), placed before what BeginPlay already runs; without it no action event fires; returns the Add Mapping Context node */
	UFUNCTION(BlueprintCallable, Category = "Unreal AI|Enhanced Input", meta = (BlueprintInternalUseOnly = "true"))
	UEdGraphNode* AddMappingContextOnBeginPlay(UObject* Blueprint, UInputMappingContext* Context, int32 Priority = 0);
};

// Copyright (c) 2026 IvanMurzak/Unreal-AI-EnhancedInput. Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.
// See the LICENSE file in the repository root for more information.

using UnrealBuildTool;

public class UnrealAIEnhancedInput : ModuleRules
{
	public UnrealAIEnhancedInput(ReadOnlyTargetRules Target) : base(Target)
	{
		PCHUsage = ModuleRules.PCHUsageMode.UseExplicitOrSharedPCHs;

		PublicDependencyModuleNames.AddRange(new string[]
		{
			"Core",
		});

		PrivateDependencyModuleNames.AddRange(new string[]
		{
			"CoreUObject",
			"Engine",
			// FJsonValue: the KeyMappings member.
			"Json",
			// The RQL module seam: IUnrealMcpRqlModule.h (sources, operations, members, guides, the editor-module template)
			// and UnrealMcpRqlTools.h (the specs run plans) live in the Unreal-MCP plugin's UnrealMcpRql module; the
			// matching `UnrealMCP` plugin dependency is in the .uplugin "Plugins" array.
			"UnrealMcpRql",

			// The gating engine plugin's runtime module (its { "Name": "EnhancedInput" } entry is in the .uplugin
			// "Plugins" array): UInputAction / UInputMappingContext for the inputActions / inputContexts sources and the
			// CreateAction / CreateContext / AddMapping / RemoveMapping operations.
			"EnhancedInput",
			// FKey: the Key argument of AddMapping / RemoveMapping.
			"InputCore",
			// Blueprint graph authoring (AddActionEvent / AddMappingContextOnBeginPlay): K2 nodes and the schema
			// (BlueprintGraph), FBlueprintEditorUtils (UnrealEd), and the "EnhancedInputAction" event node, which lives in the
			// EnhancedInput plugin's UncookedOnly InputBlueprintNodes module (this extension is editor-only). Kept here, not in
			// Unreal-MCP's core: extra engine dependencies belong to the extension that needs them.
			"BlueprintGraph",
			"UnrealEd",
			"InputBlueprintNodes",
		});
	}
}

# E2E check of the extension's RQL module (Unreal-MCP docs/rql.md). Returned to scripts/run-extension-e2e.ps1, which
# invokes `unreal-mcp-cli run-tool rql-query` against the running project's MCP server and asserts a well-formed success.
@{
    Tool   = "rql-query"
    System = $false
    Input  = '{"query":"inputActions | count"}'
    Assert = {
        param($Result)
        $serialized = $Result | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 20 -Compress
        if ($serialized -notmatch '"text"\s*:\s*"\d+"|value\\?"\s*:\s*\d') {
            throw "expected the count of Input Actions; got: $serialized"
        }
    }
}

`extensions/UnrealAIGAS/README.md`:

```md
# GAS RQL module

RQL module for Unreal's Gameplay Ability System: query ability, effect and attribute-set classes and granted abilities, grant abilities to actors.

An optional editor plugin in the [Unreal MCP monorepository](../../README.md), with its own module, version and release archive.

## Requirements

- Unreal Engine 5.7 or later (the shared extension suite verifies UE 5.7 and 5.8).
- Unreal MCP 1.0.0 or later (the RQL data layer), installed in the same project.
- Engine plugins: `GameplayAbilities`. The installer enables these dependencies.
- A C++ toolchain for your Unreal Engine installation. Extension releases contain source files and must be compiled for your project and engine.

## Install

With the Unreal Editor closed:

```sh
npm install -g unreal-mcp-cli
unreal-mcp-cli install-plugin "<UEProject>"
unreal-mcp-cli install-extension com.ivanmurzak.unreal-ai-gas "<UEProject>"
```

Replace `<UEProject>` with the project directory. The installer selects this extension's latest indexed version independently of the core and other extensions. Use `--version X.Y.Z` to select a published historical version, or `--build` to compile after installation. Otherwise rebuild the project before opening the editor.

The plugin is installed under `Plugins/UnrealAIGAS/`. Connect Unreal MCP to your AI client to use the RQL module below.

## RQL module

The extension adds its feature to the editor's RQL data layer (`rql-query` / `rql-mutate` / `rql-schema`, [docs/rql.md](../../docs/rql.md)) instead of separate tools; its guide is part of the `unreal-rql` skill.

| Kind | Names |
| --- | --- |
| Sources | `gasAbilities`, `gasEffects`, `gasAttributeSets`, `gas` |
| Operations (`call`) | `GrantAbility` |
| Members | `AbilitySystemComponent.GrantedAbilities` |

```
gasAbilities | select $type InstancingPolicy CostGameplayEffectClass
actors | get Components | where $ is AbilitySystemComponent | select Owner.Label GrantedAbilities
gas | call GrantAbility("Hero", "GA_Fireball_C", 2)
```

## Releases and development

Each extension has its own versioned source ZIP in [Unreal MCP Releases](https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Unreal-MCP/releases). The shared release index records the latest version, historical releases and archive checksums; unchanged extensions are not copied into other component releases.

See the [monorepository and test guide](../../docs/EXTENSION-MONOREPO.md) for independent publication, isolated compilation and the combined one-editor test suite. See [extension development](../../docs/EXTENSIONS.md) for the RQL module API.

Licensed under [Apache License 2.0](LICENSE).

```

`extensions/UnrealAIGAS/Source/UnrealAIGAS/Private/Tests/UnrealAIGASSpec.cpp`:

```cpp
// Copyright (c) 2026 IvanMurzak/Unreal-AI-GAS. Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.
// See the LICENSE file in the repository root for more information.

#if WITH_DEV_AUTOMATION_TESTS

#include "CoreMinimal.h"
#include "Misc/AutomationTest.h"
#include "Dom/JsonObject.h"

#include "IUnrealMcpRqlModule.h"
#include "UnrealMcpRqlTools.h"

// ============================================================================================
//  UE Automation spec for the extension's RQL module (Unreal-MCP docs/rql.md "Extensions").
//
//  The spec discovers THIS extension's live module through IModularFeatures (the path Unreal-MCP uses) and runs RQL
//  QueryPlans through the editor's RQL engine (UnrealMcpRqlTools::RunPlan). The C++ runtime has no text parser, so
//  each plan is the one Rql.Parser produces for the query in the comment above it.
//
//  Run via:  Automation RunTests UnrealAIGAS
// ============================================================================================

BEGIN_DEFINE_SPEC(FUnrealAIGASSpec, "UnrealAIGAS",
	EAutomationTestFlags::EditorContext | EAutomationTestFlags::ProductFilter)
END_DEFINE_SPEC(FUnrealAIGASSpec)

void FUnrealAIGASSpec::Define()
{
	Describe("RQL module", [this]()
	{
		It("registers this extension's RQL module as a modular feature", [this]()
		{
			IUnrealMcpRqlModule* Module = UnrealMcpRqlTools::FindModule(TEXT("com.ivanmurzak.unreal-ai-gas"));
			if (TestNotNull(TEXT("RQL module is registered"), Module))
			{
				TestEqual(TEXT("module name"), Module->GetRqlModuleName(), FString(TEXT("GAS")));
				TestFalse(TEXT("version reported"), Module->GetExtensionVersion().IsEmpty());
			}
		});

		It("adds its sources and guide to the unreal-rql skill", [this]()
		{
			const FString Skill = UnrealMcpRqlTools::SkillMarkdown();
			TestTrue(TEXT("| `gasAbilities` |"), Skill.Contains(TEXT("| `gasAbilities` |")));
			TestTrue(TEXT("| `gasEffects` |"), Skill.Contains(TEXT("| `gasEffects` |")));
			TestTrue(TEXT("| `gasAttributeSets` |"), Skill.Contains(TEXT("| `gasAttributeSets` |")));
			TestTrue(TEXT("| `gas` |"), Skill.Contains(TEXT("| `gas` |")));
			TestTrue(TEXT("## Gameplay Ability System"), Skill.Contains(TEXT("## Gameplay Ability System")));
		});
	});

	Describe("sources", [this]()
	{
		It("gasAbilities answers a query", [this]()
		{
			// gasAbilities | count
			TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> Result;
			const bool bResultOk = UnrealMcpRqlTools::RunPlan(TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"path":["gasAbilities"]},"stages":[{"op":"count"}]})RQL"), false, &Result);
			TestTrue(TEXT("a well-formed result"), Result.IsValid());
			TestTrue(TEXT("succeeds"), bResultOk);
		});

		It("gasEffects answers a query", [this]()
		{
			// gasEffects | count
			TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> Result;
			const bool bResultOk = UnrealMcpRqlTools::RunPlan(TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"path":["gasEffects"]},"stages":[{"op":"count"}]})RQL"), false, &Result);
			TestTrue(TEXT("a well-formed result"), Result.IsValid());
			TestTrue(TEXT("succeeds"), bResultOk);
		});

		It("gasAttributeSets answers a query", [this]()
		{
			// gasAttributeSets | count
			TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> Result;
			const bool bResultOk = UnrealMcpRqlTools::RunPlan(TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"path":["gasAttributeSets"]},"stages":[{"op":"count"}]})RQL"), false, &Result);
			TestTrue(TEXT("a well-formed result"), Result.IsValid());
			TestTrue(TEXT("succeeds"), bResultOk);
		});

		It("describes AbilitySystemComponent with its GrantedAbilities member", [this]()
		{
			bool bOk = false;
			const FString Schema = UnrealMcpRqlTools::Schema(TEXT("AbilitySystemComponent"), bOk);
			TestTrue(TEXT("schema ok"), bOk);
			TestTrue(TEXT("lists name:GrantedAbilities"), Schema.Contains(TEXT("\"name\":\"GrantedAbilities\"")));
		});
	});

	Describe("operation: GrantAbility", [this]()
	{
		It("is listed as an operation of the gas source", [this]()
		{
			bool bOk = false;
			const FString Schema = UnrealMcpRqlTools::Schema(TEXT("GASOperations"), bOk);
			TestTrue(TEXT("schema ok"), bOk);
			TestTrue(TEXT("lists GrantAbility("), Schema.Contains(TEXT("GrantAbility(")));
		});

		It("fails defensively on an unknown actor", [this]()
		{
			// gas | call GrantAbility("RqlSpecNoActor", "GameplayAbility")
			TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> Result;
			const bool bResultOk = UnrealMcpRqlTools::RunPlan(TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"path":["gas"]},"stages":[{"op":"call","method":"GrantAbility","args":[{"lit":"RqlSpecNoActor"},{"lit":"GameplayAbility"}]}]})RQL"), true, &Result);
			TestTrue(TEXT("a well-formed result"), Result.IsValid());
			TestFalse(TEXT("fails defensively"), bResultOk);
		});
	});
}

#endif // WITH_DEV_AUTOMATION_TESTS

`extensions/UnrealAIGAS/Source/UnrealAIGAS/Private/UnrealAIGASModule.cpp`:

```cpp
// Copyright (c) 2026 IvanMurzak/Unreal-AI-GAS. Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.
// See the LICENSE file in the repository root for more information.

#include "Modules/ModuleManager.h"
#include "Dom/JsonObject.h"
#include "Dom/JsonValue.h"

#include "IUnrealMcpRqlModule.h"
#include "UnrealAIGASRqlApi.h"

#include "Abilities/GameplayAbility.h"
#include "AbilitySystemComponent.h"
#include "AttributeSet.h"
#include "GameplayAbilitySpec.h"
#include "GameplayEffect.h"

/**
 * The extension's RQL module (Unreal-MCP docs/rql.md "Extensions"): the Gameplay Ability System is queried and changed
 * with rql-query / rql-mutate instead of dedicated tools. Reflection exposes the ability / effect / attribute-set
 * properties on their class defaults (tags, instancing policy, cost and cooldown effects, attributes, ...); the module
 * adds the class-default sources, the `gas` operations, an AbilitySystemComponent's granted abilities (not a
 * reflected property) and the agent guide rendered into the unreal-rql skill.
 *
 * The version is the .uplugin VersionName.
 */
class FUnrealAIGASRqlModule : public IUnrealMcpRqlModule
{
public:
	virtual FString GetRqlModuleName() const override { return TEXT("GAS"); }
	virtual FString GetExtensionId() const override { return TEXT("com.ivanmurzak.unreal-ai-gas"); }
	virtual FString GetExtensionVersion() const override { return UnrealMcpRql::PluginVersion(TEXT("UnrealAIGAS")); }

	virtual void ConfigureRql(FUnrealMcpRqlModuleContext& Context) override
	{
		Context.AddClassDefaultsSource(TEXT("gasAbilities"),
			TEXT("the class defaults of every Gameplay Ability class (native and the project's Blueprints), at most 200"),
			UGameplayAbility::StaticClass());
		Context.AddClassDefaultsSource(TEXT("gasEffects"),
			TEXT("the class defaults of every Gameplay Effect class (native and the project's Blueprints), at most 200"),
			UGameplayEffect::StaticClass());
		Context.AddClassDefaultsSource(TEXT("gasAttributeSets"),
			TEXT("the class defaults of every Attribute Set class (native and the project's Blueprints), at most 200"),
			UAttributeSet::StaticClass());
		Context.AddApiSource(TEXT("gas"), TEXT("Gameplay Ability System operations: call GrantAbility(actor, abilityClass, level)"),
			UUnrealAIGASRqlApi::StaticClass(), TEXT("GASOperations"));
		Context.AddJsonMember(UAbilitySystemComponent::StaticClass(), TEXT("GrantedAbilities"),
			TEXT("the abilities granted to this component: Ability (class), Level, Handle"),
			[](UObject* Object) -> TSharedPtr<FJsonValue>
			{
				TArray<TSharedPtr<FJsonValue>> Granted;
				if (const UAbilitySystemComponent* Asc = Cast<UAbilitySystemComponent>(Object))
				{
					for (const FGameplayAbilitySpec& Spec : Asc->GetActivatableAbilities())
					{
						TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> Entry = MakeShared<FJsonObject>();
						Entry->SetStringField(TEXT("Ability"), Spec.Ability ? Spec.Ability->GetClass()->GetName() : FString());
						Entry->SetNumberField(TEXT("Level"), Spec.Level);
						Entry->SetStringField(TEXT("Handle"), Spec.Handle.ToString());
						Granted.Add(MakeShared<FJsonValueObject>(Entry));
					}
				}
				return MakeShared<FJsonValueArray>(Granted);
			});
		Context.AddGuide(TEXT("Gameplay Ability System"), TEXT(R"MD(Abilities, effects and attribute sets are classes: their sources list the class defaults, whose members are the
reflected properties (`$type` is the class). Ability System Components are components:
`actors | get Components | where $ is AbilitySystemComponent`.

```
gasAbilities | select $type InstancingPolicy NetExecutionPolicy CostGameplayEffectClass CooldownGameplayEffectClass
gasEffects | select $type DurationPolicy Period
gasAttributeSets | select $type
actors | get Components | where $ is AbilitySystemComponent | select Owner.Label GrantedAbilities
gas | call GrantAbility("Hero", "GA_Fireball_C", 2)          actor (label, name or ref), ability class, level
```

Blueprint ability classes are named with a `_C` suffix (GA_Fireball_C) or by their asset path ("/Game/Abilities/GA_Fireball").
Granting needs an actor with an authoritative AbilitySystemComponent; it changes the editor-world actor only.)MD"));
	}
};

IMPLEMENT_MODULE(TUnrealMcpRqlEditorModule<FUnrealAIGASRqlModule>, UnrealAIGAS)

```

`extensions/UnrealAIGAS/Source/UnrealAIGAS/Private/UnrealAIGASRqlApi.cpp`:

```cpp
// Copyright (c) 2026 IvanMurzak/Unreal-AI-GAS. Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.
// See the LICENSE file in the repository root for more information.

#include "UnrealAIGASRqlApi.h"

#include "IUnrealMcpRqlModule.h"

#include "Abilities/GameplayAbility.h"
#include "AbilitySystemComponent.h"
#include "AbilitySystemInterface.h"
#include "GameFramework/Actor.h"
#include "GameplayAbilitySpec.h"

FString UUnrealAIGASRqlApi::GrantAbility(AActor* Actor, TSubclassOf<UGameplayAbility> Ability, int32 Level)
{
	using UnrealMcpRql::Failed;
	UAbilitySystemComponent* Asc = nullptr;
	if (const IAbilitySystemInterface* WithAsc = Cast<IAbilitySystemInterface>(Actor))
		Asc = WithAsc->GetAbilitySystemComponent();
	if (!Asc)
		Asc = Actor->FindComponentByClass<UAbilitySystemComponent>();
	if (!Asc)
		return Failed<FString>(FString::Printf(TEXT("%s has no AbilitySystemComponent"), *Actor->GetActorNameOrLabel()));
	if (!Asc->IsOwnerActorAuthoritative())
		return Failed<FString>(FString::Printf(TEXT("the AbilitySystemComponent of %s is not authoritative"), *Actor->GetActorNameOrLabel()));
	const FGameplayAbilitySpecHandle Handle = Asc->GiveAbility(FGameplayAbilitySpec(Ability, FMath::Max(Level, 1)));
	if (!Handle.IsValid())
		return Failed<FString>(FString::Printf(TEXT("could not grant %s"), *Ability->GetName()));
	return Handle.ToString();
}

// Copyright (c) 2026 IvanMurzak/Unreal-AI-GAS. Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.

#pragma once

#include "CoreMinimal.h"
#include "Templates/SubclassOf.h"
#include "UObject/Object.h"

#include "UnrealAIGASRqlApi.generated.h"

class AActor;
class UGameplayAbility;

/**
 * The `gas` RQL source (type "GASOperations"): Gameplay Ability System operations without an owner object, e.g.
 * `gas | call GrantAbility("Hero", "GA_Fireball_C")`. Every UFUNCTION here is callable from rql-mutate (Unreal-MCP's
 * IUnrealMcpRqlModule::AddApiClass); the doc comment is the description agents see. BlueprintCallable only so UHT
 * records the C++ default arguments; BlueprintInternalUseOnly keeps them out of Blueprint menus.
 */
UCLASS(Transient)
class UUnrealAIGASRqlApi : public UObject
{
	GENERATED_BODY()

public:
	/** grant a Gameplay Ability class to an actor's AbilitySystemComponent (the actor needs one) at Level; returns the spec handle */
	UFUNCTION(BlueprintCallable, Category = "Unreal AI|GAS", meta = (BlueprintInternalUseOnly = "true"))
	FString GrantAbility(AActor* Actor, TSubclassOf<UGameplayAbility> Ability, int32 Level = 1);
};

`extensions/UnrealAIGAS/Source/UnrealAIGAS/UnrealAIGAS.Build.cs`:

```cs
// Copyright (c) 2026 IvanMurzak/Unreal-AI-GAS. Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.
// See the LICENSE file in the repository root for more information.

using UnrealBuildTool;

public class UnrealAIGAS : ModuleRules
{
	public UnrealAIGAS(ReadOnlyTargetRules Target) : base(Target)
	{
		PCHUsage = ModuleRules.PCHUsageMode.UseExplicitOrSharedPCHs;

		PublicDependencyModuleNames.AddRange(new string[]
		{
			"Core",
		});

		PrivateDependencyModuleNames.AddRange(new string[]
		{
			"CoreUObject",
			"Engine",
			// FJsonValue: the GrantedAbilities member.
			"Json",
			// The RQL module seam: IUnrealMcpRqlModule.h (sources, operations, members, guides, the editor-module template)
			// and UnrealMcpRqlTools.h (the specs run plans) live in the Unreal-MCP plugin's UnrealMcpRql module; the
			// matching `UnrealMCP` plugin dependency is in the .uplugin "Plugins" array.
			"UnrealMcpRql",

			// The gating engine plugin's runtime module (its { "Name": "GameplayAbilities" } entry is in the .uplugin
			// "Plugins" array): UGameplayAbility / UGameplayEffect / UAttributeSet for the class-default sources,
			// UAbilitySystemComponent for GrantedAbilities and the GrantAbility operation.
			"GameplayAbilities",
		});
	}
}

```ps1
# E2E check of the extension's RQL module (Unreal-MCP docs/rql.md). Returned to scripts/run-extension-e2e.ps1, which
# invokes `unreal-mcp-cli run-tool rql-query` against the running project's MCP server and asserts a well-formed success.
@{
    Tool   = "rql-query"
    System = $false
    Input  = '{"query":"gasAbilities | count"}'
    Assert = {
        param($Result)
        $serialized = $Result | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 20 -Compress
        if ($serialized -notmatch '"text"\s*:\s*"\d+"|value\\?"\s*:\s*\d') {
            throw "expected the count of Gameplay Ability classes; got: $serialized"
        }
    }
}

`extensions/UnrealAILandscape/README.md`:

```md
# Landscape RQL module

RQL module for Unreal's Landscape and Water systems: query landscapes (sections, paint layers), water bodies and water zones.

An optional editor plugin in the [Unreal MCP monorepository](../../README.md), with its own module, version and release archive.

## Requirements

- Unreal Engine 5.7 or later (the shared extension suite verifies UE 5.7 and 5.8).
- Unreal MCP 1.0.0 or later (the RQL data layer), installed in the same project.
- Engine plugins: `Water`. The installer enables these dependencies.
- A C++ toolchain for your Unreal Engine installation. Extension releases contain source files and must be compiled for your project and engine.

## Install

With the Unreal Editor closed:

```sh
npm install -g unreal-mcp-cli
unreal-mcp-cli install-plugin "<UEProject>"
unreal-mcp-cli install-extension com.ivanmurzak.unreal-ai-landscape "<UEProject>"
```

Replace `<UEProject>` with the project directory. The installer selects this extension's latest indexed version independently of the core and other extensions. Use `--version X.Y.Z` to select a published historical version, or `--build` to compile after installation. Otherwise rebuild the project before opening the editor.

The plugin is installed under `Plugins/UnrealAILandscape/`. Connect Unreal MCP to your AI client to use the RQL module below.

## RQL module

The extension adds its feature to the editor's RQL data layer (`rql-query` / `rql-mutate` / `rql-schema`, [docs/rql.md](../../docs/rql.md)) instead of separate tools; its guide is part of the `unreal-rql` skill.

| Kind | Names |
| --- | --- |
| Sources | `landscapes`, `waterBodies`, `waterZones` |
| Members | `LandscapeProxy.IsPrimary`, `LandscapeProxy.ComponentCount`, `LandscapeProxy.Sections`, `LandscapeProxy.PaintLayers`, `WaterBody.WaterType`, `WaterBody.WaterMaterial`, `WaterBody.WaterZone`, `WaterBody.Water` |

```
landscapes | select Label Sections PaintLayers LandscapeMaterial
waterBodies | select Label Water
waterZones | select Label ZoneExtent
```

## Releases and development

Each extension has its own versioned source ZIP in [Unreal MCP Releases](https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Unreal-MCP/releases). The shared release index records the latest version, historical releases and archive checksums; unchanged extensions are not copied into other component releases.

See the [monorepository and test guide](../../docs/EXTENSION-MONOREPO.md) for independent publication, isolated compilation and the combined one-editor test suite. See [extension development](../../docs/EXTENSIONS.md) for the RQL module API.

Licensed under [Apache License 2.0](LICENSE).

```

`extensions/UnrealAILandscape/Source/UnrealAILandscape/Private/Tests/UnrealAILandscapeSpec.cpp`:

```cpp
// Copyright (c) 2026 IvanMurzak/Unreal-AI-Landscape. Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.
// See the LICENSE file in the repository root for more information.

#if WITH_DEV_AUTOMATION_TESTS

#include "CoreMinimal.h"
#include "Misc/AutomationTest.h"
#include "Dom/JsonObject.h"

#include "IUnrealMcpRqlModule.h"
#include "UnrealMcpRqlTools.h"

// ============================================================================================
//  UE Automation spec for the extension's RQL module (Unreal-MCP docs/rql.md "Extensions").
//
//  The spec discovers THIS extension's live module through IModularFeatures (the path Unreal-MCP uses) and runs RQL
//  QueryPlans through the editor's RQL engine (UnrealMcpRqlTools::RunPlan). The C++ runtime has no text parser, so
//  each plan is the one Rql.Parser produces for the query in the comment above it.
//
//  Run via:  Automation RunTests UnrealAILandscape
// ============================================================================================

BEGIN_DEFINE_SPEC(FUnrealAILandscapeSpec, "UnrealAILandscape",
	EAutomationTestFlags::EditorContext | EAutomationTestFlags::ProductFilter)
END_DEFINE_SPEC(FUnrealAILandscapeSpec)

void FUnrealAILandscapeSpec::Define()
{
	Describe("RQL module", [this]()
	{
		It("registers this extension's RQL module as a modular feature", [this]()
		{
			IUnrealMcpRqlModule* Module = UnrealMcpRqlTools::FindModule(TEXT("com.ivanmurzak.unreal-ai-landscape"));
			if (TestNotNull(TEXT("RQL module is registered"), Module))
			{
				TestEqual(TEXT("module name"), Module->GetRqlModuleName(), FString(TEXT("Landscape")));
				TestFalse(TEXT("version reported"), Module->GetExtensionVersion().IsEmpty());
			}
		});

		It("adds its sources and guide to the unreal-rql skill", [this]()
		{
			const FString Skill = UnrealMcpRqlTools::SkillMarkdown();
			TestTrue(TEXT("| `landscapes` |"), Skill.Contains(TEXT("| `landscapes` |")));
			TestTrue(TEXT("| `waterBodies` |"), Skill.Contains(TEXT("| `waterBodies` |")));
			TestTrue(TEXT("| `waterZones` |"), Skill.Contains(TEXT("| `waterZones` |")));
			TestTrue(TEXT("## Landscape and Water"), Skill.Contains(TEXT("## Landscape and Water")));
		});
	});

	Describe("sources", [this]()
	{
		It("landscapes answers a query", [this]()
		{
			// landscapes | count
			TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> Result;
			const bool bResultOk = UnrealMcpRqlTools::RunPlan(TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"path":["landscapes"]},"stages":[{"op":"count"}]})RQL"), false, &Result);
			TestTrue(TEXT("a well-formed result"), Result.IsValid());
			TestTrue(TEXT("succeeds"), bResultOk);
		});

		It("waterBodies answers a query", [this]()
		{
			// waterBodies | count
			TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> Result;
			const bool bResultOk = UnrealMcpRqlTools::RunPlan(TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"path":["waterBodies"]},"stages":[{"op":"count"}]})RQL"), false, &Result);
			TestTrue(TEXT("a well-formed result"), Result.IsValid());
			TestTrue(TEXT("succeeds"), bResultOk);
		});

		It("waterZones answers a query", [this]()
		{
			// waterZones | count
			TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> Result;
			const bool bResultOk = UnrealMcpRqlTools::RunPlan(TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"path":["waterZones"]},"stages":[{"op":"count"}]})RQL"), false, &Result);
			TestTrue(TEXT("a well-formed result"), Result.IsValid());
			TestTrue(TEXT("succeeds"), bResultOk);
		});
	});

	Describe("members", [this]()
	{
		It("describes LandscapeProxy with its Sections and PaintLayers members", [this]()
		{
			bool bOk = false;
			const FString Schema = UnrealMcpRqlTools::Schema(TEXT("LandscapeProxy"), bOk);
			TestTrue(TEXT("schema ok"), bOk);
			TestTrue(TEXT("lists name:Sections"), Schema.Contains(TEXT("\"name\":\"Sections\"")));
			TestTrue(TEXT("lists name:IsPrimary"), Schema.Contains(TEXT("\"name\":\"IsPrimary\"")));
			TestTrue(TEXT("lists name:ComponentCount"), Schema.Contains(TEXT("\"name\":\"ComponentCount\"")));
			TestTrue(TEXT("lists name:PaintLayers"), Schema.Contains(TEXT("\"name\":\"PaintLayers\"")));
		});

		It("describes WaterBody with its Water member", [this]()
		{
			bool bOk = false;
			const FString Schema = UnrealMcpRqlTools::Schema(TEXT("WaterBody"), bOk);
			TestTrue(TEXT("schema ok"), bOk);
			TestTrue(TEXT("lists name:Water"), Schema.Contains(TEXT("\"name\":\"Water\"")));
			TestTrue(TEXT("lists name:WaterType"), Schema.Contains(TEXT("\"name\":\"WaterType\"")));
			TestTrue(TEXT("lists name:WaterZone"), Schema.Contains(TEXT("\"name\":\"WaterZone\"")));
		});
	});
}

#endif // WITH_DEV_AUTOMATION_TESTS

`extensions/UnrealAILandscape/Source/UnrealAILandscape/Private/UnrealAILandscapeModule.cpp`:

```cpp
// Copyright (c) 2026 IvanMurzak/Unreal-AI-Landscape. Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.
// See the LICENSE file in the repository root for more information.

#include "Modules/ModuleManager.h"
#include "Dom/JsonObject.h"
#include "Dom/JsonValue.h"

#include "IUnrealMcpRqlModule.h"

#include "Engine/World.h"
#include "EngineUtils.h"               // TActorIterator
#include "Landscape.h"                 // ALandscape (the primary landscape actor)
#include "LandscapeInfo.h"             // ULandscapeInfo + FLandscapeInfoLayerSettings (paint layers)
#include "LandscapeProxy.h"            // ALandscapeProxy (+ streaming proxies)
#include "Materials/MaterialInterface.h"
#include "WaterBodyActor.h"            // AWaterBody
#include "WaterBodyComponent.h"        // UWaterBodyComponent + EWaterBodyType
#include "WaterBodyTypes.h"            // EWaterBodyType
#include "WaterSplineComponent.h"      // UWaterSplineComponent (a USplineComponent)
#include "WaterZoneActor.h"            // AWaterZone

namespace UnrealAILandscapeRqlLocal
{
	/** Every actor of class T in the editor world (the persistent level and loaded sublevels). */
	template <typename T>
	TArray<UObject*> EditorActors()
	{
		TArray<UObject*> Out;
		UWorld* World = UnrealMcpRql::EditorWorld();
		if (!World)
			return Out;
		for (TActorIterator<T> It(World); It; ++It)
		{
			if (IsValid(*It))
				Out.Add(*It);
		}
		return Out;
	}

	const TCHAR* WaterBodyTypeName(EWaterBodyType Type)
	{
		switch (Type)
		{
		case EWaterBodyType::River:      return TEXT("River");
		case EWaterBodyType::Lake:       return TEXT("Lake");
		case EWaterBodyType::Ocean:      return TEXT("Ocean");
		case EWaterBodyType::Transition: return TEXT("Custom");
		default:                         return TEXT("Unknown");
		}
	}
}

/**
 * The extension's RQL module (Unreal-MCP docs/rql.md "Extensions"): Landscape and Water are queried with rql-query
 * instead of dedicated tools. Reflection exposes the landscape, water-body and water-zone actors and their components;
 * the module adds world sources for them, the landscape section layout and paint layers and the water-body summary (not
 * reflected properties), and the agent guide rendered into the unreal-rql skill.
 *
 * The version is the .uplugin VersionName.
 */
class FUnrealAILandscapeRqlModule : public IUnrealMcpRqlModule
{
public:
	virtual FString GetRqlModuleName() const override { return TEXT("Landscape"); }
	virtual FString GetExtensionId() const override { return TEXT("com.ivanmurzak.unreal-ai-landscape"); }
	virtual FString GetExtensionVersion() const override { return UnrealMcpRql::PluginVersion(TEXT("UnrealAILandscape")); }

	virtual void ConfigureRql(FUnrealMcpRqlModuleContext& Context) override
	{
		using namespace UnrealAILandscapeRqlLocal;
		Context.AddObjectListSource(TEXT("landscapes"), TEXT("the Landscape actors and streaming proxies of the editor world"),
			ALandscapeProxy::StaticClass(), []() { return EditorActors<ALandscapeProxy>(); });
		Context.AddObjectListSource(TEXT("waterBodies"), TEXT("the Water body actors (river, lake, ocean, custom) of the editor world"),
			AWaterBody::StaticClass(), []() { return EditorActors<AWaterBody>(); });
		Context.AddObjectListSource(TEXT("waterZones"), TEXT("the Water zone actors of the editor world"),
			AWaterZone::StaticClass(), []() { return EditorActors<AWaterZone>(); });

		// The fields queries filter on are scalar members; `Sections` keeps the layout together for select output.
		Context.AddJsonMember(ALandscapeProxy::StaticClass(), TEXT("IsPrimary"), TEXT("true for the landscape actor, false for a streaming proxy"),
			[](UObject* Object) -> TSharedPtr<FJsonValue> { return MakeShared<FJsonValueBoolean>(Cast<ALandscape>(Object) != nullptr); });
		Context.AddJsonMember(ALandscapeProxy::StaticClass(), TEXT("ComponentCount"), TEXT("how many landscape components the actor has"),
			[](UObject* Object) -> TSharedPtr<FJsonValue>
			{
				const ALandscapeProxy* Proxy = Cast<ALandscapeProxy>(Object);
				return MakeShared<FJsonValueNumber>(Proxy ? Proxy->LandscapeComponents.Num() : 0);
			});
		Context.AddJsonMember(ALandscapeProxy::StaticClass(), TEXT("Sections"),
			TEXT("section layout: IsPrimary, ComponentCount, ComponentSizeQuads, SubsectionSizeQuads, NumSubsections"),
			[](UObject* Object) -> TSharedPtr<FJsonValue>
			{
				TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> Out = MakeShared<FJsonObject>();
				if (const ALandscapeProxy* Proxy = Cast<ALandscapeProxy>(Object))
				{
					Out->SetBoolField(TEXT("IsPrimary"), Cast<ALandscape>(Proxy) != nullptr);
					Out->SetNumberField(TEXT("ComponentCount"), Proxy->LandscapeComponents.Num());
					Out->SetNumberField(TEXT("ComponentSizeQuads"), Proxy->ComponentSizeQuads);
					Out->SetNumberField(TEXT("SubsectionSizeQuads"), Proxy->SubsectionSizeQuads);
					Out->SetNumberField(TEXT("NumSubsections"), Proxy->NumSubsections);
				}
				return MakeShared<FJsonValueObject>(Out);
			});
		Context.AddJsonMember(ALandscapeProxy::StaticClass(), TEXT("PaintLayers"), TEXT("the names of the landscape's paint layers"),
			[](UObject* Object) -> TSharedPtr<FJsonValue>
			{
				TArray<TSharedPtr<FJsonValue>> Layers;
				const ALandscapeProxy* Proxy = Cast<ALandscapeProxy>(Object);
				if (ULandscapeInfo* Info = Proxy ? Proxy->GetLandscapeInfo() : nullptr)
				{
					for (const FLandscapeInfoLayerSettings& Layer : Info->Layers)
						Layers.Add(MakeShared<FJsonValueString>(Layer.GetLayerName().ToString()));
				}
				return MakeShared<FJsonValueArray>(Layers);
			});
		Context.AddJsonMember(AWaterBody::StaticClass(), TEXT("WaterType"), TEXT("the water body type: River, Lake, Ocean or Custom"),
			[](UObject* Object) -> TSharedPtr<FJsonValue>
			{
				const AWaterBody* Body = Cast<AWaterBody>(Object);
				const UWaterBodyComponent* Component = Body ? Body->GetWaterBodyComponent() : nullptr;
				return MakeShared<FJsonValueString>(Component ? WaterBodyTypeName(Component->GetWaterBodyType()) : TEXT("Unknown"));
			});
		Context.AddJsonMember(AWaterBody::StaticClass(), TEXT("Water"),
			TEXT("water body summary: Type, SplinePoints"),
			[](UObject* Object) -> TSharedPtr<FJsonValue>
			{
				TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> Out = MakeShared<FJsonObject>();
				const AWaterBody* Body = Cast<AWaterBody>(Object);
				if (UWaterBodyComponent* Component = Body ? Body->GetWaterBodyComponent() : nullptr)
				{
					const UWaterSplineComponent* Spline = Component->GetWaterSpline();
					Out->SetStringField(TEXT("Type"), WaterBodyTypeName(Component->GetWaterBodyType()));
					Out->SetNumberField(TEXT("SplinePoints"), Spline ? Spline->GetNumberOfSplinePoints() : 0);
				}
				return MakeShared<FJsonValueObject>(Out);
			});
		Context.AddObjectMember(AWaterBody::StaticClass(), TEXT("WaterMaterial"), TEXT("the water body's water material"),
			UMaterialInterface::StaticClass(), [](UObject* Object) -> UObject*
			{
				const AWaterBody* Body = Cast<AWaterBody>(Object);
				const UWaterBodyComponent* Component = Body ? Body->GetWaterBodyComponent() : nullptr;
				return Component ? Component->GetWaterMaterial() : nullptr;
			});
		Context.AddObjectMember(AWaterBody::StaticClass(), TEXT("WaterZone"), TEXT("the water zone that renders the body"),
			AWaterZone::StaticClass(), [](UObject* Object) -> UObject*
			{
				const AWaterBody* Body = Cast<AWaterBody>(Object);
				const UWaterBodyComponent* Component = Body ? Body->GetWaterBodyComponent() : nullptr;
				return Component ? Component->GetWaterZone() : nullptr;
			});

		Context.AddGuide(TEXT("Landscape and Water"), TEXT(R"MD(Landscapes, water bodies and water zones are actors of the editor world: `landscapes`, `waterBodies`, `waterZones`
(the same actors as `actors | where $ is LandscapeProxy`). Their reflected properties are members (LandscapeMaterial,
the water body's components, the zone's ZoneExtent, ...); `IsPrimary`, `ComponentCount`, `PaintLayers`, `WaterType`,
`WaterMaterial` and `WaterZone` add what is not, `Sections` and `Water` summarise it.

```
landscapes | select $ref Label Sections PaintLayers LandscapeMaterial
waterBodies | where WaterType == "River" | select Label Water WaterZone Location
waterZones | select Label Location ZoneExtent
landscapes | where IsPrimary | set LandscapeMaterial = "/Game/Materials/M_Terrain"
```

Sculpting and painting are not RQL operations; edit landscape heights and layers in Landscape mode.)MD"));
	}
};

IMPLEMENT_MODULE(TUnrealMcpRqlEditorModule<FUnrealAILandscapeRqlModule>, UnrealAILandscape)

```

`extensions/UnrealAILandscape/Source/UnrealAILandscape/UnrealAILandscape.Build.cs`:

```cs
// Copyright (c) 2026 IvanMurzak/Unreal-AI-Landscape. Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.
// See the LICENSE file in the repository root for more information.

using UnrealBuildTool;

public class UnrealAILandscape : ModuleRules
{
	public UnrealAILandscape(ReadOnlyTargetRules Target) : base(Target)
	{
		PCHUsage = ModuleRules.PCHUsageMode.UseExplicitOrSharedPCHs;

		PublicDependencyModuleNames.AddRange(new string[]
		{
			"Core",
		});

		PrivateDependencyModuleNames.AddRange(new string[]
		{
			"CoreUObject",
			"Engine",
			// FJsonValue: the Sections / PaintLayers / Water members.
			"Json",
			// The RQL module seam: IUnrealMcpRqlModule.h (sources, operations, members, guides, the editor-module template)
			// and UnrealMcpRqlTools.h (the specs run plans) live in the Unreal-MCP plugin's UnrealMcpRql module; the
			// matching `UnrealMCP` plugin dependency is in the .uplugin "Plugins" array.
			"UnrealMcpRql",

			// The gating engine plugin's runtime module (its { "Name": "Water" } entry is in the .uplugin "Plugins"
			// array): AWaterBody / AWaterZone for the waterBodies / waterZones sources and the Water members.
			"Water",
			// A built-in engine module (no .uplugin entry): ALandscapeProxy / ULandscapeInfo for the landscapes source
			// and the Sections / PaintLayers members.
			"Landscape",
		});
	}
}

`extensions/UnrealAILandscape/Tests/e2e/tools/landscape-landscapes-query.e2e.ps1`:

```ps1
# E2E check of the extension's RQL module (Unreal-MCP docs/rql.md). Returned to scripts/run-extension-e2e.ps1, which
# invokes `unreal-mcp-cli run-tool rql-query` against the running project's MCP server and asserts a well-formed success.
@{
    Tool   = "rql-query"
    System = $false
    Input  = '{"query":"landscapes | count"}'
    Assert = {
        param($Result)
        $serialized = $Result | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 20 -Compress
        if ($serialized -notmatch '"text"\s*:\s*"\d+"|value\\?"\s*:\s*\d') {
            throw "expected the count of landscapes; got: $serialized"
        }
    }
}

`extensions/UnrealAINiagara/README.md`:

```md
# Niagara RQL module

RQL module for Unreal's Niagara VFX system: query Niagara systems and their emitters, place systems in the level.

An optional editor plugin in the [Unreal MCP monorepository](../../README.md), with its own module, version and release archive.

## Requirements

- Unreal Engine 5.7 or later (the shared extension suite verifies UE 5.7 and 5.8).
- Unreal MCP 1.0.0 or later (the RQL data layer), installed in the same project.
- Engine plugins: `Niagara`. The installer enables these dependencies.
- A C++ toolchain for your Unreal Engine installation. Extension releases contain source files and must be compiled for your project and engine.

## Install

With the Unreal Editor closed:

```sh
npm install -g unreal-mcp-cli
unreal-mcp-cli install-plugin "<UEProject>"
unreal-mcp-cli install-extension com.ivanmurzak.unreal-ai-niagara "<UEProject>"
```

Replace `<UEProject>` with the project directory. The installer selects this extension's latest indexed version independently of the core and other extensions. Use `--version X.Y.Z` to select a published historical version, or `--build` to compile after installation. Otherwise rebuild the project before opening the editor.

The plugin is installed under `Plugins/UnrealAINiagara/`. Connect Unreal MCP to your AI client to use the RQL module below.

## RQL module

The extension adds its feature to the editor's RQL data layer (`rql-query` / `rql-mutate` / `rql-schema`, [docs/rql.md](../../docs/rql.md)) instead of separate tools; its guide is part of the `unreal-rql` skill.

| Kind | Names |
| --- | --- |
| Sources | `niagaraSystems`, `niagara` |
| Operations (`call`) | `SpawnSystem` |
| Members | `NiagaraSystem.Emitters` |

```
niagaraSystems | select $ref Name Emitters
niagara | call SpawnSystem("/Game/VFX/NS_Fire", "(0, 0, 100)", "Campfire")
actors | get Components | where $ is NiagaraComponent | set Asset = "/Game/VFX/NS_Smoke"
```

## Releases and development

Each extension has its own versioned source ZIP in [Unreal MCP Releases](https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Unreal-MCP/releases). The shared release index records the latest version, historical releases and archive checksums; unchanged extensions are not copied into other component releases.

See the [monorepository and test guide](../../docs/EXTENSION-MONOREPO.md) for independent publication, isolated compilation and the combined one-editor test suite. See [extension development](../../docs/EXTENSIONS.md) for the RQL module API.

Licensed under [Apache License 2.0](LICENSE).

`extensions/UnrealAINiagara/Source/UnrealAINiagara/Private/Tests/UnrealAINiagaraSpec.cpp`:

```cpp
// Copyright (c) 2026 IvanMurzak/Unreal-AI-Niagara. Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.
// See the LICENSE file in the repository root for more information.

#if WITH_DEV_AUTOMATION_TESTS

#include "CoreMinimal.h"
#include "Misc/AutomationTest.h"
#include "Dom/JsonObject.h"

#include "IUnrealMcpRqlModule.h"
#include "UnrealMcpRqlTools.h"

// ============================================================================================
//  UE Automation spec for the extension's RQL module (Unreal-MCP docs/rql.md "Extensions").
//
//  The spec discovers THIS extension's live module through IModularFeatures (the path Unreal-MCP uses) and runs RQL
//  QueryPlans through the editor's RQL engine (UnrealMcpRqlTools::RunPlan). The C++ runtime has no text parser, so
//  each plan is the one Rql.Parser produces for the query in the comment above it.
//
//  Run via:  Automation RunTests UnrealAINiagara
// ============================================================================================

BEGIN_DEFINE_SPEC(FUnrealAINiagaraSpec, "UnrealAINiagara",
	EAutomationTestFlags::EditorContext | EAutomationTestFlags::ProductFilter)
END_DEFINE_SPEC(FUnrealAINiagaraSpec)

void FUnrealAINiagaraSpec::Define()
{
	Describe("RQL module", [this]()
	{
		It("registers this extension's RQL module as a modular feature", [this]()
		{
			IUnrealMcpRqlModule* Module = UnrealMcpRqlTools::FindModule(TEXT("com.ivanmurzak.unreal-ai-niagara"));
			if (TestNotNull(TEXT("RQL module is registered"), Module))
			{
				TestEqual(TEXT("module name"), Module->GetRqlModuleName(), FString(TEXT("Niagara")));
				TestFalse(TEXT("version reported"), Module->GetExtensionVersion().IsEmpty());
			}
		});

		It("adds its sources and guide to the unreal-rql skill", [this]()
		{
			const FString Skill = UnrealMcpRqlTools::SkillMarkdown();
			TestTrue(TEXT("niagaraSystems source"), Skill.Contains(TEXT("| `niagaraSystems` |")));
			TestTrue(TEXT("niagara operations source"), Skill.Contains(TEXT("| `niagara` |")));
			TestTrue(TEXT("guide section"), Skill.Contains(TEXT("## Niagara")));
		});
	});

	Describe("source: niagaraSystems", [this]()
	{
		It("answers a query (count of the project's Niagara systems)", [this]()
		{
			// niagaraSystems | count
			TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> Result;
			const bool bResultOk = UnrealMcpRqlTools::RunPlan(TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"path":["niagaraSystems"]},"stages":[{"op":"count"}]})RQL"), false, &Result);
			TestTrue(TEXT("query ok"), bResultOk);
			TestTrue(TEXT("a count"), Result.IsValid() && Result->HasField(TEXT("value")));
		});

		It("describes NiagaraSystem with its Emitters member", [this]()
		{
			bool bOk = false;
			const FString Schema = UnrealMcpRqlTools::Schema(TEXT("NiagaraSystem"), bOk);
			TestTrue(TEXT("schema ok"), bOk);
			TestTrue(TEXT("Emitters member"), Schema.Contains(TEXT("\"name\":\"Emitters\"")));
		});
	});

	Describe("operation: SpawnSystem", [this]()
	{
		It("fails defensively on a missing system and places nothing", [this]()
		{
			// niagara | call SpawnSystem("/Game/RqlSpecNoSuchSystem", "(0, 0, 0)", "RqlSpecFx")
			TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> Result;
			const bool bResultOk = UnrealMcpRqlTools::RunPlan(TEXT(R"RQL({"rql":"0.1","source":{"path":["niagara"]},"stages":[{"op":"call","method":"SpawnSystem","args":[{"lit":"/Game/RqlSpecNoSuchSystem"},{"lit":"(0, 0, 0)"},{"lit":"RqlSpecFx"}]}]})RQL"), true, &Result);
			TestTrue(TEXT("a well-formed result"), Result.IsValid());
			TestFalse(TEXT("reported as a failure"), bResultOk);
		});

		It("is listed as an operation of the niagara source", [this]()
		{
			bool bOk = false;
			const FString Schema = UnrealMcpRqlTools::Schema(TEXT("NiagaraOperations"), bOk);
			TestTrue(TEXT("schema ok"), bOk);
			TestTrue(TEXT("SpawnSystem listed"), Schema.Contains(TEXT("SpawnSystem(")));
		});
	});
}

#endif // WITH_DEV_AUTOMATION_TESTS

`extensions/UnrealAINiagara/Source/UnrealAINiagara/Private/UnrealAINiagaraModule.cpp`:

```cpp
// Copyright (c) 2026 IvanMurzak/Unreal-AI-Niagara. Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.
// See the LICENSE file in the repository root for more information.

#include "Modules/ModuleManager.h"
#include "Dom/JsonObject.h"
#include "Dom/JsonValue.h"

#include "IUnrealMcpRqlModule.h"
#include "UnrealAINiagaraRqlApi.h"

#include "NiagaraEmitterHandle.h"
#include "NiagaraSystem.h"

/**
 * The extension's RQL module (Unreal-MCP docs/rql.md "Extensions"): Niagara is queried and changed with rql-query /
 * rql-mutate instead of dedicated tools. Reflection already exposes every Niagara type (UNiagaraSystem,
 * UNiagaraComponent, ...); the module adds the `niagaraSystems` asset source, the `niagara` operations, the systems'
 * emitters (not a reflected property) and the agent guide rendered into the unreal-rql skill.
 *
 * The version is the .uplugin VersionName.
 */
class FUnrealAINiagaraRqlModule : public IUnrealMcpRqlModule
{
public:
	virtual FString GetRqlModuleName() const override { return TEXT("Niagara"); }
	virtual FString GetExtensionId() const override { return TEXT("com.ivanmurzak.unreal-ai-niagara"); }
	virtual FString GetExtensionVersion() const override { return UnrealMcpRql::PluginVersion(TEXT("UnrealAINiagara")); }

	virtual void ConfigureRql(FUnrealMcpRqlModuleContext& Context) override
	{
		Context.AddAssetSource(TEXT("niagaraSystems"), TEXT("Niagara system assets (NiagaraSystem) of the project, at most 200"),
			UNiagaraSystem::StaticClass());
		Context.AddApiSource(TEXT("niagara"), TEXT("Niagara operations: call SpawnSystem(system, location, label, autoActivate)"),
			UUnrealAINiagaraRqlApi::StaticClass(), TEXT("NiagaraOperations"));
		Context.AddJsonMember(UNiagaraSystem::StaticClass(), TEXT("Emitters"), TEXT("the system's emitters: Name, Enabled"),
			[](UObject* Object) -> TSharedPtr<FJsonValue>
			{
				TArray<TSharedPtr<FJsonValue>> Emitters;
				if (const UNiagaraSystem* System = Cast<UNiagaraSystem>(Object))
				{
					for (const FNiagaraEmitterHandle& Handle : System->GetEmitterHandles())
					{
						TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> Entry = MakeShared<FJsonObject>();
						Entry->SetStringField(TEXT("Name"), Handle.GetName().ToString());
						Entry->SetBoolField(TEXT("Enabled"), Handle.GetIsEnabled());
						Emitters.Add(MakeShared<FJsonValueObject>(Entry));
					}
				}
				return MakeShared<FJsonValueArray>(Emitters);
			});
		Context.AddGuide(TEXT("Niagara"), TEXT(R"MD(Niagara systems are assets: `niagaraSystems` (or `unreal.assets("NiagaraSystem", "/Game/VFX")`). Placed effects
are NiagaraComponents (a Niagara actor's component, or any actor's): `actors | get Components | where $ is NiagaraComponent`.

```
niagaraSystems | where Name contains "Fire" | select $ref Name Path Emitters
niagara | call SpawnSystem("/Game/VFX/NS_Fire", "(0, 0, 100)", "Campfire")        a Niagara actor in the current level; returns it
actors | get Components | where $ is NiagaraComponent | select Owner.Label Asset bAutoActivate
actors | where Label == "Campfire" | get Components | where $ is NiagaraComponent | set Asset = "/Game/VFX/NS_Smoke"
```

`Emitters` lists each emitter's Name and Enabled flag. Spawning is undoable; the level is marked unsaved.)MD"));
	}
};

IMPLEMENT_MODULE(TUnrealMcpRqlEditorModule<FUnrealAINiagaraRqlModule>, UnrealAINiagara)

```

`extensions/UnrealAINiagara/Source/UnrealAINiagara/Private/UnrealAINiagaraRqlApi.cpp`:

```cpp
// Copyright (c) 2026 IvanMurzak/Unreal-AI-Niagara. Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.
// See the LICENSE file in the repository root for more information.

#include "UnrealAINiagaraRqlApi.h"

#include "IUnrealMcpRqlModule.h"

#include "Engine/World.h"
#include "NiagaraActor.h"
#include "NiagaraComponent.h"
#include "NiagaraSystem.h"

AActor* UUnrealAINiagaraRqlApi::SpawnSystem(UNiagaraSystem* System, FVector Location, const FString& Label, bool bAutoActivate)
{
	// The core spawn (current level, transactional, labelled): Ctrl+Z removes it with the rest of the mutation.
	AActor* Actor = UnrealMcpRql::SpawnActor(ANiagaraActor::StaticClass(), Location, FRotator::ZeroRotator, Label);
	if (!Actor)
		return nullptr;
	UNiagaraComponent* Component = Actor->FindComponentByClass<UNiagaraComponent>();
	if (!Component)
	{
		Actor->GetWorld()->EditorDestroyActor(Actor, /*bShouldModifyLevel*/ true);
		return UnrealMcpRql::Failed<AActor*>(FString::Printf(TEXT("could not place %s"), *System->GetName()));
	}
	Component->SetAutoActivate(bAutoActivate);
	Component->SetAsset(System);
	return Actor;
}

`extensions/UnrealAINiagara/Source/UnrealAINiagara/Private/UnrealAINiagaraRqlApi.h`:

```h
// Copyright (c) 2026 IvanMurzak/Unreal-AI-Niagara. Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.
// See the LICENSE file in the repository root for more information.

#pragma once

#include "CoreMinimal.h"
#include "UObject/Object.h"

#include "UnrealAINiagaraRqlApi.generated.h"

class AActor;
class UNiagaraSystem;

/**
 * The `niagara` RQL source (type "NiagaraOperations"): Niagara operations without an owner object, e.g.
 * `niagara | call SpawnSystem("/Game/VFX/NS_Fire", "(0, 0, 100)", "Campfire")`. Every UFUNCTION here is callable from
 * rql-mutate (Unreal-MCP's IUnrealMcpRqlModule::AddApiClass); the doc comment is the description agents see.
 * BlueprintCallable only so UHT records the C++ default arguments; BlueprintInternalUseOnly keeps them out of menus.
 */
UCLASS(Transient)
class UUnrealAINiagaraRqlApi : public UObject
{
	GENERATED_BODY()

public:
	/** place a Niagara system in the current level as a Niagara actor at Location (Label optional, undoable); returns the actor */
	UFUNCTION(BlueprintCallable, Category = "Unreal AI|Niagara", meta = (BlueprintInternalUseOnly = "true"))
	AActor* SpawnSystem(UNiagaraSystem* System, FVector Location = FVector::ZeroVector, const FString& Label = TEXT(""),
		bool bAutoActivate = true);
};

```cs
// Copyright (c) 2026 IvanMurzak/Unreal-AI-Niagara. Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.
// See the LICENSE file in the repository root for more information.

using UnrealBuildTool;

public class UnrealAINiagara : ModuleRules
{
	public UnrealAINiagara(ReadOnlyTargetRules Target) : base(Target)
	{
		PCHUsage = ModuleRules.PCHUsageMode.UseExplicitOrSharedPCHs;

		PublicDependencyModuleNames.AddRange(new string[]
		{
			"Core",
		});

		PrivateDependencyModuleNames.AddRange(new string[]
		{
			"CoreUObject",
			"Engine",
			// FJsonValue: the Emitters member.
			"Json",
			// The RQL module seam: IUnrealMcpRqlModule.h (sources, operations, members, guides, the editor-module template)
			// and UnrealMcpRqlTools.h (the specs run plans) live in the Unreal-MCP plugin's UnrealMcpRql module; the
			// matching `UnrealMCP` plugin dependency is in the .uplugin "Plugins" array.
			"UnrealMcpRql",

			// The gating engine plugin's runtime module (its { "Name": "Niagara" } entry is in the .uplugin "Plugins"
			// array): UNiagaraSystem for the niagaraSystems source and Emitters, ANiagaraActor for SpawnSystem.
			"Niagara",
		});
	}
}

`extensions/UnrealAINiagara/Tests/e2e/tools/niagara-operations-schema.e2e.ps1`:

```ps1
# E2E check of the extension's RQL module (Unreal-MCP docs/rql.md). Returned to scripts/run-extension-e2e.ps1, which
# invokes `unreal-mcp-cli run-tool rql-schema` against the running project's MCP server and asserts a well-formed success.
@{
    Tool   = "rql-schema"
    System = $false
    Input  = '{"type":"NiagaraOperations"}'
    Assert = {
        param($Result)
        $serialized = $Result | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 20 -Compress
        if ($serialized -notmatch 'SpawnSystem') {
            throw "expected SpawnSystem among the operations; got: $serialized"
        }
    }
}

`extensions/UnrealAINiagara/Tests/e2e/tools/niagara-systems-query.e2e.ps1`:

```ps1
# E2E check of the extension's RQL module (Unreal-MCP docs/rql.md). Returned to scripts/run-extension-e2e.ps1, which
# invokes `unreal-mcp-cli run-tool rql-query` against the running project's MCP server and asserts a well-formed success.
@{
    Tool   = "rql-query"
    System = $false
    Input  = '{"query":"niagaraSystems | count"}'
    Assert = {
        param($Result)
        $serialized = $Result | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 20 -Compress
        if ($serialized -notmatch '"text"\s*:\s*"\d+"|value\\?"\s*:\s*\d') {
            throw "expected the count of Niagara systems; got: $serialized"
        }
    }
}

`extensions/UnrealAIPCG/README.md`:

```md
# PCG RQL module

RQL module for Unreal's Procedural Content Generation (PCG) framework: query graphs and PCG components, add components and run generation.

An optional editor plugin in the [Unreal MCP monorepository](../../README.md), with its own module, version and release archive.

## Requirements

- Unreal Engine 5.7 or later (the shared extension suite verifies UE 5.7 and 5.8).
- Unreal MCP 1.0.0 or later (the RQL data layer), installed in the same project.
- Engine plugins: `PCG`. The installer enables these dependencies.
- A C++ toolchain for your Unreal Engine installation. Extension releases contain source files and must be compiled for your project and engine.

## Install

With the Unreal Editor closed:

```sh
npm install -g unreal-mcp-cli
unreal-mcp-cli install-plugin "<UEProject>"
unreal-mcp-cli install-extension com.ivanmurzak.unreal-ai-pcg "<UEProject>"
```

Replace `<UEProject>` with the project directory. The installer selects this extension's latest indexed version independently of the core and other extensions. Use `--version X.Y.Z` to select a published historical version, or `--build` to compile after installation. Otherwise rebuild the project before opening the editor.

The plugin is installed under `Plugins/UnrealAIPCG/`. Connect Unreal MCP to your AI client to use the RQL module below.

## RQL module

The extension adds its feature to the editor's RQL data layer (`rql-query` / `rql-mutate` / `rql-schema`, [docs/rql.md](../../docs/rql.md)) instead of separate tools; its guide is part of the `unreal-rql` skill.

| Kind | Names |
| --- | --- |
| Sources | `pcgGraphs`, `pcg` |
| Operations (`call`) | `AddComponent`, `Generate` |
| Members | `PCGGraph.Nodes`, `PCGComponent.BoundGraph`, `PCGComponent.IsGenerating` |

```
pcgGraphs | select Name Nodes
pcg | call AddComponent("Forest", "/Game/PCG/PCG_Trees")
pcg | call Generate("Forest")
```

## Releases and development

Each extension has its own versioned source ZIP in [Unreal MCP Releases](https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Unreal-MCP/releases). The shared release index records the latest version, historical releases and archive checksums; unchanged extensions are not copied into other component releases.

See the [monorepository and test guide](../../docs/EXTENSION-MONOREPO.md) for independent publication, isolated compilation and the combined one-editor test suite. See [extension development](../../docs/EXTENSIONS.md) for the RQL module API.

#if WITH_DEV_AUTOMATION_TESTS

#include "CoreMinimal.h"
#include "Misc/AutomationTest.h"
#include "Dom/JsonObject.h"

#include "IUnrealMcpRqlModule.h"
